```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed class LocalizationService : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public static LocalizationService Current { get; } = new();
    public string Language => "zh-CN";
    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
    public event EventHandler? LanguageChanged;
    public string this[string key] => Get(key);

    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> PageNames = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
    {
        ["设备墙 / 主控"] = "设备", ["实时监控"] = "监控", ["节点"] = "界面检查", ["截图 / 取色"] = "截屏",
        ["Shell"] = "终端", ["应用"] = "应用", ["文件"] = "文件", ["文本"] = "文本",
        ["脚本"] = "自动化", ["API"] = "接口", ["扩展"] = "工具", ["设置"] = "设置"
    };

    public static string PageDisplayName(string tag) => PageNames.TryGetValue(tag, out var name) ? name : throw new ArgumentException("未知页面：" + tag, nameof(tag));

    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Chinese = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
    {
        ["Shell"] = PageDisplayName("Shell"), ["API"] = PageDisplayName("API"), ["Home"] = "主页", ["serial"] = "设备序列号",
        ["Ready"] = "就绪", ["Offline"] = "离线", ["Unauthorized"] = "等待授权", ["Discovered"] = "已发现", ["Error"] = "异常",
        ["Idle"] = "未运行", ["Running"] = "运行中", ["Cancelling"] = "正在停止", ["Completed"] = "已完成", ["Cancelled"] = "已停止",
        ["Failed"] = "失败", ["TimedOut"] = "超时", ["Lost"] = "结果待核对", ["HEX"] = "十六进制色值", ["RGB"] = "三色值",
        ["普通 API"] = "普通接口", ["Automator API"] = "自动化接口", ["当前设备 API"] = "当前设备接口", ["普通 API 地址"] = "普通接口地址",
        ["普通 API 端口"] = "普通接口端口", ["Automator 端口"] = "自动化接口端口", ["授权 Agent 地址"] = "自动化服务地址",
        ["Agent 设备 serial"] = "自动化服务设备序列号", ["语言 / 区域"] = "界面语言", ["%"] = "进度（%）",
        ["English"] = "简体中文", ["Demo Devices"] = "演示设备"
    };

    public string Get(string key) => Chinese.TryGetValue(key, out var translated) ? translated : key;
    public void SetLanguage(string value)
    {
        var culture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("zh-CN");
        CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = culture;
        CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = culture;
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(Language)));
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
        LanguageChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    public static void Bind(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty property, string key) =>
        BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, property, new Binding($"[{key}]") { Source = Current, Mode = BindingMode.OneWay });
}

public sealed class CaptionChoiceConverter : IMultiValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
    {
        var key = values.Length == 0 ? "" : values[0]?.ToString() ?? "";
        return LocalizationService.Current.Get(key);
    }
    public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}

public sealed class SubsystemCaptionConverter(string label) : IMultiValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) =>
        LocalizationService.Current.Get(label) + "：" + LocalizationService.Current.Get(values.Length > 0 && values[0] is string value ? value : "未选择");
    public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}

public sealed class StateCaptionConverter : IMultiValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => LocalizationService.Current.Get(values.Length > 0 ? values[0]?.ToString() ?? "" : "");
    public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}
```

```csharp
    private static void TextColumn(DataGrid grid, string header, string path, double width, bool readOnly = true)

        {

            stateBinding.Bindings.Add(new Binding(path)); stateBinding.Bindings.Add(new Binding(nameof(LocalizationService.Language)) { Source = LocalizationService.Current });
            binding = stateBinding;

        grid.Columns.Add(column);

    private async Task CaptureTickAsync()
    {
        if (captureInProgress || closing || ldBusy || ViewModel.HasActiveOperations || directoryOperation is { IsCompleted: false }
            || !Equals((tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag, "设备墙 / 主控") || !IsActive
            || wallMainPanel.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || ViewModel.MainDevice is not { Info.Online: true } main) return;
        var targets = new[] { main.Serial };
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(directoryCancellation.Token); deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20));
        captureInProgress = true;
        try
        {
            mainCaptureDispatchCount++; lastMainCaptureTargets = targets.ToArray();
            async Task Capture()
            {
                if (ViewModel.Demo && demoMainCaptureBarrier is { } barrier) await barrier();
                await ViewModel.RefreshAutomaticScreensAsync(targets, deadline.Token);
            }
            captureOperation = Capture(); await captureOperation;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        finally { captureInProgress = false; }
    }

    private bool NeedsDebugAutoLoad() => !(ViewModel.Demo && !(DebugAutomaticFixturePermitted || ReconnectLoadingFixturePermitted)) && !closing && !closeApproved && IsLoaded
        && Equals((tabs?.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag, "节点") && ViewModel.CurrentDevice?.Info.Online == true && ViewModel.Nodes.Count == 0;

    private Task EnsureDebugLoadedAsync()
    {
        if (!NeedsDebugAutoLoad()) { debugAutoPending = false; return Task.CompletedTask; }
        debugAutoPending = true;
        return QueueDebugAutoLoadAsync();
    }

    private Task QueueDebugAutoLoadAsync()
    {
        if (!NeedsDebugAutoLoad()) { debugAutoPending = false; return Task.CompletedTask; }
        if (!debugAutoPending || debugAutoLoading || debugAutoQueued || ViewModel.HasActiveOperations) return debugAutoOperation;
        return debugAutoOperation = RunDebugAutoLoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task RunDebugAutoLoadAsync()
    {
        debugAutoQueued = true;
        try
        {
            await System.Windows.Threading.Dispatcher.Yield(System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Background);
            debugAutoQueued = false;
            if (!NeedsDebugAutoLoad()) { debugAutoPending = false; return; }
            if (!debugAutoPending || ViewModel.HasActiveOperations) return;
            debugAutoPending = false;
            debugAutoLoading = true;
            await ViewModel.LoadNodesAsync();
        }
        finally
        {
            debugAutoQueued = false;
            debugAutoLoading = false;
            if (debugAutoPending) _ = QueueDebugAutoLoadAsync();
        }
    }

    private (double Width, double Height) SettingsWindowSize()
    {
        var bounds = WindowState == WindowState.Normal ? new Size(ActualWidth, ActualHeight) : RestoreBounds.Size;
        return (double.IsFinite(bounds.Width) && bounds.Width > 0 ? bounds.Width : Width, double.IsFinite(bounds.Height) && bounds.Height > 0 ? bounds.Height : Height);
    }

    private async void WindowClosing(object? sender, CancelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (closeApproved) return;
        e.Cancel = true;
        if (closing) return;
        if (ldBusy || ViewModel.Busy) { MessageBox.Show(this, "当前操作尚未结束，请等待操作完成后退出。", "操作进行中", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information); return; }
        if (ViewModel.HasActiveOperations && !ViewModel.Confirm("退出矩阵设备", "仍有脚本或文件传输正在运行。停止这些任务并退出？\n设备与模拟器将保持运行。")) return;
        closing = true;
        debugAutoPending = false;
        directoryCancellation.Cancel();
        directoryTimer.Stop(); captureTimer.Stop();
        await StopMonitorAsync();
        if (directoryOperation is not null) { try { await directoryOperation; } catch (OperationCanceledException) { } }
        if (captureOperation is not null) { try { await captureOperation; } catch (OperationCanceledException) { } }
        try
        {
            scanCancellation?.Cancel();
            if (scanOperation is not null) { try { await scanOperation; } catch (OperationCanceledException) { } }
            foreach (var host in nativeHosts.ToList()) host.Restore();
            if (ldWindowVisibility is not null) await ldWindowVisibility.RestoreAllAsync();
            var saved = ViewModel.Runtime.Settings with { WindowWidth = WindowState == WindowState.Normal ? ActualWidth : RestoreBounds.Width, WindowHeight = WindowState == WindowState.Normal ? ActualHeight : RestoreBounds.Height, WallColumns = ViewModel.WallColumns, SyncMouse = ViewModel.SyncMouse, SyncKeyboard = ViewModel.SyncKeyboard };
            ViewModel.Runtime.Settings = ViewModel.Runtime.SettingsStore.Save(saved);
            await ViewModel.ShutdownAsync();
            LocalizationService.Current.LanguageChanged -= OnLanguageChanged;
            foreach (var session in screenProcesses.Values) { if (session.IsCurrentProcess()) { session.Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); await session.Process.WaitForExitAsync(); } session.Process.Dispose(); }
            closeApproved = true; Close();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { closing = false; MessageBox.Show(this, "退出未完成：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex) + "\n投屏恢复记录已保留。", "退出失败", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error); }
    }

    internal void AbortStartup()
    {
        closing = closeApproved = true;
        debugAutoPending = false;
        captureTimer?.Stop();
        directoryTimer?.Stop(); directoryCancellation.Cancel();
        monitorTimer.Stop();
        scanCancellation?.Cancel();
        Close();
    }

    private void ShowText(string title, string text)

    }

    public async Task RunSmokeAsync(string? screenshotPath = null)
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("启动验收仅允许显式演示模式");
        await VerifyResponsiveApplicationsAsync();
        await VerifyApplicationApiPendingAsync();
        await VerifyApplicationPendingAsync();
        await VerifyReconnectedDebugLoadingAsync();
        await VerifyCompletedDebugCacheAsync();
        await VerifyResponsiveScreenshotAsync();
        await VerifyResponsiveDebugAsync();
        await VerifyDebugAutomaticLoadingAsync();
        await DebugPublicationSmoke.VerifyAsync(System.IO.Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "artifacts", "desktop-smoke"));
        if (tabs.SelectedIndex != 0 || wallViewMode != "list") throw new InvalidOperationException("初始页面必须是统一设备列表。");
        await VerifyDeviceActionLabelsAsync();
        await VerifyAppleAppearanceAsync(screenshotPath);
        await VerifyListConsoleSimplificationAsync();
        if (screenshotPath is not null)
        {
            if (!System.IO.Path.IsPathFullyQualified(screenshotPath)) throw new InvalidOperationException("截图输出必须为绝对路径");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(screenshotPath)!);
        }
        await ViewModel.RefreshWallAsync();
        await VerifyNativeMainTargetAsync();
        if (ViewModel.CurrentDevice is { } row) await ViewModel.SetMainAsync(row);
        await VerifyDeviceFilterIsolationAsync();
        await VerifyShellSimplificationAsync();
        await ViewModel.LoadNodesAsync();
        ViewModel.SelectedNode = ViewModel.FlattenNodes().FirstOrDefault(node => node.Source.Clickable);
        await ViewModel.CaptureAsync();
        if (ViewModel.Nodes.Count != 0 || ViewModel.SelectedNode is not null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("单独刷新截图后仍保留旧节点覆盖框与选中节点");
        if (nodeTree.Items.Count != 0 || nodeRectangles.Count != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("旧节点视觉覆盖未清空");
        await ViewModel.LoadNodesAsync();
        ViewModel.SelectedNode = ViewModel.FlattenNodes().FirstOrDefault(node => node.Source.Clickable);
        await ViewModel.RefreshWallAsync();
        if (ViewModel.Nodes.Count != 0 || ViewModel.SelectedNode is not null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("设备墙刷新截图后仍保留旧节点");
        await ViewModel.LoadNodesAsync();
        ViewModel.SelectedNode = ViewModel.FlattenNodes().FirstOrDefault(node => node.Source.Clickable);
        await ViewModel.LoadAppsAsync();
        await VerifyOperationGatesAsync();
        await VerifyOneClickProjectionAsync();
        await VerifyCanonicalDeviceActionsAsync(screenshotPath);
        await VerifyApplicationIdentityAsync();
        await VerifyApplicationManagementAsync(screenshotPath);
        await VerifyLaunchMemoryUiAsync();
        await LdWindowVisibilitySmoke.VerifyAsync(System.IO.Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "window-visibility-smoke"));
        ViewModel.SamplePixel(10, 10);
        ViewModel.ShellInput = "wm size"; await ViewModel.ExecuteShellAsync();
        var acceptanceDirectory = ViewModel.DataDirectory;

        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(path, report);
        if (screenshotPath is not null) await File.WriteAllTextAsync(System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(screenshotPath, ".json"), report);
    }

    private void SaveRender(string path)
    {
        foreach (var label in new[] { "WorkspaceSettings", "DeviceDetails" })
        {
            var control = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.Name == label);
            var position = control.TranslatePoint(new Point(), Shell);
            if (position.X < 0 || position.Y < 0 || position.X + control.ActualWidth > Shell.ActualWidth + 1 || position.Y + control.ActualHeight > Shell.ActualHeight + 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("截图前全局工具栏超出客户区：" + label);
        }
        SaveRender(path, Shell);
    }
    private static void SaveRender(string path, FrameworkElement surface)
    {
        var bitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(surface.ActualWidth)), Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(surface.ActualHeight)), 96, 96, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
        bitmap.Render(surface);
        var encoder = new PngBitmapEncoder(); encoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(bitmap)); using var file = File.Create(path); encoder.Save(file);
    }
    private static IEnumerable<T> VisualDescendants<T>(DependencyObject source) where T : DependencyObject
    {
        if (source is T match) yield return match;
        for (var index = 0; index < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(source); index++)
            foreach (var nested in VisualDescendants<T>(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(source, index))) yield return nested;
    }
}

public sealed class NonEmptyVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value as string) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, System.Globalization.CultureInfo culture) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}

public sealed class DispatcherTimerAdapter
{
    private readonly System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer timer;
    public DispatcherTimerAdapter(TimeSpan interval, Func<Task> tick)
    {
        timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer { Interval = interval };
        timer.Tick += async (_, _) => await tick();
    }
    public void Start() => timer.Start();
    public void Stop() => timer.Stop();
}
```

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed class MotionPreferences : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public static MotionPreferences Current { get; } = new();
    private bool? fixturePreference;
    public bool AnimationsEnabled => fixturePreference ?? SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation;
    public PopupAnimation PopupAnimation => AnimationsEnabled ? PopupAnimation.Fade : PopupAnimation.None;
    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

    private MotionPreferences()
    {
        SystemParameters.StaticPropertyChanged += (_, args) =>
        {
            if (args.PropertyName != nameof(SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation)) return;
            if (Application.Current?.Dispatcher is { } dispatcher && !dispatcher.CheckAccess()) dispatcher.BeginInvoke(Notify);
            else Notify();
        };
    }

    internal void SetFixturePreference(bool? enabled)
    {
        fixturePreference = enabled;
        Notify();
    }

    private void Notify()
    {
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(AnimationsEnabled)));
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(nameof(PopupAnimation)));
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed class NativeWindowHost : HwndHost
{
    private const int GwlStyle = -16;
    private const int GwlExStyle = -20;
    private const long WsChild = 0x40000000;
    private const long WsPopup = 0x80000000;
    private const long WsCaption = 0x00C00000;
    private const long WsThickFrame = 0x00040000;
    private readonly Process ownedProcess;
    private readonly string journalPath;
    private WindowRecoveryRecord? record;
    private IntPtr container;
    public int ProcessId => ownedProcess.Id;
    public bool IsAttached { get; private set; }

    public NativeWindowHost(Process ownedProcess, string journalDirectory)
    {
        this.ownedProcess = ownedProcess;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(journalDirectory);
        journalPath = Path.Combine(journalDirectory, $"{ownedProcess.Id}-{ownedProcess.MainWindowHandle.ToInt64()}.json");
    }

    protected override HandleRef BuildWindowCore(HandleRef hwndParent)
    {
        ownedProcess.Refresh();
        var window = ownedProcess.MainWindowHandle;
        ValidateOwner(window, ownedProcess.Id, ownedProcess.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks, ownedProcess.MainModule?.FileName ?? "");
        if (!GetWindowRect(window, out var bounds)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "无法读取投屏窗口位置");
        record = new WindowRecoveryRecord(window.ToInt64(), ownedProcess.Id, ownedProcess.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks, ownedProcess.MainModule?.FileName ?? "", GetParent(window).ToInt64(), GetWindowLongPtr(window, GwlStyle).ToInt64(), GetWindowLongPtr(window, GwlExStyle).ToInt64(), bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Right - bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom - bounds.Top, IsWindowVisible(window));
        var temporary = journalPath + ".tmp";
        File.WriteAllText(temporary, JsonSerializer.Serialize(record, JsonDefaults.Options));
        File.Move(temporary, journalPath, true);
        container = CreateWindowEx(0, "STATIC", "MatrixDevice.Host", WsChild, 0, 0, 1, 1, hwndParent.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (container == IntPtr.Zero) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "无法创建自有承载窗口");
        try
        {
            SetStyle(window, GwlStyle, (record.Style & ~(WsPopup | WsCaption | WsThickFrame)) | WsChild);
            SetCheckedParent(window, container);
            IsAttached = true;
            ShowWindow(window, 5);
            Layout(window, ActualWidth, ActualHeight);
            return new HandleRef(this, container);
        }
        catch
        {
            Restore();
            if (container != IntPtr.Zero) DestroyWindow(container);
            container = IntPtr.Zero;
            throw;
        }
    }

    protected override void OnWindowPositionChanged(Rect rcBoundingBox)
    {
        base.OnWindowPositionChanged(rcBoundingBox);
        if (IsAttached && record is not null) Layout(new IntPtr(record.Window), rcBoundingBox.Width, rcBoundingBox.Height);
    }

    private void Layout(IntPtr window, double width, double height)
    {
        var dpi = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(this);
        if (!SetWindowPos(window, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, Math.Max(1, (int)(width * dpi.DpiScaleX)), Math.Max(1, (int)(height * dpi.DpiScaleY)), 0x0004 | 0x0010 | 0x0020)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "投屏窗口布局失败");
    }

    protected override void DestroyWindowCore(HandleRef hwnd)
    {
        Restore();
        if (hwnd.Handle != IntPtr.Zero && !DestroyWindow(hwnd.Handle)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "自有承载窗口关闭失败");
        container = IntPtr.Zero;
    }

    public void Restore()
    {
        if (record is null) return;
        RestoreRecord(record);
        IsAttached = false;
        record = null;
        if (File.Exists(journalPath)) File.Delete(journalPath);
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> RecoverPending(string journalDirectory)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(journalDirectory)) return [];
        var errors = new List<string>();
        foreach (var path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(journalDirectory, "*.json"))
        {
            try
            {
                var saved = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<WindowRecoveryRecord>(File.ReadAllText(path), JsonDefaults.Options) ?? throw new InvalidDataException("恢复记录为空");
                RestoreRecord(saved);
                File.Delete(path);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { errors.Add($"{Path.GetFileName(path)}：{ex.Message}"); }
        }
        return errors;
    }

    private static void RestoreRecord(WindowRecoveryRecord saved)
    {
        var window = new IntPtr(saved.Window);
        ValidateOwner(window, saved.ProcessId, saved.ProcessStartUtcTicks, saved.ExecutablePath);
        var parent = new IntPtr(saved.Parent);
        if (parent != IntPtr.Zero && !IsWindow(parent)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"原父窗口已失效，保留恢复记录：{saved.Window}");
        SetCheckedParent(window, parent);
        SetStyle(window, GwlStyle, saved.Style);
        SetStyle(window, GwlExStyle, saved.ExStyle);
        var point = new WinPoint { X = saved.Left, Y = saved.Top };
        if (parent != IntPtr.Zero && !ScreenToClient(parent, ref point)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "恢复坐标换算失败");
        if (!SetWindowPos(window, IntPtr.Zero, point.X, point.Y, saved.Width, saved.Height, 0x0004 | 0x0010 | 0x0020)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "投屏窗口恢复位置失败");
        ShowWindow(window, saved.Visible ? 5 : 0);
        if (GetParent(window) != parent || GetWindowLongPtr(window, GwlStyle).ToInt64() != saved.Style) throw new InvalidOperationException("窗口恢复核验不一致");
    }

    private static void ValidateOwner(IntPtr window, int processId, long started, string executable)
    {
        if (!IsWindow(window)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"投屏窗口已失效：{window}");
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(window, out var actualId);
        if (actualId != processId) throw new InvalidOperationException("窗口 PID 已改变，拒绝修改");
        using var process = Process.GetProcessById(processId);
        if (process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks != started || !string.Equals(process.MainModule?.FileName, executable, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) throw new InvalidOperationException("进程启动时间或路径不符，拒绝修改重用窗口");
    }

    private static void SetCheckedParent(IntPtr window, IntPtr parent)
    {
        Marshal.SetLastPInvokeError(0);
        var previous = SetParent(window, parent);
        var error = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
        if (previous == IntPtr.Zero && error != 0) throw new Win32Exception(error, "窗口父子关系修改失败");
        if (GetParent(window) != parent) throw new InvalidOperationException("窗口父子关系核验失败");
    }
    private static void SetStyle(IntPtr window, int index, long value)
    {
        Marshal.SetLastPInvokeError(0);
        var result = SetWindowLongPtr(window, index, new IntPtr(value));
        if (result == IntPtr.Zero && Marshal.GetLastWin32Error() != 0) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "窗口样式修改失败");
    }

    public sealed record WindowRecoveryRecord(long Window, int ProcessId, long ProcessStartUtcTicks, string ExecutablePath, long Parent, long Style, long ExStyle, int Left, int Top, int Width, int Height, bool Visible);
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct WinRect { public int Left; public int Top; public int Right; public int Bottom; }
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct WinPoint { public int X; public int Y; }
    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true, EntryPoint = "CreateWindowExW")] private static extern IntPtr CreateWindowEx(int exStyle, string className, string title, long style, int x, int y, int width, int height, IntPtr parent, IntPtr menu, IntPtr instance, IntPtr parameter);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool DestroyWindow(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern IntPtr SetParent(IntPtr window, IntPtr parent);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern IntPtr GetParent(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, EntryPoint = "GetWindowLongPtrW", SetLastError = true)] private static extern IntPtr GetWindowLongPtr(IntPtr window, int index);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, EntryPoint = "SetWindowLongPtrW", SetLastError = true)] private static extern IntPtr SetWindowLongPtr(IntPtr window, int index, IntPtr value);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr window, out WinRect rect);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool SetWindowPos(IntPtr window, IntPtr after, int x, int y, int width, int height, uint flags);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr window, int command);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool IsWindow(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr window, out int processId);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool ScreenToClient(IntPtr window, ref WinPoint point);
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public abstract class ObservableObject : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
    protected bool Set<T>(ref T field, T value, [CallerMemberName] string? property = null)
    {
        if (EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(field, value)) return false;
        field = value;
        Changed(property);
        return true;
    }
    public void Changed([CallerMemberName] string? property = null) => PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(property));
}

public sealed class ActionCommand(Action execute, Func<bool>? canExecute = null) : ICommand
{
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged;
    public bool CanExecute(object? parameter) => canExecute?.Invoke() ?? true;
    public void Execute(object? parameter) => execute();
    public void Refresh() => CanExecuteChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
}

public sealed class AsyncCommand(Func<Task> execute, Func<bool>? canExecute = null) : ICommand
{
    private bool running;
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged;
    public bool CanExecute(object? parameter) => !running && (canExecute?.Invoke() ?? true);
    public async void Execute(object? parameter)
    { await ExecuteAsync(parameter); }
    public async Task ExecuteAsync(object? parameter = null)
    {
        if (!CanExecute(parameter)) return;
        running = true;
        Refresh();
        try { await execute(); }
        finally { running = false; Refresh(); }
    }
    public void Refresh() => CanExecuteChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
}

public sealed class DeviceRow : ObservableObject
{
    private DeviceInfo info;
    private bool selected;
    private BitmapSource? screenshot;
    private string screenState = "未载入";
    private string automationState = "未连接";
    private string scriptState = "未运行";
    private string apiAddress = "未启动";
    private DateTimeOffset? capturedAt;
    public DeviceRow(DeviceInfo info) => this.info = info;
    public DeviceInfo Info { get => info; set { info = value; Changed(); Changed(nameof(Name)); Changed(nameof(Model)); Changed(nameof(Group)); Changed(nameof(State)); Changed(nameof(Resolution)); } }
    public string Serial => info.Serial;
    public string Name => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(info.Name) ? info.Serial : info.Name;
    public string Model => $"{info.Brand} {info.Model}".Trim();
    public string Group => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(info.GroupId) ? "未分组" : info.GroupId;
    public string State => LocalizationService.Current.Get(info.State);
    public string Resolution => info.Width > 0 && info.Height > 0 ? $"{info.Width} × {info.Height}" : "未核验";
    public bool IsSelected { get => selected; set => Set(ref selected, value); }
    public BitmapSource? Screenshot { get => screenshot; set => Set(ref screenshot, value); }
    public string ScreenState { get => screenState; set => Set(ref screenState, value); }
    public string AutomationState { get => automationState; set => Set(ref automationState, value); }
    public string ScriptState { get => scriptState; set => Set(ref scriptState, value); }
    public string ApiAddress { get => apiAddress; set => Set(ref apiAddress, value); }
    public DateTimeOffset? CapturedAt { get => capturedAt; set { Set(ref capturedAt, value); Changed(nameof(FrameLabel)); } }
    public string FrameLabel => capturedAt is { } at ? $"{LocalizationService.Current.Get("截图")} {at.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss}" : LocalizationService.Current.Get("无截图");
}

public sealed class NodeRow(AndroidNode source, int depth = 0)
{
    public AndroidNode Source { get; } = source;
    public int Depth { get; } = depth;
    public string Label => string.IsNullOrEmpty(Source.Text) ? Source.ClassName?.Split('.').Last() ?? "node" : Source.Text;
    public string Id => Source.ResourceId ?? "";
    public string Bounds => $"[{Source.Bounds.Left},{Source.Bounds.Top}][{Source.Bounds.Right},{Source.Bounds.Bottom}]";
    public ObservableCollection<NodeRow> Children { get; } = new(source.ChildNodeList.Select(node => new NodeRow(node, depth + 1)));
}

public sealed record ShellEntry(int Index, string Time, string Command, string Output, string Serial = "")
{ public string Context => $"{Time} · {Serial}"; }
public sealed record PixelSample(int X, int Y, byte R, byte G, byte B)
{
    public string Hex => $"#{R:X2}{G:X2}{B:X2}";
    public string Rgb => $"RGB({R}, {G}, {B})";
    public string Position => $"{X}, {Y}";
}

public sealed class TransferRow : ObservableObject
{
    private double progress;
    private string state = "待传输";
    public required string Serial { get; init; }
    public required string Direction { get; init; }
    public required string LocalPath { get; init; }
    public required string RemotePath { get; init; }
    public bool AutoInstall { get; init; }
    public string Name => System.IO.Path.GetFileName(LocalPath);
    public string Size => FileSize(LocalPath);
    public double Progress { get => progress; set => Set(ref progress, value); }
    public string State { get => state; set => Set(ref state, value); }
    private static string FileSize(string path)
    {
        try { return System.IO.File.Exists(path) ? $"{new System.IO.FileInfo(path).Length / 1024d:F1} KiB" : "待下载"; }
        catch (Exception) { return "未核验"; }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

internal static class ResponsiveLayout
{
    private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<Window, OwnedWindowFit> ownedWindows = new();
    public static FrameworkElement Field(string label, FrameworkElement input, double labelWidth)
    {
        var row = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 9) };
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new() { Width = new GridLength(labelWidth) }); row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new());
        row.RowDefinitions.Add(new() { Height = GridLength.Auto }); row.RowDefinitions.Add(new() { Height = new GridLength(0) });
        var caption = new TextBlock { VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
        LocalizationService.Bind(caption, TextBlock.TextProperty, label); row.Children.Add(caption);
        if (input is Control) LocalizationService.Bind(input, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, label);
        Grid.SetColumn(input, 1); row.Children.Add(input);
        bool? stacked = null;
        void Arrange()
        {
            if (row.ActualWidth <= 0 || stacked == (row.ActualWidth < 460)) return;
            stacked = row.ActualWidth < 460;
            row.ColumnDefinitions[0].Width = new GridLength(stacked == true ? 0 : labelWidth);
            row.RowDefinitions[1].Height = stacked == true ? GridLength.Auto : new GridLength(0);
            Grid.SetColumnSpan(caption, stacked == true ? 2 : 1);
            Grid.SetRow(input, stacked == true ? 1 : 0); Grid.SetColumn(input, stacked == true ? 0 : 1); Grid.SetColumnSpan(input, stacked == true ? 2 : 1);
            caption.Margin = stacked == true ? new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 6) : new Thickness(0);
        }
        row.SizeChanged += (_, _) => Arrange(); row.Loaded += (_, _) => Arrange();
        return row;
    }

    public static WrapPanel Toolbar()
    {
        var panel = new WrapPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal };
        var originalCaps = new Dictionary<FrameworkElement, double>();
        void Constrain()
        {
            if (panel.ActualWidth <= 0) return;
            foreach (var child in panel.Children.OfType<FrameworkElement>())
            {
                if (!originalCaps.TryGetValue(child, out var cap)) originalCaps[child] = cap = child.MaxWidth;
                child.MaxWidth = Math.Max(child.MinWidth, Math.Min(cap, Math.Max(0, panel.ActualWidth - child.Margin.Left - child.Margin.Right)));
            }
        }
        panel.SizeChanged += (_, _) => Constrain(); panel.Loaded += (_, _) => Constrain();
        return panel;
    }

    public static void FitOwnedWindow(Window window, Window owner, double preferredWidth, double preferredHeight)
    {
        var fit = ownedWindows.GetValue(window, _ => new(window, owner));
        fit.PreferredWidth = preferredWidth; fit.PreferredHeight = preferredHeight; fit.Apply();
    }
    internal static string? FollowFailure(Window window) => ownedWindows.TryGetValue(window, out var fit) ? fit.LastFollowFailure : null;

    internal static Rect OwnerWorkArea(Window owner)
    {
        var ownerWidth = owner.ActualWidth > 0 ? owner.ActualWidth : owner.Width;
        var ownerHeight = owner.ActualHeight > 0 ? owner.ActualHeight : owner.Height;
        var handle = new WindowInteropHelper(owner).Handle;
        var monitor = MonitorFromWindow(handle, 2); var info = new MonitorInfo { Size = Marshal.SizeOf<MonitorInfo>() };
        if (handle != IntPtr.Zero && monitor != IntPtr.Zero && GetMonitorInfo(monitor, ref info) && GetWindowRect(handle, out var bounds))
        {
            var dpi = VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(owner);
            return new Rect(owner.Left + (info.Work.Left - bounds.Left) / dpi.DpiScaleX, owner.Top + (info.Work.Top - bounds.Top) / dpi.DpiScaleY,
                (info.Work.Right - info.Work.Left) / dpi.DpiScaleX, (info.Work.Bottom - info.Work.Top) / dpi.DpiScaleY);
        }
        return new Rect(owner.Left, owner.Top, ownerWidth, ownerHeight);
    }

    internal readonly record struct OwnedBounds(Rect Bounds, double MinimumWidth, double MinimumHeight, double MaximumWidth, double MaximumHeight);
    internal static OwnedBounds CalculateOwnedBounds(Rect owner, Rect work, double preferredWidth, double preferredHeight, double minimumWidth, double minimumHeight)
    {
        static bool Valid(Rect rectangle) => !rectangle.IsEmpty && double.IsFinite(rectangle.X) && double.IsFinite(rectangle.Y) && double.IsFinite(rectangle.Width) && double.IsFinite(rectangle.Height) && rectangle.Width > 0 && rectangle.Height > 0;
        if (!Valid(owner) || !Valid(work) || !double.IsFinite(preferredWidth) || !double.IsFinite(preferredHeight) || preferredWidth <= 0 || preferredHeight <= 0 || !double.IsFinite(minimumWidth) || !double.IsFinite(minimumHeight) || minimumWidth < 0 || minimumHeight < 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"弹窗边界无效：owner={owner}; work={work}; preferred={preferredWidth}×{preferredHeight}。");
        var available = Rect.Intersect(owner, work);
        if (available.IsEmpty || available.Width <= 24 || available.Height <= 24) throw new InvalidOperationException("主窗口没有足够的可见工作区，无法安全显示弹窗。");
        var maxWidth = available.Width - 24; var maxHeight = available.Height - 24;
        var minWidth = Math.Min(minimumWidth, maxWidth); var minHeight = Math.Min(minimumHeight, maxHeight);
        var width = Math.Clamp(preferredWidth, minWidth, maxWidth); var height = Math.Clamp(preferredHeight, minHeight, maxHeight);
        return new(new Rect(Math.Clamp(owner.X + (owner.Width - width) / 2, available.Left + 12, available.Right - width - 12),
            Math.Clamp(owner.Y + (owner.Height - height) / 2, available.Top + 12, available.Bottom - height - 12), width, height), minWidth, minHeight, maxWidth, maxHeight);
    }

    private sealed class OwnedWindowFit
    {
        private readonly Window window, owner;
        private readonly double minimumWidth, minimumHeight;
        public double PreferredWidth { get; set; }
        public double PreferredHeight { get; set; }
        public string? LastFollowFailure { get; private set; }
        public OwnedWindowFit(Window window, Window owner)
        {
            this.window = window; this.owner = owner; minimumWidth = window.MinWidth; minimumHeight = window.MinHeight;
            owner.SizeChanged += OwnerChanged; owner.LocationChanged += OwnerMoved;
            window.Closed += (_, _) => { owner.SizeChanged -= OwnerChanged; owner.LocationChanged -= OwnerMoved; ownedWindows.Remove(window); };
        }
        private void OwnerChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs args) => Follow();
        private void OwnerMoved(object? sender, EventArgs args) => Follow();
        private void Follow()
        {
            if (!window.IsVisible) return;
            try { Apply(); LastFollowFailure = null; }
            catch (InvalidOperationException exception)
            {
                // Moving the owner outside a work area must not discard the last valid child bounds.
                if (LastFollowFailure != exception.Message) System.Diagnostics.Trace.TraceWarning("弹窗跟随暂停：{0}；{1}", window.Title, exception.Message);
                LastFollowFailure = exception.Message;
            }
        }
        public void Apply()
        {
            if (!owner.IsLoaded) throw new InvalidOperationException("主窗口尚未完成布局，无法计算弹窗边界。");
            var fit = CalculateOwnedBounds(new Rect(owner.Left, owner.Top, owner.ActualWidth, owner.ActualHeight), OwnerWorkArea(owner), PreferredWidth, PreferredHeight, minimumWidth, minimumHeight);
            window.MinWidth = Math.Min(window.MinWidth, fit.MinimumWidth); window.MinHeight = Math.Min(window.MinHeight, fit.MinimumHeight);
            window.MaxWidth = fit.MaximumWidth; window.MaxHeight = fit.MaximumHeight;
            window.MinWidth = fit.MinimumWidth; window.MinHeight = fit.MinimumHeight; window.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
            window.Width = fit.Bounds.Width; window.Height = fit.Bounds.Height;
            window.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
            window.Left = fit.Bounds.Left; window.Top = fit.Bounds.Top;
        }
    }
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct NativeRect { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct MonitorInfo { public int Size; public NativeRect Monitor, Work; public int Flags; }
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern IntPtr MonitorFromWindow(IntPtr window, uint flags);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "GetMonitorInfoW")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GetMonitorInfo(IntPtr monitor, ref MonitorInfo info);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr window, out NativeRect bounds);
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/ScriptJobWorkspace.cs

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Windows;
using MatrixDevice.Features;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed partial class WorkspaceViewModel
{
    private IReadOnlyList<DeviceRow> RequireScriptTargets()
    {
        if (Busy || Transferring) throw new InvalidOperationException("请等待当前操作结束再运行脚本");
        if (pendingLaunchSelection > 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("所选目标包含未连接设备，请先接入全部目标");
        var targets = Targets();
        if (targets.Count == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("请先选择目标设备");
        if (targets.Any(row => !row.Info.Online)) throw new InvalidOperationException("所选目标包含未连接设备，请先接入全部目标");
        return targets;
    }
    private ScriptJobRow? selectedScriptJob;
    private Action<ScriptJobStatus>? scriptJobChanged;
    private Action<Guid, ScriptLogEntry>? scriptJobLogAdded;
    private readonly HashSet<Task> scriptJobObservers = [];
    public ObservableCollection<ScriptJobRow> ScriptJobs { get; } = [];
    public ActionCommand CancelScriptJobCommand { get; }
    public ScriptJobRow? SelectedScriptJob
    {
        get => selectedScriptJob;
        set { if (Set(ref selectedScriptJob, value)) { LoadScriptLogs(); RefreshCommands(); } }
    }
    public string ScriptLogContext => SelectedScriptJob is { } job ? $"任务日志 · {job.JobId} · {job.Serial}" : "设备日志 · 最近 500 条";

    private void AttachScriptJobs()
    {
        var source = runtime.Scripts;
        scriptJobChanged = _ => Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
        {
            if (!ReferenceEquals(source, runtime.Scripts)) return;
            RefreshScriptJobs();
        });
        scriptJobLogAdded = (id, _) => Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(source, runtime.Scripts) && SelectedScriptJob?.JobId == id) LoadScriptLogs();
        });
        source.JobChanged += scriptJobChanged;
        source.JobLogAdded += scriptJobLogAdded;
        RefreshScriptJobs();
    }

    private void DetachScriptJobs(ScriptScheduler source)
    {
        if (scriptJobChanged is not null) source.JobChanged -= scriptJobChanged;
        if (scriptJobLogAdded is not null) source.JobLogAdded -= scriptJobLogAdded;
    }

    private void RefreshScriptJobs()
    {
        var jobs = runtime.Scripts.GetJobs();
        var retained = jobs.Select(job => job.JobId).ToHashSet();
        foreach (var row in ScriptJobs.Where(row => !retained.Contains(row.JobId)).ToArray()) ScriptJobs.Remove(row);
        for (var index = 0; index < jobs.Count; index++)
        {
            var job = jobs[index];
            var row = ScriptJobs.FirstOrDefault(item => item.JobId == job.JobId);
            if (row is null) { row = new ScriptJobRow(job); ScriptJobs.Add(row); }
            else row.Update(job);
            var previousIndex = ScriptJobs.IndexOf(row);
            if (previousIndex != index) ScriptJobs.Move(previousIndex, index);
        }
        if (SelectedScriptJob is { } selected && !retained.Contains(selected.JobId)) SelectedScriptJob = null;
        RefreshCommands();
    }

    public void CancelSelectedScriptJob()
    {
        if (SelectedScriptJob is not { } job) return;
        var accepted = runtime.Scripts.CancelJob(job.JobId);
        Status = accepted ? $"已请求取消任务 {job.JobId}" : "该任务已结束或不在当前会话中";
        RefreshScriptJobs();
    }

    private async Task ObserveScriptJobAsync(ScriptScheduler source, ScriptJobHandle handle, string serial)
    {
        try { await handle.Completion; }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
            {
                if (!ReferenceEquals(source, runtime.Scripts)) return;
                Error = $"脚本任务 {handle.JobId} · {serial}：{PresentError(ex)}";
                AddActivity(Error);
            });
        }
    }

    private void TrackScriptJob(ScriptScheduler source, ScriptJobHandle handle, string serial)
    {
        scriptJobObservers.RemoveWhere(task => task.IsCompletedSuccessfully);
        scriptJobObservers.Add(ObserveScriptJobAsync(source, handle, serial));
    }

    private async Task DrainScriptJobObserversAsync()
    {
        await Task.WhenAll(scriptJobObservers.ToArray());
        scriptJobObservers.Clear();
    }
}

public sealed class ScriptJobRow(ScriptJobStatus status) : ObservableObject
{
    public ScriptJobStatus Status { get; private set; } = status;
    public Guid JobId => Status.JobId;
    public string Serial => Status.Target.Serial;
    public string Identity => $"{Serial} · 代次 {Status.Target.Generation} · {(Status.Target.IsDemo ? "演示" : "传输 " + Status.Target.TransportId)}";
    public string Package => $"{Status.PackageId} · {Status.PackageVersion}";
    public string State => Status.State switch
    {
        ScriptRunState.Running => "运行中", ScriptRunState.Cancelling => "取消中", ScriptRunState.Completed => "已完成",
        ScriptRunState.Cancelled => "已取消", ScriptRunState.Failed => "失败", _ => "未运行"
    };
    public string Progress => $"{Math.Max(0, Status.StepIndex + 1)}/{Status.StepCount}";
    public string Started => Status.StartedUtc.ToLocalTime().ToString("MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
    public string Ended => Status.EndedUtc?.ToLocalTime().ToString("MM-dd HH:mm:ss") ?? "";
    public string Result => Status.Error ?? Status.Result ?? "";
    public bool CanCancel => Status.State == ScriptRunState.Running;
    public void Update(ScriptJobStatus value)
    {
        Status = value;
        foreach (var property in new[] { nameof(Status), nameof(State), nameof(Progress), nameof(Ended), nameof(Result), nameof(CanCancel) }) Changed(property);
    }
}
```

```xml
    <Style.Triggers>
      <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource InputBorderBrush}" /></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsKeyboardFocusWithin" Value="True"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" /></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsDropDownOpen" Value="True"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" /></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"><Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.5" /></Trigger>
      <Trigger Property="Validation.HasError" Value="True"><Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource DangerBrush}" /></Trigger>
    </Style.Triggers>
  </Style>
  <Style TargetType="ComboBoxItem">
    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource TextBrush}" />
    <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
    <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6" />
    <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="30" />
    <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch" />
    <Setter Property="Template">
      <Setter.Value>
        <ControlTemplate TargetType="ComboBoxItem">
          <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="6" Margin="0,1">
            <ContentPresenter Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" HorizontalAlignment="{TemplateBinding HorizontalContentAlignment}" />
          </Border>
        </ControlTemplate>
      </Setter.Value>
    </Setter>
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/UiErrorPresentation.cs

```csharp
using System.IO;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public static class UiErrorPresentation
{
    public static string Describe(Exception error)
    {
        if (error is TimeoutException || error is TaskCanceledException { InnerException: TimeoutException }) return "操作超时，请核验设备状态后重试";
        if (error is OperationCanceledException) return "操作已停止";
        if (error is FileNotFoundException missing) return "找不到所需文件：" + (missing.FileName ?? "请检查配置路径");
        if (error.Message.TrimStart().FirstOrDefault() is >= '\u4E00' and <= '\u9FFF') return error.Message;
        if (error is DirectoryNotFoundException) return "指定目录不存在，请检查路径";
        if (error is UnauthorizedAccessException) return "没有访问目标文件或设备的权限";
        if (error is System.Text.Json.JsonException) return "数据格式无效，请检查输入的 JSON 内容";
        if (error is ArgumentException) return "参数无效，请检查输入值";
        if (error is DeviceException device)
        {
            if (device.Message.StartsWith("UI dump did not create", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return "节点读取失败：页面可能仍在变化，请暂停动态内容或切换到静止页面后重试";
            if (device.Message.StartsWith("ADB server owner changed", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return "ADB 服务已变化，请重启本程序并重新发现设备；本程序未重启 ADB";
            if (device.Message.StartsWith("Global Unicode input requires", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return "中文输入需要明确绑定雷电实例与授权设备串号；节点指定文本仍需要兼容手机服务";
            if (device.Message.StartsWith("LDPlayer serial/index binding mismatch", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return "雷电索引与设备串号的进程归属不匹配，已拒绝发送文字，请重新核验绑定";
            var message = device.Code switch
            {
                1002 => "找不到目标设备",
                1007 => "请求参数无效",
                2001 => "当前运行环境不支持此能力",
                1003 => "设备当前状态不允许执行此操作",
                _ => "设备命令未能完成"
            };
            return $"{message}（错误码 {device.Code}）";
        }
        if (error is IOException) return "文件读取、写入或本机端口操作失败，请查看诊断日志";
        return "操作未能完成，详细原因已记录到本机诊断日志";
    }
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/UnifiedDeviceRow.cs

```csharp
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed class UnifiedDeviceRow : ObservableObject
{
    private bool selected;
    public string Key { get; }
    public LdPlayerInstance? Instance { get; private set; }
    public DeviceRow? Device { get; private set; }
    public bool Connected { get; private set; }
    private string phase = "";
    private string? configuredSerial;
    public int? Index => Instance?.Index;
    public string Number => Index?.ToString() ?? "-";
    public string Name => Device?.Name ?? Instance?.Name ?? "";
    public string State => FilterState;
    public string StateDetails => $"运行状态：{FilterState}\n设备原始状态：{Device?.Info.State ?? "无设备连接"}\n操作阶段：{(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(phase) ? "无" : phase)}";
    public string FilterState
    {
        get
        {
            if (Index is 0 or 99999) return "受保护";
            if (Instance is { } instance)
            {
                if (instance.IsStarting) return "启动中";
                var stopped = !instance.AndroidStarted && instance.ProcessId <= 0 && instance.VBoxProcessId <= 0 && instance.TopWindow == 0 && instance.BindWindow == 0;
                if (stopped) return !Connected && (Device is null || Device.Info.State == "Offline") ? "已关闭" : "未知";
                if (!instance.AndroidStarted || instance.ProcessId <= 0 || instance.VBoxProcessId <= 0) return "未知";
            }
            if (Connected && Device?.Info.Online != true) return "未知";
            return Device?.Info.State switch
            {
                "Ready" when Connected => "已连接",
                "Ready" when Instance is not null => "待连接",
                "Offline" => "离线", "Unauthorized" => "未授权", "Discovered" => "已发现", "Error" => "异常",
                null when Instance?.AndroidStarted == true => "待连接",
                _ => "未知"
            };
        }
    }
    public string Model => Device?.Info.Model ?? "-";
    public string Brand => Device?.Info.Brand ?? "-";
    public string Android => Device?.Info.AndroidVersion ?? "-";
    public string Serial => Device?.Serial ?? "-";
    public string Resolution => Device?.Resolution ?? (Instance?.Width is { } width && Instance.Height is { } height ? $"{width} × {height}" : "-");
    public string Group => Device?.Group ?? "未分组";
    public string AndroidState => Instance is null ? "-" : Instance.AndroidStarted ? "已启动" : "未启动";
    public string ProcessId => Instance?.ProcessId is > 0 ? Instance.ProcessId.ToString() : "-";
    public string VBoxProcessId => Instance?.VBoxProcessId is > 0 ? Instance.VBoxProcessId.ToString() : "-";
    public string Dpi => Instance?.Dpi?.ToString() ?? "-";
    public string Generation => Instance?.Generation.ToString() ?? "-";
    public string Binding => Instance is null ? "-" : Connected ? Serial + "（已核验）" : string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredSerial) ? "尚未绑定" : configuredSerial + "（配置绑定，尚未核验）";
    public bool CanSelect => Index is not (0 or 99999);
    public bool IsSelected
    {
        get => Device?.IsSelected ?? selected;
        set { if (!CanSelect) return; selected = value; if (Device is not null) Device.IsSelected = value; Changed(); }
    }
    public string PrimaryLabel => Connected && Device is not null ? "调试" : Index is 0 or 99999 ? "受保护"
        : FilterState == "已关闭" ? "启动" : Instance?.IsStarting == true ? "等待连接"
        : FilterState == "未知" ? "接入" : Instance?.AndroidStarted == true ? "连接" : "接入";
    private const string AdmissionDescription = "重新检查实例；明确关闭时尝试启动，过渡或信息不完整时等待，核验ADB、安卓启动与截图后连接；可能失败或超时。";
    public string PrimaryDescription => PrimaryLabel switch
    {
        "调试" => "打开此设备的界面检查，不启动或重启模拟器。",
        "受保护" => "受保护编号；此入口不自动启动或接入该实例。",
        "启动" => "当前观察为已关闭。" + AdmissionDescription,
        "等待连接" => "当前观察为启动中。" + AdmissionDescription,
        "连接" => "当前观察为安卓已启动。" + AdmissionDescription,
        _ => "当前状态尚未确认。" + AdmissionDescription
    };
    public string PrimaryGlyph => PrimaryLabel == "调试" ? "\uE946" : "\uE768";
    public AsyncCommand PrimaryCommand { get; }
    public AsyncCommand ShowWindowCommand { get; }
    public AsyncCommand MainCommand { get; }

    public UnifiedDeviceRow(string key, Func<UnifiedDeviceRow, Task> activate, Func<UnifiedDeviceRow, bool> canActivate, Func<UnifiedDeviceRow, Task> showWindow, Func<UnifiedDeviceRow, bool> canShow, Func<UnifiedDeviceRow, Task> setMain)
    {
        Key = key;
        PrimaryCommand = new AsyncCommand(() => activate(this), () => canActivate(this));
        ShowWindowCommand = new AsyncCommand(() => showWindow(this), () => canShow(this));
        MainCommand = new AsyncCommand(() => setMain(this), () => Connected && Device is not null && canActivate(this));
    }

    public void Update(LdPlayerInstance? instance, DeviceRow? device, bool connected, string operationPhase, string? configuredBinding = null)
    {
        var retained = IsSelected;
        Instance = instance; Device = device; Connected = connected; phase = operationPhase; configuredSerial = configuredBinding;
        if (CanSelect && retained && device is not null && !device.IsSelected) device.IsSelected = true;
        selected = retained; Changed(""); RefreshCommands();
    }

    public void RefreshCommands() { PrimaryCommand.Refresh(); ShowWindowCommand.Refresh(); MainCommand.Refresh(); }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

    private sealed record ApiEndpointKey(object Runtime, int Protocol, string? Serial, int? Port);
    private ApiEndpointKey? apiEndpoint;
    private long apiRequestRevision;

    private ApiEndpointKey ReadApiEndpoint()
    {
        var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime;
        var protocol = apiProtocol.SelectedIndex;
        var serial = protocol == 2 ? ViewModel.CurrentDevice?.Serial : null;
        int? port = protocol switch
        {
            0 => runtime.Api.RunningBasicPort,
            1 => runtime.Api.RunningAutomatorPort,
            2 when serial is not null && runtime.Api.DevicePorts.TryGetValue(serial, out var devicePort) => devicePort,
            _ => null
        };
        return new(runtime, protocol, serial, port);
    }
    private bool OwnsApiEndpoint() => ReadApiEndpoint().Port is > 0;
    private void InvalidateApiResponse()
    {
        apiRequestRevision++;
        apiResponse.Clear();
    }
    private void RefreshApiEndpoint()
    {
        var next = ReadApiEndpoint();
        if (next == apiEndpoint) return;
        apiEndpoint = next;
        InvalidateApiResponse();
    }
    private Task SendApiTestRequestAsync() => ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("测试 API", async () =>
    {
        RefreshApiEndpoint();
        InvalidateApiResponse();
        var endpoint = apiEndpoint!;

        var method = apiMethod.SelectedItem?.ToString() ?? "GET";
        var route = apiRoute.Text;
        var payload = apiPayload.Text;
        var port = endpoint.Port ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("所选本机接口未由当前程序启动");
        if (method is not ("GET" or "POST")) throw new InvalidOperationException("请求方法必须为 GET 或 POST");
        if (!route.StartsWith('/') || route.StartsWith("//", StringComparison.Ordinal) || route.Contains("://", StringComparison.Ordinal) || route.Contains('\\') || route.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            !Uri.TryCreate($"http://127.0.0.1:{port}{route}", UriKind.Absolute, out var uri) || uri.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttp ||
            uri.Host != "127.0.0.1" || uri.Port != port || uri.UserInfo.Length != 0 || uri.Fragment.Length != 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("路由必须为当前本机接口的相对路径：" + route);
        if (method == "POST") { using var validation = JsonDocument.Parse(payload); }
        var protocol = endpoint.Protocol switch { 1 => "自动化接口", 2 => "设备接口", _ => "普通接口" };
        var source = $"来源：{protocol} http://127.0.0.1:{port}\n" +
            (endpoint.Serial is { } serial ? $"设备串号：{serial}\n" : "") + $"请求：{method} {route}\n";
        using var handler = new HttpClientHandler { UseProxy = false, AllowAutoRedirect = false };
        using var client = new HttpClient(handler) { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30) };
        using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(new HttpMethod(method), uri);
        if (method == "POST") request.Content = new StringContent(payload, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        try
        {
            using var result = await client.SendAsync(request);
            var body = await result.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            RefreshApiEndpoint();
            // A context changed away and back still invalidates this original request.
            if (revision == apiRequestRevision && endpoint == apiEndpoint)
                apiResponse.Text = source + $"HTTP {(int)result.StatusCode} {result.ReasonPhrase}\n" + body;
        }
        catch (TaskCanceledException ex) { throw new TimeoutException("本机接口请求超时\n" + source, ex); }
    }, blocksApiWrites: false);
    private FrameworkElement BuildApiPage()
    {

        apiProtocol = new ComboBox { ItemsSource = new[] { "普通 API", "Automator API", "设备接口" }, ItemTemplate = CaptionChoices(), SelectedIndex = 0, MinHeight = 44 };
        apiMethod = new ComboBox { ItemsSource = new[] { "GET", "POST" }, SelectedIndex = 0, MinHeight = 44 };
        apiRoute = new TextBox { Text = "/health", MinHeight = 44, VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto };

        foreach (var column in grid.Columns.OfType<DataGridTextColumn>())

        sections.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto }); sections.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = GridLength.Auto });
        Grid.SetRow(requestPanel, 1); requestPanel.Margin = new Thickness(0, 18, 0, 0);
        sections.Children.Add(grid); sections.Children.Add(requestPanel);

        bool? singleColumn = null;
        void ArrangeSections()

        foreach (var button in new[] { startGateways, stopAll, startDevices, stopDevices, send }) { button.MinWidth = Math.Max(44, button.MinWidth); ToolTipService.SetShowOnDisabled(button, true); }
        void Hint(Button button, string available, string unavailable)
        {

            Hint(stopAll, "停止两个网关和全部设备接口。", "当前没有已启动的接口。");
```
