"PRODUCT-FAIL" : "HARNESS-FAIL" : error switch { null => "PASS", AppPendingPreconditionFailure => "PRECONDITION-FAIL", AppPendingProductFailure => "PRODUCT-FAIL", _ => "HARNESS-FAIL" };
                reports.Add(new { name, status = classification, cleaned = cleanupError is null, checks = state.Checks.ToArray(), observations = state.Events.ToArray(), stages = state.StageReport(), ticks = state.Ticks.ToArray(), scriptEvents = state.ScriptEvents.ToArray(), calls = state.Backend?.Calls(), gates = state.Backend?.GateReport(), tasks = state.TaskReport(), failure = error?.ToString(), forbiddenOperationFailure = writeError?.ToString(), cleanupFailure = cleanupError?.ToString() });
            }
            var caseErrors = new[] { error, writeError, cleanupError }.OfType<Exception>().ToArray(); if (caseErrors.Length != 0) failures.Add(new InvalidOperationException(name, new AggregateException(caseErrors)));
            if (cleanupError is not null) throw new AggregateException("自有case未清理，停止后续接纳；余case NOT-RUN", failures);
        }
    }

    private sealed class AppPendingPreconditionFailure(string message, Exception? inner = null) : Exception(message, inner) { }
    private sealed class AppPendingProductFailure(string message, Exception? inner = null) : Exception(message, inner) { }
    private sealed class AppPendingTracked(string label, Task task, Exception? expectedFailure = null, bool allowCancellation = false)
    {
        internal readonly string Label = label; internal readonly Task Task = task; internal readonly Exception? ExpectedFailure = expectedFailure;
        internal readonly bool AllowCancellation = allowCancellation; internal bool FailureObserved;
        internal async Task Drain()
        {
            try { await Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
            catch (Exception error) when (ReferenceEquals(error, ExpectedFailure) && Task.IsFaulted) { FailureObserved = true; }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (AllowCancellation && Task.IsCanceled) { FailureObserved = true; }
        }
        internal object Report() => new { Label, expectedFailure = ExpectedFailure?.Message, AllowCancellation, FailureObserved, status = Task.Status.ToString(), Task.IsCompleted };
    }
    private sealed record AppPendingTick(int Number, long At, bool Pending, bool Running, bool Busy, bool Transferring, bool Visible, bool Closing, ScriptRunState ScriptA, int Lists);
    private sealed record AppPendingWait(Func<bool> Ready, TaskCompletionSource Completion);
    private sealed record AppPendingBlock(AppPendingGate Gate, Task Task, int ProgressNotices = 0);
    private sealed record AppPendingBusy(TaskCompletionSource Release, Task Task);

    private sealed class AppPendingState
    {
        internal MainWindow Window = null!; internal WorkspaceViewModel Vm = null!; internal AppPendingBackend Backend = null!;
        internal readonly List<string> Checks = []; internal readonly List<object> Events = []; internal readonly List<AppPendingTick> Ticks = [];
        internal readonly ConcurrentQueue<ScriptRunStatus> ScriptEvents = new();
        private readonly List<AppPendingTracked> tasks = []; private readonly List<TaskCompletionSource> releases = []; private readonly List<AppPendingWait> waits = [];
        private readonly List<DispatcherTimer> observationTimers = []; private readonly Dictionary<string, string> stages = [];
        private PropertyChangedEventHandler? propertyObserver; private Action<ScriptRunStatus>? scriptObserver; private EventHandler? tickObserver;
        private DependencyPropertyChangedEventHandler? enabledObserver; private EventHandler? closedObserver;
        private MatrixRuntime? runtime; private CatalogRepository? metadata; private RollingLog? log; private DeviceCatalog? catalog;
        private AutomationService? automation; private InputCoordinator? input; private ScriptScheduler? scripts; private ApiServiceManager? api;
        private string directory = ""; private bool shutdownByWindow; private bool closeRequestedByUser; private bool cleanupStarted;
        private int activeOperationNotices; private int transferNotices; private int overallProgressNotices;
        private DeviceRow? current; private DeviceRow? main; private DeviceRow[] rows = []; private bool[] selected = []; private DeviceRow[] targets = []; private UnifiedDeviceRow[] unified = []; private bool[] unifiedSelected = [];
        private readonly TaskCompletionSource closed = NewCompletion();
        internal DeviceRow A => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-001"); internal DeviceRow B => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-002");
        internal int TickCount => Ticks.Count;
        internal int OverallProgressNotices => overallProgressNotices;
        private static TaskCompletionSource NewCompletion() => new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

        internal async Task Initialize(MainWindow owner, string path)
        {
            stages.Add("initialize", "STARTED"); directory = path; Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
            try
            {
                Backend = new(); log = new RollingLog(Path.Combine(path, "logs")); metadata = new CatalogRepository(Path.Combine(path, "db.sqlite3"));
                catalog = new DeviceCatalog(Backend); automation = new AutomationService(Backend, catalog); scripts = new ScriptScheduler(Backend); input = new InputCoordinator(catalog, Backend); api = new ApiServiceManager(catalog, Backend, automation, log);
                var settings = new AppSettings { Language = "zh-CN", AutoStartApi = false, AutoConnect = false, SyncMouse = false, SyncKeyboard = false, WindowWidth = 1000, WindowHeight = 700 };
                runtime = new MatrixRuntime { Backend = Backend, Devices = catalog, Automation = automation, Scripts = scripts, Input = input, Api = api, Metadata = metadata, Log = log, Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings, SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(path, "AppConfig.json")), IsDemo = true };
                api.DeviceSnapshotProvider = runtime.GetDevices; Backend.Snapshot = runtime.GetDevices; Vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(runtime, path, true);
                await Track("initial-discovery", Vm.RefreshDevicesAsync()).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
                Window = new MainWindow(Vm) { Owner = owner, ShowActivated = false }; Window.captureTimer.Stop(); Window.directoryTimer.Stop(); Window.monitorTimer.Stop();
                propertyObserver = (_, args) => { if (args.PropertyName == nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.HasActiveOperations)) activeOperationNotices++; if (args.PropertyName == nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.Transferring)) transferNotices++; if (args.PropertyName == nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.OverallProgress)) overallProgressNotices++; Observe("vm:" + args.PropertyName); }; Vm.PropertyChanged += propertyObserver;
                scriptObserver = status => { ScriptEvents.Enqueue(status); Window.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() => Observe("script:" + status.State)); }; scripts.StatusChanged += scriptObserver;
                enabledObserver = (_, _) => Observe("application-cancel-enabled"); Window.applicationCancel.IsEnabledChanged += enabledObserver;
                closedObserver = (_, _) => { if (closeRequestedByUser && !cleanupStarted) shutdownByWindow = Window.closing && Window.closeApproved; closed.TrySetResult(); Observe("closed"); }; Window.Closed += closedObserver;
                Window.Show(); await Navigate("应用");
                Require(Vm.Demo && runtime.IsDemo && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Backend, Backend) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Devices, catalog) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Automation, automation) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Scripts, scripts) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Input, input) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Api, api) && !api.BasicRunning && !api.AutomatorRunning && api.DevicePorts.Count == 0 && !Window.DebugAutomaticFixturePermitted && !Window.ReconnectLoadingFixturePermitted, "一致自有Demo/STA服务，API关闭，默认节点自动许可未开放");
                await Track("set-main-b", Vm.SetMainAsync(B)).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); Vm.CurrentDevice = B; A.IsSelected = false; B.IsSelected = true; Vm.UpdateSelection(); await Idle();
                Require(Window.applicationTargets.Count == 2 && Window.applicationTargets.All(row => !row.IsSelected && row.Available) && Window.applicationReadTimer is null && !Window.applicationReadPending && Backend.Lists().Length == 0, "初始化不勾应用、不创建timer、不读取列表");
                current = Vm.CurrentDevice; main = Vm.MainDevice; rows = Vm.Devices.ToArray(); selected = Vm.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected).ToArray(); targets = Vm.Targets().ToArray(); unified = Window.unifiedDevices.ToArray(); unifiedSelected = Window.unifiedDevices.Select(row => row.IsSelected).ToArray();
                Require(ReferenceEquals(current, B) && ReferenceEquals(main, B) && targets.Length == 1 && ReferenceEquals(targets[0], B), "全局Current/Main/群控仅B，应用初始独立空选择");
                stages["initialize"] = "PASS"; Observe("initialized");
            }
            catch (AppPendingPreconditionFailure) { throw; }
            catch (Exception error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("自有应用挂起读取初始化失败", error); }
        }

        internal void Expect(params string[] names) { foreach (var name in names) stages.Add(name, "NOT-RUN"); }
        internal void Begin(string name) { stages[name] = "STARTED"; Observe("stage:" + name); }
        internal void Complete(string name) => stages[name] = "PASS";
        internal void FailActiveStage(Exception? error) { if (error is null) return; foreach (var key in stages.Where(pair => pair.Value == "STARTED").Select(pair => pair.Key).ToArray()) stages[key] = error is AppPendingPreconditionFailure ? "PRECONDITION-FAIL" : error is AppPendingProductFailure ? "PRODUCT-FAIL" : "HARNESS-FAIL"; }
        internal object[] StageReport() => stages.Select(pair => (object)new { stage = pair.Key, status = pair.Value }).ToArray();
        private Task Track(string label, Task task, Exception? expectedFailure = null) { if (!tasks.Any(item => ReferenceEquals(item.Task, task))) tasks.Add(new(label, task, expectedFailure)); return task; }
        internal object[] TaskReport() => tasks.Select(item => item.Report()).Concat(Backend?.TaskReport() ?? []).Concat(releases.Select(item => (object)new { label = "busy-release-tcs", status = item.Task.Status.ToString(), item.Task.IsCompleted })).Append(new { label = "closed-event-tcs", status = closed.Task.Status.ToString(), closed.Task.IsCompleted }).ToArray();
        internal async Task Idle() { await Window.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(Window.UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Window.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); ResolveWaits(); }
        internal async Task Finish(Task task) { await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Idle(); }

        internal async Task Navigate(string tag)
        {
            try { Window.navigation[tag].RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ButtonBase.ClickEvent)); await Idle(); Require(Equals((Window.tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag, tag), "真实导航Click选中原Tab：" + tag); }
            catch (AppPendingPreconditionFailure) { throw; }
            catch (Exception error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("真实导航不可用：" + tag, error); }
            Observe("navigation:" + tag);
        }

        internal async Task Select(string serial, bool value, bool settle = true)
        {
            try
            {
                Require(Window.applicationPage.IsVisible && Window.applicationTargetPanel.IsEnabled && !Window.applicationRunning && !Vm.Busy, "只在真实可操作应用目标区改变勾选");
                var row = Window.applicationTargets.Single(item => item.Serial == serial); var grid = VisualDescendants<DataGrid>(Window.applicationTargetPanel).Single();
                grid.ScrollIntoView(row); await Idle(); var content = grid.Columns[0].GetCellContent(row);
                Require(content is not null, "真实目标选择单元格已实现");
                var check = content as CheckBox ?? VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(content!).Single(); var binding = check.GetBindingExpression(ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty) ?? throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("真实目标CheckBox没有BindingExpression");
                Require(check.IsVisible && check.IsEnabled && ReferenceEquals(binding.DataItem, row) && binding.ParentBinding.Path.Path == nameof(ApplicationTargetRow.IsSelected) && binding.ParentBinding.Mode == BindingMode.TwoWay && row.IsSelected != value, "真实可见CheckBox绑定原目标行，且本次为有效Toggle");
                var peer = new CheckBoxAutomationPeer(check); var toggle = (IToggleProvider?)peer.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Toggle); Require(toggle is not null, "原CheckBox提供Toggle自动化模式"); toggle!.Toggle();
                Require(row.IsSelected == value && check.IsChecked == value, "Toggle经原TwoWay Binding同步目标选择");
                AttachTimer(); Observe("bound-checkbox-toggle", new { serial, value, logicalWpfAutomation = true, physicalInput = false, binding = binding.ParentBinding.Path.Path }); if (settle) await Idle();
            }
            catch (AppPendingPreconditionFailure) { throw; }
            catch (Exception error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("应用目标CheckBox/Binding前置失败：" + serial, error); }
        }

        private void AttachTimer()
        {
            var timer = Window.applicationReadTimer;
            Require(timer is not null && timer.Interval == TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(350) && ReferenceEquals(timer.Dispatcher, Window.Dispatcher), "勾选实际创建原350ms DispatcherTimer");
            if (tickObserver is not null) return;
            // The constructor installed the production callback before this observer is appended.
            tickObserver = (_, _) =>
            {
                var tick = new AppPendingTick(Ticks.Count + 1, Stopwatch.GetTimestamp(), Window.applicationReadPending, Window.applicationRunning, Vm.Busy, Vm.Transferring, Window.applicationPage.IsVisible, Window.closing || Window.closeApproved, scripts!.GetStatus(A.Serial).State, Backend.Lists().Length);
                Ticks.Add(tick); Observe("original-tick-after-production-handler", tick);
            };
            timer!.Tick += tickObserver; Observe("timer-observer-appended-after-production-constructor");
        }

        internal async Task<AppPendingTick> TickAfter(int before)
        {
            try { await WaitFor(() => TickCount > before, "original-tick-observation").WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
            catch (TimeoutException error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("原350ms timer未触发，不能算产品pending失败", error); }
            return Ticks[before];
        }

        internal void RequireBlockedTick(AppPendingTick tick, bool script = false, bool transfer = false, bool busy = false)
        {
            Require(tick.Visible && !tick.Running && tick.Lists == 0 && (!script || tick.ScriptA is ScriptRunState.Running or ScriptRunState.Cancelling) && (!transfer || tick.Transferring) && tick.Busy == busy, "原timer在真实预期阻塞期间触发且尚无List；pending值仅观察不伪造");
            Observe("blocked-pending-observed", new { tick.Pending, script, transfer, busy });
        }

        internal async Task<AppPendingBlock> BlockScript(string serial, bool fail = false)
        {
            var gate = Backend.Hold("ScriptStart", serial, fail ? new InvalidOperationException("own pending script failure") : null);
            var task = Track("script:" + serial, scripts!.RunAsync(serial, new ScriptPackage { Manifest = new() { Id = "own-pending", Name = "自有挂起读取阻塞", Version = "1.0" }, Steps = [new() { Action = "launch", Value = AppPendingBackend.ScriptPackage }] }), gate.Failure);
            try { await gate.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Idle(); Require(gate.Claimed && scripts!.GetStatus(serial).State == ScriptRunState.Running && !Vm.Busy, "真实ScriptScheduler已进入自有后端TCS门，未占Busy"); }
            catch (AppPendingPreconditionFailure) { throw; }
            catch (Exception error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("脚本未进入真实Running/TCS门", error); }
            return new(gate, task);
        }

        internal async Task ReleaseScript(AppPendingBlock script, string outcome)
        {
            var notices = activeOperationNotices;
            if (outcome == "cancelled") scripts!.Stop(script.Gate.Serial); else script.Gate.Release.TrySetResult();
            try { await script.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); if (outcome == "failed") throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("预期脚本失败未发生"); }
            catch (Exception error) when (outcome == "failed" && ReferenceEquals(error, script.Gate.Failure)) { tasks.Single(item => ReferenceEquals(item.Task, script.Task)).FailureObserved = true; Observe("expected-script-task-failure", new { error.Message, exactMarkerException = true }); }
            await Idle(); var expected = outcome switch { "completed" => ScriptRunState.Completed, "failed" => ScriptRunState.Failed, "cancelled" => ScriptRunState.Cancelled, _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(outcome)) };
            Require(scripts!.GetStatus(script.Gate.Serial).State == expected && ScriptStates(script.Gate.Serial).LastOrDefault() == expected, "真实ScriptScheduler终态与StatusChanged已到达：" + expected);
            Require(activeOperationNotices > notices, "脚本真实终态已投递VM HasActiveOperations通知，不假定此刻没有其它合法活动"); Observe("script-released:" + outcome, new { noticesBefore = notices, noticesAfter = activeOperationNotices });
        }
        internal ScriptRunState[] ScriptStates(string serial) => ScriptEvents.Where(item => item.Serial == serial).Select(item => item.State).ToArray();
        internal void RequireScriptRunning(string serial) => Require(scripts!.GetStatus(serial).State == ScriptRunState.Running && ScriptStates(serial).LastOrDefault() == ScriptRunState.Running, "其它设备合法脚本仍在Running，不作为本次应用目标的全局阻塞：" + serial);

        internal async Task<AppPendingBlock> BlockPush()
        {
            var gate = Backend.Hold("Push", B.Serial); var path = Path.Combine(directory, "own.txt"); await File.WriteAllTextAsync(path, "own pending transfer"); Vm.QueuePush(path, false);
            Require(Vm.Transfers.Count == 1 && Vm.Transfers.Single().Serial == B.Serial && !Vm.Transfers.Single().AutoInstall, "真实VM仅为全局B排队自有文件，AutoInstall关闭");
            var task = Track("push-b", Vm.StartTransfersAsync());
            try { await gate.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Idle(); Require(gate.Claimed && Vm.Transferring && !Vm.Busy, "真实Push进入稳定TCS门，无guest转发"); }
            catch (AppPendingPreconditionFailure) { throw; }
            catch (Exception error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("真实Push未进入TCS门", error); }
            return new(gate, task, overallProgressNotices);
        }
        internal async Task ReleasePush(AppPendingBlock push) { var notices = transferNotices; push.Gate.Release.TrySetResult(); await Finish(push.Task); Require(!Vm.Transferring && Vm.Transfers.Single().State == "传输完成" && transferNotices > notices, "真实VM传输finally结束并投递Transferring通知"); }

        internal async Task<AppPendingBusy> BlockBusy()
        {
            var release = NewCompletion(); var entered = NewCompletion(); releases.Add(release);
            var task = Track("busy-operation", Vm.ExecuteAsync("自有挂起读取Busy", async () => { entered.TrySetResult(); await release.Task; }));
            try { await Track("busy-entered-event", entered.Task).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); Require(Vm.Busy && !Window.applicationTargetPanel.IsEnabled, "选择之后受控真实VM ExecuteAsync进入Busy，未声称点击另一个按钮，未操作禁用目标区"); }
            catch (AppPendingPreconditionFailure) { throw; }
            catch (Exception error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("真实Busy未进入", error); }
            return new(release, task);
        }

        internal async Task ReadEntered(AppPendingGate read)
        {
            try { await read.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
            catch (TimeoutException error) { throw new AppPendingProductFailure("有效原意图释放后5秒内未进入自动List：" + read.Serial, error); }
            Product(read.Claimed && Window.applicationRunning && Vm.Busy && Backend.ActiveLists == 1 && Backend.MaximumActiveLists == 1, "自动List实际进入唯一批次/TCS门"); Observe("automatic-list-entered", new { read.Serial });
        }
        internal async Task CompleteRead(AppPendingGate read, bool failed = false, bool observeOnce = true)
        {
            read.Release.TrySetResult();
            try { await read.GateExited.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Idle(); await WaitFor(() => !Window.applicationRunning && !Vm.Busy, "read-ui-settled").WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
            catch (TimeoutException error) { throw new AppPendingProductFailure("实际自动List或原批次UI未排空", error); }
            Product(Backend.ActiveLists == 0 && Backend.ListTasksCompleted, "GateExited仅表示门退出；原List返回Task及批次UI均实际完成");
            Product(Window.applicationTasks.Count == 1 && Window.applicationTasks.Single().ResultState == (failed ? ApplicationTaskState.Failed : ApplicationTaskState.Succeeded), "原应用批次呈现预期终态");
            Product(failed ? Window.applicationRows.Count == 0 && Window.applicationTasks.Single().Message == read.Failure?.Message && Vm.Error.Length != 0 && Vm.Status == "操作失败" : Window.applicationRows.Count == 1 && Window.applicationRows.Single().Serial == read.Serial && Window.applicationRows.Single().PackageName == AppPendingBackend.ApplicationPackage && Vm.Error.Length == 0, "原列表发布/逐项marker/安全错误反馈与本次结果一致");
            if (observeOnce) await ObservationWindow();
            NoApplicationWrites(); Observe("automatic-list-finished", new { read.Serial, failed });
        }
        internal void AssertLists(params string[] serials) => Product(Backend.Lists().Select(call => call.Serial).SequenceEqual(serials), "真实List顺序 expected=" + string.Join(",", serials) + "; actual=" + string.Join(",", Backend.Lists().Select(call => call.Serial)));
        internal void NoApplicationWrites() => Product(Backend.Calls().All(call => !call.ForbiddenWrite && !call.Operation.StartsWith("UnexpectedRead:", StringComparison.Ordinal)), "应用自动路径没有设备写或无关读取；仅明确脚本stub/Push门被允许");

        private Task WaitFor(Func<bool> ready, string label)
        {
            if (ready()) return Task.CompletedTask; var completion = NewCompletion(); waits.Add(new(ready, completion)); Track(label, completion.Task); return completion.Task;
        }
        private void ResolveWaits() { foreach (var wait in waits.ToArray()) if (wait.Ready()) { waits.Remove(wait); wait.Completion.TrySetResult(); } }
        internal async Task ObservationWindow()
        {
            var completion = NewCompletion(); var timer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background, Window.Dispatcher) { Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(850) };
            timer.Tick += (_, _) => { timer.Stop(); completion.TrySetResult(); }; observationTimers.Add(timer); _ = Track("bounded-no-poll-observation", completion.Task); timer.Start();
            await completion.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Idle(); Observe("850ms-observation-complete");
        }
        internal async Task CloseByUser()
        {
            Require(!Vm.Busy && Vm.HasActiveOperations && Window.IsVisible, "真实用户Close前无Busy，存在可确认的脚本活动"); var confirmations = 0;
            Vm.Confirm = (_, _) => { confirmations++; return true; }; closeRequestedByUser = true; Window.Close();
            try { await closed.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Idle(); }
            catch (TimeoutException error) { throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure("自有Window.Close/Shutdown未完成", error); }
            Product(shutdownByWindow && confirmations == 1 && !Window.IsVisible, "真实Close/Closing/单次Shutdown完成，只写自有artifacts配置");
        }

        internal void Context()
        {
            Product(ReferenceEquals(current, Vm.CurrentDevice) && ReferenceEquals(main, Vm.MainDevice) && rows.SequenceEqual(Vm.Devices) && selected.SequenceEqual(Vm.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected)) && targets.SequenceEqual(Vm.Targets()) && unified.SequenceEqual(Window.unifiedDevices) && unifiedSelected.SequenceEqual(Window.unifiedDevices.Select(row => row.IsSelected)), "应用独立选择/读取未改变全局B的Current/Main/群控及原行引用");
        }
        internal void Require(bool value, string message) { if (!value) { Observe("precondition-failed", message); throw new AppPendingPreconditionFailure(message); } Checks.Add("PRECONDITION " + message); }
        internal void Product(bool value, string message) { if (!value) { Observe("product-failed", message); throw new AppPendingProductFailure(message); } Checks.Add("PRODUCT " + message); }
        internal void Observe(string stage, object? detail = null)
        {
            if (Events.Count == 256) Events.RemoveAt(0);
            Events.Add(new { stage, at = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp(), detail, busy = Vm?.Busy, transferring = Vm?.Transferring, running = Window?.applicationRunning, pending = Window?.applicationReadPending, timerEnabled = Window?.applicationReadTimer?.IsEnabled, closing = Window?.closing, closeApproved = Window?.closeApproved, page = (Window?.tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag, lists = Backend?.Lists().Length, current = Vm?.CurrentDevice?.Serial, main = Vm?.MainDevice?.Serial, error = Vm?.Error, activeOperationNotices, transferNotices, overallProgressNotices });
            ResolveWaits();
        }

        internal async Task Cleanup()
        {
            if (cleanupStarted) throw new InvalidOperationException("应用挂起读取case不得重复清理"); cleanupStarted = true; var errors = new List<Exception>();
            Observe("cleanup-before-lifecycle");
            if (Window is not null && !shutdownByWindow) try { Window.AbortStartup(); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            Backend?.ReleaseAll(); foreach (var release in releases) release.TrySetResult();
            if (Vm is not null) foreach (var row in Vm.Devices) scripts?.Stop(row.Serial);
            foreach (var item in tasks.Where(item => !item.Label.StartsWith("original-tick", StringComparison.Ordinal) && item.Label != "read-ui-settled").ToArray())
                try { await item.Drain(); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            if (Backend is not null) try { await Backend.DrainTasks(); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            if (Window is not null) try { await Idle(); await WaitFor(() => !Window.applicationRunning && !Vm!.Busy, "cleanup-ui-settled").WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            if (Vm is not null && !shutdownByWindow) try { await Track("own-shutdown", Vm.ShutdownAsync()).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            else if (Vm is null)
            {
                if (runtime is not null) try { await Track("partial-runtime-shutdown", runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask()).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
                else
                {
                    if (api is not null) await Attempt(() => api.DisposeAsync().AsTask()); if (input is not null) await Attempt(() => input.DisposeAsync().AsTask()); if (scripts is not null) await Attempt(() => scripts.DisposeAsync().AsTask()); if (Backend is not null) await Attempt(() => Backend.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
                    try { metadata?.Dispose(); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); } if (log is not null) await Attempt(() => log.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
                }
            }
            if (Window is not null)
            {
                try { if (Window.applicationReadTimer?.IsEnabled == true) await ObservationWindow(); await Idle(); if (Window.applicationReadTimer?.IsEnabled == true || Window.applicationRunning || Vm!.Busy) throw new InvalidOperationException("关闭后原应用timer/批次未排空；未手工Stop或清pending"); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
                if (propertyObserver is not null) Vm!.PropertyChanged -= propertyObserver; if (scriptObserver is not null) scripts!.StatusChanged -= scriptObserver;
                if (enabledObserver is not null) Window.applicationCancel.IsEnabledChanged -= enabledObserver; if (closedObserver is not null) Window.Closed -= closedObserver;
                if (tickObserver is not null && Window.applicationReadTimer is not null) Window.applicationReadTimer.Tick -= tickObserver;
                LocalizationService.Current.LanguageChanged -= Window.OnLanguageChanged;
            }
            foreach (var timer in observationTimers) timer.Stop(); foreach (var wait in waits) wait.Completion.TrySetCanceled(); waits.Clear();
            if (!closed.Task.IsCompleted) closed.TrySetCanceled();
            if (Backend is not null) try { await Backend.DrainTasks(); if (!Backend.GatesDrained || Backend.ActiveLists != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("原后端Task/TCS未排空"); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            if (tasks.Any(item => !item.Task.IsCompleted) || releases.Any(item => !item.Task.IsCompleted)) errors.Add(new InvalidOperationException("原夹具Task/TCS未完成"));
            Observe("cleanup-finished"); if (errors.Count != 0) throw new AggregateException("应用挂起读取自有清理失败", errors);
            async Task Attempt(Func<Task> action) { try { await Track("partial-service-shutdown", action()).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); } }
        }
    }

    private sealed record AppPendingCall(int Sequence, string Operation, string? Serial, string? Subject, bool ForbiddenWrite, long At, DeviceInfo? Source);
    private sealed class AppPendingGate(string operation, string serial, Exception? failure)
    {
        internal readonly string Operation = operation; internal readonly string Serial = serial; internal readonly Exception? Failure = failure;
        internal bool Claimed; internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Release = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously); internal readonly TaskCompletionSource GateExited = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    }
    private sealed class AppPendingBackend : IDeviceBackend
    {
        internal const string ScriptPackage = "com.matrix.pending.blocker"; internal const string ApplicationPackage = "com.matrix.pending.application";
        private readonly object sync = new(); private readonly List<AppPendingCall> calls = []; private readonly List<AppPendingGate> gates = []; private readonly List<AppPendingTracked> tasks = [];
        private int activeLists; private int maximumActiveLists;
        internal Func<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>>? Snapshot;
        internal int ActiveLists { get { lock (sync) return activeLists; } } internal int MaximumActiveLists { get { lock (sync) return maximumActiveLists; } }
        internal bool ListTasksCompleted { get { lock (sync) return tasks.Where(item => item.Label.StartsWith("backend-list:", StringComparison.Ordinal)).All(item => item.Task.IsCompleted); } }
        internal AppPendingCall[] Calls() { lock (sync) return calls.ToArray(); } internal AppPendingCall[] Lists() => Calls().Where(call => call.Operation == "List").ToArray();
        internal AppPendingGate Hold(string operation, string serial, Exception? failure = null) { var gate = new AppPendingGate(operation, serial, failure); lock (sync) gates.Add(gate); return gate; }
        internal async Task DrainTasks() { AppPendingTracked[] original; lock (sync) original = tasks.ToArray(); foreach (var task in original) await task.Drain(); }
        internal object[] TaskReport() { lock (sync) return tasks.Select(item => item.Report()).ToArray(); }
        internal object[] GateReport() { lock (sync) return gates.Select(gate => (object)new { gate.Operation, gate.Serial, gate.Claimed, failure = gate.Failure?.Message, entered = gate.Entered.Task.Status.ToString(), released = gate.Release.Task.Status.ToString(), gateExited = gate.GateExited.Task.Status.ToString() }).ToArray(); }
        internal bool GatesDrained { get { lock (sync) return gates.All(gate => gate.Entered.Task.IsCompleted && gate.Release.Task.IsCompleted && gate.GateExited.Task.IsCompleted); } }
        internal void ReleaseAll() { lock (sync) foreach (var gate in gates) { gate.Release.TrySetResult(); if (!gate.Claimed) { gate.Entered.TrySetCanceled(); gate.GateExited.TrySetCanceled(); } } }
        private AppPendingGate? Record(string operation, string? serial, string? subject = null, bool forbidden = false)
        {
            var source = serial is null ? null : Snapshot?.Invoke().SingleOrDefault(info => info.Serial == serial);
            lock (sync) { calls.Add(new(calls.Count + 1, operation, serial, subject, forbidden, Stopwatch.GetTimestamp(), source)); var gate = gates.FirstOrDefault(item => !item.Claimed && item.Operation == operation && item.Serial == serial); if (gate is not null) gate.Claimed = true; return gate; }
        }
        private Task<T> Track<T>(string label, Task<T> task, Exception? expectedFailure = null, bool allowCancellation = false) { lock (sync) tasks.Add(new(label, task, expectedFailure, allowCancellation)); return task; }
        private static async Task HoldGate(AppPendingGate gate, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            gate.Entered.TrySetResult(); try { await gate.Release.Task.WaitAsync(ct); if (gate.Failure is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(gate.Failure).Throw(); } finally { gate.GateExited.TrySetResult(); }
        }
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); Record("Discover", null);
            return Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>>([new() { Serial = "DEMO-001", Name = "应用挂起A", State = "Ready", Width = 160, Height = 240, TransportId = 11 }, new() { Serial = "DEMO-002", Name = "全局目标B", State = "Ready", Width = 160, Height = 240, TransportId = 22 }]);
        }
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); var gate = Record("List", serial); return Track("backend-list:" + serial, List(), gate?.Failure);
            async Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> List()
            {
                lock (sync) { activeLists++; maximumActiveLists = Math.Max(maximumActiveLists, activeLists); }
                try { if (gate is not null) await HoldGate(gate, ct); return [new(ApplicationPackage, "自有应用" + Lists().Length, "1.0")]; }
                finally { lock (sync) activeLists--; }
            }
        }
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            bool allowed; lock (sync) allowed = packageName == ScriptPackage && gates.Any(item => !item.Claimed && item.Operation == "ScriptStart" && item.Serial == serial);
            var gate = Record(allowed ? "ScriptStart" : "Start", serial, packageName, !allowed);
            if (!allowed || gate is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("本专项只允许预先登记的自有脚本stub门，禁止应用启动");
            return Track("backend-script:" + serial, Script(), gate.Failure, allowCancellation: true);
            async Task<string> Script() { await HoldGate(gate, ct); return "own script stub completed; no guest forwarded"; }
        }
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            bool allowed; lock (sync) allowed = gates.Any(item => !item.Claimed && item.Operation == "Push" && item.Serial == serial) && File.Exists(localPath) && Path.GetFileName(localPath) == "own.txt";
            var gate = Record("Push", serial, localPath, !allowed); if (!allowed || gate is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("本专项只允许预先登记的自有Push门");
            return Track("backend-push:" + serial, Push(), allowCancellation: true);
            async Task<bool> Push() { await HoldGate(gate, ct); return true; }
        }
        private Exception Forbidden(string operation, string serial, string? subject = null) { Record(operation, serial, subject, true); return new InvalidOperationException("本专项禁止设备写：" + operation + ":" + serial); }
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Shell", serial, command);
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Tap", serial);
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Swipe", serial);
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Key", serial);
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Text", serial, text);
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Stop", serial, packageName);
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Clear", serial, packageName);
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Install", serial, localPath);
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Uninstall", serial, packageName);
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Pull", serial, remotePath);
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("SetNodeText", serial, text);
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) { Record("UnexpectedRead:Screenshot", serial); throw new InvalidOperationException("本专项禁止截图读取"); }
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) { Record("UnexpectedRead:Dump", serial); throw new InvalidOperationException("本专项禁止节点读取"); }
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync() { ReleaseAll(); return ValueTask.CompletedTask; }
    }
}

using System.IO;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Features;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

internal sealed class ApplicationTargetRow(DeviceInfo info, bool protectedTarget) : ObservableObject
{
    private bool selected;
    public DeviceInfo Info { get; private set; } = info;
    public bool Protected { get; private set; } = protectedTarget;
    public string Serial => Info.Serial;
    public bool Available => Info.Online && !Protected;
    public string Caption => $"{Info.Name}\n{Serial} · {(Protected ? "受保护 / 未核验" : Info.Online ? "已连接" : "未连接")}";
    public bool IsSelected { get => selected; set => Set(ref selected, value); }
    public void Update(DeviceInfo value, bool protectedValue)
    {
        if (Info == value && Protected == protectedValue) return;
        Info = value; Protected = protectedValue; Changed(nameof(Info)); Changed(nameof(Available)); Changed(nameof(Caption));
    }
}

internal sealed class InstalledApplicationRow(ApplicationTarget target, AppInfo app) : ObservableObject
{
    private bool selected;
    private string targetName = target.Name;
    public ApplicationTarget Target { get; } = target;
    public AppInfo App { get; } = app;
    public string Serial => Target.Serial;
    public string TargetName => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetName) ? Target.Serial : targetName;
    public string PackageName => App.PackageName;
    public string Name => App.Name ?? "未提供";
    public string Version => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(App.VersionName) ? "未提供" : App.VersionName;
    public string Kind => App.IsSystem ? "系统" : "用户";
    public bool IsSelected { get => selected; set => Set(ref selected, value); }
    public void UpdateTargetName(string name) => Set(ref targetName, name, nameof(TargetName));
}

internal sealed class ApplicationTaskRow(ApplicationBatchItem item) : ObservableObject
{
    public string Serial => item.Target.Serial;
    public string Subject => item.PackageName ?? Path.GetFileName(item.LocalPath) ?? "应用列表";
    public string Operation => item.Operation switch { ApplicationOperation.List => "读取", ApplicationOperation.Install => "安装", ApplicationOperation.Uninstall => "卸载", ApplicationOperation.Start => "启动", ApplicationOperation.Stop => "停止", _ => "清数据" };
    public ApplicationTaskState ResultState { get; private set; } = ApplicationTaskState.Waiting;
    public string State => ResultState switch { ApplicationTaskState.Waiting => "等待", ApplicationTaskState.Running => "执行中", ApplicationTaskState.Succeeded => "已完成", ApplicationTaskState.CompletedUnverified => "命令完成", ApplicationTaskState.Failed => "失败", _ => "已取消" };
    public string Message { get; private set; } = "等待";
    public bool Terminal => ResultState is not (ApplicationTaskState.Waiting or ApplicationTaskState.Running);
    public void SetResult(ApplicationItemResult result) { ResultState = result.State; Message = result.Message; Changed(nameof(ResultState)); Changed(nameof(State)); Changed(nameof(Message)); Changed(nameof(Terminal)); }
}

    private void SyncApplicationApiSubscription()
    {
        var current = closing || closeApproved ? null : ViewModel.Runtime.Api;
        if (ReferenceEquals(applicationApi, current)) return;
        if (applicationApi is not null) applicationApi.RequestsDrained -= ApplicationRequestsDrained;
        applicationApi = current;
        if (applicationApi is not null) applicationApi.RequestsDrained += ApplicationRequestsDrained;
    }
    private void ApplicationRequestsDrained(object? sender, EventArgs args)
    {
        if (Dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted || Dispatcher.HasShutdownFinished) return;
        Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new Action(() =>
        {

    private static DataGrid ApplicationGrid(object source) => new() { ItemsSource = (System.Collections.IEnumerable)source, MinRowHeight = 46, IsReadOnly = false, AutoGenerateColumns = false, CanUserAddRows = false, CanUserDeleteRows = false, SelectionMode = DataGridSelectionMode.Extended, HeadersVisibility = DataGridHeadersVisibility.Column };

    private AsyncCommand ApplicationCommand(Func<Task> execute, Func<bool> enabled)
    {

        applicationCommands.Add(command); return command;
    }
    private Button ApplicationButton(string icon, string caption, Func<Task> execute, Func<bool> enabled) => Button(icon, caption, ApplicationCommand(execute, enabled));
    private bool ApplicationTargetProtected(string serial)

    private void SyncApplicationTargets()
    {
        if (applicationSyncing || applicationSummary is null) return;

        {
            foreach (var device in ViewModel.Devices)
            {
                if (applicationObservedDevices.Add(device)) device.PropertyChanged += (_, args) => { if (args.PropertyName == nameof(DeviceRow.Info)) SyncApplicationTargets(); };
                var row = applicationTargets.FirstOrDefault(target => target.Serial == device.Serial);

                }

            foreach (var row in applicationRows.ToArray())

    private void ApplicationTargetSelectionChanged()

    private void ScheduleApplicationRead()
    {

        applicationReadTimer ??= new DispatcherTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(350), DispatcherPriority.Background, async (_, _) =>
        {
            applicationReadTimer!.Stop();

            if (CanManageApplicationTargets())
            {
                applicationReadPending = false;
                try { await ReadApplicationListsAsync(); }
                catch (Exception error) { applicationResult.Text = ViewModel.PresentError(error); }
            }

    private ApplicationTarget[] SelectedApplicationTargets() => applicationTargets.Where(row => row.IsSelected).Select(row => ApplicationTarget.Freeze(row.Info)).ToArray();
    private static (string Serial, long Generation, uint? TransportId) ApplicationTargetIdentity(ApplicationTarget target) => (target.Serial, target.Generation, target.TransportId);
    private bool CanManageApplicationTargets() => !applicationRunning && !ViewModel.Busy && !ViewModel.Transferring && !ViewModel.Runtime.Api.HasActiveRequests
        && applicationTargets.Any(row => row.IsSelected) && applicationTargets.Where(row => row.IsSelected).All(row => row.Available && !ApplicationScriptBusy(ViewModel.Runtime, row.Serial));
    private bool CanManageApplicationRows() => CanManageApplicationTargets() && applicationRows.Any(row => row.IsSelected && (applicationSystemToggle.IsChecked == true || !row.App.IsSystem));
    private static bool ApplicationScriptBusy(MatrixRuntime runtime, string serial) => runtime.Scripts.GetStatus(serial).State is ScriptRunState.Running or ScriptRunState.Cancelling;
    private void RefreshApplicationControls()
    {
        if (applicationSummary is null) return;
        applicationSummary.Text = $"已选 {applicationTargets.Count(row => row.IsSelected)} 台 · {applicationRowsView.Cast<object>().Count()} 个应用";
        applicationTargetPanel.IsEnabled = !applicationRunning && !ViewModel.Busy; applicationSystemToggle.IsEnabled = !applicationRunning;
        foreach (var command in applicationCommands) command.Refresh();

    private Task ReadApplicationListsAsync() => RunApplicationPlanAsync(SelectedApplicationTargets().Select(target => new ApplicationBatchItem(target, ApplicationOperation.List)).ToArray());
    private async Task ChooseApplicationPackagesAsync()
    {
        var targets = SelectedApplicationTargets(); var chooser = new OpenFileDialog { Filter = "Android 应用 (*.apk)|*.apk", Multiselect = true, CheckFileExists = true };
        if (chooser.ShowDialog(this) != true) return;
        await RunApplicationPlanAsync(ApplicationBatch.InstallPlan(targets, chooser.FileNames), true);
    }
    private Task ChangeSelectedApplicationsAsync(ApplicationOperation operation)
    {
        var rows = applicationRows.Where(row => row.IsSelected && (applicationSystemToggle.IsChecked == true || !row.App.IsSystem)).Select(row => new ApplicationBatchItem(row.Target with { Name = row.TargetName }, operation, row.PackageName, IsSystem: row.App.IsSystem)).ToArray();
        return RunApplicationPlanAsync(ApplicationBatch.RowPlan(operation, rows), operation is ApplicationOperation.Uninstall or ApplicationOperation.Clear);

    private async Task RunApplicationPlanAsync(IReadOnlyList<ApplicationBatchItem> plan, bool askConfirmation = false)
    {
        if (!CanManageApplicationTargets()) throw new DeviceException("请明确勾选可用模拟器，并等待接口、脚本或传输任务完成。", 409, 1003);
        if (plan.Count == 0) throw new DeviceException("未选择应用任务，未操作设备。", 400, 1007);
        var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime; var frozenSelection = SelectedApplicationTargets();
        foreach (var item in plan)
        {
            if (!frozenSelection.Select(ApplicationTargetIdentity).Contains(ApplicationTargetIdentity(item.Target))) throw new DeviceException($"应用行不属于本次目标：{item.Target.Serial}。", 409, 1003);
            item.Target.RequireSame(runtime.GetDevices().SingleOrDefault(device => device.Serial == item.Target.Serial));
        }
        var confirmed = !askConfirmation || ConfirmApplicationPlan(plan);
        if (!confirmed) { applicationResult.Text = "已取消确认，未操作任何模拟器。"; return; }
        if (!CanManageApplicationTargets() || !ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) || !frozenSelection.Select(ApplicationTargetIdentity).ToHashSet().SetEquals(SelectedApplicationTargets().Select(ApplicationTargetIdentity)))
            throw new DeviceException("确认期间工作区或勾选目标已变化，未发送命令。", 409, 1003);
        var writesDevices = plan.Any(item => item.Operation != ApplicationOperation.List);
        using var write = writesDevices ? runtime.Writes.Acquire(plan.Select(item => item.Target.Serial)) : null;
        applicationReadTimer?.Stop(); applicationReadPending = false; applicationTasks.Clear(); foreach (var item in plan) applicationTasks.Add(new(item));

            await ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("应用批次", async () =>
            {
                async Task Validate(ApplicationTarget target, CancellationToken token)
                {

                    await runtime.Devices.RefreshAsync(token);
                    await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => RequireApplicationContext(runtime, target, writesDevices));
                }
                var batch = new ApplicationBatch(runtime.Backend, Validate);
                var results = await batch.ExecuteAsync(plan, true, result => Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    applicationTasks[result.Index].SetResult(result);
                    if (result.Applications is not null && ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime)) ReplaceApplicationRows(result.Item.Target, result.Applications);
                    applicationProgress.Value = (double)applicationTasks.Count(row => row.Terminal) / applicationTasks.Count; applicationResult.Text = ApplicationBatchSummary(applicationTasks);
                    runtime.Log.Write("application-batch-item", JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { result.Index, result.Item.Target.Serial, result.Item.Operation, result.Item.PackageName, result.State, result.Message }, JsonDefaults.Options), result.Item.Target.Serial);
                }), applicationCancellation.Token);
                if (results.Any(result => result.State == ApplicationTaskState.Failed)) throw new DeviceException(applicationResult.Text + "；请查看逐项结果。", 409, 1003);
            }, blocksApiWrites: !writesDevices);
        }
        finally
        {
            applicationCancellation.Dispose(); applicationCancellation = null; applicationRunning = false; applicationCancel.IsEnabled = false; RefreshApplicationControls();
        }
    }
    private void RequireApplicationContext(MatrixRuntime runtime, ApplicationTarget target, bool ownsWriteLease = false)
    {
        if (!ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) || ViewModel.Transferring || (!ownsWriteLease && runtime.Api.HasActiveRequests) || ApplicationTargetProtected(target.Serial) || ApplicationScriptBusy(runtime, target.Serial)
            || !SelectedApplicationTargets().Select(ApplicationTargetIdentity).Contains(ApplicationTargetIdentity(target)))
            throw new DeviceException($"工作区或并行任务已变化，未继续操作：{target.Serial}。", 409, 1003);
        target.RequireSame(ViewModel.Devices.SingleOrDefault(row => row.Serial == target.Serial)?.Info); target.RequireSame(runtime.GetDevices().SingleOrDefault(device => device.Serial == target.Serial));
    }
    private void ReplaceApplicationRows(ApplicationTarget target, IReadOnlyList<AppInfo> applications)
    {
        var identity = ApplicationTargetIdentity(target);
        var current = applicationTargets.FirstOrDefault(row => row.IsSelected && row.Available && ApplicationTargetIdentity(ApplicationTarget.Freeze(row.Info)) == identity);
        if (current is null) return;
        var selected = applicationRows.Where(row => ApplicationTargetIdentity(row.Target) == identity && row.IsSelected).Select(row => row.PackageName).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var row in applicationRows.Where(row => ApplicationTargetIdentity(row.Target) == identity).ToArray()) applicationRows.Remove(row);
        foreach (var application in applications.OrderBy(app => app.PackageName, StringComparer.Ordinal))
        {
            var row = new InstalledApplicationRow(target with { Name = current.Info.Name }, application) { IsSelected = selected.Contains(application.PackageName) };
            row.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => RefreshApplicationControls(); applicationRows.Add(row);
        }
        RefreshApplicationControls();
    }
    private bool ConfirmApplicationPlan(IReadOnlyList<ApplicationBatchItem> plan)
    {
        var operation = plan[0].Operation; var title = ApplicationOperationCaption(operation);
        var details = string.Join("\n", plan.Select(item => $"{item.Target.Name} ({item.Target.Serial})\n  {item.PackageName ?? Path.GetFileName(item.LocalPath)}"));
        var warning = operation switch
        {
            ApplicationOperation.Uninstall or ApplicationOperation.Clear => "此操作会删除对应应用数据，不可撤销。",
            ApplicationOperation.Install => "已有相同应用可能被覆盖安装；安装后仅刷新列表，不声明 APK 包名已核验。",
            ApplicationOperation.Start => "将向下列应用发送启动命令；命令完成不等于已核验实际运行效果。",
            ApplicationOperation.Stop => "将强制停止下列应用，可能中断未保存的操作；命令完成不等于已核验实际停止效果。",
            _ => "将读取下列模拟器的应用列表。"
        };
        var message = $"共 {plan.Count} 项，{plan.Select(item => item.Target.Serial).Distinct().Count()} 台模拟器。\n{warning}\n\n{details}";
        if (applicationConfirmationFixture is not null) return applicationConfirmationFixture(title, message);
        var dialog = new Window { Owner = this, Title = title, Width = 560, Height = 460, MinWidth = 380, MinHeight = 280, WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner, ShowInTaskbar = false };
        var panel = new DockPanel { Margin = new Thickness(16) }; var buttons = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right, Margin = new Thickness(0, 12, 0, 0) };
        var cancel = new Button { Content = "取消", IsCancel = true, MinWidth = 78 }; var accept = new Button { Content = "确认执行", IsDefault = true, MinWidth = 92 };
        accept.Click += (_, _) => dialog.DialogResult = true; buttons.Children.Add(cancel); buttons.Children.Add(accept); DockPanel.SetDock(buttons, Dock.Bottom); panel.Children.Add(buttons);
        panel.Children.Add(new TextBox { Text = message, IsReadOnly = true, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, AcceptsReturn = true }); dialog.Content = panel; return ShowOwnedDialog(dialog, 560, 460) == true;
    }
    private static string ApplicationOperationCaption(ApplicationOperation operation) => operation switch { ApplicationOperation.List => "读取应用", ApplicationOperation.Install => "安装应用", ApplicationOperation.Uninstall => "卸载应用", ApplicationOperation.Start => "启动应用", ApplicationOperation.Stop => "停止应用", _ => "清除数据" };
    private static string ApplicationBatchSummary(IEnumerable<ApplicationTaskRow> rows)
    {
        var unverified = rows.Count(row => row.ResultState == ApplicationTaskState.CompletedUnverified);
        return $"进度 {rows.Count(row => row.Terminal)}/{rows.Count()} · 已完成 {rows.Count(row => row.ResultState == ApplicationTaskState.Succeeded)}"
            + (unverified > 0 ? $" · 安装命令完成（包名未核验）{unverified}" : "")
            + $" · 失败 {rows.Count(row => row.ResultState == ApplicationTaskState.Failed)} · 取消 {rows.Count(row => row.ResultState == ApplicationTaskState.Cancelled)}";
    }
}

            {

                state.Backend.Change(state.A.Serial, original with { State = "Offline" }); await state.Sync(); before.InspectionSame(state); before.RowCacheSame(state);
                state.Backend.Change(state.A.Serial, state.Backend.Info(state.A.Serial) with { State = "Ready" }); await state.Sync();
                var readyGeneration = state.A.Info.Generation; var readyCleared = state.A.Screenshot is null && state.Vm.DebugImage is null && state.Vm.Nodes.Count == 0;
                state.Observe("new-ready-before-second-offline", new { readyGeneration, readyCleared });
                state.Backend.Change(state.A.Serial, state.Backend.Info(state.A.Serial) with { State = "Offline" }); await state.Sync();
                state.Check(readyGeneration == original.Generation + 2 && state.A.Info.State == "Offline" && state.A.Info.Generation == original.Generation + 3 && readyCleared, "Ready g→Offline g+1历史不改源戳；Ready g+2已撤旧内容再到Offline g+3");

        }
        catch (Exception error) { primary = error; Console.Error.WriteLine("COMPLETED-CACHE-PRIMARY " + error); }

        {
            try { Application.Current.MainWindow = originalMain; Application.Current.ShutdownMode = originalShutdown; LocalizationService.Current.SetLanguage(language); }
            catch (Exception restoreError) { primary = primary is null ? restoreError : new AggregateException("原失败与外层上下文恢复失败", primary, restoreError); }
            try { await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(directory, "completed-cache.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { scope = "自有Demo/STA，真实Catalog与VM/已显示WPF投影/本地PNG JSON；非Android、非物理输入、非原生保存框、非自动首载、非runtime热换", cases = reports, totalCases = reports.Count, passed = reports.Count(report => report is CompletedCacheReport { Passed: true }), failure = primary?.ToString() }, JsonDefaults.Options)); }
            catch (Exception reportError) { primary = primary is null ? reportError : new AggregateException("原失败与报告写入失败", primary, reportError); }
        }
        if (primary is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(primary).Throw();

        async Task Case(string name, Func<CompletedCacheState, Task> action)
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(directory, "c" + (++number).ToString("00")); CompletedCacheState? state = null; Exception? error = null; var cleaned = false;
            try { state = await CompletedCacheState.Create(this, path); await action(state); state.Observe("case-completed"); }
            catch (Exception caught) { error = caught; state?.Observe("case-failed"); Console.Error.WriteLine("COMPLETED-CACHE-CASE " + name + " " + caught); }
            finally
            {
                if (state is not null) try { await state.Cleanup(); cleaned = true; } catch (Exception cleanupError) { error = error is null ? cleanupError : new AggregateException(error, cleanupError); }
                reports.Add(new CompletedCacheReport(name, error is null && cleaned, cleaned, state?.Checks.ToArray() ?? [], state?.Observations.ToArray() ?? [], state?.Backend.Calls() ?? [], state?.Backend.Proofs() ?? [], error?.ToString()));
            }
            if (error is not null)
            {
                failures.Add(new InvalidOperationException(name, error));
                if (state is null || !cleaned) throw new AggregateException("夹具创建/清理未完成，停止接纳后续case", failures);
            }
        }
    }

    private sealed record CompletedCacheReport(string Name, bool Passed, bool Cleanup, string[] Checks, object[] Observations, CompletedCacheCall[] Calls, CompletedCachePayload[] Payloads, string? Failure);
    private static int? CompletedCacheId(object? value) => value is null ? null : System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(value);
    private sealed record CompletedCacheSnapshot(DeviceRow? Current, DeviceRow? Main, DeviceRow[] Targets, DeviceRow[] Rows, bool[] Selections, UnifiedDeviceRow[] UnifiedRows, string[] UnifiedKeys, bool[] UnifiedSelections, PixelSample[] Colors, long InputGeneration, BitmapSource? "", state.Vm.CurrentDevice?.AutomationState ?? "", state.NodeEvents, state.DebugEvents);
        internal void ContextSame(CompletedCacheState state)
        {

            var currentSame = ReferenceEquals(Current, state.Vm.CurrentDevice); var mainSame = ReferenceEquals(Main, state.Vm.MainDevice); var targetsSame = Targets.SequenceEqual(actualTargets);
            var selectionsSame = Selections.SequenceEqual(state.Vm.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected)); var colorsSame = Colors.SequenceEqual(state.Vm.Colors);
            var inputGenerationSame = InputGeneration == state.Vm.Runtime.Input.CurrentGeneration; var busyReleased = !state.Vm.Busy;
            var rowReferencesSame = Rows.SequenceEqual(state.Vm.Devices); var unifiedReferencesSame = UnifiedRows.SequenceEqual(state.Window.unifiedDevices);
            var unifiedKeysSame = UnifiedKeys.SequenceEqual(state.Window.unifiedDevices.Select(row => row.Key)); var unifiedSelectionsSame = UnifiedSelections.SequenceEqual(state.Window.unifiedDevices.Select(row => row.IsSelected));
            var selectedNonOnline = Rows.Where((row, index) => Selections[index] && !row.Info.Online).ToArray();
            var expectedEffective = selectedNonOnline.Length > 0 ? Array.Empty<DeviceRow>() : Targets;
            var effectiveTargetsSame = expectedEffective.SequenceEqual(actualTargets); var canWriteTargets = state.Vm.CanWriteTargets();
            state.Observe("context-components", new
            {
                currentSame, mainSame, targetsSame, selectionsSame, colorsSame, inputGenerationSame, busyReleased,
                rowReferencesSame, unifiedReferencesSame, unifiedKeysSame, unifiedSelectionsSame, effectiveTargetsSame, canWriteTargets,
                expectedCurrent = new { serial = Current?.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(Current) }, actualCurrent = new { serial = state.Vm.CurrentDevice?.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(state.Vm.CurrentDevice) },
                expectedMain = new { serial = Main?.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(Main) }, actualMain = new { serial = state.Vm.MainDevice?.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(state.Vm.MainDevice) },
                expectedTargets = Targets.Select(row => new { row.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(row), row.IsSelected, row.Info.State }).ToArray(),
                expectedEffectiveTargets = expectedEffective.Select(row => new { row.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(row) }).ToArray(), gateSelectedNonOnline = selectedNonOnline.Select(row => new { row.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(row), row.Info.State }).ToArray(),
                actualTargets = actualTargets.Select(row => new { row.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(row), row.IsSelected, row.Info.State }).ToArray(),
                expectedSelections = Selections, expectedRowIds = Rows.Select(CompletedCacheId).ToArray(), actualRows = state.Vm.Devices.Select(row => new { row.Serial, id = CompletedCacheId(row), row.IsSelected, row.Info.State }).ToArray(),
                expectedUnified = UnifiedRows.Select((row, index) => new { id = CompletedCacheId(row), key = UnifiedKeys[index], selected = UnifiedSelections[index] }).ToArray(), actualUnified = state.Window.unifiedDevices.Select(row => new { id = CompletedCacheId(row), row.Key, row.IsSelected, state = row.Device?.Info.State, hasInstance = row.Instance is not null }).ToArray(),
                expectedColors = Colors, actualColors = state.Vm.Colors.ToArray(), expectedInputGeneration = InputGeneration, actualInputGeneration = state.Vm.Runtime.Input.CurrentGeneration, state.Vm.Busy

            state.Check(currentSame && mainSame && rowReferencesSame && selectionsSame && unifiedReferencesSame && unifiedKeysSame && unifiedSelectionsSame && colorsSame && inputGenerationSame && busyReleased, "身份清理保留Current/Main/原设备与统一行引用顺序/key/勾选意图/颜色历史/输入代次且Busy释放");
            state.Check(state.Window.unifiedDevices.All(row => row.Instance is null && row.Device is not null) && effectiveTargetsSame && (selectedNonOnline.Length == 0 || !canWriteTargets), "无LD绑定夹具按冻结勾选意图验证有效目标：含非在线行必须空目标且禁止写入，其余精确保持原目标序列");
        }
        internal void RowCacheSame(CompletedCacheState state) => state.Check(ReferenceEquals(Current?.Screenshot, Image) && Current?.CapturedAt == CapturedAt && Current?.ScreenState == ScreenState && Current?.AutomationState == AutomationState, "合法同源历史保留行截图/接纳时间/截图与自动化状态");
        internal void InspectionSame(CompletedCacheState state)
        {
            var image = ReferenceEquals(Image, state.Vm.DebugImage); var nodes = Nodes.SequenceEqual(state.Vm.Nodes); var selected = ReferenceEquals(Selected, state.Vm.SelectedNode); var properties = Properties == state.Vm.NodeProperties;
            state.Observe("inspection-equality", new { image, nodes, selected, properties, imageBefore = CompletedCacheId(Image), imageAfter = CompletedCacheId(state.Vm.DebugImage), Marker, actualMarker = state.Vm.Nodes.FirstOrDefault()?.Source.Text });
            state.Check(image && nodes && selected && properties && state.Vm.CurrentDevice?.AutomationState == AutomationState && state.Vm.Error.Length == 0, "合法已完成检查保留原图/根/选择/属性/自动化状态且无错误"); state.Projection();
        }
    }
    private sealed class CompletedCacheState
    {
        internal required string Directory; internal required CompletedCacheBackend Backend; internal required WorkspaceViewModel Vm; internal required MainWindow Window;
        internal readonly List<string> Checks = []; internal readonly List<object> Observations = []; private readonly List<Task> operations = [];
        private PropertyChangedEventHandler? vmObserver; private System.Collections.Specialized.NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler? nodesObserver; private bool cleanupStarted;
        internal int NodeEvents; internal int DebugEvents;
        internal DeviceRow A => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-001"); internal DeviceRow B => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-002");
        internal static async Task<CompletedCacheState> Create(MainWindow owner, string directory)
        {
            System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(directory); var backend = new CompletedCacheBackend(); RollingLog? log = null; CatalogRepository? metadata = null; MatrixRuntime? runtime = null; WorkspaceViewModel? vm = null; MainWindow? window = null; CompletedCacheState? state = null; ScriptScheduler? scripts = null; InputCoordinator? input = null; ApiServiceManager? api = null; Task? initializing = null;
            try
            {
                log = new RollingLog(Path.Combine(directory, "logs")); metadata = new CatalogRepository(Path.Combine(directory, "db.sqlite3"));
                var catalog = new DeviceCatalog(backend); var automation = new AutomationService(backend, catalog); scripts = new ScriptScheduler(backend); input = new InputCoordinator(catalog, backend); api = new ApiServiceManager(catalog, backend, automation, log);
                var settings = new AppSettings { AutoStartApi = false, AutoConnect = false, SyncMouse = false, SyncKeyboard = false, Language = "zh-CN", WindowWidth = 1000, WindowHeight = 700 };
                runtime = new MatrixRuntime { Backend = backend, Devices = catalog, Automation = automation, Scripts = scripts, Input = input, Api = api, Log = log, Metadata = metadata, Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings, SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json")), IsDemo = true };
                api.DeviceSnapshotProvider = runtime.GetDevices; vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(runtime, directory, true); initializing = vm.RefreshDevicesAsync(); await initializing.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
                window = new MainWindow(vm) { Owner = owner, ShowActivated = false }; state = new CompletedCacheState { Directory = directory, Backend = backend, Vm = vm, Window = window };
                state.vmObserver = (_, args) => { if (args.PropertyName == nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.DebugImage)) state.DebugEvents++; }; vm.PropertyChanged += state.vmObserver;
                state.nodesObserver = (_, _) => state.NodeEvents++; vm.Nodes.CollectionChanged += state.nodesObserver;
                window.Show(); await state.Idle(); window.NavigateTo("节点"); await state.Idle();
                state.Check(vm.Demo && runtime.IsDemo && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Backend, backend) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Devices, catalog) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Automation, automation) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Input, input) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Scripts, scripts) && ReferenceEquals(runtime.Api, api) && !api.BasicRunning && !api.AutomatorRunning && api.DevicePorts.Count == 0 && !window.DebugAutomaticFixturePermitted && !window.debugAutoLoading && !window.debugAutoPending && backend.ReadCount == 0, "一致自有Demo/默认自动首载保护，API未启、导航无设备读");
                await state.Run(vm.SetMainAsync(state.B)); vm.CurrentDevice = state.A; state.A.IsSelected = state.B.IsSelected = true; await state.Idle(); backend.ClearTrace(); state.NodeEvents = state.DebugEvents = 0; state.Observe("created"); return state;
            }
            catch (Exception error)
            {
                var cleanupErrors = new List<Exception>();

                else
                {
                    try { if (window is not null) { LocalizationService.Current.LanguageChanged -= window.OnLanguageChanged; window.AbortStartup(); } } catch (Exception cleanupError) { cleanupErrors.Add(cleanupError); }
                    if (initializing is not null) await Attempt(() => initializing.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                    if (vm is not null) await Attempt(() => vm.ShutdownAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                    else if (runtime is not null) await Attempt(() => runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                    else
                    {
                        if (api is not null) await Attempt(() => api.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                        if (input is not null) await Attempt(() => input.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                        if (scripts is not null) await Attempt(() => scripts.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                        await Attempt(() => backend.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                        try { metadata?.Dispose(); } catch (Exception cleanupError) { cleanupErrors.Add(cleanupError); }
                        if (log is not null) await Attempt(() => log.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)));
                    }
                }
                if (cleanupErrors.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("夹具初始化与清理失败", new[] { error }.Concat(cleanupErrors)); throw;
                async Task Attempt(Func<Task> action) { try { await action(); } catch (Exception cleanupError) { cleanupErrors.Add(cleanupError); } }
            }
        }
        internal Task Run(Task task) { operations.Add(task); return task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
        internal async Task Idle() { await Window.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(Window.UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Window.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
        internal async Task Sync() { await Run(Vm.RefreshDeviceSnapshotAsync()); await Idle(); Observe("catalog-applied"); }
        internal async Task Seed() { await Recover(); Vm.SelectedNode = Vm.FlattenNodes().First(node => node.Source.Clickable); Vm.SamplePixel(3, 4); await Idle(); Check(Vm.SelectedNode is not null && Vm.Colors.Count == 1, "显式完成内容建立真实节点选择与像素历史"); }
        internal async Task Recover()
        {
            var calls = Backend.Calls().Length; var serial = Vm.CurrentDevice!.Serial; await Run(Vm.LoadNodesAsync()); await Idle();
            Check(Backend.Calls().Skip(calls).Select(call => call.Operation + ":" + call.Serial).SequenceEqual(new[] { "Discover:", "Screenshot:" + serial, "Dump:" + serial }), "显式请求真实调用顺序严格为Discover→当前源Screenshot→Dump");
            Check(!Vm.Busy && Vm.Error.Length == 0 && Vm.Nodes.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(Vm.DebugImage, Vm.CurrentDevice?.Screenshot) && Vm.Nodes.Single().Source.Text == Backend.LastDump(serial), "显式完成内容有可追溯节点标记且无错误"); Projection(); Observe("explicit-completed");
        }
        internal void Projection() => Check(ReferenceEquals(Window.screenshotImage.Source, Vm.DebugImage) && Window.nodeTree.Items.Count == Vm.Nodes.Count && Window.nodeTreeItems.Count == Vm.FlattenNodes().Count() && Window.nodeRectangles.Count == Vm.FlattenNodes().Count(node => node.Source.Bounds.Width > 0 && node.Source.Bounds.Height > 0) && (Vm.DebugImage is null ? !Window.nodeCanvas.Children.OfType<Image>().Any() : Window.nodeCanvas.Children.OfType<Image>().Any(image => ReferenceEquals(image.Source, Vm.DebugImage))), "原MainWindow回调的真实截图/Tree/Canvas投影与VM一致");
        internal bool SameTransportGeometry(DeviceInfo a, DeviceInfo b) => a.Serial == b.Serial && a.TransportId == b.TransportId && a.Width == b.Width && a.Height == b.Height && a.Rotation == b.Rotation;
        internal void NewReady(DeviceInfo original, long increment = 1) => Check(A.Info.Online && A.Info.Generation == original.Generation + increment, "真实Catalog换代后的Ready代次精确增长" + increment);
        internal void Cleared(DeviceRow row)
        {
            Observe("expect-invalidated"); Check(row.Screenshot is null && row.CapturedAt is null && row.ScreenState != "截图可用" && row.AutomationState != "节点可用", "换代行撤下旧Screenshot/时间/可用状态");
            if (ReferenceEquals(row, Vm.CurrentDevice)) { Check(Vm.DebugImage is null && Vm.Nodes.Count == 0 && Vm.SelectedNode is null && Vm.NodeProperties == "未选中节点" && Window.nodeTree.Items.Count == 0 && Window.nodeRectangles.Count == 0 && Window.crop is null, "换代当前检查撤下旧图/根/选择/属性及实际节点覆盖，原画布裁剪字段为空"); Projection(); }
        }
        internal void NoReadsAfter(int callCount) => Check(Backend.Calls().Skip(callCount).All(call => call.Operation == "Discover"), "身份同步/本地消费没有额外Screenshot或Dump设备读");
        internal async Task RejectExports(string prefix)
        {
            foreach (var format in new[] { "png", "json" })
            {
                var path = Path.Combine(Directory, prefix + "." + format); await Run(format == "png" ? Vm.SaveScreenshotAsync(path) : Vm.ExportNodesAsync(path)); ObserveFile("invalidated-export", path); Check(!File.Exists(path), "身份换代清理后的" + format + "不导出旧产物");
            }
        }
        internal async Task ExportPair(string prefix, BitmapSource image, string marker) { await ExportPng(prefix + ".png", image); var path = Path.Combine(Directory, prefix + ".json"); await Run(Vm.ExportNodesAsync(path)); ObserveFile("json-export", path); Check(File.Exists(path), "合法节点JSON实际创建"); var node = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AndroidNode>(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(path), JsonDefaults.Options); Check(node?.Text == marker, "磁盘JSON包含当前合法检查根标记而非其他缓存"); }
        internal async Task ExportPng(string name, BitmapSource image)
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(Directory, name); await Run(Vm.SaveScreenshotAsync(path)); ObserveFile("png-export", path); Check(File.Exists(path), "合法截图PNG实际创建");
            using var stream = File.OpenRead(path); var actual = BitmapFrame.Create(stream, BitmapCreateOptions.PreservePixelFormat, BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad); var expectedPixels = Pixels(image); var actualPixels = Pixels(actual);
            Observe("png-pixels", new { expectedWidth = image.PixelWidth, expectedHeight = image.PixelHeight, actual.PixelWidth, actual.PixelHeight, expected = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(expectedPixels)), actual = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(actualPixels)) });
            Check(actual.PixelWidth == image.PixelWidth && actual.PixelHeight == image.PixelHeight && actualPixels.SequenceEqual(expectedPixels), "磁盘PNG完整像素与合法检查源一致");
        }
        private static byte[] Pixels(BitmapSource image) { var converted = new FormatConvertedBitmap(image, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null, 0); var bytes = new byte[checked(image.PixelWidth * image.PixelHeight * 4)]; converted.CopyPixels(bytes, checked(image.PixelWidth * 4), 0); return bytes; }
        internal void ObserveFile(string stage, string path)
        {
            object? content = null; var exists = File.Exists(path);
            if (exists && Path.GetExtension(path) == ".json") { var root = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AndroidNode>(File.ReadAllText(path), JsonDefaults.Options); content = new { rootMarker = root?.Text, children = root?.ChildNodeList.Count }; }
            if (exists && Path.GetExtension(path) == ".png")
            {

                content = new { image.PixelWidth, image.PixelHeight, pixelSha256 = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(pixels)), firstBgra = pixels.Take(4).ToArray(), lastBgra = pixels.TakeLast(4).ToArray() };

        }
        internal void Check(bool value, string message) { if (!value) { Observe("assertion-failed", new { message }); throw new InvalidOperationException(message); } Checks.Add(message); }
        internal void Observe(string stage, object? detail = null) => Observations.Add(new { stage, detail, Vm.Busy, Vm.Error, Vm.Status, current = Vm.CurrentDevice?.Serial, currentId = CompletedCacheId(Vm.CurrentDevice), main = Vm.MainDevice?.Serial, imageId = CompletedCacheId(Vm.DebugImage), rootMarker = Vm.Nodes.FirstOrDefault()?.Source.Text, nodes = Vm.Nodes.Count, selectedId = CompletedCacheId(Vm.SelectedNode), tree = Window.nodeTree.Items.Count, rectangles = Window.nodeRectangles.Count, NodeEvents, DebugEvents, rows = Vm.Devices.Select(row => new { row.Serial, row.Info.State, row.Info.Generation, row.Info.TransportId, row.Info.Width, row.Info.Height, row.Info.Rotation, id = CompletedCacheId(row), image = CompletedCacheId(row.Screenshot), row.CapturedAt, row.ScreenState, row.AutomationState }).ToArray(), catalog = Vm.Runtime.GetDevices().ToArray() });

            try { Observe("cleanup-drained"); Check(!Vm.Busy && !Window.debugAutoLoading && !Window.debugAutoPending && Backend.GatesDrained, "自有操作/TCS排空且默认Demo自动泵未启动"); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
