```csharp
    private async Task VerifyDeviceActionLabelsAsync()
    {
        var failures = new List<string>(); var observations = new List<object>(); var checks = new List<string>();
        var originalCurrent = ViewModel.CurrentDevice; var originalMain = ViewModel.MainDevice; var originalPage = tabs.SelectedItem;
        var originalFocus = Keyboard.FocusedElement; var originalSelection = unifiedDevices.Select(row => (row.Key, row.IsSelected)).ToArray();
        void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (condition) checks.Add(message); else failures.Add(message); }
        async Task Settle() { await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle); await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render); await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle); }
        Check(AutomationProperties.GetName(wallSelectAll) == "选择当前筛选中可勾选的设备", "实际表头自动化名精确描述范围");
        Check(wallSelectAll.ToolTip as string == "勾选当前筛选结果中可勾选的设备；取消勾选清除全部选择（包括被筛选隐藏的设备），不删除设备或数据。", "实际表头提示包括当前筛选/隐藏清除/不删除");
        var row = new UnifiedDeviceRow("label-fixture", ActivateUnifiedRowAsync, CanActivateUnifiedRow, _ => Task.CompletedTask, _ => false, _ => Task.CompletedTask);
        var command = row.PrimaryCommand;
        var tile = new UnifiedDeviceTile { Owner = this, DataContext = row };
        var overlay = new Border { Child = tile, Background = ThemeBrush("SurfaceBrush"), Width = Math.Min(550, Shell.ActualWidth), Height = 100, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top };
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(overlay, 2); System.Windows.Controls.Panel.SetZIndex(overlay, 1000); Shell.Children.Add(overlay);
        var stopped = new LdPlayerInstance(8, "文案夹具", 0, 0, false, -1, -1);
        var running = stopped with { AndroidStarted = true, ProcessId = 81, VBoxProcessId = 82, TopWindow = 83, BindWindow = 84 };
        var device = new DeviceRow(new DeviceInfo { Serial = "label-device", State = "Ready" });
        const string admission = "重新检查实例；明确关闭时尝试启动，过渡或信息不完整时等待，核验ADB、安卓启动与截图后连接；可能失败或超时。";
        const string debug = "打开此设备的界面检查，不启动或重启模拟器。";
        const string protectedDescription = "受保护编号；此入口不自动启动或接入该实例。";
        var sequence = new (string Case, LdPlayerInstance? Instance, DeviceRow? Device, bool Connected, string Phase, string Label, string Description, bool Enabled)[]
        {
            ("冷态", stopped, null, false, "已取消", "启动", "当前观察为已关闭。" + admission, false),
            ("启动中", stopped with { IsStarting = true }, null, false, "已连接", "等待连接", "当前观察为启动中。" + admission, false),
            ("未知残留", stopped with { ProcessId = 81 }, null, false, "已连接", "接入", "当前状态尚未确认。" + admission, false),
            ("有效运行", running, null, false, "启动失败", "连接", "当前观察为安卓已启动。" + admission, false),
            ("已核验连接", running, device, true, "已取消", "调试", debug, true),
            ("已连接但启动标志矛盾", running with { IsStarting = true }, device, true, "", "调试", debug, true),
            ("已连接保护编号仍走原调试分支", running with { Index = 0 }, device, true, "", "调试", debug, true),
            ("连接标记但Device为空", running, null, true, "", "接入", "当前状态尚未确认。" + admission, true),
            ("安卓标志但缺PID", running with { VBoxProcessId = 0 }, null, false, "", "接入", "当前状态尚未确认。" + admission, false),
            ("未连接保护0", stopped with { Index = 0 }, null, false, "", "受保护", protectedDescription, false),
            ("未连接保护99999", stopped with { Index = 99999 }, null, false, "", "受保护", protectedDescription, false)
        };
        try
        {
            await Settle();
            foreach (var item in sequence)
            {
                row.Update(item.Instance, item.Device, item.Connected, item.Phase); await Settle();
                var button = VisualDescendants<Button>(tile).First();
                var caption = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(button).Last().Text;
                var name = AutomationProperties.GetName(button); var tooltip = button.ToolTip as string;
                Check(caption == item.Label && row.PrimaryLabel == item.Label && name == item.Label, "实际行按钮文本/自动化名随同一row更新：" + item.Case);
                Check(tooltip == item.Description && BindingOperations.GetBinding(button, ToolTipProperty)?.Path.Path == "PrimaryDescription", "实际行按钮描述保持动态绑定：" + item.Case);
                Check(ReferenceEquals(row.PrimaryCommand, command) && ReferenceEquals(button.Command, command) && command.CanExecute(null) == item.Enabled && button.IsEnabled == item.Enabled, "命令对象与原Demo门禁不受文案改变：" + item.Case);
                observations.Add(new { item.Case, expectedLabel = item.Label, actualLabel = caption, automationName = name, tooltip, expectedEnabled = item.Enabled, enabled = button.IsEnabled, canExecute = command.CanExecute(null), row.FilterState });
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            Shell.Children.Remove(overlay); tile.Owner = null; tile.DataContext = null;
            if (originalFocus is UIElement { IsVisible: true, IsEnabled: true } focus) focus.Focus();
        }
        Check(!Shell.Children.Contains(overlay) && ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.CurrentDevice, originalCurrent) && ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.MainDevice, originalMain) && ReferenceEquals(tabs.SelectedItem, originalPage) && originalSelection.SequenceEqual(unifiedDevices.Select(row => (row.Key, row.IsSelected))), "专项不改变视图/目标/选择并清理临时控件");
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "device-action-labels.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { status = failures.Count == 0 ? "PASS-OFFLINE" : "FAIL", scope = "actual bound row controls and immutable command identity; demo guard observations only, commands never invoked", header = new { name = AutomationProperties.GetName(wallSelectAll), tooltip = wallSelectAll.ToolTip }, assertions = checks.Count, failures, checks, observations }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        if (failures.Count != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("设备操作文案验收失败：" + string.Join("；", failures));
    }
}
```

```csharp
        void Case(string name, Action action)
        {
            activeCase = name;
            try { action(); reports.Add(new { name, status = "PASS", error = (string?)null }); }
            catch (Exception error) { failures.Add(error); reports.Add(new { name, status = "FAIL", error = error.ToString() }); }
        }
        void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(activeCase + ": " + message); }
        DeviceLayoutReportCall Call(Func<string> destination, Func<object> payload, Exception? prior = null, bool expectedError = false)
        {
            var destinations = 0; var payloads = 0; var previous = Console.Error; using var captured = new StringWriter(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture); Exception? returned;
            try { Console.SetError(new DeviceLayoutReportTee(previous, captured)); returned = SaveDeviceLayoutReport(() => { destinations++; return destination(); }, () => { payloads++; return payload(); }, prior); }
            finally { Console.SetError(previous); }
            var stderr = captured.ToString(); var classification = stderr.Length == 0 ? "NONE" : expectedError ? "EXPECTED-REPORT-ERROR" : "UNEXPECTED-REPORT-ERROR";
            var entry = new { caseName = activeCase, expectedReportError = expectedError, stderrClassification = classification, stderrForwarded = true, stderr, destinations, payloads, priorError = prior?.ToString(), returnedError = returned?.ToString() };
            observations.Add(entry); if (expectedError) expectedReportErrors.Add(entry);
            return new(returned, stderr, destinations, payloads);
        }
        void Written(string name, object payload, Action<JsonElement> verify, Exception? prior = null)
        {
            var target = Path.Combine(directory, name); var call = Call(() => target, () => payload, prior);
            Check(ReferenceEquals(call.Failure, prior) && call.Stderr.Length == 0 && call.Destinations == 1 && call.Payloads == 1, "实际报告出口成功且保留同一 prior 引用、factory 各一次");
            Check(File.Exists(target), "实际报告文件存在"); using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(target)); FiniteNumbers(document.RootElement); verify(document.RootElement);
        }
        void PreservedFailure(string name, Exception prior)
        {
            void VerifyOriginal(JsonElement root)
            {
                Check(root.GetProperty("status").GetString() == "FAIL" && root.GetProperty("phase").GetString() == "offline-reject-marker" && root.GetProperty("error").GetString() == prior.ToString(), "原 FAIL/phase/error 全文保真，不把已有失败消解为 PASS");
                if (prior is AggregateException aggregate) Check(ReferenceEquals(aggregate.InnerExceptions[0], original) && ReferenceEquals(aggregate.InnerExceptions[1], cleanup), "原 assertion/cleanup 引用及顺序不变");
            }
            Written(name, new { status = "FAIL", phase = "offline-reject-marker", error = prior.ToString(), observations = new List<object> { new { finite = 1.25 } } }, VerifyOriginal, prior);
            Written("nonfinite-" + name, new { status = "FAIL", phase = "offline-reject-marker", error = prior.ToString(), observations = new List<object> { new { finite = 1.25, nonfinite = double.NaN } } }, root => { VerifyOriginal(root); Nonfinite(root.GetProperty("observations")[0].GetProperty("nonfinite"), "NaN"); }, prior);
        }
        void ReportFailure(DeviceLayoutReportCall call, Exception? prior, Func<Exception, bool> expected)
        {
            Exception? reportError = call.Failure;
            if (prior is not null)
            {
                Check(call.Failure is AggregateException aggregate && aggregate.InnerExceptions.Count == 2 && ReferenceEquals(aggregate.InnerExceptions[0], prior) && aggregate.Message.StartsWith("验收与报告保存均失败", StringComparison.Ordinal), "原 prior 在首位，报告异常在第二位，原聚合文案不变");
                reportError = ((AggregateException)call.Failure!).InnerExceptions[1];
            }
            Check(reportError is not null && expected(reportError) && call.Stderr.Contains(reportError.ToString(), StringComparison.Ordinal), "真实报告错误类型/对象及原 stderr 全文保留");
        }
        void Nonfinite(JsonElement value, string kind) => Check(value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && value.GetProperty("value").ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null && !value.GetProperty("finite").GetBoolean() && value.GetProperty("kind").GetString() == kind, "非有限数明确 value:null/finite:false/kind=" + kind);
        void FiniteNumbers(JsonElement value)
        {
            if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number) Check(double.IsFinite(value.GetDouble()), "标准 JSON 中实际 number 必须有限");
            else if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array) foreach (var item in value.EnumerateArray()) FiniteNumbers(item);
            else if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object) foreach (var item in value.EnumerateObject()) FiniteNumbers(item.Value);
        }
        static Exception Caught(string marker) { try { throw new InvalidOperationException(marker); } catch (Exception error) { return error; } }
    }
    private sealed record DeviceLayoutReportCall(Exception? Failure, string Stderr, int Destinations, int Payloads);
    private sealed class DeviceLayoutReportTee(TextWriter original, TextWriter captured) : TextWriter
    {
        public override Encoding Encoding => original.Encoding;
        public override void Write(char value) { original.Write(value); captured.Write(value); }
        public override void Write(string? value) { original.Write(value); captured.Write(value); }
        public override void WriteLine(string? value) { original.WriteLine(value); captured.WriteLine(value); }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Features;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

internal static class DeviceWriteWorkspaceSmoke
{
    internal static async Task RunAsync(string directory, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        var app = Application.Current;
        if (app is null || !ReferenceEquals(app.Dispatcher, dispatcher) || !dispatcher.CheckAccess()
            || Thread.CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() != ApartmentState.STA || app.Windows.Count != 0 || app.MainWindow is not null
            || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(directory) || !directory.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "artifacts" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || Directory.Exists(directory) || File.Exists(directory))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Write ownership acceptance requires a fresh artifacts directory and an owned windowless STA application.");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        var results = new List<CaseResult>();
        var retained = new List<Fixture>();
        await Case("text-A-holds-API-A-rejects-B-and-read-continue", async f =>
        {
            f.Backend.HoldText = true; f.Vm.TextInput = "owned-A";
            var writing = f.Track(f.Vm.SendTextAsync()); await f.Observe(f.Backend.Entered.Task);
            f.Check(f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001") && !f.Runtime.Api.UiWriteBusy, "VM text has a targeted lease, not a global HTTP block.");
            await f.CheckApi(HttpStatusCode.Conflict, HttpStatusCode.OK);
            f.Backend.Release.TrySetResult(); await f.Wait(writing);
            f.Check(f.Vm.Error.Length == 0 && !f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001"), "Completed text releases its original lease.");
        });
        await Case("upload-install-keeps-lease-during-cancel", async f =>
        {
            f.Backend.HoldPush = true; f.Backend.HoldInstall = true;
            var apk = Path.Combine(f.Directory, "owned-demo.apk"); await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(apk, [1, 2, 3]);
            f.Vm.QueuePush(apk, true); var transferring = f.Track(f.Vm.StartTransfersAsync());
            await f.Observe(f.Backend.Entered.Task); f.Check(f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001") && !f.Runtime.Api.UiWriteBusy, "Upload holds A without blocking B.");
            await f.CheckApi(HttpStatusCode.Conflict, HttpStatusCode.OK);
            f.Backend.Release.TrySetResult(); await f.Observe(f.Backend.InstallEntered.Task);
            f.Check(f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001"), "The lease spans Push through Install.");
            f.Vm.CancelTransfersCommand.Execute(null);
            f.Check(!transferring.IsCompleted && f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001"), "Cancellation does not release an ignored in-flight install.");
            await f.CheckApi(HttpStatusCode.Conflict, HttpStatusCode.OK);
            f.Backend.InstallRelease.TrySetResult(); await f.Wait(transferring);
            f.Check(!f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001") && !f.Vm.Transferring, "Original transfer and install drained before release.");
        });
        await Case("busy-B-rejects-whole-VM-text-group", async f =>
        {
            f.Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-002").IsSelected = true;
            using (f.Writes.Acquire(["DEMO-002"]))
            {
                f.Vm.TextInput = "must-not-send"; await f.Wait(f.Vm.SendTextAsync());
                f.Check(f.Vm.Error.Length > 0 && !f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001") && f.Backend.Calls.All(call => call.Operation != "Text"), "Busy B rejects the entire group without writing or retaining A.");
            }
        });
        await Case("shell-failure-releases-VM-lease", async f =>
        {
            f.Backend.HoldShell = true; f.Vm.ShellInput = "owned-failure";
            var writing = f.Track(f.Vm.ExecuteShellAsync()); await f.Observe(f.Backend.Entered.Task);
            f.Check(f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001"), "Shell holds its complete operation.");
            f.Backend.Release.TrySetResult(); await f.Wait(writing);
            f.Check(f.Vm.Error.Length > 0 && f.Vm.ShellInput.Length == 0 && !f.Writes.IsBusy("DEMO-001"), "Original shell failure is visible and its lease is released.");
        });
        await Case("VM-busy-Up-clears-cached-Down", async f =>
        {
            var a = f.Vm.CurrentDevice!.Info;
            var input = new InputSnapshot { SourceSerial = a.Serial, SourceGeneration = a.Generation,
                Generation = f.Runtime.Input.CurrentGeneration, GestureId = 701, SourceWidth = a.Width, SourceHeight = a.Height,
                X = 10, Y = 10, Kind = InputKind.Down };
            await f.Wait(f.Vm.SendInputAsync(input));
            f.Backend.HoldStart = true;
            var script = new ScriptPackage { Manifest = new ScriptManifest { Id = "owned-write", Name = "Owned write", Version = "1" },
                Steps = [new ScriptStep { Action = "launchapp", Value = "com.android.settings" }] };
            var running = f.Track(f.Runtime.Scripts.RunAsync(a.Serial, script));
            await f.Observe(f.Backend.Entered.Task);
            await f.Wait(f.Vm.SendInputAsync(input with { Kind = InputKind.Up }));
            f.Check(f.Vm.Error.Length > 0, "The original UI script-busy refusal remains visible.");
            f.Backend.Release.TrySetResult(); await f.Wait(running);
            await f.Wait(f.Vm.SendInputAsync(input with { Kind = InputKind.Up }));
            f.Check(f.Backend.Calls.All(call => call.Operation != "Tap" && call.Operation != "Swipe"), "A repeated UI Up cannot send the abandoned gesture after the script completes.");
        });
        var windowsUnchanged = app.Windows.Count == 0 && app.MainWindow is null;
        var pass = windowsUnchanged && retained.Count == 0 && results.Count == 5 && results.All(row => row.Passed);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "summary.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            status = pass ? "PASS-WRITE-OWNERSHIP-VM-NOT-GUI" : "FAIL-WRITE-OWNERSHIP-VM", results, windowsUnchanged, retainedOwners = retained.Count,
            scope = "Owned Demo backend, actual WorkspaceViewModel text/transfer/auto-install/Shell/Input and loopback HTTP. No Window, physical input, real emulator or ADB. The APK is inert bytes accepted only by Demo.",
            untested = new[] { "physical GUI", "ApplicationsView actual picker/confirmation", "real simulator", "cross-process ownership", "Runtime swap", "final dual 30 minutes" }
        }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        if (!pass) throw new InvalidOperationException("Write ownership VM cases did not all pass; preserve the report.");

        async Task Case(string name, Func<Fixture, Task> body)
        {
            if (retained.Count != 0)
            {
                results.Add(new(name, "NOT-RUN", false, "A previous fixture did not prove cleanup; no later owner was created.", null, [], [], []));
                return;
            }
            var f = new Fixture(Path.Combine(directory, "case-" + (results.Count + 1)));
            Exception? error = null; Exception? cleanup = null;
            try { await f.Initialize(); await body(f); }
            catch (Exception failure) { error = failure; }
            finally { try { await f.Cleanup(); } catch (Exception failure) { cleanup = failure; } }
            results.Add(new CaseResult(name, error is null && cleanup is null ? "PASS" : "FAIL", error is null && cleanup is null, error?.ToString(), cleanup?.ToString(), f.Checks.ToArray(), f.Backend.Calls.ToArray(), f.Tasks.Select(task => task.Status.ToString()).ToArray()));
            if (cleanup is not null) retained.Add(f);
        }
    }

    private sealed record CaseResult(string Name, string Status, bool Passed, string? Error, string? CleanupError, string[] Checks, Call[] Calls, string[] Tasks);
    private sealed record Call(string Operation, string Serial);

    private sealed class Fixture(string directory)
    {
        internal string Directory => directory;
        internal readonly DeviceWriteCoordinator Writes = new();
        internal readonly HeldDemoBackend Backend = new();
        internal readonly List<Task> Tasks = [];
        internal readonly List<string> Checks = [];
        internal MatrixRuntime Runtime = null!;
        internal WorkspaceViewModel Vm = null!;
        private RollingLog? log;
        private CatalogRepository? metadata;
        private ScriptScheduler? scripts;
        private InputCoordinator? input;
        private ApiServiceManager? api;
        private readonly HttpClient client = new() { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8) };
        private int portA, portB;
        internal Task Track(Task task) { Tasks.Add(task); return task; }
        internal Task<T> Track<T>(Task<T> task) { Tasks.Add(task); return task; }
        internal async Task Wait(Task task) { if (!Tasks.Contains(task)) Tasks.Add(task); await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)); }
        internal Task Observe(Task signal) => signal.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        internal void Check(bool value, string message) { Checks.Add(message); if (!value) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }
        internal async Task Initialize()
        {
            System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            var settings = new AppSettings { AutoStartApi = false, AutoConnect = false, SyncKeyboard = false, SyncMouse = false, AdbAllowedSerials = [], LdSerialBindings = [], AdbPath = "", LdConsolePath = "" };
            var catalog = new DeviceCatalog(Backend); var ownLog = new RollingLog(Path.Combine(directory, "logs")); log = ownLog;
            var automation = new AutomationService(Backend, catalog);
            var ownScripts = new ScriptScheduler(Backend, Writes); scripts = ownScripts;
            var ownInput = new InputCoordinator(catalog, Backend, Writes); input = ownInput;
            var ownApi = new ApiServiceManager(catalog, Backend, automation, ownLog, Writes); api = ownApi;
            var ownMetadata = new CatalogRepository(Path.Combine(directory, "db.sqlite3")); metadata = ownMetadata;
            Runtime = new MatrixRuntime { Writes = Writes, Backend = Backend, Devices = catalog, Scripts = ownScripts, Input = ownInput, Api = ownApi, Automation = automation,
                Log = ownLog, Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings, SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json")),
                Metadata = ownMetadata, IsDemo = true };
            Vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(Runtime, directory, true);
            await Wait(Vm.RefreshDevicesAsync());
            Vm.CurrentDevice = Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-001");
            foreach (var row in Vm.Devices) row.IsSelected = row.Serial == "DEMO-001";
            portA = await ownApi.StartDeviceAsync("DEMO-001"); portB = await ownApi.StartDeviceAsync("DEMO-002");
        }
        internal async Task CheckApi(HttpStatusCode a, HttpStatusCode b)
        {
            var beforeA = Backend.Calls.Count(call => call.Serial == "DEMO-001" && call.Operation == "Text");
            var beforeB = Backend.Calls.Count(call => call.Serial == "DEMO-002" && call.Operation == "Text");
            using var responseA = await Track(client.PostAsJsonAsync($"http://127.0.0.1:{portA}/text", new { Text = "peer-A" }));
            using var responseB = await Track(client.PostAsJsonAsync($"http://127.0.0.1:{portB}/text", new { Text = "peer-B" }));
            using var read = await Track(client.GetAsync($"http://127.0.0.1:{portA}/device"));
            Check(responseA.StatusCode == a && responseB.StatusCode == b && read.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK, "HTTP A/B admission and read status match the held VM operation.");
            Check(Backend.Calls.Count(call => call.Serial == "DEMO-001" && call.Operation == "Text") == beforeA, "This rejected HTTP request did not write A before returning conflict.");
            Check(Backend.Calls.Count(call => call.Serial == "DEMO-002" && call.Operation == "Text") == beforeB + 1, "This HTTP request reached B exactly once while A remained held.");
        }
        internal async Task Cleanup()
        {
            Backend.Release.TrySetResult(); Backend.InstallRelease.TrySetResult();
            foreach (var task in Tasks.ToArray()) { try { await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12)); } catch when (task.IsCompleted) { } }
            foreach (var task in Backend.Tasks.ToArray()) { if (!Tasks.Contains(task)) Tasks.Add(task); try { await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12)); } catch when (task.IsCompleted) { } }
            if (Vm is not null) await ObserveCleanup(Vm.ShutdownAsync());
            else if (Runtime is not null) await ObserveCleanup(Runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            else
            {
                if (api is not null) await ObserveCleanup(api.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
                if (input is not null) await ObserveCleanup(input.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
                if (scripts is not null) await ObserveCleanup(scripts.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
                await ObserveCleanup(Backend.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
                metadata?.Dispose();
                if (log is not null) await ObserveCleanup(log.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            }
            client.Dispose();
            Check(Tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted) && Backend.Tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted), "Original tasks and forwarding operations are terminal.");
            using var noOutstandingLeases = Writes.AcquireAll();
        }
        private async Task ObserveCleanup(Task task) { Tasks.Add(task); await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12)); }
    }

    private sealed class HeldDemoBackend : IDeviceBackend
    {
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend inner = new();
        internal readonly ConcurrentQueue<Call> Calls = new();
        internal readonly ConcurrentQueue<Task> Tasks = new();
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Release = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource InstallEntered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource InstallRelease = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal bool HoldText, HoldPush, HoldInstall, HoldShell, HoldStart;
        private Task Forward(string operation, string serial, Func<Task> action)
        {
            Calls.Enqueue(new(operation, serial)); var task = Execute(); Tasks.Enqueue(task); return task;
            async Task Execute()
            {
                if (serial == "DEMO-001" && (operation == "Text" && HoldText || operation == "Push" && HoldPush || operation == "Shell" && HoldShell || operation == "StartApp" && HoldStart))
                { Entered.TrySetResult(); await Release.Task; }
                if (serial == "DEMO-001" && operation == "Install" && HoldInstall) { InstallEntered.TrySetResult(); await InstallRelease.Task; }
                await action();
            }
        }
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.DiscoverAsync(ct);
        public async Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            string output = "";
            await Forward("Shell", serial, async () => { if (HoldShell && serial == "DEMO-001") throw new InvalidOperationException("Owned shell failure."); output = await inner.ShellAsync(serial, command, useRoot, ct); });
            return output;
        }
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.DumpAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Tap", serial, () => inner.TapAsync(serial, x, y, ct));
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Swipe", serial, () => inner.SwipeAsync(serial, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct));
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.KeyEventAsync(serial, code, ct);
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Text", serial, () => inner.TextAsync(serial, text, ct));
        public async Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            string output = "";
            await Forward("StartApp", serial, async () => output = await inner.StartAppAsync(serial, packageName, activity, ct));
            return output;
        }
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.StopAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ClearAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ListAppsAsync(serial, showSystem, needVersion, ct);
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Install", serial, () => inner.InstallAsync(serial, localPath, CancellationToken.None));
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.UninstallAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Push", serial, () => inner.PushAsync(serial, localPath, remotePath, progress, ct));
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PullAsync(serial, remotePath, localPath, progress, ct);
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SetNodeTextAsync(serial, selector, text, ct);
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => inner.DisposeAsync();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private FrameworkElement BuildDirectory()
    {
        var panel = new DockPanel { Margin = new Thickness(12, 0, 8, 0) };
        var filters = new StackPanel(); DockPanel.SetDock(filters, Dock.Top);
        filters.Children.Add(Label("设备目录"));
        panel.Children.Add(filters);

        var edit = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 10, 0, 8) }; DockPanel.SetDock(edit, Dock.Bottom);
        foreach (var (label, property) in new[] { ("画面", nameof(DeviceRow.ScreenState)), ("节点", nameof(DeviceRow.AutomationState)), ("脚本", nameof(DeviceRow.ScriptState)), ("API", nameof(DeviceRow.ApiAddress)) })
        {
            var status = BoundText("CurrentDevice." + property, true);
            var binding = new MultiBinding { Converter = new SubsystemCaptionConverter(label) };
            binding.Bindings.Add(new Binding("CurrentDevice." + property)); binding.Bindings.Add(new Binding(nameof(LocalizationService.Language)) { Source = LocalizationService.Current });
            status.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, binding);
            status.FontSize = 11; status.Margin = new Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0); edit.Children.Add(status);
        }
        edit.Children.Add(Field("名称", BoundInput(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.DeviceName)), 50));
        edit.Children.Add(Button("\uE74E", "保存信息", ViewModel.SaveMetadataCommand));
        panel.Children.Add(edit);

        var list = new ListBox { Name = "DetailsDeviceChoice", ItemsSource = new ListCollectionView(ViewModel.Devices), IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem = false, Background = Brushes.Transparent, BorderThickness = new Thickness(0), HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, ItemTemplate = DeviceTemplate() };
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(list, "详情设备");
        list.SetBinding(Selector.SelectedItemProperty, new Binding(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.CurrentDevice)) { Mode = BindingMode.OneWay });
        list.SelectionChanged += (_, _) => { if (list.SelectedItem is DeviceRow selected) ViewModel.CurrentDevice = selected; };
        panel.Children.Add(list);
        return panel;
    }

    private static DataTemplate DeviceTemplate()
    {
        var root = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(StackPanel)); root.SetValue(MarginProperty, new Thickness(0, 5, 0, 6));
        var row = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(DockPanel));
        var name = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBlock)); name.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new Binding(nameof(DeviceRow.Name))); name.SetValue(TextBlock.FontWeightProperty, FontWeights.SemiBold); name.SetValue(TextBlock.TextTrimmingProperty, TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis); row.AppendChild(name); root.AppendChild(row);
        foreach (var property in new[] { nameof(DeviceRow.Serial), nameof(DeviceRow.Resolution), nameof(DeviceRow.State) })
        {
            var text = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBlock)); text.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new Binding(property)); text.SetValue(TextBlock.FontSizeProperty, 11d); text.SetValue(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, Brushes.DimGray); text.SetValue(TextBlock.TextTrimmingProperty, TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis); text.SetValue(MarginProperty, new Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0)); root.AppendChild(text);
        }
        return new DataTemplate { VisualTree = root };
    }

}
```

```csharp
namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

{
    private FrameworkElement BuildExtensionsPage()
    {

            await ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("删除资料包", async () => { await Task.Run(() => service.Delete(record, true)); records.Remove(record); });
        }));
        DockPanel.SetDock(backupActions, Dock.Top); backupPanel.Children.Add(backupActions);
        var boundary = new TextBlock { TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Foreground = Brushes.DimGray, Margin = new Thickness(0, 9, 0, 9) }; LocalizationService.Bind(boundary, TextBlock.TextProperty, "此页导入和导出本地包，不自动恢复设备数据。"); DockPanel.SetDock(boundary, Dock.Top); backupPanel.Children.Add(boundary); backupPanel.Children.Add(list);
        grid.Children.Add(backupPanel);
        page.Children.Add(grid); return page;
    }
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/Views/LdPlayerView.cs

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private readonly ObservableCollection<LdInstanceRow> ldRows = [];
    private readonly List<AsyncCommand> ldCommands = [];
    private readonly Dictionary<string, AsyncCommand> ldCommandsByLabel = [];
    private LdInstanceRow? ldSelection;
    private bool ldBusy;
    private TextBlock ldFeedback = null!;

    private FrameworkElement BuildInstanceActions()
    {
        var toolbar = Toolbar();
        toolbar.Children.Add(LdButton("\uE710", "新建空白实例", () => EditLdInstanceAsync(true), requireSelection: false));
        var menu = new ContextMenu();
        AddMenu("\uE713", "资源配置", () => EditLdInstanceAsync(false), requireStopped: true);
        AddMenu("\uE71A", "关闭实例", () => ExecuteLdPlayerAsync("quit"), requireProcess: true);
        AddMenu("\uE777", "重启实例", () => ExecuteLdPlayerAsync("reboot"), requireProcess: true);
        menu.Items.Add(new Separator());
        var show = new AsyncCommand(async () =>
        {
            foreach (var row in unifiedDevices.Where(row => row.IsSelected).ToArray()) await ShowUnifiedWindowAsync(row);
        }, () => !ldBusy && !ViewModel.Busy && unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.IsSelected && row.Index is { } index && ldWindowVisibility?.IsHidden(index) == true));
        launchCommands.Add(show);
        menu.Items.Add(new MenuItem { Header = "恢复旧版隐藏窗口", Icon = WallGlyph("\uE8A7"), Command = show });
        var more = WallButton("\uE712", "实例操作", new ActionCommand(() => { }));
        more.Name = "InstanceActions";
        more.ContextMenu = menu; menu.PlacementTarget = more; menu.Placement = System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.PlacementMode.Bottom;
        more.Click += (_, _) => menu.IsOpen = true;
        toolbar.Children.Add(more);
        UpdateLdPlayerRows();
        ViewModel.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => RefreshLdButtons();
        return toolbar;

        void AddMenu(string glyph, string label, Func<Task> action, bool requireStopped = false, bool requireProcess = false)
        {
            var button = LdButton(glyph, label, action, requireStopped: requireStopped, requireProcess: requireProcess);
            menu.Items.Add(new MenuItem { Header = label, Icon = WallGlyph(glyph), Command = button.Command, ToolTip = label + "：仅操作列表中唯一勾选的实例" });
        }
    }

    private void SelectUnifiedInstance(UnifiedDeviceRow? row)
    {
        var selected = unifiedDevices.Where(item => item.IsSelected).ToArray();
        if (selected.Length != 1 || !ReferenceEquals(row, selected[0])) row = null;
        var instance = row?.Index is { } index ? ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer?.Instances.FirstOrDefault(item => item.Index == index) : null;
        ldSelection = instance is null ? null : new LdInstanceRow(instance, row!.Binding, row.State);
        RefreshLdButtons();
    }

    private Button LdButton(string glyph, string label, Func<Task> action, bool requireSelection = true, bool requireStopped = false, bool requireProcess = false)
    {
        var command = new AsyncCommand(async () =>
        {
            try { await action(); }
            catch (Exception error) { ldFeedback.Text = label + "失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(error); }
        }, () => !ldBusy && !captureInProgress && !ViewModel.HasActiveOperations && ViewModel.ConnectionReloadAvailable && ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer is not null && (!requireSelection || ldSelection is not null && (ViewModel.Demo || ldSelection.Index is > 0 and < 99999)) && (!requireStopped || ldSelection?.Instance is { IsStarting: false, AndroidStarted: false, ProcessId: <= 0, VBoxProcessId: <= 0, TopWindow: 0, BindWindow: 0 }) && (!requireProcess || ldSelection?.Instance is { ProcessId: > 0 } || ldSelection?.Instance.AndroidStarted == true));
        ldCommands.Add(command);
        ldCommandsByLabel.Add(label, command);
        return Button(glyph, label, command);
    }

    private void RefreshLdButtons() { foreach (var command in ldCommands) command.Refresh(); RefreshLaunchCommands(); }
    private void UpdateLdPlayerRows()
    {
        ldRows.Clear();
        if (ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer is not { } service)
        {
            ldFeedback.Text = "雷电能力未接入：请在设置中选择雷电命令行程序路径，保存并重新启动。本页不会自动配置设备序列号。";
            RefreshLdButtons(); return;
        }
        foreach (var instance in service.Instances)
        {
            var binding = ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.TryGetValue(instance.Index, out var serial) ? serial + "（配置绑定，尚未核验）" : "尚未绑定";
            ldRows.Add(new LdInstanceRow(instance, binding, InstanceConnectionState(instance)));
        }
        var selected = unifiedDevices.Where(row => row.IsSelected).Take(2).ToArray();
        SelectUnifiedInstance(selected.Length == 1 ? selected[0] : null);
        if (ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayerError is { } error) ldFeedback.Text = "雷电实例发现失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(new InvalidOperationException(error));
        else if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ldFeedback.Text)) ldFeedback.Text = ViewModel.Demo ? "演示模式" : "";
        RefreshLdButtons();
    }

    private async Task RefreshLdPlayerUiAsync()
    {
        if (ViewModel.HasActiveOperations) return;
        ldBusy = true; ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(true); ldFeedback.Text = "正在刷新雷电实例…"; RefreshLdButtons();
        try { await ViewModel.Runtime.RefreshLdPlayerAsync(); UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory(); }
        catch (Exception error) { ldFeedback.Text = "刷新雷电实例失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(error); }
        finally { ldBusy = false; ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(false); RefreshLdButtons(); }
    }

    private async Task ExecuteLdPlayerAsync(string operation, JsonObject? body = null)
    {
        if (ViewModel.HasActiveOperations) throw new DeviceException("请先结束界面操作、脚本或文件传输，再操作雷电实例");
        var selected = ldSelection ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未选择雷电实例");
        var service = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("雷电命令行能力尚未接入");
        if (!ViewModel.Demo && selected.Index is <= 0 or >= 99999) throw new DeviceException("原实例0和系统保留编号受保护。", 403, 1003);
        if (!ViewModel.Demo && operation is not ("launch" or "quit" or "reboot") && !LdInstanceConnected(selected.Index)) throw new DeviceException("请先接入该实例，再执行应用或输入操作。", 403, 1003);
        body ??= new JsonObject(); body["expectedGeneration"] = selected.Generation;
        if (operation is "quit" or "reboot")
        {
            var label = operation == "quit" ? "关闭雷电实例" : "重启雷电实例";
            if (!ViewModel.Confirm(label, $"实例：{selected.Name}\n编号：{selected.Index}\n会话代次：{selected.Generation}\n此操作会中断该实例中的活动应用。确认继续？")) { ldFeedback.Text = "操作已取消，未发送命令。"; return; }
            body["confirmed"] = true;
        }
        ldBusy = true; ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(true); ldFeedback.Text = "正在执行所选实例命令…"; RefreshLdButtons();
        try
        {
            using var write = ViewModel.Runtime.AcquireLdWrite(selected.Index);
            ViewModel.Runtime.RequireFrozenConnectionSettings();
            if (ViewModel.Runtime.Api.LdCommandIdentityGuard is { } verify) await verify(selected.Index, operation, CancellationToken.None);
            var result = await service.ExecuteAsync(selected.Index, operation, body, CancellationToken.None);
            UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-command-result", $"index={result.Index}; accepted={result.Accepted}; verified={result.Verified}; {result.Message}");
            ldFeedback.Text = $"实例 {result.Index}：" + (result.Verified ? "操作已完成" : "命令已提交，等待状态更新");
        }
        catch (Exception error) { UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory(); ldFeedback.Text = $"实例 {selected.Index} 操作失败：{ViewModel.PresentError(error)}"; }
        finally { ldBusy = false; ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(false); RefreshLdButtons(); }
    }
}

public sealed class LdInstanceRow(LdPlayerInstance instance, string binding, string connectionState = "待接入")
{
    public LdPlayerInstance Instance { get; } = instance;
    public int Index => Instance.Index;
    public string Name => Instance.Name;
    public string AndroidState => Instance.AndroidStarted ? "已启动" : "未启动";
    public string ProcessState => Instance.ProcessId > 0 ? "已发现进程" : "未发现进程";
    public int ProcessId => Instance.ProcessId;
    public int VBoxProcessId => Instance.VBoxProcessId;
    public string Size => Instance.Width is { } width && Instance.Height is { } height ? $"{width} × {height}" : "未核验";
    public string Dpi => Instance.Dpi?.ToString() ?? "未核验";
    public long Generation => Instance.Generation;
    public string Binding { get; } = binding;
    public string ConnectionState { get; } = connectionState;
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/Views/LdWindowVisibilitySmoke.cs

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public static class LdWindowVisibilitySmoke
{
    public static async Task VerifyAsync(string evidenceDir)
    {
        if (!Path.IsPathFullyQualified(evidenceDir)) throw new ArgumentException("窗口自测证据目录必须为绝对路径。");
        if (Application.Current is null || !Application.Current.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
            throw new InvalidOperationException("窗口自测必须在本程序 WPF Dispatcher 上运行。");
        var directory = Path.Combine(evidenceDir, "self-window-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        using var process = Process.GetCurrentProcess();
        var birth = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks;
        var executable = process.MainModule?.FileName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("无法读取自测进程路径。");
        var install = Path.GetDirectoryName(executable)!;
        var visibility = new LdWindowVisibility(directory, install);
        var passed = new List<string>();
        var windows = new List<Window>();
        var window = MakeWindow(); windows.Add(window);
        await RenderAsync();
        var handle = new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle;
        var instance = new LdPlayerInstance(1, "本程序窗口自测，不是真实模拟器", handle.ToInt64(), 0, false, process.Id, -1);
        var parent = GetParent(handle);
        var style = GetWindowLongPtr(handle, -16).ToInt64();
        var exStyle = GetWindowLongPtr(handle, -20).ToInt64();
        try
        {
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(handle), "自测窗口没有正常显示。");
            await ExpectAsync(400, () => visibility.HideAsync(instance with { Index = 0 }, birth));
            await ExpectAsync(409, () => visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth + 1));
            await ExpectAsync(409, () => visibility.HideAsync(instance with { ProcessId = int.MaxValue }, birth));
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(handle) && JournalCount(directory) == 0, "错误身份触碰了窗口或建立恢复记录。");
            passed.Add("protected-index-and-wrong-owner-refused");

            var outside = Path.Combine(directory, "empty-sdk"); Directory.CreateDirectory(outside);
            var wrongInstall = new LdWindowVisibility(Path.Combine(directory, "wrong-install"), outside);
            await ExpectAsync(403, () => wrongInstall.HideAsync(instance, birth));
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(handle), "安装路径拒绝后窗口被隐藏。");
            passed.Add("executable-outside-frozen-install-refused");

            Assert(await visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth), "自有可见窗口未获得隐藏所有权。");
            Assert(!IsWindowVisible(handle) && visibility.IsHidden(1) && JournalCount(directory) == 1, "隐藏状态或预写恢复记录不正确。");
            Assert((GetWindowLongPtr(handle, -16).ToInt64() & ~0x10000000L) == (style & ~0x10000000L) && GetParent(handle) == parent && GetWindowLongPtr(handle, -20).ToInt64() == exStyle,
                "隐藏改变了可见位以外的样式或父窗口。");
            await visibility.ShowAsync(1);
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(handle) && !visibility.IsHidden(1) && JournalCount(directory) == 0 && GetForegroundWindow() != handle,
                "恢复未显示自有窗口、遗留记录或激活了窗口。");
            Assert(GetWindowLongPtr(handle, -16).ToInt64() == style && GetParent(handle) == parent && GetWindowLongPtr(handle, -20).ToInt64() == exStyle,
                "恢复改变了原窗口样式或父窗口。");
            passed.Add("journal-before-hide-and-nonactivating-show");

            window.Hide(); await RenderAsync();
            Assert(!await visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth) && !visibility.IsHidden(1) && JournalCount(directory) == 0,
                "此前已经隐藏的窗口被本组件占有。");
            await visibility.ShowAsync(1);
            Assert(!IsWindowVisible(handle), "显示操作修改了并非本组件隐藏的窗口。");
            window.Show(); await RenderAsync();
            passed.Add("preexisting-hidden-window-not-owned");

            await visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth);
            var recordPath = Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "ld-window-*.json", SearchOption.AllDirectories).Single();
            var recordText = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(recordPath);
            var record = JsonNode.Parse(recordText)!.AsObject();
            var marker = record["marker"]!.GetValue<string>();
            RemoveProp(handle, marker);
            await ExpectAsync(409, () => visibility.ShowAsync(1));
            Assert(!IsWindowVisible(handle) && File.Exists(recordPath), "窗口标记丢失后仍恢复窗口或删除恢复记录。");
            if (!SetProp(handle, marker, new IntPtr(1))) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "无法恢复自测窗口标记");
            await visibility.ShowAsync(1);
            passed.Add("missing-marker-reuse-guard-refused");

            await visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth);
            recordPath = Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "ld-window-*.json", SearchOption.AllDirectories).Single();
            recordText = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(recordPath);
            record = JsonNode.Parse(recordText)!.AsObject();
            record["processStartUtcTicks"] = birth + 1;
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(recordPath, record.ToJsonString(JsonDefaults.Options));
            var recovery = new LdWindowVisibility(directory, install);
            var refused = await recovery.RecoverPendingAsync();
            Assert(refused.Count == 1 && !IsWindowVisible(handle) && File.Exists(recordPath), "恢复错误出生时刻的记录没有被拒绝。");
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(recordPath, recordText);
            Assert((await recovery.RecoverPendingAsync()).Count == 0 && IsWindowVisible(handle) && JournalCount(directory) == 0,
                "同进程恢复记录回放失败。");
            await visibility.RestoreAllAsync();
            passed.Add("journal-replay-and-wrong-birth-refusal");

            var second = MakeWindow(); windows.Add(second); await RenderAsync();
            var secondHandle = new WindowInteropHelper(second).Handle;
            var secondInstance = instance with { Index = 2, TopWindow = secondHandle.ToInt64() };
            await visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth);
            await visibility.HideAsync(secondInstance, birth);
            await visibility.RestoreAllAsync();
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(handle) && IsWindowVisible(secondHandle) && JournalCount(directory) == 0,
                "批量恢复没有恢复所有自有窗口。");
            passed.Add("restore-all-owned-windows");

            await visibility.HideAsync(secondInstance, birth);
            second.Close(); windows.Remove(second);
            await visibility.ShowAsync(2);
            Assert(JournalCount(directory) == 0 && !visibility.IsHidden(2), "窗口关闭后未安全清理自有恢复记录。");
            passed.Add("closed-window-record-cleanup");

            using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource(); cancellation.Cancel();
            try { await visibility.HideAsync(instance, birth, cancellation.Token); throw new InvalidOperationException("取消状态被忽略。"); }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(handle) && JournalCount(directory) == 0, "已取消操作仍隐藏了窗口。");
            passed.Add("pre-cancelled-hide-no-mutation");

            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(directory, "result.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
            {
                subject = "own-process-wpf-windows-only", processId = process.Id, processStartUtcTicks = birth,
                executable, externalWindowsTouched = false, realLdPlayerTested = false,
                desktopSha256 = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(typeof(LdWindowVisibility).Assembly.Location))),
                passed, count = passed.Count, pendingRecords = JournalCount(directory)
            }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        }
        finally
        {
            foreach (var ownWindow in windows) ownWindow.Close();
            await visibility.RestoreAllAsync();
        }
    }

    private static Window MakeWindow()
    {
        var window = new Window
        {
            Title = "本程序窗口恢复自测", Width = 280, Height = 120, Left = -10000, Top = -10000,
            WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual, ShowActivated = false, ShowInTaskbar = false,
            Content = new TextBlock { Text = "本程序创建的测试窗口，不是真实雷电实例。", TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap }
        };
        window.Show(); return window;
    }
    private static async Task RenderAsync() => await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.Render);
    private static int JournalCount(string directory) => Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "ld-window-*.json", SearchOption.AllDirectories).Count();
    private static void Assert(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }
    private static async Task ExpectAsync(int status, Func<Task> action)
    {
        try { await action(); }
        catch (DeviceException error) when (error.Status == status) { return; }
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"预期窗口操作被拒绝，HTTP 类状态码={status}。");
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern IntPtr GetParent(IntPtr window);

    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, EntryPoint = "RemovePropW")] private static extern IntPtr RemoveProp(IntPtr window, string name);
```

```csharp
    internal static async Task RunLiveDualSyncAcceptanceAsync(string[] args)

            if (key is not ("--manifest" or "--manifest-sha256" or "--data-dir") || !values.TryAdd(key, "")) throw new ArgumentException("Unknown or duplicate dual-sync argument: " + key);
            if (++index >= args.Length || args[index].StartsWith("--", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new ArgumentException("Missing value: " + key);
            values[key] = args[index];
        }
        if (values.Count != 4 || !values.ContainsKey("--verify-live-dual-sync") || !values.ContainsKey("--manifest") || !values.ContainsKey("--manifest-sha256") || !values.ContainsKey("--data-dir")) throw new ArgumentException("Dual sync requires exactly mode, manifest, SHA256 and data-dir.");
        var output = DualSyncAbsolute(values["--data-dir"]); var input = DualSyncAbsolute(values["--manifest"]);

        if (!manifestSha.Equals(values["--manifest-sha256"], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) throw new ArgumentException("Manifest SHA256 mismatch.");

        var manifest = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<DualSyncManifest>(bytes, new JsonSerializerOptions(JsonDefaults.Options) { UnmappedMemberHandling = JsonUnmappedMemberHandling.Disallow }) ?? throw new ArgumentException("Empty manifest.");
        DualSyncValidateManifest(manifest);

    private static void DualSyncValidateManifest(DualSyncManifest manifest)
    {
        if (manifest.Version != 1 || manifest.Server is null || manifest.Targets is not { Length: 2 } || manifest.Directory is null || manifest.Directory.Length is < 3 or > 1000
            || manifest.Targets.Any(target => target is null) || manifest.Directory.Any(row => row is null)) throw new ArgumentException("Invalid fixed dual-sync manifest shape.");

            || !DualSyncAbsolute(manifest.Server.Path).Equals(@"E:\leidian\LDPlayer14\adb.exe", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || !string.Equals(manifest.Server.Sha256, "705DDC21F33AC52105D1B075B019962AD0E44FB3D560BDE69CE8CB3A36BCA183", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) throw new ArgumentException("This acceptance is locked to the approved LDPlayer14 console and ADB executable identities.");

            || manifest.Server.Pid <= 0 || manifest.Server.StartedUtcTicks <= 0) throw new ArgumentException("Console/server proof is incomplete.");
        if (!manifest.Targets.Select(target => target.Index).Order().SequenceEqual(new[] { 1, 2 }) || manifest.Targets.Select(target => target.Serial).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() != 2
            || manifest.Directory.Select(row => row.Index).Distinct().Count() != manifest.Directory.Length || !manifest.Directory.Any(row => row.Index == 0)) throw new ArgumentException("Only unique exact dedicated instances 1/2 and a complete directory including 0 are accepted.");
        foreach (var target in manifest.Targets)
        {
            var row = manifest.Directory.SingleOrDefault(item => item.Index == target.Index) ?? throw new ArgumentException("Missing target directory row.");
            var approvedName = target.Index == 1 ? "MatrixAcceptance-20261014-184112" : "MatrixAcceptance-20261014-205326";
            if (!string.Equals(target.Name, approvedName, StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new ArgumentException("Target name is outside the two approved dedicated instances.");
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(target.Name) || target.Name != row.Name || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(target.Serial) || !Regex.IsMatch(target.Serial, @"^(emulator-[1-9][0-9]{0,4}|127\.0\.0\.1:[1-9][0-9]{0,4})$")
                || row.Width is not > 0 || row.Height is not > 0 || row.Dpi is not > 0 || row.IsStarting) throw new ArgumentException("Target name, serial or original dimensions are invalid.");
            if (target.Index == 1 && (target.AllowLaunch || !row.AndroidStarted || row.ProcessId <= 0 || row.VBoxProcessId <= 0 || target.PlayerStartedUtcTicks <= 0 || target.VBoxStartedUtcTicks <= 0 || target.TransportId is not > 0)) throw new ArgumentException("Instance 1 must already be running with complete fixed process/transport proof.");
            if (target.Index == 2 && target.AllowLaunch && (row.AndroidStarted || row.ProcessId > 0 || row.VBoxProcessId > 0 || row.TopWindow != 0 || row.BindWindow != 0 || target.PlayerStartedUtcTicks != 0 || target.VBoxStartedUtcTicks != 0 || target.TransportId is not null)) throw new ArgumentException("Instance 2 must be explicitly cold with no windows/processes/transport; only it may launch.");
            if (target.Index == 2 && !target.AllowLaunch && (!row.AndroidStarted || row.ProcessId <= 0 || row.VBoxProcessId <= 0 || target.PlayerStartedUtcTicks <= 0 || target.VBoxStartedUtcTicks <= 0 || target.TransportId is not > 0)) throw new ArgumentException("Ready instance 2 requires exact native process births and Ready transport; relaunch is forbidden.");
        }
        var readyTargets = manifest.Targets.Where(target => !target.AllowLaunch).ToArray();
        if (readyTargets.Select(target => target.TransportId).Distinct().Count() != readyTargets.Length) throw new ArgumentException("Approved Ready targets must have unique transports.");
    }

        private void OnTargetFailed(string serial, Exception error) => targetErrors.Enqueue(new InvalidOperationException(serial, error));
        private async Task Epoch(string stage, CancellationToken ct)
        {

            var process = DualSyncProcess(manifest.Server.Pid, manifest.Server.StartedUtcTicks);
            Need(process.Path.Equals(manifest.Server.Path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && DualSyncHash(process.Path).Equals(manifest.Server.Sha256, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), "Existing 5037 executable identity changed.");
            Need(DualSyncHash(manifest.ConsolePath).Equals(manifest.ConsoleSha256, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), "Console executable changed.");
            await Trace("5037-owner-probe", new { stage, manifest.Server.Pid, manifest.Server.StartedUtcTicks, process.Path, ownerProof = "Exact TCP connection owner via public host-only LdPlayerAdbBinding; no ADB bytes or guest request." });

        private async Task<IReadOnlyList<LdPlayerInstance>> HostIdentity(string stage, CancellationToken ct)

                if (ready.TryGetValue(target.Index, out var frozen))
                {

                    await LdPlayerAdbBinding.VerifyAsync(target.Serial, row.VBoxProcessId, frozen.VBoxBirth, ct);

                    catch (Exception error) { reportErrors.Add(error); deadline.Cancel(); }

            else await Trace("reuse-only-ready-instances", new { indices = new[] { 1, 2 }, launches, relaunchForbidden = true });
            rows = await HostIdentity("after-launch-or-ready-reuse", Ct);
            foreach (var target in manifest.Targets)
            {

                ready[target.Index] = (row, DualSyncProcess(row.ProcessId, target.AllowLaunch ? null : target.PlayerStartedUtcTicks).Birth,

        private async Task CreateRuntime()

            {

            } while (true);

            var snapshots = (await HostIdentity("before-admission", Ct)).Where(row => row.Index is 1 or 2).ToArray();

            Need(admissions.Count == 2 && admissions.All(proof => proof.Name == Target(proof.Index).Name && proof.Serial == Target(proof.Index).Serial), "Resolved serials differ from approved names/serials.");
            Need(admissions.All(proof => Target(proof.Index).AllowLaunch || proof.TransportId == Target(proof.Index).TransportId), "Approved Ready admission transport changed before guest initialization.");
            settings = LdConnectionAdmission.Apply(settings, admissions); await HostIdentity("before-runtime", Ct);
            await Step("create-inherited-epoch-runtime", async () =>
            {

                runtime = await runtimeCreation;
                return new { runtime.IsDemo, runtime.DiscoveryError, runtime.LdPlayerError, devices = runtime.Devices.Snapshot };
            });
            await HostIdentity("after-runtime", Ct); Need(!runtime.IsDemo && runtime.Backend is AdbDeviceBackend && runtime.DiscoveryError is null && runtime.LdPlayerError is null && runtime.Devices.Snapshot.Count == 2, "Exact real two-target runtime required.");
            foreach (var device in runtime.Devices.Snapshot) { Need(device.Online && admissions.Any(proof => proof.Serial == device.Serial && proof.TransportId == device.TransportId), "Runtime Ready identity mismatch."); devices.Add(device.Serial, device); }
            vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(runtime, Path.Combine(output, "runtime"), false); await vm.RefreshDevicesAsync(); Need(vm.Error.Length == 0 && vm.Devices.Count == 2, "Real VM discovery failed.");
            runtime.Input.TargetFailed += OnTargetFailed; await vm.SetMainAsync(Row(1)); vm.CurrentDevice = Row(2); SelectB(true);
            Need(vm.Error.Length == 0 && ReferenceEquals(vm.MainDevice, Row(1)) && ReferenceEquals(vm.CurrentDevice, Row(2)), "Main1/Current2 setup failed.");
            await Save("frozen-identities.json", new { ready = ready.Select(pair => new { index = pair.Key, pair.Value.Row, pair.Value.PlayerBirth, pair.Value.VBoxBirth }), devices = devices.Values, admissions });
            await Identity("runtime-ready", Ct);

        private void SelectB(bool selected) { foreach (var row in vm!.Devices) row.IsSelected = selected && row.Serial == Target(2).Serial; vm.UpdateSelection(); }
        private async Task Identity(string stage, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await HostIdentity(stage + "-host-before", ct); runtime!.RequireFrozenConnectionSettings();
            Need(!runtime.Api.BasicRunning && !runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning && runtime.Api.DevicePorts.Count == 0 && !runtime.Settings.AutoStartApi && !runtime.Settings.AutoConnect && runtime.Settings.AgentBaseUrl is null, "Background services must stay disabled.");
            var backend = (AdbDeviceBackend)runtime.Backend; var registered = await backend.ListRegisteredDevicesAsync(ct);

        private async Task<string> Shell(int index, string name, string command)

        private async Task<DualSyncFrame> Read(int index, string name)
        {

            {

                var packages = Regex.Matches(activity, @"(?:topResumedActivity|mResumedActivity).*?\b([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)/").Select(match => match.Groups[1].Value).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
                Need(packages.Length == 1, "Ambiguous actual foreground package.");

                Need(size.Width == devices[serial].Width && size.Height == devices[serial].Height, "Actual PNG differs from frozen device dimensions.");
                var file = name + ".png"; await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(Path.Combine(output, file), png, Ct);
                await Trace("foreground-raw", new { name, serial, activity });

            }), ct => Identity(name + "-after", ct));
```
