```csharp
        private async Task<(DualSyncFrame A, DualSyncFrame B)> Prepare(string name, bool forSwipe)
        {
            foreach (var index in new[] { 1, 2 }) await Shell(index, name + "-settings-" + index, "am start -W -a android.settings.SETTINGS -f 0x10008000");
            var a = await Read(1, name + "-before-a"); var b = await Read(2, name + "-before-b");
            Need(a.Foreground == "com.android.settings" && b.Foreground == "com.android.settings", "Fixed Settings UI-task setup did not reach Settings on both guests.");
            if (forSwipe) { a = await PrepareSwipeHeader(1, name, a); b = await PrepareSwipeHeader(2, name, b); }
            return (a, b);
        }
        private async Task<DualSyncFrame> PrepareSwipeHeader(int index, string name, DualSyncFrame before)
        {
            var candidate = ScrollContainer(before);
            if (candidate is not null && Anchors(candidate).Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length >= 4)
            {
                await Trace("header-setup-skipped", new { setupOnly = true, index, reason = "Original four-anchor precondition already satisfied.", before.Png, before.PngSha256 });
                return before;
            }
            var nodes = NodeSearch.FindAll(before.Root, new()).ToArray();
            AndroidNode Exact(string id, string className)
            {
                var matches = nodes.Where(node => node.ResourceId == "com.android.settings:id/" + id).ToArray();
                Need(matches.Length == 1, "Unique Settings header setup role missing: " + id);
                var node = matches[0];
                Need(node.PackageName == "com.android.settings" && node.ClassName == className && node.Enabled && node.VisibleToUser
                    && !node.Clickable && !node.Checkable && node.Bounds.Width > 0 && node.Bounds.Height > 0, "Unsafe Settings header setup role: " + id);
                return node;
            }
            var outer = Exact("settings_homepage_container", "android.widget.ScrollView");
            var inner = Exact("main_content_scrollable_container", "android.widget.ScrollView");
            var caption = Exact("homepage_title", "android.widget.TextView");
            var descendants = NodeSearch.FindAll(outer, new()).ToArray();
            Need(before.Foreground == "com.android.settings" && outer.Scrollable && inner.Scrollable && descendants.Any(node => ReferenceEquals(node, inner))
                && descendants.Any(node => ReferenceEquals(node, caption)) && !NodeSearch.FindAll(inner, new()).Any(node => ReferenceEquals(node, caption)), "Settings header/list hierarchy is not the approved setup scene.");
            Need(outer.Bounds.Left >= 0 && outer.Bounds.Top >= 0 && outer.Bounds.Right <= before.Width && outer.Bounds.Bottom <= before.Height
                && Inside(outer.Bounds, inner.Bounds.Left, inner.Bounds.Top) && Inside(outer.Bounds, inner.Bounds.Right - 1, inner.Bounds.Bottom - 1)
                && Inside(outer.Bounds, caption.Bounds.Left, caption.Bounds.Top) && Inside(outer.Bounds, caption.Bounds.Right - 1, caption.Bounds.Bottom - 1)
                && caption.Bounds.Bottom <= inner.Bounds.Top, "Settings header setup geometry is not safely contained.");
            var x = outer.Bounds.CenterX; var y = caption.Bounds.CenterY; var endY = outer.Bounds.Top + Math.Max(1, caption.Bounds.Height / 8);
            Need(Inside(outer.Bounds, x, y) && Inside(outer.Bounds, x, endY) && y < inner.Bounds.Top && endY < inner.Bounds.Top
                && y - endY >= 64 && y - endY <= outer.Bounds.Height / 2, "Header setup travel is outside the bounded anti-tap safety margin.");
            var intersections = nodes.Where(node => node.VisibleToUser && (node.Clickable || node.Checkable) && node.Bounds.Width > 0 && node.Bounds.Height > 0
                && x >= node.Bounds.Left && x < node.Bounds.Right && node.Bounds.Top <= y && node.Bounds.Bottom > endY).ToArray();
            Need(intersections.Length == 0, "Header setup line intersects a visible clickable/checkable node; no setup gesture sent.");
            object Role(AndroidNode node) => new { node.ResourceId, node.ClassName, node.PackageName, node.Enabled, node.VisibleToUser, node.Clickable, node.Checkable, node.Scrollable, node.Bounds };
            var plan = new { setupOnly = true, index, serial = Target(index).Serial, x, y, endY, durationMs = 300, minimumAntiTapTravelPixels = 64,
                before.Png, before.PngSha256, outer = Role(outer), inner = Role(inner), caption = Role(caption), interactiveLineIntersections = intersections.Length };
            await Identity(name + "-header-setup-before-" + index, Ct);
            await AfterGuard(() => Step(name + "-header-setup-once-" + index, async () =>
            {
                await Trace("setup-only-header-plan", plan);
                await runtime!.Backend.SwipeAsync(Target(index).Serial, x, y, x, endY, 300, Ct);
                return plan;
            }), ct => Identity(name + "-header-setup-after-" + index, ct));
            var prepared = await Read(index, name + "-header-baseline-" + index);
            var preparedNodes = Nodes(prepared);
            Need(prepared.Foreground == "com.android.settings" && preparedNodes.Count(node => node.ResourceId == outer.ResourceId && node.ClassName == outer.ClassName && node.PackageName == outer.PackageName) == 1
                && preparedNodes.Count(node => node.ResourceId == inner.ResourceId && node.ClassName == inner.ClassName && node.PackageName == inner.PackageName) == 1, "Header setup did not preserve the verified Settings homepage.");
            Scroll(prepared);
            return prepared;
        }
        private async Task Exercise(string name, string action, bool sync)
        {
            var before = await Prepare(name, action == "swipe"); var a = before.A; var b = before.B;
            var targets = vm!.InputTargets(a.Serial, action != "home"); Need(targets.SequenceEqual(sync ? new[] { b.Serial } : []), "Original InputTargets does not match the four-state selection contract.", "PRODUCT-FAIL");
            var bStable = Stable(b); var scrollA = action == "swipe" ? Scroll(a) : null; var scrollB = action == "swipe" ? Scroll(b) : null;
            Need(TitleAnchors(b).Length >= 3 && !SearchEditor(a) && !SearchEditor(b), "Fresh Settings root with stable title anchors required before any input.");
            InputSnapshot? snapshot = null; string? launcherA = null, launcherB = null;
            if (action == "home")
            {
                launcherA = ResolveHome(await Shell(1, name + "-resolve-a", "cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME"));
                launcherB = ResolveHome(await Shell(2, name + "-resolve-b", "cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME"));
                Need(launcherA != a.Foreground && launcherB != b.Foreground, "Resolved Home launcher must differ from prepared Settings foreground.");
            }
            else
            {
                var bounds = action == "tap" ? Search(a).Bounds : scrollA!.Bounds;
                var x = bounds.CenterX; var y = action == "tap" ? bounds.CenterY : bounds.Top + bounds.Height * 3 / 4;
                var y2 = action == "tap" ? y : bounds.Top + bounds.Height / 4;
                var mapped = InputCoordinator.ScalePoint(x, y, a.Width, a.Height, b.Width, b.Height);
                var mappedEnd = InputCoordinator.ScalePoint(x, y2, a.Width, a.Height, b.Width, b.Height);
                var safe = action == "tap" ? Search(b).Bounds : scrollB!.Bounds;
                Need(Inside(safe, mapped.X, mapped.Y) && Inside(safe, mappedEnd.X, mappedEnd.Y), "Mapped input is outside the verified safe B Settings control; no gesture sent.");
                snapshot = new() { SourceSerial = a.Serial, SourceGeneration = devices[a.Serial].Generation, Generation = runtime!.Input.CurrentGeneration,
                    SourceWidth = a.Width, SourceHeight = a.Height, TargetSerials = targets.ToArray(), Kind = action == "tap" ? InputKind.Tap : InputKind.Swipe,
                    X = x, Y = y, X2 = x, Y2 = y2, DurationMs = 300 };
            }
            await Identity(name + "-input-before", Ct);
            await AfterGuard(() => Step(name + "-input-once", async () =>
            {
                Need(ReferenceEquals(vm.MainDevice, Row(1)) && ReferenceEquals(vm.CurrentDevice, Row(2)) && !Row(1).IsSelected, "Main/Current/selection source drift.");
                if (action == "home") await vm.KeyAsync(3); else await vm.SendInputAsync(snapshot!);
                Need(vm.Error.Length == 0 && targetErrors.IsEmpty, "Original VM input failed: " + vm.Error, "PRODUCT-FAIL");
                return new { action, sync, snapshot, key = action == "home" ? 3 : (int?)null, vm.SyncMouse, vm.SyncKeyboard, main = vm.MainDevice?.Serial, current = vm.CurrentDevice?.Serial, selected = vm.Devices.Where(row => row.IsSelected).Select(row => row.Serial).ToArray() };
            }), ct => Identity(name + "-input-after", ct));
            var afterA = await Read(1, name + "-after-a"); var afterB = await Read(2, name + "-after-b");
            bool Effect(DualSyncFrame old, DualSyncFrame current, AndroidNode? scroll, string? launcher) => action switch
            {
                "tap" => (current.Foreground is "com.android.settings" or "com.android.settings.intelligence") && SearchEditor(current) && !SearchEditor(old),
                "swipe" => current.Foreground == "com.android.settings" && ScrollContainer(current) is { } afterScroll && Anchors(afterScroll).Length > 0 && Anchors(scroll!) != Anchors(afterScroll),
                _ => current.Foreground == launcher && current.Foreground != old.Foreground
            };
            Need(Effect(a, afterA, scrollA, launcherA), "Source A has no objective " + action + " effect.", "PRODUCT-FAIL");
            Need(sync ? Effect(b, afterB, scrollB, launcherB) : Stable(afterB) == bStable && afterB.Foreground == b.Foreground,
                "Target B did not match expected independent/synchronized " + action + " effect.", "PRODUCT-FAIL");
            await Save(name + "-effect.json", new { action, sync, sourceChanged = true, targetChanged = sync, source = a.Serial, target = b.Serial,
                beforeA = Stable(a), afterA = Stable(afterA), beforeB = bStable, afterB = Stable(afterB), main = vm.MainDevice?.Serial, current = vm.CurrentDevice?.Serial });
        }
        private static AndroidNode[] Nodes(DualSyncFrame frame) => NodeSearch.FindAll(frame.Root, new()).Where(node => node.Enabled && node.VisibleToUser && node.Bounds.Width > 0 && node.Bounds.Height > 0).ToArray();
        private static AndroidNode Search(DualSyncFrame frame) => Nodes(frame).FirstOrDefault(node => node.PackageName == "com.android.settings" && !node.Checkable &&
            ((node.Text ?? "").Contains("搜索", StringComparison.Ordinal) || (node.ContentDesc ?? "").Contains("搜索", StringComparison.Ordinal) || (node.Text ?? "").Contains("Search", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || (node.ContentDesc ?? "").Contains("Search", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            ?? throw new DualSyncFailure("PRECONDITION-FAIL", "No verified safe Settings search entry.");
        private static bool SearchEditor(DualSyncFrame frame) => Nodes(frame).Any(node => node.ResourceId == "android:id/search_src_text" && node.Focused && (node.ClassName is "android.widget.EditText" or "android.widget.AutoCompleteTextView") && (node.PackageName is "com.android.settings" or "com.android.settings.intelligence"));
        private static AndroidNode Scroll(DualSyncFrame frame)
        {
            var node = ScrollContainer(frame)
                ?? throw new DualSyncFailure("PRECONDITION-FAIL", "No verified safe Settings scroll container.");
            Need(Anchors(node).Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length >= 4, "Not enough concrete list anchors; no swipe sent."); return node;
        }
        private static AndroidNode? ScrollContainer(DualSyncFrame frame) => Nodes(frame).FirstOrDefault(node => node.PackageName == "com.android.settings" && node.Scrollable && node.Bounds.Width >= 100 && node.Bounds.Height >= 150);
        private static bool IsTitle(AndroidNode node) => node.ResourceId == "android:id/title" || node.ResourceId?.EndsWith("/title", StringComparison.Ordinal) == true;
        private static string[] TitleAnchors(DualSyncFrame frame) => Nodes(frame).Where(node => IsTitle(node) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(node.Text)).Select(node => node.ResourceId + "|" + node.Text + "|" + node.Bounds).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
        private static string Anchors(AndroidNode node) => string.Join("\n", NodeSearch.FindAll(node, new()).Where(item => item.VisibleToUser && IsTitle(item) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Text)
            && item.Bounds.Width > 0 && item.Bounds.Height > 0 && item.Bounds.Top >= node.Bounds.Top && item.Bounds.Bottom <= node.Bounds.Bottom)
            .Select(item => item.ResourceId + "|" + item.Text + "|" + item.Bounds).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal));
        private static string Stable(DualSyncFrame frame) => frame.Foreground + "\n" + SearchEditor(frame) + "\n" + string.Join("\n", TitleAnchors(frame));
        private static bool Inside(NodeBounds bounds, int x, int y) => x >= bounds.Left && x < bounds.Right && y >= bounds.Top && y < bounds.Bottom;
        private static string ResolveHome(string value) => Regex.Matches(value, @"(?m)^\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)/[A-Za-z0-9_.$]+\s*$").Select(match => match.Groups[1].Value).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).SingleOrDefault()
            ?? throw new DualSyncFailure("PRECONDITION-FAIL", "Home launcher did not resolve unambiguously.");
        private sealed class DualSyncLdRunner(DualSyncRun owner, ILdConsoleRunner inner) : ILdConsoleRunner
        {
            public async Task<string> RunAsync(IReadOnlyList<string> arguments, CancellationToken ct = default)
            {
                var launch = arguments.SequenceEqual(new[] { "launch", "--index", "2" });
                Need(arguments.SequenceEqual(new[] { "list2" }) || launch, "LD command outside list2/launch2 rejected.");
                Need(!launch || owner.Target(2).AllowLaunch, "Ready continuation forbids every launch command.");
                await owner.Epoch("ld-before", ct); if (launch) Need(Interlocked.Increment(ref owner.launches) == 1, "A second launch attempt is forbidden.");
                return await owner.AfterGuard(async () => { var value = await inner.RunAsync(arguments, ct); await owner.Trace("ld-return", new { arguments, value }); return value; }, after => owner.Epoch("ld-after", after));
            }
        }
        private sealed class DualSyncProgress(Action<LdLaunchProgress> callback) : IProgress<LdLaunchProgress>
        { public void Report(LdLaunchProgress value) => callback(value); }
    }

    private static string DualSyncAbsolute(string value) => Path.IsPathFullyQualified(value) ? Path.GetFullPath(value) : throw new ArgumentException("Absolute path required: " + value);
    private static bool DualSyncSha(string value) => value is not null && Regex.IsMatch(value, "^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$");
    private static string DualSyncHash(string path) { using var file = File.OpenRead(path); return Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(file)); }
    private static (string Path, long Birth) DualSyncProcess(int pid, long? expected = null)
    {
        using var process = Process.GetProcessById(pid); var birth = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks;
        if (process.HasExited || expected is { } value && value != birth) throw new DualSyncFailure("PRECONDITION-FAIL", "PID exited/reused: " + pid);
        return (process.MainModule?.FileName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Process executable path unavailable."), birth);
    }
    private static void DualSyncUniqueKeys(JsonElement element)
    {
        if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            var keys = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var property in element.EnumerateObject()) { if (!keys.Add(property.Name)) throw new ArgumentException("Duplicate manifest JSON key: " + property.Name); DualSyncUniqueKeys(property.Value); }
        }
        else if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array) foreach (var item in element.EnumerateArray()) DualSyncUniqueKeys(item);
    }
}
```

```csharp
            {

                ViewModel.Transfers.Add(new TransferRow { Serial = row.Serial, Direction = "下载", LocalPath = pulled, RemotePath = remote });
                await ViewModel.StartTransfersAsync();
                if (ViewModel.Transfers.Any(task => task.State != "传输完成") || !File.ReadAllBytes(local).SequenceEqual(File.ReadAllBytes(pulled))) throw new InvalidOperationException("界面文件队列失败或哈希不一致");
            }
            finally { await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.ShellAsync(row.Serial, "rm -f " + AdbDeviceBackend.Quote(remote)); }
        });
        await Check("UI-text", async () =>
        {
            var serial = ViewModel.CurrentDevice!.Serial;
            await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.StopAppAsync(serial, "com.android.settings.intelligence"); await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.StopAppAsync(serial, "com.android.settings");
            await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.ShellAsync(serial, "am start -W -a android.settings.SETTINGS"); await Task.Delay(800);
            var control = NodeSearch.FindAll(await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.DumpAsync(serial), new()).First(node => node.PackageName == "com.android.settings" && (node.Text ?? "").Contains("搜索", StringComparison.Ordinal) && node.Bounds.Width > 0);
            await ViewModel.CaptureAsync();
            var row = ViewModel.CurrentDevice!;
            await ViewModel.SendInputAsync(new InputSnapshot { SourceSerial = serial, SourceGeneration = row.Info.Generation, Generation = ViewModel.Runtime.Input.CurrentGeneration,
                Kind = InputKind.Tap, X = control.Bounds.CenterX, Y = control.Bounds.CenterY, SourceWidth = row.Screenshot!.PixelWidth, SourceHeight = row.Screenshot.PixelHeight });
            await Task.Delay(500);
            ViewModel.TextInput = "界面中文 Test 8";
            if (!ViewModel.TextCommand.CanExecute(null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("实机文本按钮不允许操作");
            await ViewModel.SendTextAsync();
            var fields = NodeSearch.FindAll(await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.DumpAsync(serial), new() { ResourceId = "android:id/search_src_text" });
            if (!fields.Any(node => node.Text == ViewModel.TextInput)) throw new InvalidOperationException("界面中文输入精确回读不符");
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(output, "text-readback.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(fields, JsonDefaults.Options));
        });
        await Check("UI-clear-stale-nodes", async () =>
        {
            await ViewModel.CaptureAsync();
            if (ViewModel.Nodes.Count != 0 || ViewModel.SelectedNode is not null || nodeTree.Items.Count != 0 || nodeRectangles.Count != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("实机新截图仍留旧节点");
            await ViewModel.LoadNodesAsync();
        });
        await Check("UI-navigation", async () =>
        {
            var selected = ViewModel.CurrentDevice; var main = ViewModel.MainDevice;
            foreach (var tab in tabs.Items.Cast<TabItem>())
            {
                NavigateTo(tab.Tag!.ToString()!); await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
                if (!ReferenceEquals(selected, ViewModel.CurrentDevice) || !ReferenceEquals(main, ViewModel.MainDevice)) throw new InvalidOperationException("实机导航改变目标");
                SaveRender(Path.Combine(output, $"page-{tabs.SelectedIndex:D2}.png"));
            }
            NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控");
            SetWallViewMode("list"); await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (WallViewMode != "list") throw new InvalidOperationException("设备管理不再保持唯一列表模式。");
            SaveRender(Path.Combine(output, "wall-list.png"));
        });
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(output, "build-sha256.txt"), Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(typeof(MainWindow).Assembly.Location))));
    }
}
```

```csharp
    private static string? FrameDigest(MonitorTile tile)
    {
        if (tile.Frame.Source is not System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapSource bitmap) return null;
        var bytes = new byte[bitmap.PixelWidth * bitmap.PixelHeight * 4]; bitmap.CopyPixels(bytes, bitmap.PixelWidth * 4, 0);
        return Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(bytes));
    }

    private static bool RecentMonitorFrame(DateTimeOffset? lastFrameAt, DateTimeOffset now) =>
        lastFrameAt is { } received && received <= now && now - received <= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12);

    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "IsWindowVisible")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool MonitorWindowVisible(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "IsIconic")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool MonitorWindowIconic(IntPtr window);
}
```

```csharp
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private async Task VerifyMonitorProjectionAsync(string? screenshot)
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("离线监控夹具仅限演示模式。");
        var sampledAt = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 10, 15, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
        if (RecentMonitorFrame(null, sampledAt) || RecentMonitorFrame(sampledAt.AddSeconds(-12).AddTicks(-1), sampledAt)
            || RecentMonitorFrame(sampledAt.AddTicks(1), sampledAt) || !RecentMonitorFrame(sampledAt.AddSeconds(-2.4), sampledAt)
            || !RecentMonitorFrame(sampledAt.AddSeconds(-12), sampledAt)) throw new InvalidOperationException("新帧时间窗口未正确区分短时静止、缺失、陈旧与未来时间。");
        await StopMonitorAsync(); monitorStopping = true;
        var current = ViewModel.CurrentDevice;
        var main = ViewModel.MainDevice;
        var targets = ViewModel.Targets().ToArray();
        var nodes = ViewModel.Nodes.ToArray();
        try
        {
            NavigateTo("实时监控");
            monitorTiles.Clear(); monitorWall.Children.Clear();
            for (var index = 1; index <= 2; index++)
            {
                var key = "fixture:" + index;
                var tile = new MonitorTile(key, () => SelectMonitor(key), () => Task.CompletedTask, () => Task.CompletedTask) { Eligible = true };
                tile.Name.Text = $"离线测试画面 {index}"; tile.Subtitle.Text = "合成像素夹具 · 非真实设备";
                monitorTiles.Add(key, tile); monitorWall.Children.Add(tile.Surface);
                var oldEpoch = tile.BeginVideo();
                tile.ClearUntrustedFrame();
                tile.AcceptFrame(oldEpoch, new(32, 18, new byte[32 * 18 * 4], 1, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow));
                tile.Present(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow, true);
                if (tile.LastFrameAt is not null || tile.Frame.Source is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException("已失效会话仍可发布帧。");
                var stop = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                tile.StopCompletion = stop.Task;
                if (!ReferenceEquals(tile.StopAsync(), stop.Task) || tile.StopAsync().IsCompleted) throw new InvalidOperationException("重复停止未共享尚未完成的清理任务。");
                stop.SetResult(); await tile.StopAsync();
                var pixels = new byte[32 * 18 * 4];
                for (var pixel = 0; pixel < pixels.Length; pixel += 4) { pixels[pixel] = (byte)(index == 1 ? 210 : 40); pixels[pixel + 1] = (byte)(pixel / 4 % 32 * 7); pixels[pixel + 2] = (byte)(index == 1 ? 30 : 220); pixels[pixel + 3] = 255; }
                var epoch = tile.BeginVideo();
                tile.AcceptFrame(epoch, new(32, 18, pixels, 2, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow)); tile.Present(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow, true);
                if (tile.Frame.Source is null || tile.Presented != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("未选中卡片没有呈现视频帧。");
                if (!tile.State.Text.EndsWith(tile.LastFrameAt!.Value.ToLocalTime().ToString("HH:mm:ss"), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("卡片到帧时间未按本地时区显示。");
                tile.Present(tile.LastFrameAt.Value.AddSeconds(6), true);
                if (!tile.State.Text.StartsWith("等待新帧", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !tile.State.Text.EndsWith(tile.LastFrameAt.Value.ToLocalTime().ToString("HH:mm:ss"), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("陈旧帧时间未按本地时区显示。");
                tile.SetResource(new(index, 1, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddSeconds(-2), null, 128 * 1048576, null));
                tile.SetResource(new(index, 1, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow, 7 * index, 160 * 1048576, null));
                if (tile.LatestResource is not { Error: null, WorkingSetBytes: 167772160 } latest || latest.CpuPercent != 7 * index)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("最近资源观测未保留真实样本。");
                if (tile.Resource.ToolTip is not string resourceTip || !resourceTip.StartsWith(latest.ObservedAt.ToLocalTime().ToString("HH:mm:ss"), StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("资源提示时间未按本地时区显示。");
                tile.State.Text = "离线合成帧（非实时视频验收）";
            }
            SelectMonitor("fixture:2");
            if (!ReferenceEquals(current, ViewModel.CurrentDevice) || !ReferenceEquals(main, ViewModel.MainDevice) || !targets.SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Targets()) || !nodes.SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Nodes))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("监看选择改变控制上下文。");
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (monitorTiles.Values.Any(tile => tile.Frame.ActualHeight < 1 || tile.Surface.ActualWidth > monitorScroll.ViewportWidth)) throw new InvalidOperationException("监控卡片画面为空或超出视口。");
            if (screenshot is not null) SaveRender(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(screenshot)!, "monitor-offline.png"));
        }
        finally
        {
            monitorTiles.Clear(); monitorWall.Children.Clear(); monitorStopping = false;
            NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;

using System.Windows.Shapes;
using Path = System.IO.Path;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, MonitorTile> monitorTiles = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private ResourceSampler monitorResources = new();
    private readonly DispatcherTimer monitorTimer = new() { Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(125) };
    private WrapPanel monitorWall = null!;
    private ScrollViewer monitorScroll = null!;
    private TextBlock monitorSummary = null!;
    private TextBlock monitorHost = null!;
    private TextBlock monitorDetail = null!;
    private MatrixRuntime? monitorRuntime;
    private Task monitorReconcile = Task.CompletedTask;
    private Task monitorSampling = Task.CompletedTask;
    private DateTimeOffset monitorLastReconcile;
    private DateTimeOffset monitorLastSample;
    private string? monitorSelected;
    private bool monitorPaused;
    private bool monitorStopping;
    private bool monitorWasActive;
    private long monitorEpoch;
    private int monitorHostValidSamples;
    private HostResourceSample? monitorLatestHost;
    private bool monitorCompact;
    private bool monitorConnectedOnly = true;
    private string monitorNotice = "";
    private ToggleButton monitorPauseChoice = null!;
    private ToggleButton monitorWallChoice = null!;
    private ToggleButton monitorListChoice = null!;
    private ComboBox monitorScopeChoice = null!;

    private bool MonitorActive => !closing && !monitorStopping && !monitorPaused && Equals((tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag, "实时监控");

    private FrameworkElement BuildMonitorPage()
    {
        var page = Page();
        var header = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10) };
        var pause = WallToggle("\uE769", "暂停监控"); pause.Content = ShellGlyph("\uE769"); pause.Width = pause.MinWidth = pause.Height = 44; pause.Padding = new Thickness(0);
        monitorPauseChoice = pause;
        pause.Checked += (_, _) => { monitorPaused = true; monitorEpoch++; pause.ToolTip = "恢复监控"; System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(pause, "恢复监控"); pause.Content = ShellGlyph("\uE768"); monitorLastReconcile = default; MonitorTick(); };
        pause.Unchecked += (_, _) => { monitorPaused = false; monitorEpoch++; pause.ToolTip = "暂停监控"; System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(pause, "暂停监控"); pause.Content = ShellGlyph("\uE769"); monitorLastReconcile = default; monitorTimer.Start(); MonitorTick(); };
        var modes = new WrapPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0) };
        var wall = WallToggle("\uE8A9", "画面墙"); var list = WallToggle("\uE9D5", "资源列表"); wall.IsChecked = true;
        wall.Height = list.Height = 44;
        monitorWallChoice = wall; monitorListChoice = list;
        wall.Click += (_, _) => { wall.IsChecked = true; list.IsChecked = false; SetMonitorMode(false); };
        list.Click += (_, _) => { wall.IsChecked = false; list.IsChecked = true; SetMonitorMode(true); };
        modes.Children.Add(wall); modes.Children.Add(list);
        var scope = new ComboBox { Width = 118, Height = 44, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 6), ItemsSource = new[] { "已连接设备", "全部目录" }, SelectedIndex = 0 };
        monitorScopeChoice = scope;
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(scope, "监控范围");
        scope.SelectionChanged += (_, _) => { monitorConnectedOnly = scope.SelectedIndex == 0; monitorEpoch++; monitorLastReconcile = default; MonitorTick(); };
        modes.Children.Add(scope); modes.Children.Add(pause);
        var heading = new StackPanel();
        heading.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Name = "PageHeading", Text = LocalizationService.PageDisplayName("实时监控"), FontSize = 20, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold });
        monitorHost = new TextBlock { Text = "主机资源：待采样", Foreground = WallMuted, FontSize = 12, Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0), TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
        heading.Children.Add(new ScrollViewer { Content = monitorHost, MaxHeight = 48, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled }); header.Children.Add(heading); header.Children.Add(modes);
        DockPanel.SetDock(header, Dock.Top); page.Children.Add(header);
        monitorSummary = new TextBlock { Foreground = WallMuted, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 8), TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, ToolTip = "视频到帧率不等于应用帧率；静止画面可能不产生新帧。" };
        var summaryViewport = new ScrollViewer { Content = monitorSummary, MaxHeight = 48, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled };
        DockPanel.SetDock(summaryViewport, Dock.Top); page.Children.Add(summaryViewport);
        monitorDetail = new TextBlock { Foreground = WallMuted, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, MinHeight = 24, Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0), Text = "未选中监看设备" };
        var detailViewport = new ScrollViewer { Name = "MonitorDetailScroll", Content = monitorDetail, MaxHeight = 72, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled };
        DockPanel.SetDock(detailViewport, Dock.Bottom); page.Children.Add(detailViewport);
        monitorWall = new WrapPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal };
        monitorScroll = new ScrollViewer { Content = monitorWall, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled, CanContentScroll = false };
        monitorScroll.SizeChanged += (_, _) => { foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values) tile.ApplyLayout(monitorCompact, monitorScroll.ViewportWidth); };
        monitorScroll.ScrollChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            monitorEpoch++; monitorLastReconcile = default;
            foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values) tile.ApplyLayout(monitorCompact, monitorScroll.ViewportWidth);
        };
        page.Children.Add(monitorScroll);
        monitorTimer.Tick += (_, _) => MonitorTick();
        ViewModel.PropertyChanged += (_, args) =>
        {
            if (args.PropertyName is nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.Counts)) { monitorEpoch++; monitorLastReconcile = default; }
        };
        return page;
    }

    private void MonitorNavigationChanged()
    {
        if (monitorWall is null) return;
        monitorEpoch++;
        var active = Equals((tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag, "实时监控");
        if (active || monitorWasActive) { monitorLastReconcile = default; monitorTimer.Start(); MonitorTick(); }
        monitorWasActive = active;
    }

    private void MonitorTick()
    {
        if (monitorWall is null || monitorStopping) return;
        var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        if (monitorRuntime is not null && !ReferenceEquals(monitorRuntime, ViewModel.Runtime))
            foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values) { tile.Eligible = false; tile.ClearUntrustedFrame(); tile.State.Text = "连接上下文已变化"; }
        foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values) { tile.ApplyLayout(monitorCompact, monitorScroll.ViewportWidth); tile.Present(now, MonitorActive && !monitorCompact && tile.VisibleIn(monitorScroll)); }
        LogMonitorFailures();
        if (monitorSelected is { } selected && monitorTiles.TryGetValue(selected, out var current))
            monitorDetail.Text = string.IsNullOrEmpty(monitorNotice) ? current.Detail : monitorNotice;
        var playing = monitorTiles.Values.Count(tile => tile.Session is { IsRunning: true } && tile.LastFrameAt is not null);
        monitorSummary.Text = monitorPaused ? "监控已暂停" : !MonitorActive ? "监控已停止" : $"可见 {monitorTiles.Values.Count(tile => tile.VisibleIn(monitorScroll))} 台 · 视频 {playing} 路";
        if (monitorReconcile.IsCompleted && now - monitorLastReconcile >= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1))
        {
            monitorLastReconcile = now;
            monitorReconcile = ReconcileMonitorAsync();
        }
        if (MonitorActive && monitorSampling.IsCompleted && now - monitorLastSample >= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2))
        {
            monitorLastSample = now;
            monitorSampling = SampleMonitorAsync();
        }
        if (!MonitorActive && monitorReconcile.IsCompleted && monitorTiles.Values.All(tile => tile.Session is null)) monitorTimer.Stop();
    }

    private async Task ReconcileMonitorAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime;
            var epoch = monitorEpoch;
            bool Current() => epoch == monitorEpoch && ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) && MonitorActive && !ldBusy;
            if (!ReferenceEquals(monitorRuntime, runtime))
            {
                await Task.WhenAll(monitorTiles.Values.Select(tile => tile.StopAsync()).ToArray());
                monitorTiles.Clear(); monitorWall.Children.Clear(); monitorSelected = null; monitorDetail.Text = "未选中监看设备";
                monitorRuntime = runtime; monitorResources = new ResourceSampler();
            }
            if (!MonitorActive || ldBusy)
            {
                await Task.WhenAll(monitorTiles.Values.Select(tile => tile.StopAsync()).ToArray());
                monitorResources = new ResourceSampler();
                return;
            }
            var expected = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (var row in unifiedDevices.Where(row => !monitorConnectedOnly || row.Connected).ToArray())
            {
                if (!Current()) return;
                expected.Add(row.Key);
                if (!monitorTiles.TryGetValue(row.Key, out var tile))
                {
                    tile = new MonitorTile(row.Key, () => SelectMonitor(row.Key), () => OpenMonitorWindowAsync(row.Key), () => RetryMonitorAsync(row.Key));
                    monitorTiles.Add(row.Key, tile); monitorWall.Children.Add(tile.Surface);
                }
                var instance = runtime.LdPlayer?.Instances.FirstOrDefault(instance => instance.Index == row.Index);
                var signature = $"{row.Serial}/{row.Device?.Info.Generation}/{instance?.Generation}/{instance?.ProcessId}/{instance?.VBoxProcessId}";
                if (tile.Signature != signature)
                {
                    tile.Eligible = false; tile.ClearUntrustedFrame(); tile.Resource.Text = "CPU 待采样 · 工作集 未知"; tile.State.Text = "实例身份已更新";
                    await tile.StopAsync();
                    if (!Current()) return;
                    tile.Reset(signature, instance, row.Device);
                }
                tile.Name.Text = row.Name;
                tile.Subtitle.Text = instance is null ? row.Serial : $"实例 {instance.Index} · {row.Serial}";
                var eligible = row.Connected && row.Device?.Info.Online == true && instance is { Index: > 0 and < 99999, AndroidStarted: true }
                    && runtime.Settings.AdbAllowedSerials.Contains(row.Serial, StringComparer.Ordinal) && LdInstanceConnected(instance.Index);
                tile.Eligible = eligible;
                tile.Open.IsEnabled = eligible;
                if (!eligible || monitorCompact || !tile.VisibleIn(monitorScroll))
                {
                    if (!eligible) { tile.ClearUntrustedFrame(); tile.Resource.Text = "CPU 未知 · 工作集 未知"; if (!tile.Failed) tile.State.Text = "未连接/未授权"; }
                    await tile.StopAsync();
                    if (!Current()) return;
                    if (!eligible) tile.ClearUntrustedFrame();
                    if (!tile.Failed) tile.State.Text = eligible ? monitorCompact ? "资源监控 · 视频已暂停" : "画面已暂停 · 不在可视区域" : instance?.Index == 0 ? "受保护 · 未监控" : !row.Connected ? "未连接" : "未授权视频";
                    continue;
                }
                if (tile.Session is not null || tile.Failed || ViewModel.Demo) continue;
                await tile.StopCompletion;
                if (!Current() || tile.Session is not null || tile.Failed) return;
                if (!tile.VisibleIn(monitorScroll) || !unifiedDevices.Contains(row) || !LdInstanceConnected(instance!.Index)) continue;
                if (runtime.Backend is not AdbDeviceBackend backend) { tile.Fail("当前后端不支持实时视频"); continue; }
                var ffmpeg = ResolveMonitorFfmpeg(runtime.Settings.MonitorFfmpegPath);
                if (ffmpeg is null) { tile.Fail("未配置 FFmpeg，前往环境设置"); continue; }
                if (runtime.Settings.MonitorServerPath != runtime.FrozenConnectionSettings.MonitorServerPath) { tile.Fail("视频组件配置已修改，重启程序后生效"); continue; }
                if (!File.Exists(runtime.Settings.MonitorServerPath)) { tile.Fail("未配置官方视频组件，前往环境设置"); continue; }
                var width = row.Device!.Info.Width; var height = row.Device.Info.Height;
                var scale = 320d / Math.Max(width, height);
                var frameWidth = Math.Max(16, (int)(width * scale) / 2 * 2);
                var frameHeight = Math.Max(16, (int)(height * scale) / 2 * 2);
                tile.State.Text = "视频连接中";
                var videoEpoch = tile.BeginVideo();
                tile.Session = new ScreenVideoSession(backend, row.Serial, ffmpeg, frameWidth, frameHeight,
                    frame => tile.AcceptFrame(videoEpoch, frame),
                    status => tile.AcceptStatus(videoEpoch, status));
                tile.Session.Start();
                runtime.Log.Write("monitor-video-start", $"index={instance!.Index}; serial={row.Serial}; generation={instance.Generation}; size={frameWidth}x{frameHeight}");
            }
            foreach (var key in monitorTiles.Keys.Where(key => !expected.Contains(key)).ToArray())
            {
                await monitorTiles[key].StopAsync(); LogMonitorFailures(); monitorWall.Children.Remove(monitorTiles[key].Surface); monitorTiles.Remove(key);
                if (monitorSelected == key) { monitorSelected = null; monitorDetail.Text = "未选中监看设备"; }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            monitorSummary.Text = "监控更新失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex);
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("monitor-reconcile-error", ex.ToString());
        }
    }

    private async Task SampleMonitorAsync()
    {
        var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime;
        var epoch = monitorEpoch;
        var sampler = monitorResources;
        var targets = monitorTiles.Values.Where(tile => tile.Eligible && tile.Target is not null).Select(tile => (tile.Key, Target: tile.Target!)).ToArray();
        try
        {
            var result = await Task.Run(() => (Host: sampler.SampleHost(), Rows: targets.Select(item => (item.Key, Sample: sampler.SampleInstance(item.Target))).ToArray()));
            if (closing || epoch != monitorEpoch || !ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) || !MonitorActive) return;
            var host = result.Host;
            monitorLatestHost = host;
            if (host.CpuPercent is not null && host.TotalPhysical is > 0 && host.AvailablePhysical is not null) monitorHostValidSamples++;
            monitorHost.Text = $"主机 CPU {Percent(host.CpuPercent, host.Error is null)} · 内存 {Memory(host.TotalPhysical is { } total && host.AvailablePhysical is { } free ? total - free : null)} / {Memory(host.TotalPhysical)} · {host.ObservedAt.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss}";
            monitorHost.ToolTip = host.Error;
            foreach (var item in result.Rows)
            {
                if (monitorTiles.TryGetValue(item.Key, out var tile) && tile.Target?.Generation == item.Sample.Generation && targets.Any(target => target.Key == item.Key && target.Target == tile.Target)) tile.SetResource(item.Sample);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { monitorHost.Text = "主机资源未知：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex); ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("monitor-resource-error", ex.ToString()); }
    }

    private static string Percent(double? value, bool pending = false) => value is { } number ? $"{number:0.0}%" : pending ? "待采样" : "未知";
    private static string Memory(long? value) => value is { } bytes ? bytes >= 1024L * 1024 * 1024 ? $"{bytes / 1073741824d:0.00} GB" : $"{bytes / 1048576d:0} MB" : "未知";
    private static string? ResolveMonitorFfmpeg(string configured)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured)) return Path.IsPathFullyQualified(configured) && File.Exists(configured) ? configured : null;
        return (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH") ?? "").Split(Path.PathSeparator).Where(path => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)).Select(path => Path.Combine(path.Trim('"'), "ffmpeg.exe")).FirstOrDefault(File.Exists);
    }

    private void SelectMonitor(string key)
    {
        monitorSelected = key; monitorNotice = "";
        foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values) tile.Surface.BorderBrush = ThemeBrush(tile.Key == key ? "AccentBrush" : "BorderBrush");
        MonitorTick();
    }

    private void SetMonitorMode(bool compact)
    {
        monitorCompact = compact; monitorEpoch++; monitorLastReconcile = default;
        monitorWallChoice.IsChecked = !compact; monitorListChoice.IsChecked = compact;
        foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values) tile.ApplyLayout(compact, monitorScroll.ViewportWidth);
        MonitorTick();
    }

    private async Task RetryMonitorAsync(string key)
    {
        if (!monitorTiles.TryGetValue(key, out var tile)) return;
        await tile.StopAsync(); tile.Failed = false; tile.Frame.Source = null; tile.LastFrameAt = null; tile.State.Text = "等待视频";
        monitorTimer.Start();
        monitorLastReconcile = default; MonitorTick();
    }

    private async Task OpenMonitorWindowAsync(string key)
    {
        if (!monitorTiles.TryGetValue(key, out var tile) || !tile.Eligible || tile.Instance is not { } instance || tile.Device is not { } device) return;
        try
        {
            var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime;
            var target = tile.Target ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未取得已核验的进程身份。");
            runtime.RequireFrozenConnectionSettings();
            if (runtime.Backend is not AdbDeviceBackend backend) throw new InvalidOperationException("仅真实雷电实例支持打开窗口。");
            await backend.VerifyIdentityAsync(device.Serial);
            if (!ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) || !LdInstanceConnected(instance.Index) || runtime.LdPlayer?.Instances.FirstOrDefault(item => item.Index == instance.Index) != instance) throw new InvalidOperationException("实例身份已变化，请重新接入。");
            if (ldWindowVisibility?.IsHidden(instance.Index) == true) await ldWindowVisibility.ShowAsync(instance.Index);
            if (!ReferenceEquals(runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) || !LdInstanceConnected(instance.Index) || runtime.LdPlayer?.Instances.FirstOrDefault(item => item.Index == instance.Index) != instance) throw new InvalidOperationException("窗口恢复期间实例身份已变化。");
            var foreground = LdRunningWindow.Show(instance, Path.GetDirectoryName(runtime.Settings.LdConsolePath)!, target.PlayerBirth);
            monitorDetail.Text = monitorNotice = foreground ? $"已请求显示 {tile.Name.Text} 的模拟器窗口" : "已请求显示窗口，Windows 未允许切换前台";
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { monitorDetail.Text = monitorNotice = "打开窗口失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex); ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("monitor-window-error", ex.ToString()); }
    }

    private async Task StopMonitorAsync()
    {
        monitorStopping = true; monitorEpoch++; monitorTimer.Stop();
        await monitorReconcile;
        await Task.WhenAll(monitorTiles.Values.Select(tile => tile.StopAsync()).ToArray());
        LogMonitorFailures();
        await monitorSampling;
        monitorResources = new ResourceSampler();
        monitorStopping = false;
    }
    internal Task StopMonitorAfterFailureAsync() => StopMonitorAsync();

    private void LogMonitorFailures()
    {
        foreach (var tile in monitorTiles.Values.Where(tile => tile.Failed && !tile.FailureLogged))
        {
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("monitor-video-error", $"key={tile.Key}; serial={tile.Device?.Serial}; {tile.FailureReason}");
            tile.FailureLogged = true;
        }
    }

    private sealed class MonitorTile
    {
        internal readonly string Key;
        internal readonly Border Surface;
        internal readonly Image Frame = new() { Stretch = Stretch.Uniform };
        internal readonly TextBlock Name = new() { FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis };
        internal readonly TextBlock Subtitle = new() { FontSize = 11, Foreground = WallMuted, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis };
        internal readonly TextBlock State = new() { Text = "等待视频", FontSize = 11, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis };
        internal readonly TextBlock Resource = new() { Text = "CPU 待采样 · 工作集 未知", FontSize = 11, Foreground = WallMuted };
        internal readonly Button Open;
        private readonly Border videoSurface;
        private readonly Polyline cpuLine = new() { Stroke = ThemeBrush("AccentBrush"), StrokeThickness = 1.5 };
        private readonly Polyline memoryLine = new() { Stroke = ThemeBrush("SuccessBrush"), StrokeThickness = 1.5 };
        private readonly Canvas chart;
        private readonly List<MonitorResourceSample> history = [];
        private WriteableBitmap? bitmap;
        internal string Signature = "";
        internal LdPlayerInstance? Instance;
        internal DeviceRow? Device;
        internal MonitorProcessTarget? Target;
        internal ScreenVideoSession? Session;
        private sealed record PendingVideo(long Epoch, ScreenVideoFrame Frame);
        private PendingVideo? pendingFrame;
        private readonly object frameGate = new();
        private string? pendingStatus;
        private long videoEpoch;
        internal Task StopCompletion = Task.CompletedTask;
        internal DateTimeOffset? LastFrameAt;
        internal bool Eligible;
        internal bool Failed;
        internal string? FailureReason;
        internal bool FailureLogged;
        internal long Received;
        internal long Presented;
        internal int ValidResourceSamples;
        internal MonitorResourceSample? LatestResource;
        private long previousCount;
        private DateTimeOffset previousRateAt;
        private double? arrivalRate;
        internal string Detail => $"{Name.Text} · {Subtitle.Text} · {State.Text} · {Resource.Text} · 最近 {history.Count} 个资源样本";

        internal MonitorTile(string key, Action select, Func<Task> open, Func<Task> retry)
        {
            Key = key;
            Surface = new Border { Width = 330, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 12, 12), Padding = new Thickness(9), BorderThickness = new Thickness(1), BorderBrush = ThemeBrush("BorderBrush"), CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(8), Background = ThemeBrush("SurfaceBrush") };
            var stack = new StackPanel(); Surface.Child = stack;
            var title = new DockPanel();
            Open = MonitorIcon("\uE8A7", "打开模拟器窗口", open);
            DockPanel.SetDock(Open, Dock.Right); title.Children.Add(Open);
            var again = MonitorIcon("\uE72C", "重试视频", retry); DockPanel.SetDock(again, Dock.Right); title.Children.Add(again);
            var names = new StackPanel(); names.Children.Add(Name); names.Children.Add(Subtitle); title.Children.Add(names); stack.Children.Add(title);
            Name.SetBinding(ToolTipProperty, new Binding(nameof(TextBlock.Text)) { Source = Name }); Subtitle.SetBinding(ToolTipProperty, new Binding(nameof(TextBlock.Text)) { Source = Subtitle });
            Resource.TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis;
            videoSurface = new Border { Height = 180, Background = ThemeBrush("TextBrush"), Margin = new Thickness(0, 7, 0, 6), Child = Frame }; stack.Children.Add(videoSurface);
            stack.Children.Add(State); stack.Children.Add(Resource);
            chart = new Canvas { Height = 24, ClipToBounds = true, ToolTip = "最近15分钟：蓝色 CPU；绿色进程工作集（独立比例）", Margin = new Thickness(0, 5, 0, 0) };
            chart.SizeChanged += (_, _) => DrawResourceHistory();
            chart.Children.Add(cpuLine); chart.Children.Add(memoryLine); stack.Children.Add(chart);
            Surface.MouseLeftButtonDown += async (_, args) =>
            {
                if (args.OriginalSource is DependencyObject source && FindButton(source) is not null) return;
                select();
                if (args.ClickCount == 2) await open();
            };
        }

        internal void ApplyLayout(bool compact, double viewportWidth)
        {
            var available = double.IsFinite(viewportWidth) && viewportWidth > 0 ? Math.Max(1, viewportWidth - Surface.Margin.Left - Surface.Margin.Right) : 330;
            Surface.Width = compact ? available : Math.Min(330, available);
            videoSurface.Visibility = compact ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        }

        private static Button? FindButton(DependencyObject source)
        {
            for (var current = source; current is not null; current = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(current)) if (current is Button button) return button;
            return null;
        }
        private static Button MonitorIcon(string glyph, string tooltip, Func<Task> action)
        {
            var button = new Button { Content = ShellGlyph(glyph, 14), Width = 44, Height = 44, MinWidth = 44, ToolTip = tooltip, Padding = new Thickness(0) };
            System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(button, tooltip);
            button.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "IconButton");
            button.Click += async (_, _) => { button.IsEnabled = false; try { await action(); } finally { button.IsEnabled = true; } };
            return button;
        }
        internal bool VisibleIn(ScrollViewer viewport)
        {
            if (!Surface.IsVisible || !Surface.IsLoaded || viewport.ActualHeight <= 0) return false;
            try
            {
                var content = VisualDescendants<ScrollContentPresenter>(viewport).FirstOrDefault(item => ReferenceEquals(item.TemplatedParent, viewport));
                if (content is null) return false;
                var intersection = Rect.Intersect(Surface.TransformToAncestor(content).TransformBounds(new Rect(Surface.RenderSize)), new Rect(content.RenderSize));
                return !intersection.IsEmpty && intersection.Width > 0 && intersection.Height > 0;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException) { return false; }
        }
        internal void Reset(string signature, LdPlayerInstance? instance, DeviceRow? device)
        {
            Signature = signature; Instance = instance; Device = device; Failed = false; FailureReason = null; FailureLogged = false; history.Clear(); cpuLine.Points.Clear(); memoryLine.Points.Clear(); ClearUntrustedFrame(); Received = Presented = previousCount = 0; ValidResourceSamples = 0; LatestResource = null; previousRateAt = default; arrivalRate = null;
            Resource.Text = "CPU 待采样 · 工作集 未知";
            Target = null;
            if (instance is { ProcessId: > 0 })
            {
                try { Target = new(instance.Index, instance.Generation, instance.ProcessId, Birth(instance.ProcessId), instance.VBoxProcessId, Birth(instance.VBoxProcessId)); }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException or System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception) { Resource.ToolTip = ex.Message; }
            }
        }
        private static long Birth(int pid) { if (pid <= 0) return 0; using var process = Process.GetProcessById(pid); return process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks; }
        internal long BeginVideo()
        {
            lock (frameGate) { videoEpoch++; pendingFrame = null; pendingStatus = null; previousRateAt = default; previousCount = Received = 0; arrivalRate = null; return videoEpoch; }
        }
        internal void AcceptFrame(long epoch, ScreenVideoFrame frame)
        {
            lock (frameGate) { if (videoEpoch == epoch) pendingFrame = new(epoch, frame); }
        }
        internal void AcceptStatus(long epoch, string status)
        {
            lock (frameGate) { if (videoEpoch == epoch) pendingStatus = status; }
        }
        internal void ClearUntrustedFrame()
        {
            lock (frameGate) { videoEpoch++; pendingFrame = null; pendingStatus = null; }
            Frame.Source = null; bitmap = null; LastFrameAt = null;
        }
        internal void Present(DateTimeOffset now, bool active)
        {
            PendingVideo? pending;
            string? status;
            lock (frameGate) { pending = pendingFrame; pendingFrame = null; status = pendingStatus; }
            if (pending is { } packet && packet.Epoch == videoEpoch && active && Eligible)
            {
                var frame = packet.Frame;
                if (bitmap is null || bitmap.PixelWidth != frame.Width || bitmap.PixelHeight != frame.Height)
                    bitmap = new WriteableBitmap(frame.Width, frame.Height, 96, 96, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null);
                bitmap.WritePixels(new Int32Rect(0, 0, frame.Width, frame.Height), frame.Bgra, frame.Width * 4, 0);
                Frame.Source = bitmap; LastFrameAt = frame.ReceivedAt; Received = frame.Sequence; Presented++;
            }
            if (now - previousRateAt >= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2))
            {
                if (previousRateAt != default) arrivalRate = (Received - previousCount) / (now - previousRateAt).TotalSeconds;
                previousRateAt = now; previousCount = Received;
            }
            if (Session is { Completion.IsCompleted: true, LastError: { } error } && !Failed) Fail(error);
            if (Failed) return;
            if (!Eligible) return;
            if (!active) { if (LastFrameAt is not null) State.Text = "画面已暂停 · 历史帧"; return; }
            if (LastFrameAt is { } received)
                State.Text = now - received > TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) ? $"等待新帧 · 上次 {received.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss}" : $"视频 · 到帧 {arrivalRate?.ToString("0.0") ?? "--"} 帧/秒 · {received.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss}";
            else if (Session is not null) { State.Text = status ?? "视频连接中"; State.ToolTip = status; }
        }
        internal void Fail(string reason) { Failed = true; if (FailureReason != reason) FailureLogged = false; FailureReason = reason; State.Text = "视频不可用：" + reason; State.ToolTip = reason; }
        internal void SetResource(MonitorResourceSample sample)
        {
            LatestResource = sample;
            if (sample.CpuPercent is not null && sample.WorkingSetBytes is > 0) ValidResourceSamples++;
            history.Add(sample); history.RemoveAll(item => sample.ObservedAt - item.ObservedAt > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
            if (history.Count > 451) history.RemoveRange(0, history.Count - 451);
            Resource.Text = $"CPU {Percent(sample.CpuPercent, sample.Error is null)} · 工作集 {Memory(sample.WorkingSetBytes)}";
            Resource.ToolTip = $"{sample.ObservedAt.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss} · Player+VBox工作集含共享页，非安卓内存\n{sample.Error}";
            DrawResourceHistory();
        }
        private void DrawResourceHistory()
        {
            cpuLine.Points.Clear(); memoryLine.Points.Clear();
            if (history.Count == 0) return;
            var memoryMax = Math.Max(1, history.Max(item => item.WorkingSetBytes ?? 0));
            var cpuStart = history.FindLastIndex(item => item.CpuPercent is null) + 1;
            var memoryStart = history.FindLastIndex(item => item.WorkingSetBytes is null) + 1;
            for (var i = 0; i < history.Count; i++)
            {
                var x = i * chart.ActualWidth / Math.Max(1, history.Count - 1);
                if (i >= cpuStart && history[i].CpuPercent is { } cpu) cpuLine.Points.Add(new Point(x, 23 - Math.Clamp(cpu, 0, 100) * .22));
                if (i >= memoryStart && history[i].WorkingSetBytes is { } bytes) memoryLine.Points.Add(new Point(x, 23 - bytes * 22d / memoryMax));
            }
        }
        internal Task StopAsync()
        {
            var session = Session;
            if (session is null) return StopCompletion;
            Session = null;
            lock (frameGate) { videoEpoch++; pendingFrame = null; pendingStatus = null; }
            return StopCompletion = StopCoreAsync(session);
        }
        private async Task StopCoreAsync(ScreenVideoSession session)
        {
            try { await session.DisposeAsync(); }
            catch (Exception ex) { Fail("视频清理失败：" + ex.Message); }
            if (session.LastError is { } error) Fail(error);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Features;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private async Task VerifyNativeMainTargetAsync()
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("投屏目标离线验收仅限演示模式。");
        var previousCurrent = ViewModel.CurrentDevice;
        var previousMain = ViewModel.MainDevice;
        var main = ViewModel.Devices[0];
        var other = ViewModel.Devices[1];
        var mainInfo = main.Info;
        var otherInfo = other.Info;
        var otherSelected = other.IsSelected;
        var syncMouse = ViewModel.SyncMouse;
        var syncKeyboard = ViewModel.SyncKeyboard;
        var cases = new List<string>();
        using var self = Process.GetCurrentProcess();
        var executable = self.MainModule?.FileName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("当前进程路径不可用。");
        void Check(bool condition, string name)
        {
            if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException("主控投屏离线验收失败：" + name);
            cases.Add(name);
        }
        void Reject(Action action, string name)
        {
            try { action(); }
            catch (DeviceException) { cases.Add(name); return; }
            throw new InvalidOperationException("主控投屏未拒绝失效上下文：" + name);
        }
        try
        {
            Check(ViewModel.MainDevice is null && !CanEmbedScrcpy(), "没有明确主控时不回退到当前设备");
            await ViewModel.SetMainAsync(main);
            ViewModel.CurrentDevice = other;
            var target = MainScreenSnapshot() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("主控投屏快照缺失。");
            var otherTarget = target with { Row = other, Serial = other.Serial, Generation = other.Info.Generation, TransportId = other.Info.TransportId };
            screenProcesses.Add(other.Serial, new(otherTarget, self, self.Id, self.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks, executable));
            Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "主控 A 无投屏时，不嵌入当前设备 B 的进程");
            var session = new ScrcpySession(target, self, self.Id, self.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks, executable);
            screenProcesses.Add(main.Serial, session);
            Check(CanEmbedScrcpy(), "当前设备 B 不覆盖主控 A 的投屏目标");
            Check(!CanLaunchScrcpy(), "演示模式始终禁止启动外部客户端");
            other.Info = otherInfo with { State = "Offline" };
            Check(CanEmbedScrcpy(), "当前 B 离线不阻止在线主控 A 投屏");
            other.IsSelected = true;
            ViewModel.SyncMouse = ViewModel.SyncKeyboard = true;
            Check(CanEmbedScrcpy(), "开启同步并勾选离线 B 不耦合单主控投屏");
            other.IsSelected = otherSelected;
            ViewModel.SyncMouse = syncMouse; ViewModel.SyncKeyboard = syncKeyboard;
            ViewModel.CurrentDevice = null;
            Check(CanEmbedScrcpy(), "当前设备为空仍使用明确主控 A");
            ViewModel.CurrentDevice = other;
            other.Info = otherInfo;
            main.Info = mainInfo with { State = "Offline" };
            Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "主控 A 离线时不回退到在线 B");
            Reject(() => RequireMainScreenTarget(target), "离线源拒绝旧快照");
            main.Info = mainInfo with { Generation = mainInfo.Generation + 1 };
            Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "主控代次变化后旧投屏不可嵌入");
            Reject(() => RequireMainScreenTarget(target), "拒绝旧主控代次");
            main.Info = mainInfo with { TransportId = (mainInfo.TransportId ?? 0) + 1 };
            Reject(() => RequireMainScreenTarget(target), "拒绝旧 transport");
            main.Info = mainInfo;
            Reject(() => RequireMainScreenTarget(target with { Runtime = null! }), "拒绝旧 runtime");
            ViewModel.Devices.Remove(main);
            try { Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "已移出当前工作区的主控不可投屏"); }
            finally { ViewModel.Devices.Insert(0, main); }
            ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(true);
            try { Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "外部忙状态禁用投屏"); }
            finally { ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(false); }
            screenProcesses[main.Serial] = session with { BirthUtcTicks = session.BirthUtcTicks + 1 };
            Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "拒绝 birth 不匹配的进程");
            Reject(() => RequireScrcpySession(target, screenProcesses[main.Serial]), "窗口等待后重验进程 birth");
            screenProcesses[main.Serial] = session with { ProcessId = session.ProcessId + 1 };
            Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "拒绝 PID 不匹配的进程");
            screenProcesses[main.Serial] = session with { ExecutablePath = executable + ".not-owned" };
            Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "拒绝可执行文件路径不匹配的进程");
            screenProcesses[main.Serial] = session with { };
            Reject(() => RequireScrcpySession(target, session), "窗口等待后拒绝已替换的所有权记录");
            screenProcesses[main.Serial] = session;
            var package = new ScriptPackage
            {
                Manifest = new ScriptManifest { Id = "native-main-gate", Name = "主控门禁离线夹具", Version = "1.0" },
                Steps = [new ScriptStep { Action = "wait", DurationMs = 30000 }]
            };
            var otherScript = ViewModel.Runtime.Scripts.RunAsync(other.Serial, package);
            try { Check(CanEmbedScrcpy(), "当前 B 的脚本不阻止主控 A 投屏"); }
            finally { ViewModel.Runtime.Scripts.Stop(other.Serial); await otherScript; }
            var mainScript = ViewModel.Runtime.Scripts.RunAsync(main.Serial, package);
            try { Check(!CanEmbedScrcpy(), "主控 A 的活动脚本阻止投屏"); }
            finally { ViewModel.Runtime.Scripts.Stop(main.Serial); await mainScript; }
            await ViewModel.SetMainAsync(other);
            await Task.Yield();
            Reject(() => RequireMainScreenTarget(target), "异步让出后切换主控拒绝旧快照守卫");
            await ViewModel.SetMainAsync(main);
            Reject(() => RequireMainScreenTarget(target), "主控切走再切回仍拒绝旧输入代次");
            Check(CanEmbedScrcpy(), "重新选择相同有效设备后仍可使用其自有投屏");
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "native-main-target.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
            {
                mode = "demo", status = "PASS-OFFLINE",
                fixtureScope = "仅主控与会话守卫；外部进程启动、ADB、真实确认弹窗和嵌入路径均未调用；此处不是进程或网络探针计数。",
                actualEmbeddingExercised = false, confirmationTimingExercised = false, cases
            }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        }
        finally
        {
            foreach (var key in screenProcesses.Where(pair => ReferenceEquals(pair.Value.Process, self)).Select(pair => pair.Key).ToArray()) screenProcesses.Remove(key);
            main.Info = mainInfo;
            other.Info = otherInfo;
            other.IsSelected = otherSelected;
            ViewModel.SyncMouse = syncMouse; ViewModel.SyncKeyboard = syncKeyboard;
            ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(false);
            if (previousMain is not null) await ViewModel.SetMainAsync(previousMain);
            ViewModel.CurrentDevice = previousCurrent;
        }
    }
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/Views/NativeView.cs

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Features;
using MatrixDevice.Host;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private sealed record MainScreenTarget(MatrixRuntime Runtime, DeviceRow Row, string Serial, long Generation, uint? TransportId, long InputGeneration);
    private sealed record ScrcpySession(MainScreenTarget Target, Process Process, int ProcessId, long BirthUtcTicks, string ExecutablePath)
    {
        public bool IsCurrentProcess()
        {
            try
            {
                if (Process.HasExited || Process.Id != ProcessId) return false;
                using var current = Process.GetProcessById(ProcessId);
                return !current.HasExited && current.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks == BirthUtcTicks
                    && string.Equals(current.MainModule?.FileName, ExecutablePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException or Win32Exception) { return false; }
        }
    }

    private MainScreenTarget? MainScreenSnapshot()
    {
        if (ViewModel.Busy || ViewModel.MainDevice is not { } row) return null;
        var target = new MainScreenTarget(ViewModel.Runtime, row, row.Serial, row.Info.Generation, row.Info.TransportId, ViewModel.Runtime.Input.CurrentGeneration);
        try { RequireMainScreenTarget(target); return target; }
        catch (DeviceException) { return null; }
    }

    private void RequireMainScreenTarget(MainScreenTarget target)
    {
        if (closing || ldBusy || !ReferenceEquals(target.Runtime, ViewModel.Runtime) || !ReferenceEquals(target.Row, ViewModel.MainDevice)
            || !ViewModel.Devices.Contains(target.Row) || ViewModel.Transferring || target.Runtime.Api.HasActiveRequests
            || target.Runtime.Scripts.GetStatus(target.Serial).State is ScriptRunState.Running or ScriptRunState.Cancelling
            || target.Runtime.Input.CurrentGeneration != target.InputGeneration || !SameScreenDevice(target.Row.Info, target)
            || !SameScreenDevice(target.Runtime.GetDevices().SingleOrDefault(row => row.Serial == target.Serial), target))
            throw new DeviceException($"主控或连接身份已变化，未继续投屏：{target.Serial}。", 409, 1003);
        target.Runtime.RequireFrozenConnectionSettings();
    }

    private static bool SameScreenDevice(DeviceInfo? device, MainScreenTarget target) => device is { Online: true }
        && device.Serial == target.Serial && device.Generation == target.Generation && device.TransportId == target.TransportId;

    private async Task VerifyMainScreenIdentityAsync(MainScreenTarget target)
    {
        RequireMainScreenTarget(target);
        if (target.Runtime.Backend is AdbDeviceBackend backend) await backend.VerifyIdentityAsync(target.Serial);
        RequireMainScreenTarget(target);
    }

    private bool CanLaunchScrcpy() => !ViewModel.Demo && MainScreenSnapshot() is { } target && File.Exists(target.Runtime.Settings.ScrcpyPath)
        && (!screenProcesses.TryGetValue(target.Serial, out var session) || !session.IsCurrentProcess());
    private bool CanEmbedScrcpy() => MainScreenSnapshot() is { } target && screenProcesses.TryGetValue(target.Serial, out var session)
        && SessionMatchesTarget(session, target) && !nativeHosts.Any(host => host.ProcessId == session.ProcessId && host.IsAttached);

    private static bool SessionMatchesTarget(ScrcpySession session, MainScreenTarget target) => ReferenceEquals(session.Target.Runtime, target.Runtime)
        && ReferenceEquals(session.Target.Row, target.Row) && session.Target.Serial == target.Serial && session.Target.Generation == target.Generation
        && session.Target.TransportId == target.TransportId && session.IsCurrentProcess();

    private void RequireScrcpySession(MainScreenTarget target, ScrcpySession session)
    {
        RequireMainScreenTarget(target);
        if (!screenProcesses.TryGetValue(target.Serial, out var owned) || !ReferenceEquals(session, owned) || !SessionMatchesTarget(session, target))
            throw new DeviceException($"投屏进程或设备身份已变化，未嵌入窗口：{target.Serial}。", 409, 1003);
        if (nativeHosts.Any(host => host.ProcessId == session.ProcessId && host.IsAttached)) throw new InvalidOperationException("窗口已嵌入");
    }
    private async Task OpenScreenAsync()
    {
        if (!CanLaunchScrcpy()) return;
        var target = MainScreenSnapshot() ?? throw new DeviceException("主控不可用，请重新打开控制面板。", 409, 1003);
        var settings = target.Runtime.Settings;
        if (!ViewModel.Confirm("外部投屏客户端风险", "启动scrcpy会运行其外部ADB客户端，可能影响现有ADB服务。当前程序会在服务身份变化时拒绝继续。确认已核验该工具并接受此风险？")) return;
        await ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("启动 scrcpy", async () =>
        {
            if (ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("演示模式不启动外部 scrcpy");
            await VerifyMainScreenIdentityAsync(target);
            var path = System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(settings.ScrcpyPath);
            if (!File.Exists(path)) throw new FileNotFoundException("请在设置中配置有效 scrcpy 路径", path);
            if (screenProcesses.TryGetValue(target.Serial, out var existing) && existing.IsCurrentProcess()) throw new InvalidOperationException("该设备已有本程序启动的投屏窗口");
            var start = new ProcessStartInfo(path) { UseShellExecute = false, CreateNoWindow = true };
            foreach (var argument in new[] { "--serial", target.Serial, "--window-title", "MatrixDevice · " + target.Serial, "--max-size", settings.MainMaxSize.ToString(), "--max-fps", settings.MainMaxFps.ToString(), "--video-bit-rate", settings.MainBitRate.ToString(), "--no-audio" }) start.ArgumentList.Add(argument);
            if (settings.ShowFps) start.ArgumentList.Add("--print-fps");
            var process = Process.Start(start) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("无法创建 scrcpy 进程");
            screenProcesses[target.Serial] = new(target, process, process.Id, process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks, path);
            target.Row.ScreenState = "scrcpy 进程已启动 · 待窗口核验";
            await Task.Delay(400);
            RequireMainScreenTarget(target);
            if (process.HasExited) throw new InvalidOperationException($"scrcpy 已退出，退出码 {process.ExitCode}");
        });
    }

    private async Task EmbedScreenAsync()
    {
        if (!CanEmbedScrcpy()) return;
        var target = MainScreenSnapshot() ?? throw new DeviceException("主控不可用，请重新打开控制面板。", 409, 1003);
        var session = screenProcesses[target.Serial];
        await ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("嵌入投屏窗口", async () =>
        {
            await VerifyMainScreenIdentityAsync(target);
            RequireScrcpySession(target, session);
            var process = session.Process;
            for (var retry = 0; retry < 20 && process.MainWindowHandle == IntPtr.Zero; retry++)
            {
                await Task.Delay(100);
                RequireScrcpySession(target, session);
                process.Refresh();
            }
            if (process.MainWindowHandle == IntPtr.Zero) throw new InvalidOperationException("投屏窗口尚未出现");
            await VerifyMainScreenIdentityAsync(target);
            RequireScrcpySession(target, session);
            var window = new Window { Owner = this, Title = "投屏 · " + target.Serial, Width = 600, Height = 850, WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner };
            ResponsiveLayout.FitOwnedWindow(window, this, 600, 850);
            var host = new NativeWindowHost(process, System.IO.Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "window-recovery"));
            window.Content = host; nativeHosts.Add(host);
            window.Closing += (_, args) => { try { host.Restore(); nativeHosts.Remove(host); } catch (Exception ex) { args.Cancel = true; MessageBox.Show(window, ViewModel.PresentError(ex), "窗口恢复失败", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error); } };
            window.Show(); target.Row.ScreenState = "已嵌入自有 scrcpy 窗口";
        });
    }

    private Task RestoreScreensAsync() => ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("恢复投屏窗口", async () =>
    {
        var failures = new List<string>(); foreach (var host in nativeHosts.ToList()) { try { host.Restore(); } catch (Exception ex) { failures.Add(ViewModel.PresentError(ex)); } }
        if (failures.Count > 0) throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Join("\n", failures)); await Task.CompletedTask;
    });

}
```

```csharp
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private CancellationTokenSource? scanCancellation;
    private Task<NetworkScanResult>? scanOperation;

    private FrameworkElement BuildScanner()
    {
        var panel = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 5, 0, 7) };
        var startIp = new TextBox { Text = "127.0.0.1" };
        var endIp = new TextBox { Text = "127.0.0.1" };
        var port = new TextBox { Text = "5555" };
        var timeout = new TextBox { Text = "1500" };
        panel.Children.Add(Field("起始 IP", startIp, 70));
        panel.Children.Add(Field("结束 IP", endIp, 70));
        panel.Children.Add(Field("端口", port, 70));
        panel.Children.Add(Field("超时 ms", timeout, 70));
        var summary = new TextBlock { Text = "未扫描", TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0) };
        AsyncCommand? scan = null;
        ActionCommand? cancel = null;
        scan = new AsyncCommand(async () =>
        {
            if (ViewModel.Runtime.Backend is not AdbDeviceBackend backend || ViewModel.Demo) return;
            if (!int.TryParse(port.Text, out var remotePort) || !int.TryParse(timeout.Text, out var timeoutMs)) { summary.Text = "端口和超时必须为整数"; return; }
            scanCancellation = new CancellationTokenSource(); cancel?.Refresh(); scan?.Refresh();
            startIp.IsEnabled = endIp.IsEnabled = port.IsEnabled = timeout.IsEnabled = false;
            try
            {
                var progress = new Progress<NetworkScanProgress>(value => summary.Text = $"探测 {value.Completed}/{value.Total}\n发现 {value.Found} 连接 {value.Connected}\n{value.CurrentAddress}");
                scanOperation = new NetworkDeviceScanner(backend).ScanAsync(startIp.Text.Trim(), endIp.Text.Trim(), remotePort, probeTimeoutMs: timeoutMs, progress: progress, ct: scanCancellation.Token);
                var result = await scanOperation;
                if (closing) return;
                summary.Text = $"扫描结束\n目标 {result.Total} 发现 {result.Found} 连接 {result.Connected}";
                await ViewModel.RefreshDevicesAsync();
                if (result.Endpoints.Any(endpoint => endpoint.Found && !endpoint.Connected)) ShowText("网络发现结果", string.Join("\n", result.Endpoints.Select(endpoint => $"{endpoint.Address}:{endpoint.Port} · {(endpoint.Connected ? "已连接" : endpoint.Found ? "连接失败" : "未发现")} · {endpoint.Error}")));
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { summary.Text += "\n扫描已停止"; }
            catch (Exception ex) { summary.Text = "扫描失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex); }
            finally
            {
                scanCancellation.Dispose(); scanCancellation = null; scanOperation = null;
                startIp.IsEnabled = endIp.IsEnabled = port.IsEnabled = timeout.IsEnabled = true;
                cancel?.Refresh(); scan?.Refresh();
            }
        }, () => scanCancellation is null && !ViewModel.Demo && ViewModel.Runtime.Backend is AdbDeviceBackend && !ViewModel.Busy);
        cancel = new ActionCommand(() => scanCancellation?.Cancel(), () => scanCancellation is not null);
        var controls = Toolbar(); controls.Children.Add(Button("\uE721", "扫描", scan)); controls.Children.Add(Button("\uE71A", "停止", cancel)); panel.Children.Add(controls); panel.Children.Add(summary);
        ViewModel.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => scan.Refresh();
        var header = new TextBlock { MaxWidth = 185, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
        LocalizationService.Bind(header, TextBlock.TextProperty, ViewModel.Demo ? "网络发现 · 演示模式禁用" : "网络发现");
        var expander = new Expander { Header = header, Content = panel, Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0) };
        return expander;
    }
}
```
