using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text.Json;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    internal async Task RunOneClickStartAcceptanceAsync(string output, string approvedCandidate)
    {
        var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime;
        if (ViewModel.Demo || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(output) || !ViewModel.DataDirectory.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "artifacts" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || runtime.Settings.AdbAllowedSerials.Length != 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("冷启动验收必须使用无初始授权的隔离artifacts工作区。");
        var runId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var confirm = ViewModel.Confirm; var confirmations = 0;
        var passed = false; var visible = false; var colors = 0;
        var othersUnchanged = false; var otherCount = 0; var playerPid = 0; var vboxPid = 0;
        string? failure = null;
        Directory.CreateDirectory(output);
        var resultPath = Path.Combine(output, "result.json");
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(resultPath, JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { runId, passed = false, state = "running" }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        try
        {
            var target = runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1);
            if (!target.Name.StartsWith("MatrixAcceptance-", StringComparison.Ordinal) || target.AndroidStarted || target.ProcessId > 0 || target.VBoxProcessId > 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("仅允许已关闭的专用测试实例1，不能为验收关闭其它实例。");
            var original = runtime.LdPlayer.Instances.Where(item => item.Index != 1).ToArray();
            otherCount = original.Length;
            ViewModel.Confirm = (_, _) => { confirmations++; throw new InvalidOperationException("一键启动出现确认框。"); };
            await ConnectLdInstancesAsync([1], new Dictionary<int, string> { [1] = approvedCandidate });
            if (confirmations != 0 || !LdInstanceConnected(1) || ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.GetValueOrDefault(1) != approvedCandidate || ViewModel.Devices.Count != 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("一键冷启动未完成指定实例连接：" + ldFeedback.Text);
            var connected = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1);
            visible = connected.TopWindow > 0 && LaunchWindowVisible(new IntPtr(connected.TopWindow));
            if (!visible || ldWindowVisibility?.IsHidden(1) == true) throw new InvalidOperationException("新启动的雷电窗口未正常显示。");
            var png = await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.ScreenshotAsync(approvedCandidate);
            var size = PngImage.ReadDimensions(png);
            colors = Enumerable.Range(0, 16).Select(i => PngImage.ColorAt(png, i * (size.Width - 1) / 15, i * (size.Height - 1) / 15)).Distinct().Count();
            if (colors < 2) throw new InvalidOperationException("启动后的截图未检出有效画面。");
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(Path.Combine(output, "visible-device.png"), png);
            await ViewModel.Runtime.RefreshLdPlayerAsync();
            var launched = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1);
            playerPid = launched.ProcessId; vboxPid = launched.VBoxProcessId;
            if (!launched.AndroidStarted || playerPid <= 0 || vboxPid <= 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("截图后实例未保持运行。");
            if (launched.TopWindow <= 0 || !LaunchWindowVisible(new IntPtr(launched.TopWindow)) || ldWindowVisibility?.IsHidden(1) == true)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("截图后实例窗口没有保持可见。");
            foreach (var before in original)
            {
                var after = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.SingleOrDefault(item => item.Index == before.Index);
                if (after is null || after.Name != before.Name || after.ProcessId != before.ProcessId || after.VBoxProcessId != before.VBoxProcessId || after.AndroidStarted != before.AndroidStarted)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("测试期间其它实例状态发生变化，不能标记互不干扰通过。");
            }
            othersUnchanged = true;
            SetWallViewMode("list"); UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle);
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
            SaveRender(Path.Combine(output, "connected.png"));
            passed = true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { failure = ex.ToString(); throw; }
        finally
        {
            ViewModel.Confirm = confirm;
            Exception? restoreFailure = null;
            try { if (ldWindowVisibility is not null) await ldWindowVisibility.ShowAsync(1); }
            catch (Exception ex) { restoreFailure = ex; passed = false; }
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(resultPath, JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
            {
                runId, passed, state = "finished", failure, restorationFailure = restoreFailure?.ToString(),
                index = 1, startupConfirmationDialogs = confirmations, windowVisibleVerified = visible,
                screenshotSampleColors = colors, restored = ldWindowVisibility?.IsHidden(1) != true,
                emulatorShutdownNotRequested = true, otherInstanceCount = otherCount, othersUnchanged,
                launchAttempted = coldLaunched.Contains(1), observedPlayerPid = playerPid,
                observedVBoxPid = vboxPid, backgroundLaunchEnabled = false
            }, JsonDefaults.Options));
            if (restoreFailure is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException("验收窗口恢复失败，详见本轮result.json。", restoreFailure);
        }
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "IsWindowVisible")]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool LaunchWindowVisible(IntPtr window);
}

        internal void Precondition(bool value, string message) { if (!value) { Observe("precondition-failed", new { message }); throw new ReconnectPreconditionException(message); } Checks.Add("PRECONDITION " + message); }
        internal void Check(bool value, string message) { if (!value) { Observe("assertion-failed", new { message }); throw new InvalidOperationException(message); } Checks.Add(message); }

    private sealed class ReconnectBlocker(Func<Task> release) { internal Task Release() => release(); }
    private sealed record ReconnectCall(int Sequence, string Operation, string? Serial, long At, DeviceInfo? Source);

    private sealed class ReconnectGate(string operation, string? serial, Exception? failure)

    private sealed class ReconnectBackend : IDeviceBackend

        private readonly Dictionary<string, DeviceInfo> devices = new(StringComparer.Ordinal) { ["DEMO-001"] = new() { Serial = "DEMO-001", Name = "恢复A", State = "Ready", Width = 160, Height = 240, Rotation = 0, TransportId = 11 }, ["DEMO-002"] = new() { Serial = "DEMO-002", Name = "阻塞B", State = "Ready", Width = 160, Height = 240, Rotation = 0, TransportId = 22 } };
        internal Func<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>>? CatalogSnapshot; internal int MaximumActiveShotDump { get; private set; }
        internal ReconnectCall[] Calls() { lock (sync) return calls.ToArray(); } internal ReconnectPayload[] Payloads() { lock (sync) return payloads.ToArray(); }
        internal int ReadCount { get { lock (sync) return calls.Count(call => call.Operation is "Screenshot" or "Dump"); } } internal int ActiveShotDump { get { lock (sync) return activeShotDump; } }
        internal bool GatesDrained { get { lock (sync) return gates.All(gate => gate.Entered.Task.IsCompleted && gate.Release.Task.IsCompleted); } }
        internal object[] GateStates() { lock (sync) return gates.Select(gate => (object)new { gate.Operation, gate.Serial, gate.Claimed, entered = gate.Entered.Task.Status.ToString(), released = gate.Release.Task.Status.ToString(), gate.AdmittedAt, gate.Source, gate.PayloadMarker }).ToArray(); }
        internal DeviceInfo Info(string serial) { lock (sync) return devices[serial]; } internal void Change(string serial, DeviceInfo info) { lock (sync) devices[serial] = info; } internal void ChangeOnNextDiscover(DeviceInfo info) { lock (sync) nextDiscovery = info; }
        internal string? LastDump(string serial) { lock (sync) return payloads.LastOrDefault(payload => payload.Operation == "Dump" && payload.Serial == serial)?.Marker; } internal ReconnectPayload? LastShot(string serial) { lock (sync) return payloads.LastOrDefault(payload => payload.Operation == "Screenshot" && payload.Serial == serial); }
        internal void ClearTrace() { lock (sync) { calls.Clear(); payloads.Clear(); } } internal ReconnectGate Hold(string operation, string? serial, Exception? failure = null) { var gate = new ReconnectGate(operation, serial, failure); lock (sync) gates.Add(gate); return gate; }
        internal void ReleaseAll() { lock (sync) foreach (var gate in gates) { gate.Release.TrySetResult(); if (!gate.Claimed) gate.Entered.TrySetCanceled(); } }
        private async Task<T> Complete<T>(string operation, string? serial, Func<int, DeviceInfo?, T> make, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); var source = serial is null ? null : CatalogSnapshot?.Invoke().FirstOrDefault(info => info.Serial == serial); ReconnectGate? gate; int sequence; var admitted = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp(); var read = operation is "Screenshot" or "Dump";
            lock (sync) { sequence = calls.Count + 1; calls.Add(new(sequence, operation, serial, admitted, source)); gate = gates.FirstOrDefault(item => !item.Claimed && item.Operation == operation && item.Serial == serial); if (gate is not null) { gate.Claimed = true; gate.AdmittedAt = admitted; gate.Source = source; } if (read) { activeShotDump++; MaximumActiveShotDump = Math.Max(MaximumActiveShotDump, activeShotDump); } }
            try

        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => Complete<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>>("Discover", null, (sequence, _) =>
        {
            lock (sync) { if (nextDiscovery is { } changed) { devices[changed.Serial] = changed; nextDiscovery = null; } var snapshot = devices.Values.ToArray(); payloads.Add(new(sequence, "Discover", null, snapshot, null, "discover:" + sequence, null, null)); return snapshot; }
        }, ct);
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Complete("Screenshot", serial, (sequence, source) =>
        {
            var info = Info(serial); int marker; lock (sync) marker = ++frame; var red = (byte)(marker % 200 + 1); var green = (byte)(serial == "DEMO-001" ? 31 : 73);
            var png = PngImage.Create(info.Width, info.Height, (x, y) => (red, green, (byte)((x + y) % 251))); var text = $"frame:{marker}:{serial}:g{source?.Generation}:t{info.TransportId}:{info.Width}x{info.Height}:r{info.Rotation}";
            lock (sync) payloads.Add(new(sequence, "Screenshot", serial, null, source, text, Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(png)), [0, green, red, 255])); return png;
        }, ct);
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Complete("Dump", serial, (sequence, source) =>
        {
            var info = Info(serial); var marker = $"nodes:{serial}:{sequence}:g{source?.Generation}:t{info.TransportId}:{info.Width}x{info.Height}:r{info.Rotation}";
            var node = new AndroidNode { Text = marker, ResourceId = "fixture:root", Enabled = true, Bounds = new(0, 0, info.Width, info.Height), ChildNodeList = [new AndroidNode { Text = marker + ":child", ResourceId = "fixture:child", Clickable = true, Enabled = true, Bounds = new(5, 5, 50, 50) }] };
            lock (sync) payloads.Add(new(sequence, "Dump", serial, null, source, marker, null, null)); return node;
        }, ct);
        public async Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default) { await Complete("StartApp", serial, (_, _) => true, ct); return await inner.StartAppAsync(serial, packageName, activity, ct); }
        public async Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) { await Complete("Push", serial, (_, _) => true, ct); await inner.PushAsync(serial, localPath, remotePath, progress, ct); }

            var candidates = VisualDescendants<ToggleButton>(Page).Where(button => button is not CheckBox && (AutomationProperties.GetName(button) == role || button.Content as string == role)).ToArray();
            if (candidates.Length == 0) { Observe("original-no-segment", role); return; }
            Require(candidates.Length == 1, "公开分段角色唯一：" + role); var button = candidates[0];
            if (!button.IsVisible) { Observe("wide-no-segment", role); return; }
            if (button.IsChecked != true) await Invoke(button); await ApplyGlyphScale();
            Product((role == "目标" ? Targets : role == "任务" ? Tasks : Apps).IsVisible, "公开分段显示原表：" + role);
        }
        private ToggleButton? FocusSegment(string role)
        {

            if (candidates.Length == 0) { Observe("segment-focus", new { role, status = "NOT-APPLICABLE", reason = "Original page has no segment; no baseline claim added" }); return null; }

        }

        internal Rect PageClip() => Rect.Intersect(new Rect(Window.Shell.RenderSize), DeviceProbeBounds(Page, Window.Shell));
        internal Rect Clip(FrameworkElement element)
        {
            var clip = PageClip();
            for (DependencyObject? value = element; value is not null && !ReferenceEquals(value, Window.Shell); value = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(value))
            {
                if (value is FrameworkElement parent && parent.ClipToBounds) clip.Intersect(DeviceProbeBounds(parent, Window.Shell));
                if (value is ScrollViewer scroll) clip.Intersect(DeviceProbeViewport(Window.Shell, scroll));
            }
            return clip;
        }
        internal void Hit44(Control control) => DeviceProbe44(control, Window.Shell, Clip(control), Product);

    private sealed class LayoutAppsSnapshot
    {

        }

            state.Product(targetRows.SequenceEqual(window.applicationTargets) && appRows.SequenceEqual(window.applicationRows) && taskRows.SequenceEqual(window.applicationTasks) && targetSelected.SequenceEqual(window.applicationTargets.Select(row => row.IsSelected)) && appSelected.SequenceEqual(window.applicationRows.Select(row => row.IsSelected)), "原行对象、集合次序及目标/应用勾选保持");
            state.Product(taskStates.SequenceEqual(window.applicationTasks.Select(row => (row.ResultState, row.Message))) && visible.SequenceEqual(window.applicationRowsView.Cast<object>()) && sorts.SequenceEqual(window.applicationRowsView.SortDescriptions) && system == window.applicationSystemToggle.IsChecked && result == window.applicationResult.Text && progress == window.applicationProgress.Value, "过滤/排序/逐项任务/批次反馈保持"); state.Context();

    private sealed record LayoutAppsCall(int Sequence, string Operation, string? Serial, bool Forbidden);
    private sealed class LayoutAppsGate(Exception? failure)
    {
        internal readonly Exception? Failure = failure; internal bool Claimed;
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Release = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Returned = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    }

    {
        internal const string FailureMarker = "受控应用列表失败；原始结果需完整阅读。first-marker / " + "应用正文长结果保留、滚动与停止后续可达。" + "com.matrix.layout.failure.with.a.long.package.name / " + "last-marker";
        private readonly object sync = new(); private readonly List<LayoutAppsCall> calls = []; private readonly List<LayoutAppsGate> gates = []; private readonly List<Task> tasks = []; private int active;
        internal int ActiveLists { get { lock (sync) return active; } } internal int ListCalls { get { lock (sync) return calls.Count(call => call.Operation == "List"); } }
        internal bool ListTasksCompleted { get { lock (sync) return tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted); } }
        internal bool AllTerminal { get { lock (sync) return tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted) && gates.All(gate => gate.Entered.Task.IsCompleted && gate.Release.Task.IsCompleted && gate.Returned.Task.IsCompleted); } }

        internal object[] GateReport() { lock (sync) return gates.Select(gate => (object)new { gate.Claimed, entered = gate.Entered.Task.Status.ToString(), released = gate.Release.Task.Status.ToString(), returned = gate.Returned.Task.Status.ToString(), expectedFailure = gate.Failure?.Message }).ToArray(); }

        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Shell", serial);
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Tap", serial);
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw Forbidden("Swipe", serial);

    public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)

        var preferred = values.Length > 0 && values[0] is int count ? count : 5;
        var width = values.Length > 1 && values[1] is double available ? available : 700;
        return Math.Max(1, Math.Min(preferred, (int)Math.Floor(width / 135)));
    }
    public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}

                else Check(picture.Right <= Math.Min(tree.Left, properties.Left) + .5 && tree.Bottom <= properties.Top + .5 && Separate(picture, tree) && Separate(picture, properties) && Separate(tree, properties), "中屏原画面在左，树/属性在右上下有序且不重叠");

                Check(visible.Length == 1 && (expectedMode is null || visible[0].Name == expectedMode), "窄屏只有本次选择的原正文可见");
                var active = visible[0].Element; var slot = System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.LayoutInformation.GetLayoutSlot(active); var actual = DeviceProbeBounds(active, Window.Shell);
                Check(slot.Width >= Body.ActualWidth - 24 && slot.Height >= Math.Max(100, Body.ActualHeight - 96) && DeviceProbeContains(clip, actual), "窄屏本次原正文使用完整可用区而非窄残栏");

        }
        internal async Task Mode(string caption)
        {
            if (Body.ActualWidth >= 640) { Check(caption == "画面" ? Picture.IsVisible : caption == "节点" ? Window.nodeTree.IsVisible : Properties.IsVisible, "宽中屏原内容可见：" + caption); LayoutGeometry(); return; }
            var mode = VisualDescendants<ButtonBase>(Page).Single(button => AutomationProperties.GetName(button) == caption && button.IsVisible);
            var oldTreeFocus = Window.nodeTree.IsKeyboardFocusWithin; var oldPropertyFocus = Properties.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
            DeviceProbe44(mode, Window.Shell, PageClip(), Check); await Invoke(mode);
            Check(caption == "画面" ? Picture.IsVisible : caption == "节点" ? Window.nodeTree.IsVisible : Properties.IsVisible, "实际窄屏分段：" + caption);
            LayoutGeometry(caption);
            if (oldTreeFocus && !Window.nodeTree.IsVisible || oldPropertyFocus && !Properties.IsVisible)
            {
                FrameworkElement active = caption == "画面" ? Picture : caption == "节点" ? Window.nodeTree : Properties;
                var focused = Keyboard.FocusedElement as FrameworkElement;
                Observe("mode-focus-transfer", new { caption, oldTreeFocus, oldPropertyFocus, modeFocus = mode.IsKeyboardFocusWithin, activeFocus = active.IsKeyboardFocusWithin, focusedVisible = focused?.IsVisible, focusedType = focused?.GetType().Name });
                Check((mode.IsKeyboardFocusWithin || active.IsKeyboardFocusWithin) && focused?.IsVisible == true && (Window.nodeTree.IsVisible || !Window.nodeTree.IsKeyboardFocusWithin) && (Properties.IsVisible || !Properties.IsKeyboardFocusWithin), "隐藏有焦点正文后，真实焦点落在本次可见分段或其正文");
            }
        }
        internal FrameworkElement HeaderHit(TreeViewItem item)
        {
            var presenter = VisualDescendants<ContentPresenter>(item).First(value => Equals(value.Content, item.Header) && Ancestors(value).OfType<TreeViewItem>().First() == item);
            FrameworkElement header = presenter;
            foreach (var candidate in Ancestors(presenter).TakeWhile(value => !ReferenceEquals(value, item)).OfType<FrameworkElement>()) if (candidate.ActualHeight is >= 43.9 and <= 80 && candidate.ActualWidth >= 44) { header = candidate; break; }
            var bounds = DeviceProbeBounds(header, Window.Shell); var visible = Rect.Intersect(bounds, DeviceProbeViewport(Window.Shell, TreeScroll));
            Observations.Add(new { stage = "tree-header-hit", node = (item.Tag as NodeRow)?.Id, bounds = FiniteRect(bounds), visible = FiniteRect(visible) });
            Check(!visible.IsEmpty && visible.Width >= 43.9 && visible.Height >= 43.9 && DeviceProbeContains(PageClip(), visible), "树头真实选择区可见至少44，不扩大设备像素框");
            foreach (var point in new[] { new Point(visible.X + visible.Width / 2, visible.Y + 2), new Point(visible.X + visible.Width / 2, visible.Bottom - 2) })
            {
                var hit = Window.Shell.InputHitTest(point) as DependencyObject; Check(hit is not null && (ReferenceEquals(item, hit) || item.IsAncestorOf(hit)), "树头可见选择区实际命中原TreeItem");
            }
            return header;
        }
        internal (NodeRow Node, double Y, double Horizontal, double Vertical) TreeIntent()
        {
            var clip = DeviceProbeViewport(Window.Shell, TreeScroll);
            var row = Window.nodeTreeItems.Where(pair => pair.Key.Children.Count == 0 && pair.Value.IsVisible).Select(pair => (pair.Key, Bounds: DeviceProbeBounds(pair.Value, Window.Shell)))
                .Where(pair => pair.Bounds.Top >= clip.Top - .5 && pair.Bounds.Bottom <= clip.Bottom + .5 && Rect.Intersect(pair.Bounds, clip).Width > 0).OrderBy(pair => pair.Bounds.Top).First();
            return (row.Key, row.Bounds.Top - clip.Top, TreeScroll.HorizontalOffset, TreeScroll.VerticalOffset);
        }
        internal void CheckTreeIntent((NodeRow Node, double Y, double Horizontal, double Vertical) expected)
        {
            var actual = TreeIntent(); Observe("tree-intent", new { expected = new { expected.Node.Id, expected.Y, expected.Horizontal, expected.Vertical }, actual = new { actual.Node.Id, actual.Y, actual.Horizontal, actual.Vertical }, TreeScroll.ScrollableHeight, TreeScroll.ViewportHeight });
            Check(ReferenceEquals(expected.Node, actual.Node) && Math.Abs(expected.Y - actual.Y) < 1 && Math.Abs(expected.Horizontal - actual.Horizontal) < 1 && Math.Abs(expected.Vertical - actual.Vertical) < 1, "恢复同尺寸后的树滚动意图/锚点不被隐藏重排清零");
        }
        internal void PropertyTail()
        {
            var leading = Properties.GetRectFromCharacterIndex(Properties.Text.Length - 1, false); var trailing = Properties.GetRectFromCharacterIndex(Properties.Text.Length - 1, true);
            var local = leading.IsEmpty || trailing.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : Rect.Union(leading, trailing); var tail = local.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : Properties.TransformToAncestor(Window.Shell).TransformBounds(local); var viewport = DeviceProbeViewport(Window.Shell, PropertyScroll);
            Observe("property-tail", new { tail = FiniteRect(tail), viewport = FiniteRect(viewport), Properties.Text.Length, PropertyScroll.VerticalOffset, PropertyScroll.ScrollableHeight });
            Check(!tail.IsEmpty && DeviceProbeContains(viewport, tail), "长属性末字符实际滚入文本视口，不只比字符串/DesiredSize");
        }
        internal async Task ReplacePropertyIntent(string signal)
        {
            var original = Vm.FlattenNodes().Single(node => node.Id == "layout.leaf.47");
            var item = Window.nodeTreeItems[original]; item.BringIntoView(); await Settle(); HeaderHit(item);
            ((ISelectionItemProvider)new TreeViewItemAutomationPeer(item).GetPattern(PatternInterface.SelectionItem)).Select(); await Settle();
            var text = Properties; var scroll = PropertyScroll; var binding = BindingOperations.GetBindingExpression(text, TextBox.TextProperty);
            Check(binding is not null && text.IsReadOnly && ReferenceEquals(Vm.SelectedNode, original), "新意图使用原只读属性绑定和实际选中节点：" + signal);
            var focusReturned = text.Focus(); await Settle();
            Check(Window.IsActive && text.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && text.IsVisible, "新意图自有属性正文单次Focus前置：" + signal);

            var width = Window.ActualWidth; var height = Window.ActualHeight; var oldText = text.Text;
            var events = new List<object>(); var posts = new List<DispatcherOperation>(); var postedOverflow = false; var sizeChanges = 0;
            var wheelCount = 0; var downCount = 0; var keyCount = 0; var selectionCount = 0; var textCount = 0;
            double expectedOffset = double.NaN; var expectedStart = -1; var expectedLength = -1; var expectedCaret = -1; var expectedNode = original;

            MouseWheelEventHandler wheel = (_, args) => { wheelCount++; events.Add(new { kind = "wheel", args.Delta, proof = EventProof(args) }); };
            MouseButtonEventHandler down = (_, args) => { downCount++; events.Add(new { kind = "preview-down", button = args.ChangedButton.ToString(), proof = EventProof(args) }); };
            KeyEventHandler key = (_, args) => { keyCount++; events.Add(new { kind = "preview-key", key = args.Key.ToString(), proof = EventProof(args) }); };
            RoutedEventHandler selected = (_, args) => { selectionCount++; events.Add(new { kind = "selection", text.SelectionStart, text.SelectionLength, text.CaretIndex, proof = EventProof(args) }); };
            TextChangedEventHandler changed = (_, args) => { textCount++; events.Add(new { kind = "text", length = text.Text.Length, boundValueMatches = text.Text == Vm.NodeProperties, proof = EventProof(args) }); };
            text.AddHandler(Mouse.PreviewMouseWheelEvent, wheel, true); text.AddHandler(Mouse.PreviewMouseDownEvent, down, true); text.AddHandler(Keyboard.PreviewKeyDownEvent, key, true);
            text.SelectionChanged += selected; text.TextChanged += changed; Window.SizeChanged += sized; Window.Dispatcher.Hooks.OperationPosted += posted;

                Check(Math.Abs(Window.ActualWidth - 390) < .6 && Math.Abs(Window.ActualHeight - 1080) < .6 && text.IsVisible && Math.Abs(narrowOffset - oldOffset) > 2, "实际窄屏重排已改变中段offset，尚未排空idle：" + signal);
                Window.Width = width; Window.Height = height; Window.UpdateLayout();

                    Check(!postedOverflow && pending && sizeChanges >= 2 && Math.Abs(Window.ActualWidth - width) < .6 && Math.Abs(Window.ActualHeight - height) < .6, "真实resize后Input阶段仍有有界待处理ContextIdle：" + signal);

                        var point = new Point(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2); var hit = Window.Shell.InputHitTest(point) as UIElement;
                        var targetOwnsHit = hit is not null && (ReferenceEquals(target, hit) || target.IsAncestorOf(hit));

                    }
                    else
                    {
                        expectedNode = Vm.FlattenNodes().Single(node => node.Id == "layout.leaf.46"); var next = Window.nodeTreeItems[expectedNode]; HeaderHit(next);
                        ((ISelectionItemProvider)new TreeViewItemAutomationPeer(next).GetPattern(PatternInterface.SelectionItem)).Select();
                        Check(ReferenceEquals(Vm.SelectedNode, expectedNode) && next.IsSelected, "真实原树UIA选择长46发布合法新属性文本");
                    }
                    Observe("new-intent-signal", new { signal, beforeWheel, wheelCount, beforeDown, downCount, beforeKey, keyCount, beforeSelection, selectionCount, beforeText, textCount, posts = PostedProof() });
                }, DispatcherPriority.Input);

                {
                    if (signal == "text") Check(textCount > 0 && text.Text != oldText && text.Text == Vm.NodeProperties && ReferenceEquals(Vm.SelectedNode, expectedNode), "原绑定实际TextChanged且新长文本已发布，不直接写只读TextBox");
                    Check(scroll.ScrollableHeight > 100, "新输入后的实际滚动范围足够量化中段：" + signal);
                    expectedOffset = scroll.ScrollableHeight * .27;
                    Check(expectedOffset > 2 && scroll.ScrollableHeight - expectedOffset > 2 && Math.Abs(expectedOffset - oldOffset) > 2, "新意图S1为可区别S0的合法中段：" + signal);
                    scroll.ScrollToVerticalOffset(expectedOffset); Window.UpdateLayout();
                    expectedStart = text.SelectionStart; expectedLength = text.SelectionLength; expectedCaret = text.CaretIndex;
                    Observe("new-intent-explicit-scroll", new { signal, expectedOffset, actualOffset = scroll.VerticalOffset, scroll.ScrollableHeight, expectedStart, expectedLength, expectedCaret, posts = PostedProof(), scope = "Explicit ScrollTo only quantifies the new intent after the single routed/model signal; not proof of physical scrolling" });
                }, DispatcherPriority.Input);
                await injection.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await Settle();

                    && mappings.Count == Window.nodeTreeItems.Count && mappings.All(pair => ReferenceEquals(Window.nodeTreeItems[pair.Key], pair.Value)) && rectangles.Count == Window.nodeRectangles.Count && rectangles.All(pair => ReferenceEquals(Window.nodeRectangles[pair.Key], pair.Value))
                    && ReferenceEquals(current, Vm.CurrentDevice) && ReferenceEquals(main, Vm.MainDevice) && targets.SequenceEqual(Vm.Targets()) && Backend.Calls().Length == calls;
                Observe("new-intent-final", new { signal, stable, oldOffset, expectedOffset, actualOffset = scroll.VerticalOffset, scroll.ScrollableHeight, text.SelectionStart, text.SelectionLength, text.CaretIndex, expectedStart, expectedLength, expectedCaret, selected = Vm.SelectedNode?.Id, textLength = text.Text.Length, wheelCount, downCount, keyCount, selectionCount, textCount, events = events.ToArray(), posts = PostedProof() });
                Check(stable && ReferenceEquals(Vm.SelectedNode, expectedNode) && text.Text == Vm.NodeProperties, "新意图保持原对象/绑定/源/上下文且仅允许新文本节点合法变化：" + signal);
                Check(Math.Abs(Window.ActualWidth - width) < .6 && Math.Abs(Window.ActualHeight - height) < .6 && double.IsFinite(expectedOffset) && Math.Abs(scroll.VerticalOffset - expectedOffset) < 1 && Math.Abs(scroll.VerticalOffset - oldOffset) > 2, "回原尺寸且idle排空后S1不被旧S0覆盖：" + signal);

        internal void Save(string stage)
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(Directory, stage + ".png"); Window.SaveRender(path);
            var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(path); Check(bytes.Length > 0, "必需节点布局截图已实际保存：" + stage);

        }
        internal async Task Cleanup() { Backend.ReleaseAll(); await Wait(() => !Vm.Busy, "自有节点任务未排空"); Check(Backend.GatesComplete, "全部自有节点TCS已释放/排空"); Window.AbortStartup(); await Vm.ShutdownAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
    }

    private sealed record NodeLayoutSnapshot(Viewbox Picture, Canvas Canvas, TreeView Tree, TextBox Properties, Image Image, object? Source, NodeRow[] Nodes, NodeRow? Selected, string Text, int SelectionStart, int SelectionLength, int Caret, double PropertyVertical, double PropertyHorizontal,
        Dictionary<NodeRow, TreeViewItem> Items, Dictionary<NodeRow, Rectangle> Rectangles, Dictionary<NodeRow, bool> Expanded, DeviceRow? Current, DeviceRow? Main, DeviceRow[] Targets)
    {
        internal static NodeLayoutSnapshot Take(NodeLayoutCase state, (NodeRow Node, double Y, double Horizontal, double Vertical) treeIntent) => new(state.Picture, state.Window.nodeCanvas, state.Window.nodeTree, state.Properties, state.Window.nodeCanvas.Children.OfType<Image>().Single(), state.Vm.DebugImage,
            state.Vm.Nodes.ToArray(), state.Vm.SelectedNode, state.Properties.Text, state.Properties.SelectionStart, state.Properties.SelectionLength, state.Properties.CaretIndex, state.PropertyScroll.VerticalOffset, state.PropertyScroll.HorizontalOffset,
            state.Window.nodeTreeItems.ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key, pair => pair.Value), state.Window.nodeRectangles.ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key, pair => pair.Value), state.Window.nodeTreeItems.ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key, pair => pair.Value.IsExpanded), state.Vm.CurrentDevice, state.Vm.MainDevice, state.Vm.Targets().ToArray());
        internal void References(NodeLayoutCase state)
        {
            var controls = ReferenceEquals(Picture, state.Picture) && ReferenceEquals(Canvas, state.Window.nodeCanvas) && ReferenceEquals(Tree, state.Window.nodeTree) && ReferenceEquals(Properties, state.Properties) && ReferenceEquals(Image, state.Window.nodeCanvas.Children.OfType<Image>().Single());
            var data = ReferenceEquals(Source, state.Vm.DebugImage) && Nodes.SequenceEqual(state.Vm.Nodes) && ReferenceEquals(Selected, state.Vm.SelectedNode) && Text == state.Properties.Text;
            var mappings = Items.Count == state.Window.nodeTreeItems.Count && Items.All(pair => state.Window.nodeTreeItems.TryGetValue(pair.Key, out var actual) && ReferenceEquals(pair.Value, actual)) && Rectangles.Count == state.Window.nodeRectangles.Count && Rectangles.All(pair => state.Window.nodeRectangles.TryGetValue(pair.Key, out var actual) && ReferenceEquals(pair.Value, actual));
            var folds = Expanded.All(pair => state.Window.nodeTreeItems[pair.Key].IsExpanded == pair.Value); var context = ReferenceEquals(Current, state.Vm.CurrentDevice) && ReferenceEquals(Main, state.Vm.MainDevice) && Targets.SequenceEqual(state.Vm.Targets());
            state.Observe("reference-state", new { controls, data, mappings, folds, context }); state.Check(controls && data && mappings && folds && context, $"纯重排保留控件/数据/映射/fold/上下文 controls={controls};data={data};mappings={mappings};folds={folds};context={context}");
        }
        internal void PropertyState(NodeLayoutCase state)
        {
            var selection = SelectionStart == state.Properties.SelectionStart && SelectionLength == state.Properties.SelectionLength && Caret == state.Properties.CaretIndex;
            var expectedVertical = Math.Min(PropertyVertical, state.PropertyScroll.ScrollableHeight); var expectedHorizontal = Math.Min(PropertyHorizontal, state.PropertyScroll.ScrollableWidth);
            state.Observe("property-state", new { selection, SelectionStart, SelectionLength, Caret, actualStart = state.Properties.SelectionStart, actualLength = state.Properties.SelectionLength, actualCaret = state.Properties.CaretIndex, expectedVertical, expectedHorizontal, actualVertical = state.PropertyScroll.VerticalOffset, actualHorizontal = state.PropertyScroll.HorizontalOffset, state.PropertyScroll.ScrollableHeight, state.PropertyScroll.ViewportHeight });
            state.Check(selection && Math.Abs(expectedVertical - state.PropertyScroll.VerticalOffset) < 1 && Math.Abs(expectedHorizontal - state.PropertyScroll.HorizontalOffset) < 1, "同尺寸恢复保留文本选区/caret/合法clamp后的滚动意图");
        }
    }
    private sealed record NodeLayoutCall(int Sequence, string Operation, string? Serial);
    private sealed class NodeLayoutGate(Exception? error)
    {
        internal readonly Exception? Error = error;
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Release = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal bool Claimed;
    }
    private sealed class NodeLayoutBackend(bool portrait) : IDeviceBackend
    {
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend inner = new(); private readonly List<NodeLayoutCall> calls = []; private readonly List<NodeLayoutGate> gates = [];
        internal bool LongSecondLeaf;
        private int Width => portrait ? 360 : 720; private int Height => portrait ? 640 : 360;
        internal NodeLayoutCall[] Calls() { lock (calls) return calls.ToArray(); }
        internal void ClearCalls() { lock (calls) calls.Clear(); }
        private void Record(string operation, string? serial) { lock (calls) calls.Add(new(calls.Count + 1, operation, serial)); }
        internal NodeLayoutGate HoldShot(Exception? error = null) { var gate = new NodeLayoutGate(error); gates.Add(gate); return gate; }
        internal bool GatesComplete => gates.All(gate => gate.Entered.Task.IsCompleted && gate.Release.Task.IsCompleted);
        internal void ReleaseAll() { foreach (var gate in gates) { gate.Release.TrySetResult(); if (!gate.Claimed) gate.Entered.TrySetCanceled(); } }
        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) { Record("Discover", null); return (await inner.DiscoverAsync(ct)).Select(info => info.Serial == "DEMO-002" ? info with { Width = Width, Height = Height } : info).ToArray(); }
        public async Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            Record("Screenshot", serial); await inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct); var payload = PngImage.Create(Width, Height, (x, y) => ((byte)(x % 251), (byte)(y % 251), (byte)112));
            var gate = gates.FirstOrDefault(value => !value.Claimed); if (gate is not null) { gate.Claimed = true; gate.Entered.TrySetResult(); await gate.Release.Task.WaitAsync(ct); if (gate.Error is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(gate.Error).Throw(); } return payload;
        }
        public async Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default)

                Check(captureDispatcherTimer.IsEnabled == originalCaptureTimerEnabled, "专项结束恢复captureTimer原运行态");
            }
            catch (Exception timerError) { failure = failure is null ? timerError : new AggregateException("验收与定时器恢复均失败", failure, timerError); }
            try { if (screenshot is not null) { Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(screenshot)!); SaveRender(screenshot); } }
            catch (Exception screenshotError) { failure = failure is null ? screenshotError : new AggregateException("验收与最终截图均失败", failure, screenshotError); }
            failure = SaveDeviceLayoutReport(() => Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "device-layout.json"), () => new
            {
                status = failure is null ? "PASS-OFFLINE-WPF" : "FAIL", scope = "Isolated Demo, actual WPF controls and routed events; not physical clicks, Android, ADB wire, DPI or discovery proof",
                width, height, actualWidth = ActualWidth, actualHeight = ActualHeight, phase, checks, observations, fixtureInvocations, error = failure?.ToString()
            }, failure);
        }
        if (failure is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(failure).Throw();
    }

    private static Exception? SaveDeviceLayoutReport(Func<string> destination, Func<object> report, Exception? priorFailure)
    {
        try
        {
            var options = new JsonSerializerOptions(JsonDefaults.Options);
            options.Converters.Add(new DeviceLayoutDoubleConverter());
            File.WriteAllText(destination(), JsonSerializer.Serialize(report(), options));
        }
        catch (Exception reportError) { Console.Error.WriteLine(reportError); priorFailure = priorFailure is null ? reportError : new AggregateException("验收与报告保存均失败", priorFailure, reportError); }
        return priorFailure;
    }

    private sealed class DeviceLayoutDoubleConverter : JsonConverter<double>
    {
        public override double Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options) => throw new NotSupportedException("设备布局报告转换器仅支持写出。");
        public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, double value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            if (double.IsFinite(value)) { writer.WriteNumberValue(value); return; }
            writer.WriteStartObject();
            writer.WriteNull("value"); writer.WriteBoolean("finite", false);
            writer.WriteString("kind", double.IsNaN(value) ? "NaN" : double.IsPositiveInfinity(value) ? "PositiveInfinity" : "NegativeInfinity");
            writer.WriteEndObject();
        }
    }

    private static Rect DeviceProbeBounds(FrameworkElement element, Visual ancestor) => element.TransformToAncestor(ancestor).TransformBounds(new Rect(element.RenderSize));
    private static bool DeviceProbeContains(Rect viewport, Rect bounds) { viewport.Inflate(.5, .5); return bounds.Width > 0 && bounds.Height > 0 && viewport.Contains(bounds); }
    private static Rect DeviceProbeIntersection(Rect first, Rect second) => Rect.Intersect(first, second);
    private static DataGridCell DeviceProbeCell(DependencyObject element)
    {
        for (var current = element; current is not null; current = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(current)) if (current is DataGridCell cell) return cell;
        throw new InvalidOperationException("控件不在实际DataGridCell内。");
    }
    private static ScrollContentPresenter DeviceProbePresenter(ScrollViewer scroll) => VisualDescendants<ScrollContentPresenter>(scroll).Single(item => ReferenceEquals(item.TemplatedParent, scroll));
    private static Rect DeviceProbeViewport(FrameworkElement ancestor, ScrollViewer scroll)
    {
        var presenter = DeviceProbePresenter(scroll);
        return DeviceProbeBounds(presenter, ancestor);
    }
    private static void DeviceProbe44(Control control, FrameworkElement ancestor, Rect viewport, Action<bool, string> check)
    {
        var bounds = DeviceProbeBounds(control, ancestor);
        check(control.IsVisible && control.ActualWidth >= 43.9 && control.ActualHeight >= 43.9 && DeviceProbeContains(viewport, bounds), "完整44命中位于视口: " + AutomationProperties.GetName(control));
        DependencyObject? parent = control;
        while (parent is not null && parent is not DataGridCell && parent is not DataGridColumnHeader) parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(parent);
        if (parent is FrameworkElement cell) check(DeviceProbeContains(DeviceProbeBounds(cell, ancestor), bounds), "完整命中未越过单元格: " + control.Name);
        foreach (var point in new[] { new Point(2, 2), new Point(control.ActualWidth / 2, control.ActualHeight / 2), new Point(control.ActualWidth - 2, control.ActualHeight - 2) })
        {
            var location = control.TranslatePoint(point, ancestor);
            DependencyObject? target = null;
            if (control.IsEnabled) target = ancestor.InputHitTest(location) as DependencyObject;
            else VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(ancestor,
                item => item is UIElement element && (!element.IsVisible || !element.IsHitTestVisible) ? HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren : HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue,
                result => { target = result.VisualHit; return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop; }, new PointHitTestParameters(location));
            var ancestors = new List<string>();
            for (var current = target; current is not null; current = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(current))
                ancestors.Add(current.GetType().Name + ":" + (current as FrameworkElement)?.Name);
            check(target is not null && (ReferenceEquals(control, target) || control.IsAncestorOf(target)),
                $"控件命中归属: type={control.GetType().Name}; name={control.Name}; automation={AutomationProperties.GetName(control)}; key={(control.DataContext as UnifiedDeviceRow)?.Key}; enabled={control.IsEnabled}; bounds={bounds}; viewport={viewport}; point={point}; location={location}; visual={string.Join('>', ancestors)}");
        }
    }
    private static (string Key, double Y) DeviceProbeAnchor(DataGrid grid, ScrollViewer scroll)
    {
        var viewport = DeviceProbeViewport(grid, scroll);
        var row = VisualDescendants<DataGridRow>(grid).Where(item => item.IsVisible && item.Item is UnifiedDeviceRow && DeviceProbeBounds(item, grid) is var bounds && bounds.Top >= viewport.Top - .5 && bounds.Bottom <= viewport.Bottom + .5 && Rect.Intersect(bounds, viewport).Width > 0).OrderBy(item => DeviceProbeBounds(item, grid).Top).First();
        return (((UnifiedDeviceRow)row.Item).Key, DeviceProbeBounds(row, grid).Top - viewport.Top);
    }
    private static void DeviceProbeCheckAnchor(DataGrid grid, ScrollViewer scroll, (string Key, double Y) anchor, double horizontal, double vertical, Action<bool, string> check)
    {
        var actual = DeviceProbeAnchor(grid, scroll);
        var details = FormattableString.Invariant($" expectedKey={anchor.Key}; expectedY={anchor.Y}; expectedH={horizontal}; expectedV={vertical}; actualKey={actual.Key}; actualY={actual.Y}; actualH={scroll.HorizontalOffset}; actualV={scroll.VerticalOffset}; scrollMaxH={scroll.ScrollableWidth}; scrollMaxV={scroll.ScrollableHeight}; viewportW={scroll.ViewportWidth}; viewportH={scroll.ViewportHeight}; extentW={scroll.ExtentWidth}; extentH={scroll.ExtentHeight}; pixelViewport={DeviceProbeViewport(grid, scroll)}; selectedKey={(grid.SelectedItem as UnifiedDeviceRow)?.Key}; currentKey={(grid.CurrentItem as UnifiedDeviceRow)?.Key}");
        check(actual.Key == anchor.Key && Math.Abs(actual.Y - anchor.Y) <= 1, "滚动首个完整行Key与相对Y恢复:" + details);
        check(Math.Abs(scroll.VerticalOffset - Math.Min(vertical, scroll.ScrollableHeight)) <= .1 && Math.Abs(scroll.HorizontalOffset - Math.Min(horizontal, scroll.ScrollableWidth)) <= 1, "横纵滚动恢复且仅允许合法钳制:" + details);
    }
}

    private static T MonitorProbeField<T>(MonitorTile tile, string name)
    {
        var field = typeof(MonitorTile).GetField(name, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("已核监控私有字段不存在: " + name);
        return field.GetValue(tile) is T value ? value : throw new InvalidOperationException("监控字段类型不符或为空: " + name + "; expected=" + typeof(T).FullName);
    }
    private static T MonitorProbeAncestor<T>(DependencyObject child) where T : DependencyObject
    {
        for (var current = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(child); current is not null; current = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(current)) if (current is T found) return found;
        throw new InvalidOperationException("缺少实际监控祖先: " + typeof(T).FullName);
    }
    private static byte[] MonitorProbePixels(int seed)
    {
        var bytes = new byte[32 * 18 * 4];
        for (var offset = 0; offset < bytes.Length; offset += 4) { bytes[offset] = (byte)((offset / 4 + seed) % 256); bytes[offset + 1] = (byte)((seed * 19) % 256); bytes[offset + 2] = (byte)((offset / 128 * 17) % 256); bytes[offset + 3] = 255; }
        return bytes;
    }
    private static void MonitorProbeChart(MonitorTile tile, Action<bool, string> check, List<object> observations, string phase)
    {
        var history = MonitorProbeField<List<MonitorResourceSample>>(tile, "history"); var chart = MonitorProbeField<Canvas>(tile, "chart");
        var cpu = MonitorProbeField<Polyline>(tile, "cpuLine"); var memory = MonitorProbeField<Polyline>(tile, "memoryLine");
        var cpuStart = history.FindLastIndex(sample => sample.CpuPercent is null) + 1; var memoryStart = history.FindLastIndex(sample => sample.WorkingSetBytes is null) + 1;
        var memoryMax = history.Count == 0 ? 1 : Math.Max(1, history.Max(sample => sample.WorkingSetBytes ?? 0)); var expectedCpu = new List<Point>(); var expectedMemory = new List<Point>();
        for (var index = 0; index < history.Count; index++)
        {
            var x = index * chart.ActualWidth / Math.Max(1, history.Count - 1);
            if (index >= cpuStart && history[index].CpuPercent is { } value) expectedCpu.Add(new(x, 23 - Math.Clamp(value, 0, 100) * .22));
            if (index >= memoryStart && history[index].WorkingSetBytes is { } bytes) expectedMemory.Add(new(x, 23 - bytes * 22d / memoryMax));
        }
        bool Same(PointCollection actual, List<Point> expected) => actual.Count == expected.Count && actual.Select((point, index) => (point - expected[index]).Length <= .01).All(equal => equal);
        observations.Add(new { phase = phase + "-chart", tile.Key, width = chart.ActualWidth, height = chart.ActualHeight, samples = history.Count, cpuStart, memoryStart, cpuPoints = cpu.Points.ToArray(), memoryPoints = memory.Points.ToArray(), valid = tile.ValidResourceSamples, latest = tile.LatestResource, fullStrokePixelsClaimed = false });
        check(chart.ActualWidth > 0 && double.IsFinite(chart.ActualWidth) && Same(cpu.Points, expectedCpu) && Same(memory.Points, expectedMemory), "ActualWidth投影及最后unknown后段语义正确: " + tile.Key);

    private static void ObserveScreenshotPointer(ShotCase state, string phase, double zoom, Point requestedScreen)
    {
        try
        {
            var window = state.Window; var canvas = window.screenshotCanvas; var shell = window.Shell;
            var fields = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["phase"] = phase, ["zoom"] = zoom, ["observedAt"] = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("O", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) };
            void Read(string name, Func<object?> read) { try { fields[name] = read(); } catch (Exception error) { fields[name + "Error"] = new { type = error.GetType().FullName, error.Message }; } }
            static object Position(Point value) => new { x = double.IsFinite(value.X) ? (double?)value.X : null, y = double.IsFinite(value.Y) ? (double?)value.Y : null, finite = double.IsFinite(value.X) && double.IsFinite(value.Y) };
            static object? Identity(object? value) => value is null ? null : new { type = value.GetType().FullName, id = System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(value) };
            Point? os = null, mouse = null; PresentationSource? active = null, target = null;
            Read("requestedScreen", () => Position(requestedScreen));
            Read("cursorBefore", () => { var succeeded = GetAppearanceCursorPosition(out var value); if (succeeded) os = new Point(value.X, value.Y); return new { succeeded, x = succeeded ? (int?)value.X : null, y = succeeded ? (int?)value.Y : null }; });
            Read("requestedShell", () => Position(shell.PointFromScreen(requestedScreen)));
            Read("requestedCanvas", () => Position(canvas.PointFromScreen(requestedScreen)));
            Read("requestedHit", () => Identity(shell.InputHitTest(shell.PointFromScreen(requestedScreen))));
            Read("osShell", () => os is Point value ? Position(shell.PointFromScreen(value)) : null);
            Read("osCanvas", () => os is Point value ? Position(canvas.PointFromScreen(value)) : null);
            Read("osHit", () => os is Point value ? Identity(shell.InputHitTest(shell.PointFromScreen(value))) : null);
            Read("mouseCanvas", () => { mouse = Mouse.GetPosition(canvas); return Position(mouse.Value); });
            Read("mouseScreen", () => mouse is Point value ? Position(canvas.PointToScreen(value)) : null);
            Read("mouseShell", () => Position(Mouse.GetPosition(shell)));
            Read("activeSource", () => { active = Mouse.PrimaryDevice.ActiveSource; return active?.GetType().FullName; });
            Read("activeSourceId", () => active is null ? (int?)null : System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(active));
            Read("activeHwnd", () => (active as HwndSource)?.Handle.ToInt64());
            Read("activeRoot", () => Identity(active?.RootVisual));
            Read("targetSource", () => { target = PresentationSource.FromVisual(canvas); return target?.GetType().FullName; });
            Read("targetSourceId", () => target is null ? (int?)null : System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(target));
            Read("targetHwnd", () => (target as HwndSource)?.Handle.ToInt64());
            Read("targetRoot", () => Identity(target?.RootVisual));
            Read("sameSource", () => active is not null && ReferenceEquals(active, target));
            Read("captured", () => Identity(Mouse.Captured));
            Read("directlyOver", () => Identity(Mouse.DirectlyOver));
            Read("focused", () => Identity(Keyboard.FocusedElement));
            Read("windowHwnd", () => new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle.ToInt64());
            Read("isActive", () => window.IsActive);
            Read("isLoaded", () => window.IsLoaded);
            Read("isVisible", () => window.IsVisible);
            Read("windowState", () => window.WindowState.ToString());
            Read("keyboardWithin", () => window.IsKeyboardFocusWithin);
            Read("cursorAfter", () => { var succeeded = GetAppearanceCursorPosition(out var value); return new { succeeded, x = succeeded ? (int?)value.X : null, y = succeeded ? (int?)value.Y : null }; });
            fields["completedAt"] = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("O", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            state.Observations.Add(new { stage = "coordinate-pointer-diagnostic", detail = fields });
        }
        catch (Exception error) { try { state.Observations.Add(new { stage = "coordinate-pointer-diagnostic-error", phase, type = error.GetType().FullName, error.Message }); } catch (Exception) { } }
    }

    private sealed class ShotCase

        internal readonly List<string> Checks = []; internal readonly List<object> Observations = [];

                runtime = new MatrixRuntime { Backend = backend, Devices = catalog, Automation = automation, Scripts = scripts, Input = input, Api = api, Metadata = metadata, Log = log, Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings, SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json")), IsDemo = true }; api.DeviceSnapshotProvider = runtime.GetDevices;
                vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(runtime, directory, true); await vm.RefreshDevicesAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); await vm.SetMainAsync(vm.Devices[0]).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); vm.CurrentDevice = vm.Devices[1]; vm.Devices[0].IsSelected = true; vm.UpdateSelection();
                window = new MainWindow(vm) { Owner = owner, ShowActivated = true }; var state = new ShotCase { Window = window, Vm = vm, Backend = backend, Directory = directory };

                window.Show(); await state.Settle(); state.Check(window.IsLoaded && new WindowInteropHelper(window).Handle != IntPtr.Zero && Math.Abs(window.ActualWidth - width) < .6 && Math.Abs(window.ActualHeight - height) < .6, "实际HWND请求尺寸不Clamp");

            });
        await Case("actual-parameter-control-and-run", 1440, 900, state => state.Stage("actual-edit-submit-demo-effect", state.EditAndRun));
        await Case("invalid-json-zero-admission", 1440, 900, state => state.Stage("actual-invalid-edit-rejected", state.InvalidEdit));
        await Case("actual-job-selection-and-cancel", 1440, 900, state => state.Stage("actual-selected-job-cancel-b-continues", state.CancelSelection));
        await Case("resize-and-view-state", 1440, 900, state => state.Stage("same-controls-values-targets-and-logs", state.ResizeState));
        await Case("actual-500-log-tail-and-source", 1000, 700, state => state.Stage("real-window-tail-and-source-isolation", state.RealLogTail));
        var summary = new
        {
            status = failures.Count == 0 ? "PASS-OWN-WPF-SCRIPT-WORKSPACE" : "FAIL", reports,
            scope = "Real shown owned Demo WPF controls, original bindings and scheduler. Managed WPF render only; no OS input, external UIA, Sky, Android, ADB, API, user settings or native picker.",
            nativePicker = "NOT-RUN", functionalEditingAndCancellation = "OWN-WPF-CONTROLS-ONLY", oldAcceptance = "NOT-RUN-IN-THIS-MODE",
            windows = Application.Current.Windows.Count, mainWindowNull = Application.Current.MainWindow is null,
            errors = failures.Select(error => error.ToString()).ToArray()
        };
        try { File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "script-workspace.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(summary, JsonDefaults.Options)); }
        catch (Exception error) { failures.Add(new IOException("FIXTURE-FAIL: 工作区报告写入失败", error)); }
        if (failures.Count != 0) throw new AggregateException("自动化工作区独立验收失败", failures);

        async Task Case(string name, int width, int height, Func<ScriptWorkspaceCase, Task> action)
        {
            if (stop) { reports.Add(new { name, status = "NOT-RUN", reason = "先前案例清理未完成" }); return; }
            var state = new ScriptWorkspaceCase(Path.Combine(directory, name), width, height, dispatcher);
            var classes = new HashSet<string>(); Exception? failure = null; Exception? cleanup = null; var initialized = false;
            try { await state.Initialize(); initialized = true; await action(state); }
            catch (Exception error) { failure = error; classes.Add(initialized ? "FIXTURE-FAIL" : "PRECONDITION-FAIL"); }
            finally { try { await state.Cleanup(); } catch (Exception error) { cleanup = error; classes.Add("CLEANUP-FAIL"); stop = true; } }
            if (state.Failures.Count > 0) classes.Add("PRODUCT-FAIL");
            foreach (var item in state.StageFailures) classes.Add(item.Classification);
            reports.Add(new { name, status = classes.Count > 1 ? "MIXED-FAIL" : classes.SingleOrDefault() ?? "PASS", failureClasses = classes,
                initialized, cleaned = cleanup is null, checks = state.Checks, stages = state.Stages, observations = state.Observations,
                productFailures = state.Failures, stageFailures = state.StageFailures, calls = state.Backend.Calls.ToArray(),
                jobs = state.TerminalJobs, backendDisposed = state.Backend.Disposed, backendActive = state.Backend.Active,
                error = failure?.ToString(), cleanup = cleanup?.ToString() });
            if (classes.Count > 0) failures.Add(new InvalidOperationException(name + ": " + string.Join(", ", classes),
                new AggregateException(new[] { failure, cleanup }.OfType<Exception>().Concat(state.StageFailures.Select(item => new Exception(item.Error))).Concat(state.Failures.Select(message => new Exception(message))))));
        }
    }

    private sealed class ScriptWorkspacePrecondition(string message) : Exception(message);
    private sealed record ScriptWorkspaceStageFailure(string Stage, string Classification, string Error);
    private sealed class ScriptWorkspaceCase(string directory, int width, int height, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        internal readonly ScriptWorkspaceBackend Backend = new();
        internal MainWindow Window = null!;
        internal WorkspaceViewModel Vm = null!;
        internal MatrixRuntime Runtime = null!;

        internal readonly List<object> Observations = [];
        internal readonly Dictionary<string, string> Stages = [];
        internal readonly List<ScriptWorkspaceStageFailure> StageFailures = [];
        internal object[] TerminalJobs = [];
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, TaskCompletionSource> terminals = new();
        private readonly List<Task> ownedTasks = [];
        private bool userClose, disposed;
        private FrameworkElement page = null!;
        private DataGrid parameters = null!, jobs = null!;
        private ListBox logs = null!;
        private FrameworkElement result = null!;
        private object[] parameterRows = [], jobRows = [];
        private string[] presentationLogs = [], callsBeforeLayout = [];
        private ScriptJobRow? presentationJob;
        private const string LongResult = "PRESENTATION-ONLY-BEGIN\n";
        private string resultText = "";
        internal DataGrid Parameters => parameters;
        internal DataGrid Jobs => jobs;
        private DeviceRow A => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-001");
        private DeviceRow B => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-002");

        internal async Task Initialize()
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            var settings = new AppSettings { Language = "zh-CN", WindowWidth = width, WindowHeight = height, AutoStartApi = false,
                AutoConnect = false, SyncKeyboard = false, SyncMouse = false, AgentBaseUrl = null, AgentSerial = null };
            var catalog = new DeviceCatalog(Backend); var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(Backend, catalog, true);
            var automation = new AutomationService(Backend, catalog); var log = new RollingLog(Path.Combine(directory, "logs"));
            Runtime = new MatrixRuntime { Backend = Backend, Devices = catalog, Scripts = scheduler, Automation = automation,
                Input = new InputCoordinator(catalog, Backend), Log = log, Metadata = new CatalogRepository(Path.Combine(directory, "db.sqlite3")),
                Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings, SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json")), IsDemo = true,
                Api = new ApiServiceManager(catalog, Backend, automation, log) };
            Runtime.Scripts.JobChanged += OnJob;
            Vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(Runtime, directory, true); await Vm.RefreshDevicesAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Vm.CurrentDevice = A; A.IsSelected = true; Vm.UpdateSelection();
            Window = new MainWindow(Vm) { ShowActivated = false };
            Window.Closing -= Window.WindowClosing; Window.Closing += OnClose;
            Application.Current.MainWindow = Window;
            Window.Show(); Window.NavigateTo("脚本"); await Settle();
            Observe("actual-window-before-precondition", new { width, height, Window.ActualWidth, Window.ActualHeight, Window.IsLoaded, Window.IsVisible, Window.WindowState });
            Require(Window.IsLoaded && Window.IsVisible && PresentationSource.FromVisual(Window) is not null
                && Math.Abs(Window.ActualWidth - width) < .6 && Math.Abs(Window.ActualHeight - height) < .6, "实际已显示窗口尺寸必须等于请求尺寸");
            Require(Runtime.IsDemo && Vm.Demo && ReferenceEquals(Runtime.Backend, Backend) && !Runtime.Api.BasicRunning && !Runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning
                && Runtime.Api.DevicePorts.Count == 0 && !Runtime.Settings.AutoStartApi && !Runtime.Settings.AutoConnect
                && !Runtime.Settings.SyncKeyboard && !Runtime.Settings.SyncMouse, "自有 Demo 禁用所有外部接口、自动连接和同步");
            page = (FrameworkElement)((TabItem)Window.tabs.SelectedItem).Content;
            Require(Equals(((TabItem)Window.tabs.SelectedItem).Tag, "脚本"), "实际脚本页面已选中");
            var sections = VisualDescendants<TabControl>(page).Single();
            foreach (TabItem tab in sections.Items)
            {
                sections.SelectedItem = tab; await Settle();
                foreach (var expander in VisualDescendants<Expander>(page)) expander.IsExpanded = true;
                await Settle();
                parameters ??= VisualDescendants<DataGrid>(page).FirstOrDefault(element => ReferenceEquals(element.ItemsSource, Vm.Parameters))!;
                jobs ??= VisualDescendants<DataGrid>(page).FirstOrDefault(element => ReferenceEquals(element.ItemsSource, Vm.ScriptJobs))!;
                logs ??= VisualDescendants<ListBox>(page).FirstOrDefault(element => ReferenceEquals(element.ItemsSource, Vm.ScriptLogs))!;
                result ??= VisualDescendants<FrameworkElement>(page).FirstOrDefault(element => TextPath(element) == "SelectedScriptJob.Result")!;
            }
            Require(parameters is not null && jobs is not null && logs is not null && result is not null, "原参数、任务、日志和结果绑定控件存在（兼容原两标签及四视图）");
            Observe("initialized", new { requested = new { width, height }, actual = new { Window.ActualWidth, Window.ActualHeight }, Window.ShowActivated,
                views = sections.Items.Cast<TabItem>().Select(tab => tab.Header?.ToString()).ToArray(), backend = "owned forwarding Demo", nativePicker = "NOT-RUN" });
        }
        private void OnClose(object? sender, CancelEventArgs e) { e.Cancel = true; userClose = true; }
        private void OnJob(ScriptJobStatus value)
        {
            if (value.State is ScriptRunState.Completed or ScriptRunState.Cancelled or ScriptRunState.Failed)
                terminals.GetOrAdd(value.JobId, _ => new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)).TrySetResult();
        }
        internal async Task Stage(string name, Func<Task> action)
        {
            var before = Failures.Count; Stages[name] = "STARTED";
            try { Require(!userClose, "用户未关闭自有验收窗口"); await action(); Stages[name] = Failures.Count == before ? "PASS" : "PRODUCT-FAIL"; }
            catch (Exception error) { var kind = error is ScriptWorkspacePrecondition ? "PRECONDITION-FAIL" : "FIXTURE-FAIL"; Stages[name] = kind; StageFailures.Add(new(name, kind, error.ToString())); }
        }
        private void Product(bool condition, string message)
        { if (condition) Checks.Add(message); else { Failures.Add(message); Observe("product-failure", message); } }
        private static void Require(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new ScriptWorkspacePrecondition(message); }
        private void Observe(string phase, object value) => Observations.Add(new { phase, value });
        private Task Track(Task task) { ownedTasks.Add(task); return task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)); }
        private async Task Settle()
        {
            await dispatcher.InvokeAsync(Window.UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await dispatcher.InvokeAsync(Window.UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            await dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        }
        private async Task Reveal(FrameworkElement element)
        {
            for (DependencyObject? item = element; item is not null && !ReferenceEquals(item, page); item = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(item) ?? (item is Visual ? VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(item) : null))
            {
                if (item is TabItem tab && ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(tab) is TabControl tabs) tabs.SelectedItem = tab;
                if (item is Expander expander) expander.IsExpanded = true;
            }
            await Settle();
        }
        private Button Tool(string caption) => VisualDescendants<Button>(page).Single(button => AutomationProperties.GetName(button) == caption);
        private async Task Invoke(Button button)
        {
            Require(button.IsVisible && button.IsEnabled, "实际按钮可见可执行：" + AutomationProperties.GetName(button));
            var peer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(button);
            Require(peer?.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Invoke) is IInvokeProvider, "原 WPF 控件具有 Invoke provider");
            ((IInvokeProvider)peer!.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Invoke)).Invoke(); await Settle();
        }

                Parameters = Enumerable.Range(0, 24).Select(index => new ScriptParameter
                {

                    Unit = "呈现单位-" + new string('U', 60), Min = -1000, Max = 1000000,

            A.Info = A.Info with { Name = "目标 A-" + new string('A', 100) }; B.Info = B.Info with { Name = "目标 B-" + new string('B', 100) }; A.IsSelected = B.IsSelected = true; Vm.UpdateSelection();
            resultText = LongResult + string.Join("\n", Enumerable.Range(0, 128).Select(index => $"第{index:D3}行 " + new string('R', 100))) + "\nPRESENTATION-ONLY-TAIL";
            for (var index = 0; index < 100; index++) Vm.ScriptJobs.Add(new ScriptJobRow(new ScriptJobStatus(Guid.NewGuid(),
                new("PRESENTATION-ONLY-" + index + new string('S', 45), index + 1, null, true), "呈现脚本-" + new string('P', 80), "1.0",
                ScriptRunState.Completed, 9, 10, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-index - 1), DateTimeOffset.UtcNow, Result: resultText)));
            presentationJob = Vm.ScriptJobs[0]; Vm.SelectedScriptJob = presentationJob;

            Product(Backend.Calls.ToArray().SequenceEqual(beforeError), "原 ExecuteAsync 生成呈现错误压力不调用后端");

            Observe("presentation-only", new { parameters = Vm.Parameters.Count, jobs = Vm.ScriptJobs.Count, logs = Vm.ScriptLogs.Count,
                resultCharacters = resultText.Length, backendRuns = Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Count, errorCharacters = Vm.Error.Length });
