```csharp
        internal async Task Geometry()
        {
            var error = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(Window.Shell).Single(text => TextPath(text) == nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.Error));
            var errorScroll = Parent<ScrollViewer>(error); Require(errorScroll is not null, "公共错误栏真实滚动容器");
            Observe("shared-error-pressure", new { error.Text, error.ActualHeight, scrollHeight = errorScroll!.ActualHeight, maxHeight = N(errorScroll.MaxHeight), bounds = R(Bounds(errorScroll)) });
            Product(errorScroll.IsVisible && Math.Abs(errorScroll.ActualHeight - 100) < .6, "长多行错误真实撑满公共错误栏100高，再测正文预算");
            foreach (var control in new[] { Tool("导入脚本包"), Tool("运行所选"), Tool("停止所选设备") }) Hit44(control);
            foreach (var control in new FrameworkElement[] { parameters, jobs, logs, result })
            {
                await Reveal(control); var viewport = ReadingViewport(control); var clip = Clip(control);
                Observe("reading-viewport", new { type = control.GetType().Name, source = TextPath(control), actual = R(Bounds(control)), viewport = R(viewport), clip = R(clip) });
                var minimum = control is DataGrid ? 96 : 48;
                Product(control.IsVisible && viewport.Width >= 100 && viewport.Height >= minimum, $"{control.GetType().Name} 真实可见阅读视口 >=100x{minimum}");
                if (control is DataGrid grid)
                {
                    Product(grid.ColumnHeaderHeight >= 43.9 && grid.RowHeight >= 43.9, "表格原行/列头实际配置支持44命中");
                    foreach (TabItem tab in VisualDescendants<TabControl>(page).Single().Items)
                    {
                        Hit44(tab);
                        if (AutomationProperties.GetName(tab) == "运行记录" && tab.Header is FrameworkElement) RecordCaptionHit(tab);
                    }
                }
            }
            await Reveal(parameters); Save("parameters"); await Reveal(jobs); Save("jobs"); await Reveal(logs); Save("logs"); await Reveal(result); Save("result");
        }
        private Rect Bounds(FrameworkElement element) => element.TransformToAncestor(Window.Shell).TransformBounds(new Rect(element.RenderSize));
        private Rect Clip(FrameworkElement element)
        {
            var clip = new Rect(Window.Shell.RenderSize);
            for (DependencyObject? item = element; item is Visual && !ReferenceEquals(item, Window.Shell); item = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(item))
                if (item is FrameworkElement ancestor && (ancestor.ClipToBounds || ancestor is ScrollContentPresenter)) clip.Intersect(Bounds(ancestor));
            return clip;
        }
        private Rect ReadingViewport(FrameworkElement control)
        {
            var viewport = Bounds(control); viewport.Intersect(Clip(control));
            var presenter = VisualDescendants<ScrollContentPresenter>(control).FirstOrDefault();
            if (presenter is not null) viewport.Intersect(Bounds(presenter));
            else if (control is TextBlock)
            {
                var scroll = Parent<ScrollViewer>(control); if (scroll is not null) viewport.Intersect(Bounds(scroll));
            }
            return viewport;
        }
        private void Hit44(FrameworkElement control)
        {
            var bounds = Bounds(control); var clipped = bounds; clipped.Intersect(Clip(control));
            Product(control.IsVisible && clipped.Width >= 43.9 && clipped.Height >= 43.9, "祖先裁剪后44命中：" + (AutomationProperties.GetName(control) is { Length: > 0 } name ? name : control.GetType().Name));
            if (!control.IsEnabled)
                Product(presentationJob is not null && ReferenceEquals(control, Tool("停止所选设备"))
                    && ReferenceEquals(((Button)control).Command, Vm.StopScriptCommand) && !Vm.StopScriptCommand.CanExecute(null)
                    && Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().All(job => job.State is ScriptRunState.Completed or ScriptRunState.Cancelled or ScriptRunState.Failed),
                    "仅呈现案例无真实活动任务时停止所选设备应禁用，不要求 disabled 控件的 enabledHit");
            else if (!clipped.IsEmpty && clipped.Width > 0 && clipped.Height > 0)
            {
                var point = new Point(clipped.X + clipped.Width / 2, clipped.Y + clipped.Height / 2);
                var hit = Window.Shell.InputHitTest(point) as DependencyObject;
                Product(hit is not null && (ReferenceEquals(hit, control) || control.IsAncestorOf(hit)), "实际命中仍归原控件：" + control.GetType().Name);
            }
            Observe("hit44", new { control = control.GetType().Name, name = AutomationProperties.GetName(control), bounds = R(bounds), clipped = R(clipped) });
        }
        private void RecordCaptionHit(TabItem recordTab)
        {
            var header = (FrameworkElement)recordTab.Header;
            var caption = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(header).SingleOrDefault(text => text.Text == AutomationProperties.GetName(recordTab));
            var border = caption is null ? null : Parent<Border>(caption);
            Require(border is not null && header.IsAncestorOf(border), "记录Header包含原本地化caption的独立Border");
            Hit44(border!); var bounds = Bounds(border!); var hit = Window.Shell.InputHitTest(new Point(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2)) as DependencyObject;
            var belongs = false;
            for (var item = hit; item is not null; item = item is Visual ? VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(item) : LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(item))
            {
                if (item is Button) break;
                if (ReferenceEquals(item, border) || ReferenceEquals(item, recordTab)) { belongs = true; break; }
            }
            Product(belongs, "记录caption中心实际命中归caption/Tab，不是Header取消按钮");
            Observe("record-caption-hit", new { bounds = R(bounds), actualHit = hit?.GetType().Name, belongs });
        }
        internal async Task ReadTable(DataGrid grid, string[] paths)
        {
            await Reveal(grid); var columns = grid.Columns.OfType<DataGridTextColumn>().ToDictionary(ColumnPath);
            Product(paths.All(columns.ContainsKey) && columns.Count == paths.Length, "原全部数据列保留：" + string.Join(",", paths));
            var source = grid.Items.Cast<object>().Where(item => item != CollectionView.NewItemPlaceholder).ToArray();
            Require(source.Length >= 24, "多行首/中/末真实滚动样本已加载");
            foreach (var index in new[] { 0, source.Length / 2, source.Length - 1 }) foreach (var path in paths)
            {
                if (!columns.TryGetValue(path, out var column)) continue;
                grid.ScrollIntoView(source[index], column); await Settle();
                var content = column.GetCellContent(source[index]);
                Require(content is not null, "实际原列虚拟化内容已实现：" + path);
                var text = content as TextBlock ?? VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(content!).FirstOrDefault();
                Require(text is not null, "原列实际 TextBlock：" + path);
                var expected = source[index].GetType().GetProperty(path)!.GetValue(source[index])?.ToString() ?? "";
                var visible = Bounds(text!); visible.Intersect(ReadingViewport(grid));
                Product(text!.Text == expected && visible.Width >= Math.Min(36, text.ActualWidth) && visible.Height >= 10, $"首中末横向阅读原字段 {index}/{path}");
                var fullWidth = Measure(text).WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace <= visible.Width + .75;
                var editor = path == "Value" && !grid.IsReadOnly;
                var resultAlternative = path == "Result";
                var tipOwner = text.ToolTip?.ToString() == expected ? (FrameworkElement)text : Parent<DataGridCell>(text);
                var tooltip = !fullWidth && !editor && !resultAlternative && tipOwner?.ToolTip?.ToString() == expected && await ReadTooltip(tipOwner, expected);
                Product(fullWidth || editor || resultAlternative || tooltip, $"长字段有真实完整阅读路径 {index}/{path}");
                Observe("table-field", new { path, index, expected, actual = text.Text, visible = R(visible), desiredWidth = Measure(text).WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace,
                    fullWidth, editor, resultAlternative, tooltip, horizontal = VisualDescendants<ScrollViewer>(grid).First().HorizontalOffset });
            }
        }
        private async Task<bool> ReadTooltip(FrameworkElement owner, string expected)
        {
            var original = owner.ToolTip; var tip = original as System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip ?? new System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip { Content = original, PlacementTarget = owner };
            var wasOpen = tip.IsOpen;
            try
            {
                if (original is not System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip) owner.ToolTip = tip;
                tip.IsOpen = true; await Settle();
                var text = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(tip).FirstOrDefault(item => item.Text == expected);
                var readable = text is not null && text.IsVisible && tip.IsOpen && tip.IsVisible && text.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.Wrap
                    && text.ActualWidth > 0 && tip.ActualWidth <= 361;
                if (text is not null)
                {
                    var measured = Measure(text); measured.MaxTextWidth = Math.Max(1, text.ActualWidth);
                    readable &= text.ActualHeight + 1 >= measured.Height;
                    Observe("actual-tooltip", new { expected, tip.IsOpen, tip.IsVisible, tip.ActualWidth, tip.ActualHeight, tip.MaxWidth,
                        text.Text, text.TextWrapping, textWidth = text.ActualWidth, textHeight = text.ActualHeight, measured.Height });
                }
                return readable;
            }
            finally { tip.IsOpen = wasOpen; owner.ToolTip = original; }
        }
        internal async Task ReadValueEditors()
        {
            foreach (var index in new[] { 0, Vm.Parameters.Count / 2, Vm.Parameters.Count - 1 })
                await Edit(Vm.Parameters[index], null);
        }
        private async Task<bool> Edit(ParameterEditor row, string? value)
        {
            await Reveal(parameters); var column = parameters.Columns.OfType<DataGridTextColumn>().Single(item => ColumnPath(item) == "Value");
            parameters.ScrollIntoView(row, column); await Settle(); parameters.SelectedItem = row; parameters.CurrentCell = new(row, column);
            var began = parameters.BeginEdit(); await Settle(); Product(began, "原 Value 单元格真实 BeginEdit"); if (!began) return false;
            var content = column.GetCellContent(row); var editor = content as TextBox ?? (content is null ? null : VisualDescendants<TextBox>(content).FirstOrDefault());
            Require(editor is not null, "原 DataGrid 实现真实 Value TextBox 编辑器");
            Hit44(editor!); var before = row.Value;
            if (value is not null) { editor!.SetCurrentValue(TextBox.TextProperty, value); editor.GetBindingExpression(TextBox.TextProperty)!.UpdateSource(); }
            var expected = value ?? before; Product(editor!.Text == expected && row.Value == expected, "真实 TextBox 绑定值全文准确，没有直接写 ParameterEditor");
            editor.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(0); await Settle(); var home = editor.HorizontalOffset; editor.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(editor.ExtentWidth); await Settle();
            var last = editor.Text.Length == 0 ? Rect.Empty : editor.GetRectFromCharacterIndex(editor.Text.Length - 1);
            var lastInShell = last.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : editor.TransformToAncestor(Window.Shell).TransformBounds(last); var clip = ReadingViewport(editor);
            Product(editor.Text.Length == 0 || !lastInShell.IsEmpty && lastInShell.IntersectsWith(clip), "真实 Value 编辑器末尾字符可见而非仅有完整字符串");
            var cellCommitted = parameters.CommitEdit(DataGridEditingUnit.Cell, true); var rowCommitted = parameters.CommitEdit(DataGridEditingUnit.Row, true); await Settle();
            Product(cellCommitted && rowCommitted && row.Value == expected, "原 DataGrid Cell/Row CommitEdit 提交值");
            Observe("actual-value-editor", new { row.Key, before, expected, row.Value, began, cellCommitted, rowCommitted, home, end = editor.HorizontalOffset, last = R(lastInShell), viewport = R(clip) });
            return cellCommitted && rowCommitted && row.Value == expected;
        }
        internal async Task ReadCompleteResult()

        internal async Task SwitchResultSelection()

            try

                {

                    row.Update(row.Status with { Result = expected }); await Reveal(jobs); jobs.ScrollIntoView(row); jobs.SelectedItem = row; await Settle();
                    Product(ReferenceEquals(Vm.SelectedScriptJob, row) && Vm.SelectedScriptJob?.JobId == row.JobId, "原任务表TwoWay选中对应不同JobId");
                    await Reveal(result); var actual = result is TextBox box ? box.Text : ((TextBlock)result).Text;
                    Product(actual == expected && ReferenceEquals(result.DataContext, Vm) && result.IsVisible, "同一原结果控件随不同JobId显示准确不同全文");
                    Observe("different-job-result", new { row.JobId, expected, actual, viewport = R(ReadingViewport(result)), selected = Vm.SelectedScriptJob?.JobId });
                }
            }
            catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            finally
            {

                    var restored = result is TextBox box ? box.Text : ((TextBlock)result).Text;
                    Product(ReferenceEquals(Vm.SelectedScriptJob, presentationJob) && restored == resultText, "结果切换专项恢复原presentationJob及精确16KiB正文");
                }

            }

        }
        private bool CharacterVisible(TextBlock text, bool last)
        {
            if (!text.IsArrangeValid || !text.IsMeasureValid) return false;
            var pointer = last ? text.ContentEnd.GetPositionAtOffset(-1, LogicalDirection.Backward) : text.ContentStart.GetPositionAtOffset(1, LogicalDirection.Forward);
            var rect = pointer?.GetCharacterRect(last ? LogicalDirection.Backward : LogicalDirection.Forward) ?? Rect.Empty;
            var bounds = rect.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : text.TransformToAncestor(Window.Shell).TransformBounds(rect); var clip = Clip(text);
            Observe("actual-character", new { last, textLength = text.Text.Length, bounds = R(bounds), clip = R(clip) });
            return !bounds.IsEmpty && bounds.Height >= 1 && bounds.IntersectsWith(clip);
        }

        private (string Text, double Y) Anchor()
        {

                && Bounds(element).Bottom <= viewport.Bottom + .5).OrderBy(element => Bounds(element).Top).FirstOrDefault();
            Require(item is not null, "日志阅读锚点必须是实际完整可见原行"); return (item!.Content?.ToString() ?? "", Bounds(item).Top - viewport.Top);
        }
        internal void Save(string name)
        {
            var visual = Window.Shell; var dpi = VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(visual); var pixelWidth = (int)Math.Ceiling(visual.ActualWidth * dpi.DpiScaleX); var pixelHeight = (int)Math.Ceiling(visual.ActualHeight * dpi.DpiScaleY);
            Require(pixelWidth > 0 && pixelHeight > 0, "自有 WPF 渲染尺寸有效");
            var bitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(pixelWidth, pixelHeight, dpi.PixelsPerInchX, dpi.PixelsPerInchY, PixelFormats.Pbgra32); bitmap.Render(visual);
            var pixels = new byte[pixelWidth * pixelHeight * 4]; bitmap.CopyPixels(pixels, pixelWidth * 4, 0);
            var colors = new HashSet<int>(); for (var index = 0; index < pixels.Length; index += 4 * 37) colors.Add(BitConverter.ToInt32(pixels, index));
            Product(colors.Count > 12, "自有 WPF 渲染非空白：" + name);
            var encoder = new PngBitmapEncoder(); encoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(bitmap)); using var file = File.Create(Path.Combine(directory, name + ".png")); encoder.Save(file);
            Observe("managed-render", new { name, pixelWidth, pixelHeight, colors = colors.Count, noDesktopCapture = true });
        }
        internal async Task Cleanup()
        {
            if (disposed) throw new InvalidOperationException("重复清理"); disposed = true;
            Backend.ReleaseAll();
            if (Vm is not null) await Vm.ShutdownAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15));
            else if (Runtime is not null) await Runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15));
            else await Backend.DisposeAsync();
            await Task.WhenAll(ownedTasks).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
            if (Runtime is not null)
            {
                Runtime.Scripts.JobChanged -= OnJob;

        private static string ColumnPath(DataGridTextColumn column)
        {

            if (column.Binding is MultiBinding multi && multi.Bindings.Count == 2 && multi.Bindings[0] is Binding { Path.Path: "State" }

    private sealed class ScriptWorkspaceBackend : IDeviceBackend, IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend
    {
        private sealed class Gate
        {
            internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Released = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend inner = new(); private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<int, Gate> gates = new();
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Gate> serialGates = new(); private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, int> serialLaunches = new();
        internal readonly ConcurrentQueue<string> Calls = new(); internal int Active, Disposals; private int launch;
        internal bool Disposed => Disposals == 1;
        internal void Block(int ordinal) => gates[ordinal] = new();
        internal Task Entered(int ordinal) => gates[ordinal].Entered.Task;
        internal void Release(int ordinal) { if (gates.TryGetValue(ordinal, out var gate)) gate.Released.TrySetResult(); }
        internal void BlockSerial(string serial, int ordinal) => serialGates[serial + "#" + ordinal] = new();
        internal Task EnteredSerial(string serial, int ordinal) => serialGates[serial + "#" + ordinal].Entered.Task;
        internal void ReleaseSerial(string serial, int ordinal) { if (serialGates.TryGetValue(serial + "#" + ordinal, out var gate)) gate.Released.TrySetResult(); }
        internal void ReleaseAll() { foreach (var gate in gates.Values.Concat(serialGates.Values)) gate.Released.TrySetResult(); }
        public IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands BindIdentity(DeviceCatalog catalog) => new Pinned(this, inner.BindIdentity(catalog));
        private sealed class Pinned(ScriptWorkspaceBackend owner, IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands commands) : IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands
        {
            public bool IsDemo => commands.IsDemo;
            public async Task<string> StartAppAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default)
            {
                var ordinal = Interlocked.Increment(ref owner.launch); var serialOrdinal = owner.serialLaunches.AddOrUpdate(target.Serial, 1, (_, previous) => previous + 1);
                owner.Calls.Enqueue("PinnedStart:" + target.Serial + ":" + packageName); Interlocked.Increment(ref owner.Active);
                try { if (owner.gates.TryGetValue(ordinal, out var gate) || owner.serialGates.TryGetValue(target.Serial + "#" + serialOrdinal, out gate)) { gate.Entered.TrySetResult(); await gate.Released.Task.WaitAsync(ct); } return await commands.StartAppAsync(target, packageName, ct); }
                finally { Interlocked.Decrement(ref owner.Active); }
            }
            public Task TapAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) { owner.Calls.Enqueue("PinnedTap:" + target.Serial); return commands.TapAsync(target, x, y, ct); }
            public Task SwipeAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) { owner.Calls.Enqueue("PinnedSwipe:" + target.Serial); return commands.SwipeAsync(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct); }
        }
        private Task<T> Call<T>(string name, Func<Task<T>> action) { Calls.Enqueue(name); return action(); }
        private Task Call(string name, Func<Task> action) { Calls.Enqueue(name); return action(); }
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Discover", () => inner.DiscoverAsync(ct));
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Shell:" + serial, () => inner.ShellAsync(serial, command, useRoot, ct));
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Screenshot:" + serial, () => inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct));
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Dump:" + serial, () => inner.DumpAsync(serial, ct));
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Tap:" + serial, () => inner.TapAsync(serial, x, y, ct));
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Swipe:" + serial, () => inner.SwipeAsync(serial, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct));
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Key:" + serial, () => inner.KeyEventAsync(serial, code, ct));
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Text:" + serial, () => inner.TextAsync(serial, text, ct));
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Start:" + serial, () => inner.StartAppAsync(serial, packageName, activity, ct));
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Stop:" + serial, () => inner.StopAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct));
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Clear:" + serial, () => inner.ClearAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct));
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("List:" + serial, () => inner.ListAppsAsync(serial, showSystem, needVersion, ct));
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Install:" + serial, () => inner.InstallAsync(serial, localPath, ct));
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Uninstall:" + serial, () => inner.UninstallAsync(serial, packageName, ct));
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Push:" + serial, () => inner.PushAsync(serial, localPath, remotePath, progress, ct));
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("Pull:" + serial, () => inner.PullAsync(serial, remotePath, localPath, progress, ct));
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => Call("NodeText:" + serial, () => inner.SetNodeTextAsync(serial, selector, text, ct));
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() { Interlocked.Increment(ref Disposals); await inner.DisposeAsync(); }
    }
}
```

```csharp
            Exception? modalFailure = null; var modalCount = 0;
            responsiveOwnedDialogFixture = dialog =>
            {
                var timeout = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) };
                timeout.Tick += (_, _) => { timeout.Stop(); modalFailure = new InvalidOperationException("弹窗夹具超时：" + dialog.Title); dialog.Close(); };
                dialog.Closed += (_, _) => timeout.Stop(); timeout.Start();
                dialog.ContentRendered += async (_, _) =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await Settle(); CheckOwned(dialog); modalCount++;
                        var buttons = VisualDescendants<Button>(dialog).ToArray(); var cancel = buttons.Single(button => button.IsCancel);
                        Check(buttons.Where(button => button.IsDefault || button.IsCancel).All(button => VisibleInside(button, (FrameworkElement)dialog.Content)), "模态确认/取消按钮可见：" + dialog.Title);
                        foreach (var scroll in VisualDescendants<ScrollViewer>(dialog).Where(scroll => scroll.ScrollableHeight > 0)) scroll.ScrollToEnd();
                        await Settle();
                        if (screenshot is not null) SaveRender(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(screenshot)!, "modal-" + modalCount + ".png"), dialog);
                        var peer = new ButtonAutomationPeer(cancel); ((IInvokeProvider)peer.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Invoke)).Invoke();
                    }
                    catch (Exception exception) { modalFailure = exception; dialog.Close(); }
                };
            };
            try
            {
                var target = ViewModel.CurrentDevice ?? ViewModel.Devices.First();
                Check(!ConfirmApplicationPlan([new(new(target.Serial, target.Name, target.Info.Generation, target.Info.TransportId), ApplicationOperation.Uninstall, "com.matrix.demo")]), "应用确认实际取消，未调用卸载");
                if (modalFailure is not null) throw modalFailure;
                await EditLdInstanceAsync(true); if (modalFailure is not null) throw modalFailure;
                Check(modalCount == 2, "实际应用确认与雷电编辑均仅取消");
            }
            finally { responsiveOwnedDialogFixture = null; }
            ShowDeviceDirectory(); await Settle(); CheckOwned(directoryWindow!); directoryWindow!.Hide();
            ShowScanner(); await Settle(); CheckOwned(scannerWindow!); scannerWindow!.Hide();
            var follow = new Window { Owner = this, Title = "跟随 owner 几何夹具", MinWidth = 360, MinHeight = 480, Content = new Border() };
            ResponsiveLayout.FitOwnedWindow(follow, this, 700, 700); follow.Show(); await Settle();
            await Resize(390, 640); CheckOwned(follow); await Resize(requestedWidth, requestedHeight); CheckOwned(follow);
            var lastValid = new Rect(follow.Left, follow.Top, follow.ActualWidth, follow.ActualHeight); var ownerLeft = Left;
            try
            {
                Left = -100000; await Settle();
                Check(ResponsiveLayout.FollowFailure(follow) is not null && new Rect(follow.Left, follow.Top, follow.ActualWidth, follow.ActualHeight) == lastValid, "owner 移出工作区时保留最后边界并记录诊断，不冒泡崩溃");
            }
            finally { Left = ownerLeft; await Settle(); }
            CheckOwned(follow); Check(ResponsiveLayout.FollowFailure(follow) is null, "owner 回到工作区后恢复跟随"); follow.Close();
        }
        finally
        {
            responsiveOwnedDialogFixture = null; directoryWindow?.Hide(); scannerWindow?.Hide();
            if (navigationDrawerOpen) CloseNavigationDrawer();
            ViewModel.ShellInput = originalShell; ViewModel.TextInput = originalText;
            sidebarPreference = originalPreference; await Resize(requestedWidth, requestedHeight); ApplyResponsiveWorkspace(); NavigateTo(originalPage); await Settle();
        }
        Check(ReferenceEquals(main, ViewModel.MainDevice) && ReferenceEquals(current, ViewModel.CurrentDevice) && selected.SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Devices.Select(row => (row.Serial, row.IsSelected))) && ViewModel.ShellInput == originalShell && ViewModel.TextInput == originalText, "调整布局不改变主控/目标/勾选/输入");
        Check(ActualWidth == requestedWidth && ActualHeight == requestedHeight, "最终取证恢复原始请求尺寸");
        Capture("");
        var report = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { scope = "A04 shared shell only; fixed page multi-column bodies deferred; no device/process/network operations; native MessageBox/file chooser and physical mixed-DPI not tested; routed keyboard/click fixtures, not OS mouse synthesis", requestedWidth, requestedHeight, actualWidth = ActualWidth, actualHeight = ActualHeight, hwnd = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle.ToInt64(), loaded = IsLoaded, visible = IsVisible, captureState = "idle", assertions = checks.Count, checks, breakpoints, fieldStates, geometries }, JsonDefaults.Options);
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "responsive-shell.json"), report);
        if (screenshot is not null) await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.ChangeExtension(screenshot, ".json"), report);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private FrameworkElement BuildScreenshotPage()
    {
        var page = Page();
        var toolbar = Toolbar(); toolbar.Children.Add(Button("\uE722", "刷新截图", ViewModel.ScreenshotCommand)); toolbar.Children.Add(Button("\uE74E", "保存 PNG", async () => await SaveImageAsync(false))); toolbar.Children.Add(Button("\uE7A8", "保存裁剪", async () => await SaveImageAsync(true)));
        screenshotMode = new ComboBox { ItemsSource = new[] { "取色", "裁剪" }, ItemTemplate = CaptionChoices(), SelectedIndex = 0, Width = 115, MinHeight = 44 }; toolbar.Children.Add(screenshotMode);
        LocalizationService.Bind(screenshotMode, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, "截图操作模式");
        LocalizationService.Bind(screenshotMode, ToolTipProperty, "截图操作模式");
        var zoom = new Slider { Minimum = .1, Maximum = 3, Value = 1, Width = 150, MinHeight = 44, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, ToolTip = "缩放" }; zoom.ValueChanged += (_, _) => { screenshotScale.ScaleX = zoom.Value; screenshotScale.ScaleY = zoom.Value; }; toolbar.Children.Add(zoom); toolbar.Children.Add(Button("\uE740", "原始大小", () => zoom.Value = 1));
        LocalizationService.Bind(zoom, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, "缩放");
        foreach (var button in toolbar.Children.OfType<Button>()) { button.MinWidth = 44; button.MinHeight = 44; }
        DockPanel.SetDock(toolbar, Dock.Top); page.Children.Add(toolbar);
        var panes = new Grid { Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed, Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0) };
        DockPanel.SetDock(panes, Dock.Top); page.Children.Add(panes);
        var grid = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(0, 10, 0, 0), ClipToBounds = true };
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition()); grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(310) });
        var colors = new DataGrid { ItemsSource = ViewModel.Colors, IsReadOnly = true, Margin = new Thickness(10, 0, 0, 0) }; TextColumn(colors, "坐标", nameof(PixelSample.Position), 100); TextColumn(colors, "HEX", nameof(PixelSample.Hex), 80); TextColumn(colors, "RGB", nameof(PixelSample.Rgb), 140); colors.MouseDoubleClick += (_, _) => { if (colors.SelectedItem is PixelSample color) Clipboard.SetText($"{color.Hex} {color.Rgb}"); }; Grid.SetColumn(colors, 1); grid.Children.Add(colors);
        foreach (var column in colors.Columns) { column.MinWidth = column.Width.Value; column.Width = DataGridLength.SizeToCells; }
        screenshotCanvas = new Canvas { Background = ThemeBrush("CanvasBrush"), LayoutTransform = screenshotScale };
        screenshotImage = new Image { Stretch = Stretch.None }; screenshotCanvas.Children.Add(screenshotImage);
        var cropColor = ((SolidColorBrush)ThemeBrush("DangerBrush")).Color;
        cropRectangle = new Rectangle { Stroke = ThemeBrush("DangerBrush"), StrokeThickness = 2, Fill = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(35, cropColor.R, cropColor.G, cropColor.B)), Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed, IsHitTestVisible = false }; screenshotCanvas.Children.Add(cropRectangle);
        screenshotCanvas.MouseLeftButtonDown += ScreenshotDown; screenshotCanvas.MouseMove += ScreenshotMove; screenshotCanvas.MouseLeftButtonUp += ScreenshotUp;
        screenshotScroll = new ScrollViewer { Content = screenshotCanvas, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto }; grid.Children.Add(screenshotScroll);
        var paneButtons = new Dictionary<string, ToggleButton>();
        var selectedPane = "画面";
        var narrow = false;
        var updatingPanes = false;
        foreach (var caption in new[] { "画面", "色值" })
        {
            panes.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition());
            var button = new ToggleButton { MinWidth = 44, MinHeight = 44, Height = 44, Padding = new Thickness(6, 0, 6, 0), Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, caption == "色值" ? 0 : 4, 0), IsChecked = caption == selectedPane };
            button.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "SegmentedToggle");
            LocalizationService.Bind(button, ContentControl.ContentProperty, caption);
            LocalizationService.Bind(button, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, caption);
            LocalizationService.Bind(button, ToolTipProperty, caption);
            button.Checked += (_, _) => { if (!updatingPanes) { selectedPane = caption; ArrangeScreenshot(); } };
            button.Unchecked += (_, _) => { if (!updatingPanes && selectedPane == caption) ArrangeScreenshot(); };
            Grid.SetColumn(button, paneButtons.Count); paneButtons.Add(caption, button); panes.Children.Add(button);
        }
        grid.SizeChanged += (_, _) => ArrangeScreenshot();
        grid.Loaded += (_, _) => ArrangeScreenshot();
        page.Children.Add(grid); return page;

        void ArrangeScreenshot()
        {
            if (grid.ActualWidth <= 0) return;
            var colorFocus = colors.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
            var imageFocus = screenshotScroll.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
            var paneFocus = panes.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
            var next = grid.ActualWidth < 640;
            if (next != narrow)
            {
                if (next) { if (colorFocus) selectedPane = "色值"; else if (imageFocus) selectedPane = "画面"; }
                narrow = next;
                grid.ColumnDefinitions[1].Width = new GridLength(narrow ? 0 : 310);
                Grid.SetColumn(colors, narrow ? 0 : 1);
                colors.Margin = narrow ? new Thickness(0) : new Thickness(10, 0, 0, 0);
            }
            panes.Visibility = narrow ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            screenshotScroll.Visibility = !narrow || selectedPane == "画面" ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            colors.Visibility = !narrow || selectedPane == "色值" ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            updatingPanes = true;
            try { foreach (var (caption, button) in paneButtons) button.IsChecked = caption == selectedPane; }
            finally { updatingPanes = false; }
            if (narrow && (colorFocus && selectedPane != "色值" || imageFocus && selectedPane != "画面")) paneButtons[selectedPane].Focus();
            else if (!narrow && paneFocus) { if (selectedPane == "色值") colors.Focus(); else screenshotScroll.Focus(); }
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveImageAsync(bool useCrop)
    {
        if (useCrop && crop is null) { MessageBox.Show(this, "尚未选择裁剪区域", "保存裁剪", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information); return; }
        var dialog = new SaveFileDialog { Filter = "PNG|*.png", FileName = useCrop ? "crop.png" : "screenshot.png" };
        if (dialog.ShowDialog(this) == true) await ViewModel.SaveScreenshotAsync(dialog.FileName, useCrop ? crop : null);
    }

    private Point ClampScreenshot(Point point) => ViewModel.DebugImage is { } image ? new Point(Math.Clamp(point.X, 0, image.PixelWidth - 1), Math.Clamp(point.Y, 0, image.PixelHeight - 1)) : default;
    private void ScreenshotDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (ViewModel.DebugImage is null) return;
        var point = ClampScreenshot(e.GetPosition(screenshotCanvas));
        if (screenshotMode.SelectedIndex == 0) ViewModel.SamplePixel((int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
        else { cropStart = point; crop = null; cropRectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Visible; cropRectangle.Width = cropRectangle.Height = 0; screenshotCanvas.CaptureMouse(); }
    }
    private void ScreenshotMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (cropStart is not { } start) return;
        var point = ClampScreenshot(e.GetPosition(screenshotCanvas));
        Canvas.SetLeft(cropRectangle, Math.Min(start.X, point.X)); Canvas.SetTop(cropRectangle, Math.Min(start.Y, point.Y)); cropRectangle.Width = Math.Abs(start.X - point.X); cropRectangle.Height = Math.Abs(start.Y - point.Y);
    }
    private void ScreenshotUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (cropStart is not { } start || ViewModel.DebugImage is not { } image) return;
        var end = ClampScreenshot(e.GetPosition(screenshotCanvas)); var x = (int)Math.Min(start.X, end.X); var y = (int)Math.Min(start.Y, end.Y); var width = (int)Math.Abs(start.X - end.X); var height = (int)Math.Abs(start.Y - end.Y);
        crop = width > 0 && height > 0 ? new Int32Rect(x, y, Math.Min(width, image.PixelWidth - x), Math.Min(height, image.PixelHeight - y)) : null;
        cropStart = null; screenshotCanvas.ReleaseMouseCapture();
    }

    private static Point? MapImage(Image image, Point point)
    {
        if (image.Source is not BitmapSource source || source.PixelWidth <= 0 || source.PixelHeight <= 0 || image.ActualWidth <= 0 || image.ActualHeight <= 0) return null;
        var scale = Math.Min(image.ActualWidth / source.PixelWidth, image.ActualHeight / source.PixelHeight); var left = (image.ActualWidth - source.PixelWidth * scale) / 2; var top = (image.ActualHeight - source.PixelHeight * scale) / 2;
        var x = (point.X - left) / scale; var y = (point.Y - top) / scale;
        return x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= source.PixelWidth || y >= source.PixelHeight ? null : new Point(x, y);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Features;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

internal static class ScriptJobEditingSmoke
{
    internal static async Task RunAsync(string dataDirectory, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        if (!dispatcher.CheckAccess() || Thread.CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() != ApartmentState.STA
            || Application.Current.Windows.Count != 0 || Application.Current.MainWindow is not null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("脚本任务 VM 验收仅限无窗口的自有 Demo/STA。");
        var directory = Path.Combine(dataDirectory, "script-job-editing");
        if (Directory.Exists(directory)) throw new InvalidOperationException("任务验收目录已存在。");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        var reports = new List<object>(); var failures = new List<Exception>(); var failureClasses = new HashSet<string>(); var stopRemaining = false;
        await Case("selection-and-package-edit-do-not-retarget", async state =>
        {
            await state.Import("com.android.settings", 0);
            state.Select(true, false); await state.Vm.StartScriptAsync();
            var job = state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Single();
            await state.Backend.Entered("DEMO-001");
            state.Select(false, true); state.Vm.CurrentDevice = state.B;
            await state.Import("com.matrix.demo", 0);
            state.Backend.Release("DEMO-001");
            await state.Terminal(job.JobId); await state.Fence();
            Require((await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-001")).PackageName == "com.android.settings", "编辑包或目标选择改变了已接纳任务的实际 A 效果。");
            Require((await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-002")).PackageName == "com.matrix.demo", "未接纳的 B 被执行。");
            Require(state.Vm.ScriptJobs.Single().JobId == job.JobId && state.Vm.SelectedScriptJob?.JobId == job.JobId, "任务记录身份漂移。");
            Require(state.Vm.ScriptLogs.Count == state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobLogs(job.JobId).Count, "切换当前设备覆盖了选中任务日志。");
        });
        await Case("cancel-job-not-current-device-selection", async state =>
        {
            await state.Import("com.android.settings", 0);
            state.Select(true, true); await state.Vm.StartScriptAsync();
            var jobs = state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs();
            var a = jobs.Single(job => job.Target.Serial == "DEMO-001"); var b = jobs.Single(job => job.Target.Serial == "DEMO-002");
            await Task.WhenAll(state.Backend.Entered("DEMO-001"), state.Backend.Entered("DEMO-002"));
            state.Vm.SelectedScriptJob = state.Vm.ScriptJobs.Single(row => row.JobId == a.JobId);
            state.Select(false, true); state.Vm.CurrentDevice = state.B;
            Require(state.Vm.CancelScriptJobCommand.CanExecute(null), "活动任务取消命令不可用。");
            state.Vm.CancelScriptJobCommand.Execute(null);
            state.Backend.Release("DEMO-002");
            await Task.WhenAll(state.Terminal(a.JobId), state.Terminal(b.JobId)); await state.Fence();
            Require(state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJob(a.JobId)!.State == ScriptRunState.Cancelled && state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJob(b.JobId)!.State == ScriptRunState.Completed, "按任务取消停错设备或影响并行任务。");
            Require((await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-001")).PackageName == "com.matrix.demo" && (await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-002")).PackageName == "com.android.settings", "取消后的实际双目标效果不符合预期。");
        });
        await Case("old-selected-job-cannot-cancel-new-same-device-run", async state =>
        {
            await state.Import("com.matrix.demo", 0); state.Select(true, false); await state.Vm.StartScriptAsync();
            var old = state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Single(); await state.Backend.Entered("DEMO-001"); state.Backend.Release("DEMO-001"); await state.Terminal(old.JobId); await state.Fence();
            var oldRow = state.Vm.ScriptJobs.Single(); var oldLogs = state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobLogs(old.JobId).ToArray();
            state.Backend.Block("DEMO-001"); await state.Import("com.android.settings", 0); await state.Vm.StartScriptAsync();
            var next = state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Single(job => job.JobId != old.JobId);
            await state.Backend.Entered("DEMO-001");
            state.Vm.SelectedScriptJob = oldRow;
            Require(!state.Vm.CancelScriptJobCommand.CanExecute(null), "终态任务仍显示可取消。");
            state.Vm.CancelSelectedScriptJob();
            Require(state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJob(next.JobId)!.State == ScriptRunState.Running, "取消旧记录改变了在途新任务状态。");
            state.Backend.Release("DEMO-001");
            await state.Terminal(next.JobId); await state.Fence();
            Require(state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJob(next.JobId)!.State == ScriptRunState.Completed && (await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-001")).PackageName == "com.android.settings", "旧任务取消影响同串号新任务。");
            Require(oldLogs.SequenceEqual(state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobLogs(old.JobId)) && state.Vm.ScriptJobs.Count == 2, "后一次运行覆盖了旧任务日志或记录。");
        });
        await Case("stale-row-rejected-without-metadata-or-effect", async state =>
        {
            await state.Import("com.android.settings", 0); state.Select(true, false);
            state.A.Info = state.A.Info with { Generation = state.A.Info.Generation + 1 };
            await state.Vm.StartScriptAsync(); await state.Fence();
            Require(state.Vm.Error.Length > 0 && state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Count == 0 && state.Vm.ScriptJobs.Count == 0, "失效身份被接纳或未显示拒绝。");
            Require(state.Runtime.Metadata.GetAll<ScriptDeviceParameters>("ScriptDeviceConfiguration").Count == 0, "未接纳的身份写入参数记录。");
            Require((await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-001")).PackageName == "com.matrix.demo", "身份拒绝仍触发应用启动。");
        });
        await Case("busy-target-rejected-idle-target-admitted", async state =>
        {
            await state.Import("com.android.settings", 0); state.Select(true, true);
            state.OwnedRuns.Add(state.Runtime.Scripts.RunAsync("DEMO-001", new ScriptPackage
            {
                Manifest = new() { Id = "owned-legacy", Name = "自有占用", Version = "1.0" }, Steps = [new() { Action = "wait", DurationMs = 60000 }]
            }));
            Require(state.Vm.StartScriptCommand.CanExecute(null), "一个忙目标阻止了空闲目标的明确提交。");
            await state.Vm.StartScriptAsync();
            var job = state.Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Single();
            Require(job.Target.Serial == "DEMO-002" && state.Vm.Error.Contains("DEMO-001", StringComparison.Ordinal), "未正确汇总 A 拒绝与 B 接纳。");
            var saved = state.Runtime.Metadata.GetAll<ScriptDeviceParameters>("ScriptDeviceConfiguration");
            Require(saved.Count == 1 && saved.Single().Serial == "DEMO-002", "为未接纳的忙目标保存了参数。");
            await state.Backend.Entered("DEMO-002"); state.Backend.Release("DEMO-002"); await state.Terminal(job.JobId); await state.Fence();
            Require((await state.Backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-002")).PackageName == "com.android.settings" && state.Runtime.Scripts.GetStatus("DEMO-001").State == ScriptRunState.Running, "空闲目标无实际效果，或改变了原忙目标。");
        });
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "summary.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            status = failures.Count == 0 ? "PASS-SCRIPT-JOB-EDITING" : failureClasses.Count == 1 ? failureClasses.Single() : "MIXED-FAIL", reports, failureClasses,
            scope = "Owned Demo backend and real WorkspaceViewModel import/start/select/cancel/log paths. No Window, physical input, GUI, ADB, APK, API or real-instance acceptance.",
            windows = Application.Current.Windows.Count, errors = failures.Select(error => error.ToString()).ToArray()
        }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        if (failures.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("脚本任务 VM 验收失败", failures);

        async Task Case(string name, Func<State, Task> action)
        {
            if (stopRemaining) { reports.Add(new { name, status = "NOT-RUN", reason = "前一案例清理失败" }); return; }
            var state = new State(Path.Combine(directory, name), dispatcher); Exception? failure = null; bool cleaned = false, initialized = false; var classes = new HashSet<string>();
            try { await state.Initialize(); initialized = true; await action(state); }
            catch (Exception error) { failure = error; classes.Add(!initialized ? "PRECONDITION-FAIL" : error is ProductFailure ? "PRODUCT-FAIL" : "FIXTURE-FAIL"); }
            finally
            {
                try { await state.Cleanup(); cleaned = true; }
                catch (Exception error) { failure = failure is null ? error : new AggregateException(failure, error); classes.Add("CLEANUP-FAIL"); }
            }
            foreach (var classification in classes) failureClasses.Add(classification);
            reports.Add(new { name, status = failure is null ? "PASS" : classes.Count == 1 ? classes.Single() : "MIXED-FAIL", failureClasses = classes, initialized, cleaned, jobs = state.Jobs, error = failure?.ToString() });
            if (failure is not null) failures.Add(failure);
            if (!cleaned) stopRemaining = true;
        }
    }

    private sealed class ProductFailure(string message) : Exception(message);
    private static void Require(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new ProductFailure(message); }
    private sealed class State(string directory, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        internal MatrixRuntime Runtime = null!;
        internal WorkspaceViewModel Vm = null!;
        internal readonly JobBackend Backend = new();
        internal DeviceRow A => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-001");
        internal DeviceRow B => Vm.Devices.Single(row => row.Serial == "DEMO-002");
        internal ScriptJobStatus[] Jobs = [];
        internal readonly List<Task> OwnedRuns = [];
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, TaskCompletionSource> terminals = new();
        internal async Task Initialize()
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            var settings = new AppSettings { Language = "zh-CN" };
            var catalog = new DeviceCatalog(Backend); var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(Backend, catalog, true);
            var automation = new AutomationService(Backend, catalog); var log = new RollingLog(Path.Combine(directory, "logs"));
            Runtime = new MatrixRuntime
            {
                Backend = Backend, Devices = catalog, Scripts = scheduler, Automation = automation,
                Input = new InputCoordinator(catalog, Backend), Log = log,
                Metadata = new CatalogRepository(Path.Combine(directory, "db.sqlite3")), Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings,
                SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json")), IsDemo = true,
                Api = new ApiServiceManager(catalog, Backend, automation, log)
            };
            Runtime.Scripts.JobChanged += OnJob;
            Vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(Runtime, directory, true); await Vm.RefreshDevicesAsync();
            Require(Runtime.IsDemo && Vm.Demo && Vm.Devices.Count == 2 && !Runtime.Api.BasicRunning && !Runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning, "自有无接口 Demo 前置不成立。");
            Vm.CurrentDevice = A;

        private void OnJob(ScriptJobStatus status)
        {

                terminals.GetOrAdd(status.JobId, _ => new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)).TrySetResult();
        }
        internal Task Terminal(Guid id) => terminals.GetOrAdd(id, _ => new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)).Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        internal Task Fence() => dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle).Task;
        internal void Select(bool a, bool b) { A.IsSelected = a; B.IsSelected = b; Vm.UpdateSelection(); }
        internal async Task Import(string app, int wait)
        {
            var package = new ScriptPackage { Manifest = new() { Id = "owned-job", Name = "自有任务验收", Version = "1.0" }, Steps = [new() { Action = "wait", DurationMs = wait }, new() { Action = "launchapp", Value = app }] };
            var path = Path.Combine(directory, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".jxscript");
            ScriptPackageService.Save(path, package); await Vm.ImportScriptAsync(path);

        }
        internal async Task Cleanup()
        {
            if (Runtime is null) { await Backend.DisposeAsync(); return; }
            if (Vm is null) { await Runtime.DisposeAsync(); return; }
            await Vm.ShutdownAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
            await Task.WhenAll(OwnedRuns).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
            Runtime.Scripts.JobChanged -= OnJob;
            await Fence(); Jobs = Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().ToArray();
            Require(Jobs.All(job => job.State is ScriptRunState.Completed or ScriptRunState.Cancelled or ScriptRunState.Failed), "清理后仍有活动任务。");
            Require(Application.Current.Windows.Count == 0 && Application.Current.MainWindow is null, "无窗验收创建了窗口。");
        }
    }

    private sealed class JobBackend : IDeviceBackend, IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend
    {
        private sealed class Gate
        {
            internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Entered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            internal readonly TaskCompletionSource Released = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        }
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend inner = new();
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Gate> gates = new();
        internal void Block(string serial) => gates[serial] = new();
        internal Task Entered(string serial) => gates.GetOrAdd(serial, _ => new()).Entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        internal void Release(string serial) => gates.GetOrAdd(serial, _ => new()).Released.TrySetResult();
        public IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands BindIdentity(DeviceCatalog catalog) => new Pinned(this, inner.BindIdentity(catalog));
        private sealed class Pinned(JobBackend owner, IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands commands) : IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands
        {
            public bool IsDemo => commands.IsDemo;
            public async Task<string> StartAppAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default)
            {
                var gate = owner.gates.GetOrAdd(target.Serial, _ => new()); gate.Entered.TrySetResult();
                await gate.Released.Task.WaitAsync(ct);
                return await commands.StartAppAsync(target, packageName, ct);
            }
            public Task TapAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => commands.TapAsync(target, x, y, ct);
            public Task SwipeAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => commands.SwipeAsync(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct);
        }
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.DiscoverAsync(ct);
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ShellAsync(serial, command, useRoot, ct);
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.DumpAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TapAsync(serial, x, y, ct);
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SwipeAsync(serial, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct);
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.KeyEventAsync(serial, code, ct);
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TextAsync(serial, text, ct);
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.StartAppAsync(serial, packageName, activity, ct);
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.StopAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ClearAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ListAppsAsync(serial, showSystem, needVersion, ct);
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.InstallAsync(serial, localPath, ct);
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.UninstallAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PushAsync(serial, localPath, remotePath, progress, ct);
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PullAsync(serial, remotePath, localPath, progress, ct);
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SetNodeTextAsync(serial, selector, text, ct);
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => inner.DisposeAsync();
    }
}
```

```csharp
    private sealed class ScriptParameterEditingState(string directory, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {

            var coordinator = new InputCoordinator(catalog, Backend); input = coordinator; var services = new ApiServiceManager(catalog, Backend, automation, ownLog); api = services;
            var settings = new AppSettings { Language = "zh-CN", AutoStartApi = false, AutoConnect = false, SyncMouse = false, SyncKeyboard = false };
            Runtime = new MatrixRuntime { Backend = Backend, Devices = catalog, Automation = automation, Scripts = scheduler, Input = coordinator, Api = services,
                Metadata = ownMetadata, Log = ownLog, Settings = settings, FrozenConnectionSettings = settings, SettingsStore = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json")), IsDemo = true };

            services.DeviceSnapshotProvider = Runtime.GetDevices; services.ScriptWriteBusy = ScriptBusy; services.AnyScriptWriteBusy = () => catalog.Snapshot.Any(device => ScriptBusy(device.Serial));
            catalog.DeviceDisconnected += serial => scheduler.Stop(serial); scheduler.EntryAdded += (serial, entry) => ownLog.Write("script", entry.Message, serial);

                sameAutomation = ReferenceEquals(Runtime.Automation, automation), sameInput = ReferenceEquals(Runtime.Input, coordinator), sameApi = ReferenceEquals(Runtime.Api, services),

        internal async Task Import(bool v1, bool wireNull)

                ["parameters"] = new[] { new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["key"] = "targetApp", ["type"] = "string", ["value"] = wireNull ? null : "com.matrix.demo", ["defaultValue"] = "com.android.settings" } }

        internal object[] LogEvents() { lock (sync) return logEvents.ToArray(); } internal object[] RowEvents() { lock (sync) return rowEvents.ToArray(); }

        internal async Task Finish(Task task) { tasks.Add(task); await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
        internal async Task<T> Finish<T>(Task<T> task) { tasks.Add(task); return await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
        internal object[] TaskReport() => tasks.Select(task => (object)new { status = task.Status.ToString(), task.IsCompleted, task.IsCompletedSuccessfully }).ToArray();
        internal async Task Cleanup()
        {

                if (watching)
                {
                    Runtime.Scripts.StatusChanged -= OnStatus; Runtime.Scripts.EntryAdded -= OnLog;
                    foreach (var row in Vm.Devices) row.PropertyChanged -= OnRow;
                }
                Terminal.TrySetCanceled(); Lifetime.Dispose();
            }
            try { await Finish(dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle).Task); }
            catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); }
            if (tasks.Any(task => !task.IsCompleted) || !Terminal.Task.IsCompleted || !Backend.Drained || !Backend.Disposed) errors.Add(new InvalidOperationException("自有公开任务/TCS/实际后端任务未排空或未实际释放。"));
            Observations.Add(new { stage = "cleanup", backendDisposed = Backend.Disposed, forwardingDrained = Backend.Drained, pendingPublicTasks = tasks.Count(task => !task.IsCompleted), terminal = Terminal.Task.Status.ToString() });
            CleanupErrors.AddRange(errors.Select(error => error.ToString()));
            if (errors.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("自有参数编辑 VM 清理失败", errors);
            async Task Attempt(Func<Task> action) { try { await Finish(action()); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); } }
        }
    }

    private sealed record ScriptParameterEditingCall(string Phase, string Operation, string? Serial, string? Subject, string Status, bool Completed, string? Error);
    private sealed class ScriptParameterEditingBackend : IDeviceBackend, IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend
    {
        private sealed class Call(string phase, string operation, string? serial, string? subject)
        { internal readonly string Phase = phase, Operation = operation; internal readonly string? Serial = serial, Subject = subject; internal Task? Task; internal string? Error; }
        internal readonly DemoDeviceBackend Inner = new(); private readonly object sync = new(); private readonly List<Call> calls = [];
        internal string Phase { get; set; } = "initialize";
        internal ScriptParameterEditingCall[] Calls(string? phase = null) { lock (sync) return calls.Where(call => phase is null || call.Phase == phase).Select(call => new ScriptParameterEditingCall(call.Phase, call.Operation, call.Serial, call.Subject, call.Task?.Status.ToString() ?? "SynchronousThrow", call.Task?.IsCompleted ?? call.Error is not null, call.Error ?? call.Task?.Exception?.ToString())).ToArray(); }
        internal bool Drained { get { lock (sync) return calls.All(call => call.Task?.IsCompleted ?? call.Error is not null); } }
        internal bool Disposed { get { lock (sync) return calls.Any(call => call.Operation == "Dispose" && call.Task?.IsCompletedSuccessfully == true); } }
        public IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands BindIdentity(DeviceCatalog catalog) => new Pinned(this, Inner.BindIdentity(catalog));
        private sealed class Pinned(ScriptParameterEditingBackend owner, IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands inner) : IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands
        {
            public bool IsDemo => inner.IsDemo;
            public Task<string> StartAppAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => owner.Forward("StartApp", target.Serial, packageName, () => inner.StartAppAsync(target, packageName, ct));
            public Task TapAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => owner.Forward("Tap", target.Serial, $"{x},{y}", () => inner.TapAsync(target, x, y, ct));
            public Task SwipeAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => owner.Forward("Swipe", target.Serial, $"{x1},{y1},{x2},{y2},{durationMs}", () => inner.SwipeAsync(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct));
        }
        private Task Forward(string operation, string? serial, string? subject, Func<Task> action)
        {
            var call = new Call(Phase, operation, serial, subject); lock (sync) calls.Add(call);
            try { var task = action(); lock (sync) call.Task = task; return task; } catch (Exception error) { lock (sync) call.Error = error.ToString(); throw; }
        }
        private Task<T> Forward<T>(string operation, string? serial, string? subject, Func<Task<T>> action)
        {
            var call = new Call(Phase, operation, serial, subject); lock (sync) calls.Add(call);
            try { var task = action(); lock (sync) call.Task = task; return task; } catch (Exception error) { lock (sync) call.Error = error.ToString(); throw; }
        }
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Discover", null, null, () => Inner.DiscoverAsync(ct));
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Shell", serial, command, () => Inner.ShellAsync(serial, command, useRoot, ct));
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Screenshot", serial, null, () => Inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct));
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Dump", serial, null, () => Inner.DumpAsync(serial, ct));
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Tap", serial, $"{x},{y}", () => Inner.TapAsync(serial, x, y, ct));
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Swipe", serial, $"{x1},{y1},{x2},{y2},{durationMs}", () => Inner.SwipeAsync(serial, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct));
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Key", serial, code.ToString(), () => Inner.KeyEventAsync(serial, code, ct));
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Text", serial, text, () => Inner.TextAsync(serial, text, ct));
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("StartApp", serial, packageName, () => Inner.StartAppAsync(serial, packageName, activity, ct));
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("StopApp", serial, packageName, () => Inner.StopAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct));
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("ClearApp", serial, packageName, () => Inner.ClearAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct));
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("ListApps", serial, null, () => Inner.ListAppsAsync(serial, showSystem, needVersion, ct));
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Install", serial, localPath, () => Inner.InstallAsync(serial, localPath, ct));
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Uninstall", serial, packageName, () => Inner.UninstallAsync(serial, packageName, ct));
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Push", serial, remotePath, () => Inner.PushAsync(serial, localPath, remotePath, progress, ct));
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("Pull", serial, remotePath, () => Inner.PullAsync(serial, remotePath, localPath, progress, ct));
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forward("SetNodeText", serial, text, () => Inner.SetNodeTextAsync(serial, selector, text, ct));
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => new(Forward("Dispose", null, null, () => Inner.DisposeAsync().AsTask()));
    }
}
```

```csharp
            summaryPanel.MaxHeight = shortPage ? 20 : 54;
            targets.MaxHeight = shortPage ? 20 : 36;
        }

        TabItem AddScriptSection(string caption, FrameworkElement content)
        {
            var title = new TextBlock { VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
            LocalizationService.Bind(title, TextBlock.TextProperty, caption);
            var section = new TabItem { Header = title, Content = content, MinHeight = 44, MinWidth = 44 };
            LocalizationService.Bind(section, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, caption);
            sections.Items.Add(section); return section;
        }
    }

    private static ScrollViewer ScriptContext(TextBlock text, double maximumHeight)
    {
        text.SetBinding(ToolTipProperty, new Binding(nameof(TextBlock.Text)) { Source = text });
        return new ScrollViewer { Content = text, MaxHeight = maximumHeight, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto };
    }
```

```csharp
    private static IEnumerable<Control> SettingsControls(DependencyObject parent)
    {
        foreach (var child in LogicalTreeHelper.GetChildren(parent).OfType<DependencyObject>())
        {
            if (child is Control control) yield return control;
            foreach (var descendant in SettingsControls(child)) yield return descendant;
        }
    }

    private FrameworkElement PathField(string label, string binding)
    {
        var row = new DockPanel(); var browse = Button("\uE8B7", "浏览", () =>
        {
            var dialog = new OpenFileDialog { Filter = binding.EndsWith("MonitorServerPath", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "官方视频组件|scrcpy-server*|所有文件|*.*" : "程序|*.exe|所有文件|*.*" };
            if (dialog.ShowDialog(this) != true) return;
            if (binding.EndsWith("AdbPath", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { ViewModel.Settings.AdbPath = dialog.FileName; ViewModel.Settings.Changed(nameof(SettingsEditor.AdbPath)); }
            else if (binding.EndsWith("LdConsolePath", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { ViewModel.Settings.LdConsolePath = dialog.FileName; ViewModel.Settings.Changed(nameof(SettingsEditor.LdConsolePath)); }
            else if (binding.EndsWith("MonitorServerPath", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { ViewModel.Settings.MonitorServerPath = dialog.FileName; ViewModel.Settings.Changed(nameof(SettingsEditor.MonitorServerPath)); }
            else if (binding.EndsWith("MonitorFfmpegPath", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { ViewModel.Settings.MonitorFfmpegPath = dialog.FileName; ViewModel.Settings.Changed(nameof(SettingsEditor.MonitorFfmpegPath)); }
            else { ViewModel.Settings.ScrcpyPath = dialog.FileName; ViewModel.Settings.Changed(nameof(SettingsEditor.ScrcpyPath)); }
        }); DockPanel.SetDock(browse, Dock.Right); row.Children.Add(browse); var input = BoundInput(binding); LocalizationService.Bind(input, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, label); LocalizationService.Bind(browse, System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, "浏览" + label); row.Children.Add(input); return Field(label, row);
    }

    private static FrameworkElement UnavailableSetting(string label, FrameworkElement control, string reason)
    {
        var row = Field(label, control); row.IsEnabled = false;
        ToolTipService.SetShowOnDisabled(row, true); LocalizationService.Bind(row, ToolTipProperty, reason);
        return row;
    }

}
```

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
```
