namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private static readonly List<object> retainedSettingsWorkspaces = [];

    internal static async Task RunSettingsWorkspaceVerificationAsync(string directory, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        if (!dispatcher.CheckAccess() || Thread.CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() != ApartmentState.STA
            || Application.Current.Windows.Count != 0 || Application.Current.MainWindow is not null
            || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(directory) || Directory.Exists(directory) || File.Exists(directory))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("设置验收要求 fresh artifacts 目录及无用户窗口的自有 STA。");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        var reports = new List<object>(); var failures = new List<Exception>(); var stop = false;
        var conditionalNotRun = new List<object>();
        foreach (var size in new[] { (W: 390, H: 640), (W: 390, H: 844), (W: 768, H: 1024), (W: 1000, H: 700), (W: 1440, H: 900), (W: 1920, H: 1080) })
            await Case($"geometry-{size.W}-{size.H}", size.W, size.H, state => state.Geometry());
        await Case("numeric-binding-abc-and-empty", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            foreach (var text in new[] { "abc", "" })
            {
                await state.Edit("BasicApiPort", text);
                state.Product(Validation.GetHasError(state.Input("BasicApiPort")), "实际数值绑定出现转换错误", new { text });
                await state.Reject("原数值转换错误不得保存旧整数");
                await state.Edit("BasicApiPort", "18080");
                state.Product(!Validation.GetHasError(state.Input("BasicApiPort")), "纠正数值后绑定错误消失");
                await state.Save(); state.Saved("纠正后保存", value => value.BasicApiPort == 18080);
            }
        });
        await Case("valid-boundaries-and-nullable-clear", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            foreach (var values in new[] { new[] { "180", "1", "10000", "1" }, new[] { "4096", "120", "100000000", "300" } })
            {
                await state.Edit("MainMaxSize", values[0]); await state.Edit("MainMaxFps", values[1]);
                await state.Edit("MainBitRate", values[2]); await state.Edit("CommandTimeoutSeconds", values[3]);
                await state.Save(); state.Saved("有效上下边界精确保留", value => value.MainMaxSize == int.Parse(values[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    && value.MainMaxFps == int.Parse(values[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) && value.MainBitRate == int.Parse(values[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                    && value.CommandTimeoutSeconds == int.Parse(values[3], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
            await state.Edit("AdbSerialsJson", "[\"DEMO-001\"]"); await state.Edit("AgentSerial", "DEMO-001");
            await state.Edit("AgentBaseUrl", "https://settings-owned.invalid/"); await state.Save();
            state.Saved("合法URL只解析保存", value => value.AgentBaseUrl == "https://settings-owned.invalid/");
            await state.Edit("AgentBaseUrl", ""); await state.Edit("AgentSerial", ""); await state.Save();
            state.Saved("nullable清空不恢复旧地址", value => value.AgentBaseUrl is null && value.AgentSerial is null);
            foreach (var property in new[] { "AutoConnect", "AutoStartApi", "ShowFps" }) await state.Toggle(property, true);
            await state.Save(); state.Saved("原复选框只保存偏好、不隐式启动服务", value => value.AutoConnect && value.AutoStartApi && value.ShowFps && !state.Runtime.Api.BasicRunning);
        });
        await Case("out-of-range-and-nonfinite", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            foreach (var item in new[] { ("MainMaxSize", "179", "1280"), ("MainMaxSize", "4097", "1280"),
                ("MainMaxFps", "121", "45"), ("CommandTimeoutSeconds", "301", "30"),
                ("MainBitRate", "9999", "6000000"), ("WindowWidth", "NaN", "1000"), ("WindowHeight", "Infinity", "700") })
            {
                await state.Edit(item.Item1, item.Item2); await state.Reject(item.Item1 + "=" + item.Item2);
                await state.Edit(item.Item1, item.Item3);
            }
            await state.Save(); state.Saved("纠正越界值后可恢复", value => value.MainMaxSize == 1280 && value.MainMaxFps == 45 && value.CommandTimeoutSeconds == 30);
            try
            {
                const double target = AppSettings.MaximumWindowWidth + 100;
                state.Window.Width = target; await state.Settle();
                state.Observe("actual-out-of-range-resize", new { target, observedWidth = state.Window.Width, state.Window.ActualWidth, AppSettings.MaximumWindowWidth });
                if (state.Window.ActualWidth > AppSettings.MaximumWindowWidth)
                { state.RequireActualOutOfRangeWidth(); await state.Reject("实际手动resize超界不得绕过最终尺寸校验"); }
                else
                {
                    var limitation = new { step = "actual-oversize-window-save", status = "NOT-RUN", reason = "实际窗口超界前置未建立，不推断平台或产品原因", target,
                        observedWidth = state.Window.Width, state.Window.ActualWidth };
                    state.Observe("actual-out-of-range-resize-not-run", limitation); conditionalNotRun.Add(limitation);
                }
            }
            finally { state.Window.Width = 1000; await state.Settle(); }
            await state.Save(); state.Saved("恢复实际窗口尺寸后原保存可重试", value => value.WindowWidth == 1000);
        });
        await Case("URL-scheme-and-relative-path", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            await state.Edit("AdbSerialsJson", "[\"DEMO-001\"]"); await state.Edit("AgentSerial", "DEMO-001");
            foreach (var address in new[] { "ftp://settings-owned.invalid/", "relative/agent" })
            { await state.Edit("AgentBaseUrl", address); await state.Reject("非法Agent地址只校验不连接：" + address); }
            foreach (var address in new[] { "http://settings-owned.invalid/", "https://settings-owned.invalid/" })
            { await state.Edit("AgentBaseUrl", address); await state.Save(); state.Saved("HTTP(S)只保存，不创建新连接", value => value.AgentBaseUrl == address); }
        });
        await Case("JSON-and-duplicate-port-recovery", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            foreach (var item in new[] { ("AdbSerialsJson", "[", "[]"), ("AdbSerialsJson", "[\"DEMO-001\",\"DEMO-001\"]", "[]"),
                ("LdBindingsJson", "{", "{}"), ("LdBindingsJson", "{\"1\":\"DEMO-001\",\"2\":\"DEMO-001\"}", "{}"),
                ("AutomatorApiPort", "8080", "17171") })
            { await state.Edit(item.Item1, item.Item2); await state.Reject("坏JSON/重复身份/端口：" + item.Item1); await state.Edit(item.Item1, item.Item3); }
            await state.Save(); state.Saved("纠正后保存恢复", value => value.AutomatorApiPort == 17171 && value.AdbAllowedSerials.Length == 0);
        });
        await Case("write-failure-and-retry", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            await state.Edit("CommandTimeoutSeconds", "31");
            using (var held = new FileStream(state.ConfigPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read))
                await state.Reject("自有主配置禁止替换的真实写入故障");
            await state.Save(); state.Saved("释放原文件句柄后重试", value => value.CommandTimeoutSeconds == 31);
        });
        await Case("external-writer-two-consecutive-saves", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            foreach (var item in new[] { (Root: "/sdcard/External-One", Timeout: "31", Width: 1200d), (Root: "/sdcard/External-Two", Timeout: "32", Width: 1300d) })
            {
                var external = new SettingsStore(state.ConfigPath); var disk = external.Load(); external.Save(disk with { FileRoot = item.Root, WindowWidth = item.Width });
                state.Observe("external-write", state.Config()); await state.Edit("CommandTimeoutSeconds", item.Timeout); await state.Save();
                state.Saved("连续Save保留外writer未编辑字段与未手动调整的geometry", value => value.FileRoot == item.Root && value.WindowWidth == item.Width && value.CommandTimeoutSeconds == int.Parse(item.Timeout, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                state.Product(state.Input("FileRoot").Text == item.Root && state.Vm.Settings.FileRoot == item.Root, "同一Editor与原TextBox吸收外部合并结果", new { state.Vm.Settings.FileRoot, text = state.Input("FileRoot").Text });
                state.Product(Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualWidth - 1000) < .6 && state.Input("WindowWidth").Text == item.Width.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture),
                    "外writer尺寸被保存但不冒充本窗口用户resize或强制套用", new { state.Window.ActualWidth, text = state.Input("WindowWidth").Text });
            }
        });
        await Case("explicit-size-save-and-original-close", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            await state.Edit("WindowWidth", "768"); await state.Edit("WindowHeight", "1024"); await state.Save();
            state.Saved("显式尺寸保存", value => value.WindowWidth == 768 && value.WindowHeight == 1024);
            state.Product(Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualWidth - 768) < .6 && Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualHeight - 1024) < .6,
                "原保存命令应用明确编辑的实际窗口尺寸", new { state.Window.ActualWidth, state.Window.ActualHeight });
            await state.NormalClose(); var reloaded = new SettingsStore(state.ConfigPath).Load();
            state.Product(reloaded.WindowWidth == 768 && reloaded.WindowHeight == 1024, "原WindowClosing完成后fresh Store仍保留显式尺寸", new { reloaded.WindowWidth, reloaded.WindowHeight });
        });
        await Case("manual-resize-unrelated-save-and-single-axis", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            state.Window.Width = 1100; state.Window.Height = 780; await state.Settle();
            await state.Edit("CommandTimeoutSeconds", "31"); await state.Save();
            state.Product(Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualWidth - 1100) < .6 && Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualHeight - 780) < .6, "无关保存不重置手动resize", new { state.Window.ActualWidth, state.Window.ActualHeight });
            state.Saved("手动resize后的普通保存同步Editor/Runtime/Store", value => value.WindowWidth == 1100 && value.WindowHeight == 780);
            await state.Edit("WindowWidth", "1200"); await state.Save();
            state.Product(Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualWidth - 1200) < .6 && Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualHeight - 780) < .6, "只提交宽度保留手动调整的另一轴", new { state.Window.ActualWidth, state.Window.ActualHeight });
            state.Saved("单轴提交后另一轴三方仍为780", value => value.WindowWidth == 1200 && value.WindowHeight == 780);
            var external = new SettingsStore(state.ConfigPath); var disk = external.Load(); external.Save(disk with { WindowWidth = 1250 });
            foreach (var timeout in new[] { "32", "33" })
            {
                await state.Edit("CommandTimeoutSeconds", timeout); await state.Save();
                state.Saved("程序化应用尺寸之后的连续Save不覆写外writer", value => value.WindowWidth == 1250 && value.WindowHeight == 780);
                state.Product(Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualWidth - 1200) < .6, "外writer width不冒充本窗口实际resize", new { state.Window.ActualWidth });
            }
            state.Window.Height = 800; await state.Settle(); await state.Save();
            state.Saved("后续真实手动height保留外writer width", value => value.WindowWidth == 1250 && value.WindowHeight == 800);
            state.Product(Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualWidth - 1200) < .6 && Math.Abs(state.Window.ActualHeight - 800) < .6, "手动另一轴不强制套外部width", new { state.Window.ActualWidth, state.Window.ActualHeight });
        });
        await Case("busy-and-owned-running-port", 1000, 700, async state =>
        {
            var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously); state.ReleaseOnCleanup(release);
            var busy = state.Track(state.Vm.ExecuteAsync("owned-settings-busy", () => release.Task, blocksApiWrites: false));
            try
            {
                await state.Settle(); var before = state.Config(); var settings = state.Runtime.Settings;
                state.Product(!state.SaveButton.IsEnabled && !state.Vm.SaveSettingsCommand.CanExecute(null), "Busy禁用原保存控件与命令");
                await state.Save(); state.Product(before == state.Config() && ReferenceEquals(settings, state.Runtime.Settings), "Busy保存不落盘或替换设置");
            }
            finally { release.TrySetResult(); await state.Wait(busy); }
            state.Product(state.SaveButton.IsEnabled && !state.Vm.Busy, "Busy原任务完成后保存恢复");
            var listener = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, 0); int port;
            try { listener.Start(); port = ((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port; }
            finally { listener.Stop(); }
            await state.Edit("BasicApiPort", port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)); await state.Save();
            state.Saved("自有端口保存", value => value.BasicApiPort == port);
            await state.Wait(state.Runtime.Api.StartBasicAsync(port));
            await state.Edit("BasicApiPort", (port == 65535 ? port - 1 : port + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            await state.Reject("运行中自有API拒绝修改端口");
            using (var client = new HttpClient(new HttpClientHandler { UseProxy = false, AllowAutoRedirect = false }) { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5) })
            {
                var response = state.Track(client.GetAsync($"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health")); using var actual = await response;
                state.Product(actual.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK && state.Runtime.Api.RunningBasicPort == port, "拒绝后原owned loopback监听仍在", new { actual.StatusCode, state.Runtime.Api.RunningBasicPort });
            }
            await state.Wait(state.Runtime.Api.StopAsync()); await state.Save();
            state.Saved("停止自有API后可重试", value => value.BasicApiPort != port);
        });
        var summary = new { status = failures.Count == 0 ? "PASS-OWN-WPF-SETTINGS" : "FAIL-SETTINGS-WORKSPACE", reports,
            windows = Application.Current.Windows.Count, mainWindowNull = Application.Current.MainWindow is null, retainedOwners = retainedSettingsWorkspaces.Count,
            scope = "Owned shown Demo WPF, actual TextBox bindings and original save command; original WindowClosing only in its explicit case. Not external GUI input or real-device acceptance.",
            notRun = new object[] { "native picker", "real legacy window recovery", "maximized/RestoreBounds save", "physical GUI input", "DPI", "Agent network", "real simulator/ADB", "AP042/AP045", "final dual 30 minutes" }.Concat(conditionalNotRun).ToArray() };
        try { File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "settings-workspace.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(summary, JsonDefaults.Options)); }
        catch (Exception error) { failures.Add(new IOException("REPORT-FAIL: 设置验收报告保存失败", error)); }
        if (failures.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("设置工作区验收未全部通过", failures);

        async Task Case(string name, int width, int height, Func<SettingsWorkspaceCase, Task> body)
        {
            if (stop) { reports.Add(new { name, status = "NOT-RUN", reason = "前例资源/原任务未证明安全清理" }); return; }
            var state = new SettingsWorkspaceCase(Path.Combine(directory, name), width, height, dispatcher);
            var classes = new HashSet<string>(); Exception? error = null; Exception? cleanup = null; var initialized = false;
            try { await state.Initialize(); initialized = true; await body(state); }
            catch (Exception failure) { error = failure; classes.Add(failure is SettingsWorkspacePrecondition || !initialized ? "PRECONDITION-FAIL" : "FIXTURE-FAIL"); }
            finally { try { await state.Cleanup(); } catch (Exception failure) { cleanup = failure; classes.Add("CLEANUP-FAIL"); stop = true; } }
            if (state.Failures.Count > 0) classes.Add("PRODUCT-FAIL");
            var report = new { name, status = classes.Count > 1 ? "MIXED-FAIL" : classes.SingleOrDefault() ?? "PASS", failureClasses = classes,
                initialized, checks = state.Checks, observations = state.Observations, productFailures = state.Failures, error = error?.ToString(), cleanup = cleanup?.ToString(),
                tasks = state.TaskStates(), state.NormalCloseRequests, state.ShutdownRequests, state.CleanupOwner, state.Closed, state.Retained };
            try { File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(state.Directory, "case.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(report, JsonDefaults.Options)); }
            catch (Exception failure) { classes.Add("REPORT-FAIL"); failures.Add(failure); }
            reports.Add(classes.Contains("REPORT-FAIL") ? new { name, status = "REPORT-FAIL", failureClasses = classes, preservedResult = (object)report } : (object)report);
            if (classes.Count > 0) failures.Add(new InvalidOperationException(name + ": " + string.Join(",", classes), new AggregateException(new[] { error, cleanup }.OfType<Exception>().Concat(state.Failures.Select(message => new Exception(message))))));
        }
    }

    private sealed record SettingsConfigEvidence(bool Exists, long Bytes, string? Sha256, long? WriteTicks, string? Base64);
    private sealed class SettingsWorkspacePrecondition(string message) : Exception(message);
    private sealed class SettingsWorkspaceCase(string directory, int width, int height, Dispatcher dispatcher)
    {
        internal string Directory => directory;
        internal string ConfigPath => Path.Combine(directory, "AppConfig.json");
        internal MainWindow Window = null!;
        internal WorkspaceViewModel Vm = null!;
        internal MatrixRuntime Runtime = null!;
        internal Button SaveButton = null!;
        internal readonly List<string> Checks = [], Failures = [];
        internal readonly List<object> Observations = [];
        internal int NormalCloseRequests, ShutdownRequests;
        internal string CleanupOwner = "not-started";
        internal bool Closed, Retained;
        private readonly List<Task> tasks = [];
        private readonly List<TaskCompletionSource> releases = [];
        private readonly CancellationTokenSource deadline = new(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(90));
        private readonly TaskCompletionSource loaded = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously), closed = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        private readonly Dictionary<string, TextBox> inputs = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private readonly Dictionary<DependencyObject, BindingBase> originalBindings = new(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance);
        private readonly Dictionary<Button, System.Windows.Input.ICommand?> originalCommands = new();
        private Task<MatrixRuntime>? creation; private Task? shutdown;
        private FrameworkElement page = null!;
        private object[] identities = []; private DeviceRow[] devices = []; private bool[] selected = [];
        private bool closeAttempted, userClose, cleanupStarted;
        private int step;

        internal Task Track(Task task) { tasks.Add(task); return task; }
        internal Task<T> Track<T>(Task<T> task) { tasks.Add(task); return task; }
        internal async Task Wait(Task task) { if (!tasks.Contains(task)) tasks.Add(task); await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)); }
        internal async Task Settle()
        {
            await Wait(dispatcher.InvokeAsync(Window.UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.DataBind).Task);
            await Wait(dispatcher.InvokeAsync(Window.UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render).Task);
            await Wait(dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle).Task);
        }
        internal void Product(bool value, string expected, object? actual = null)
        {
            Checks.Add((value ? "PASS " : "FAIL ") + expected); Observe("assert", new { expected, actual, passed = value });
            if (!value) Failures.Add(expected);
        }
        private static void Require(bool value, string expected) { if (!value) throw new SettingsWorkspacePrecondition(expected); }
        internal void Observe(string operation, object? actual) => Observations.Add(new { step = ++step, operation, actual });
        internal TextBox Input(string property) => inputs["Settings." + property];
        internal object[] TaskStates() => tasks.Select(task => (object)new { status = task.Status.ToString(), task.IsCompleted }).ToArray();
        internal void ReleaseOnCleanup(TaskCompletionSource signal) => releases.Add(signal);
        internal void RequireActualOutOfRangeWidth() => Require(Window.ActualWidth > AppSettings.MaximumWindowWidth, "平台实际显示超界宽度，非Width属性被平台夹取");
        private object[] Identity() => [Vm, Vm.Settings, Runtime, Runtime.Backend, Runtime.Devices, Runtime.Scripts, Runtime.Input, Runtime.Api, Runtime.Metadata, Runtime.SettingsStore, Runtime.Writes, Runtime.FrozenConnectionSettings, page, SaveButton, Vm.SaveSettingsCommand, Vm.CurrentDevice!, Vm.MainDevice!];
        private void Context()
        {
            Product(identities.SequenceEqual(Identity(), ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance) && devices.SequenceEqual(Vm.Devices, ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance)
                && selected.SequenceEqual(Vm.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected)), "保持Editor/Runtime/组件/页面/命令/设备对象与选择身份");
            foreach (var pair in originalBindings)
            {
                var property = pair.Key is TextBox ? TextBox.TextProperty : ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty;
                Product(ReferenceEquals(BindingOperations.GetBindingBase(pair.Key, property), pair.Value), "保留原Binding实例：" + ((pair.Key as FrameworkElement)?.Name ?? ""));
            }
            Product(originalCommands.All(pair => ReferenceEquals(pair.Key.Command, pair.Value)), "全部原按钮命令实例保留");
            Product(inputs.Values.ToHashSet(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance).SetEquals(VisualDescendants<TextBox>(page))
                && originalCommands.Keys.ToHashSet(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance).SetEquals(VisualDescendants<Button>(page))
                && originalBindings.Keys.OfType<CheckBox>().ToHashSet(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance).SetEquals(VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(page)), "当前真实页面仍包含同一组原控件而非旧引用或替身");
            Product(!Runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning && Runtime.Api.DevicePorts.Count == 0 && Runtime.Scripts.GetJobs().Count == 0, "无隐式自动化接口/设备接口/脚本接纳");
        }
        internal async Task Initialize()
        {
            Require(Application.Current.Windows.Count == 0 && Application.Current.MainWindow is null, "前例窗口已释放");
            System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            var settings = new AppSettings { Language = "zh-CN", WindowWidth = width, WindowHeight = height, AutoStartApi = false, AutoConnect = false,
                AgentBaseUrl = null, AgentSerial = null, SyncMouse = false, SyncKeyboard = false, AdbPath = "", LdConsolePath = "", AdbAllowedSerials = [], LdSerialBindings = [] };
            creation = Track(MatrixRuntime.CreateAsync(settings, directory, demo: true, ct: deadline.Token));
            Runtime = await creation.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15)); Require(Runtime.IsDemo && Runtime.Backend is DemoDeviceBackend, "实际自有Demo后端");
            Vm = new WorkspaceViewModel(Runtime, directory, true); await Wait(Vm.RefreshDevicesAsync());
            Require(Vm.Devices.Count == 2, "自有Demo两设备"); await Wait(Vm.SetMainAsync(Vm.Devices[0]));
            Vm.CurrentDevice = Vm.Devices[1]; Vm.Devices[1].IsSelected = true; Vm.UpdateSelection();
            Window = new MainWindow(Vm) { ShowActivated = false }; Window.Closing -= Window.WindowClosing; Window.Closing += OnClose;
            Window.Loaded += OnLoaded; Window.Closed += OnClosed; Application.Current.MainWindow = Window;
            Window.Show(); Window.NavigateTo("设置"); await Wait(loaded.Task); await Settle();
            Observe("actual-window", new { width, height, Window.ActualWidth, Window.ActualHeight, Window.IsLoaded, Window.IsVisible, Window.ShowActivated });
            Require(Window.IsLoaded && Window.IsVisible && PresentationSource.FromVisual(Window) is not null && Math.Abs(Window.ActualWidth - width) < .6 && Math.Abs(Window.ActualHeight - height) < .6, "真实外窗尺寸等于请求");
            page = (FrameworkElement)((TabItem)Window.tabs.SelectedItem).Content;
            foreach (var box in VisualDescendants<TextBox>(page))
            {
                var binding = BindingOperations.GetBinding(box, TextBox.TextProperty) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("原设置输入缺少Binding");
                Require(binding.Path?.Path.StartsWith("Settings.", StringComparison.Ordinal) == true, "设置输入有原Binding");
                inputs.Add(binding.Path!.Path, box); originalBindings.Add(box, binding);
            }
            foreach (var check in VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(page))
            { var binding = BindingOperations.GetBinding(check, ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty); Require(binding is not null, "原复选框绑定"); originalBindings.Add(check, binding!); }
            foreach (var button in VisualDescendants<Button>(page)) originalCommands.Add(button, button.Command);
            Require(inputs.Count == 21 && originalBindings.Count == 25 && originalCommands.Count == 7, "原21输入/4复选框/7按钮完整");
            SaveButton = originalCommands.Keys.Single(button => ReferenceEquals(button.Command, Vm.SaveSettingsCommand));
            identities = Identity(); devices = Vm.Devices.ToArray(); selected = devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected).ToArray();
            await Save(); Require(Vm.Error.Length == 0 && File.Exists(ConfigPath), "原控件初始合法保存可用"); Context();
        }
        private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs args) => loaded.TrySetResult();
        private void OnClosed(object? sender, EventArgs args) { Closed = true; closed.TrySetResult(); }
        private void OnClose(object? sender, CancelEventArgs args) { args.Cancel = true; userClose = true; }
        internal SettingsConfigEvidence Config()
        {
            if (!File.Exists(ConfigPath)) return new(false, 0, null, null, null);
            var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(ConfigPath); return new(true, bytes.LongLength, Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(bytes)), File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(ConfigPath).Ticks, Convert.ToBase64String(bytes));
        }
        internal async Task Edit(string property, string text)
        {
            var input = Input(property); var expression = input.GetBindingExpression(TextBox.TextProperty);
            Require(expression is not null && input.IsEnabled && !input.IsReadOnly, "编辑原可用输入：" + property);
            input.SetCurrentValue(TextBox.TextProperty, text); expression!.UpdateSource(); await Settle();
            Product(ReferenceEquals(expression, input.GetBindingExpression(TextBox.TextProperty)), "实际编辑保持原BindingExpression：" + property);
            Observe("edit", new { property, requested = text, actual = input.Text, hasError = Validation.GetHasError(input), errors = Validation.GetErrors(input).Select(error => error.ErrorContent?.ToString()).ToArray() });
        }
        internal async Task Toggle(string property, bool value)
        {
            var control = originalBindings.Keys.OfType<CheckBox>().Single(check => BindingOperations.GetBinding(check, ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty)?.Path.Path == "Settings." + property);
            Require(control.IsEnabled, "实际复选框可用：" + property);

            Window.NavigateTo("文本"); await Settle(); Window.NavigateTo("设置"); await Settle();

        private Rect Clip(FrameworkElement item)
        {

                if (parent is FrameworkElement ancestor && (ancestor.ClipToBounds || ancestor is ScrollContentPresenter)) clip.Intersect(Bounds(ancestor));

        }
        private void Hit44(FrameworkElement item)
        {
            var visible = Bounds(item); visible.Intersect(Clip(item));
            Product(item.IsVisible && !visible.IsEmpty && visible.Width >= 43.9 && visible.Height >= 43.9, "实际祖先裁剪后44交互区：" + AutomationProperties.GetName(item), RectValue(visible));
            if (item.IsEnabled && !visible.IsEmpty && visible.Width > 0 && visible.Height > 0)
            {
                var hit = Window.Shell.InputHitTest(new Point(visible.X + visible.Width / 2, visible.Y + visible.Height / 2)) as DependencyObject;
                Product(hit is not null && (ReferenceEquals(item, hit) || item.IsAncestorOf(hit)), "enabled实际命中归原控件");
            }
            else Product(item is TextBox box && new[] { "Settings.MiniMaxSize", "Settings.MiniMaxFps", "Settings.MiniBitRate" }.Contains(BindingOperations.GetBinding(box, TextBox.TextProperty)?.Path.Path)
                || item is CheckBox check && BindingOperations.GetBinding(check, ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty)?.Path.Path == "Settings.ForceHardwareDecode", "仅4个明确未接入项允许disabled，不以InputHitTest判假红");
        }
        private static FrameworkElement? ParentWithToolTip(FrameworkElement item)
        {
            for (DependencyObject? current = item; current is Visual; current = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(current))
                if (current is FrameworkElement element && element.ToolTip is not null) return element;
            return null;
        }
        private async Task ReadDisabledTip(FrameworkElement owner)
        {
            owner.BringIntoView(); await Settle(); var original = owner.ToolTip;
            var expected = original as string ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("原禁用原因必须为完整文本");
            var originalBinding = BindingOperations.GetBindingBase(owner, ToolTipProperty);
            var tip = new System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip { Content = expected, PlacementTarget = owner, Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom };
            try
            {
                owner.SetCurrentValue(ToolTipProperty, tip); tip.SetCurrentValue(System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip.IsOpenProperty, true); await Settle();
                Product(ReferenceEquals(originalBinding, BindingOperations.GetBindingBase(owner, ToolTipProperty)), "打开自有原因Popup不替换原BindingBase");
                var text = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(tip).FirstOrDefault(item => item.Text == expected);
                Product(ToolTipService.GetShowOnDisabled(owner) && tip.IsOpen && tip.IsVisible && tip.ActualWidth > 0 && tip.ActualWidth <= 361
                    && text is not null && text.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.Wrap && text.IsVisible && text.ActualHeight >= text.DesiredSize.Height - .5,
                    "真实禁用原因Popup完整换行可读", new { expected, tip.IsOpen, tip.IsVisible, tip.ActualWidth, tip.ActualHeight, wrap = text?.TextWrapping.ToString(), textHeight = text?.ActualHeight, desiredHeight = text?.DesiredSize.Height });
            }
            finally
            {
                tip.SetCurrentValue(System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip.IsOpenProperty, false); owner.SetCurrentValue(ToolTipProperty, original);
                Product(ReferenceEquals(originalBinding, BindingOperations.GetBindingBase(owner, ToolTipProperty)) && Equals(owner.ToolTip, original), "关闭原因Popup后原值与原绑定完整恢复");
            }
        }
        private static object RectValue(Rect rect) => new { empty = rect.IsEmpty, x = Finite(rect.X), y = Finite(rect.Y), width = Finite(rect.Width), height = Finite(rect.Height) };
        private static double? Finite(double number) => double.IsFinite(number) ? number : null;
        internal async Task Cleanup()
        {
            Require(!cleanupStarted, "唯一清理请求"); cleanupStarted = true; foreach (var signal in releases) signal.TrySetResult(); deadline.Cancel();
            var drain = Task.WhenAll(tasks.ToArray()); try { await drain.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15)); } catch { if (!drain.IsCompleted) { Retain(); throw new InvalidOperationException("原任务尚未终态，不释放其资源"); } }
            if (Runtime is null && creation?.IsCompletedSuccessfully == true) Runtime = creation.Result;
            if (creation is not null && !creation.IsCompleted) { Retain(); throw new InvalidOperationException("Runtime创建所有权未解析"); }
            if (closeAttempted)
            {
                if (!closed.Task.IsCompletedSuccessfully || !Window.closeApproved) { Retain(); throw new InvalidOperationException("原正常关闭未完成；不启动第二清理owner"); }
            }
            else
            {
                CleanupOwner = Vm is not null ? "fixture-VM-Shutdown" : Runtime is not null ? "fixture-Runtime-Dispose" : "factory-no-runtime";
                if (Window is not null) { Window.Closing -= OnClose; Window.Loaded -= OnLoaded; LocalizationService.Current.LanguageChanged -= Window.OnLanguageChanged; Window.AbortStartup(); }
                if (Vm is not null) { ShutdownRequests++; shutdown = Vm.ShutdownAsync(); }
                else if (Runtime is not null) { ShutdownRequests++; shutdown = Runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask(); }
                if (shutdown is not null)
                {
                    _ = Track(shutdown); try { await shutdown.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15)); } catch { if (!shutdown.IsCompleted) Retain(); throw; }
                }
            }
            if (Window is not null) { Window.Loaded -= OnLoaded; Window.Closed -= OnClosed; }
            Require(!userClose && tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted) && Application.Current.Windows.Count == 0, "无用户关闭干扰/未终态任务/残窗");
            if (Runtime is not null) Require(!Runtime.Api.BasicRunning && !Runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning && Runtime.Api.DevicePorts.Count == 0, "自有接口全部结束");
            Application.Current.MainWindow = null; deadline.Dispose();
            Observe("cleanup", new { CleanupOwner, NormalCloseRequests, ShutdownRequests, Closed, Retained, originalTasksTerminal = tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted) });
            void Retain() { Retained = true; retainedSettingsWorkspaces.Add(this); }
        }
    }
}

using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using System.IO;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    internal async Task VerifyShellSimplificationAsync()
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("外壳验收仅允许演示工作区。");
        if (WorkspacePages.Length != 12 || tabs.Items.Count != 12 || navigation.Count != 12)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("统一导航应包含 12 个独立页面。");
        if (WorkspacePages.Any(page => page.Tag == "雷电实例") || tabs.Items.Cast<TabItem>().Any(page => Equals(page.Tag, "雷电实例")) || navigation.ContainsKey("雷电实例"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("旧雷电实例独立入口仍然存在。");
        if (!navigation.Keys.ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal).SetEquals(WorkspacePages.Select(page => page.Tag)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("导航入口与页面定义不一致。");
        if (workspace.RowDefinitions.Count != 4 || Grid.GetRow(tabs) != 2)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("删除摘要后仍保留空白行。");

        var previousTag = (tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag?.ToString() ?? WorkspacePages[0].Tag;
        var previousDevice = ViewModel.CurrentDevice;
        var directoryWasVisible = directoryWindow?.IsVisible == true;
        try
        {
            foreach (var page in WorkspacePages)
            {
                NavigateTo(page.Tag);
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
                UpdateLayout();
                VerifyNoRemovedShellControls(Shell, LocalizationService.PageDisplayName(page.Tag));
                if (!navigation.TryGetValue(page.Tag, out var link) || link.IsChecked != true || !link.IsVisible)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"页面 {LocalizationService.PageDisplayName(page.Tag)} 没有唯一有效导航入口。");
            }

            NavigateTo("节点");
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            var target = VisualDescendants<ComboBox>(Shell).Single(input => input.Name == "SingleDeviceTarget");
            if (!target.IsVisible || target.IsEditable || !target.Items.Cast<DeviceRow>().SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Devices) || BindingOperations.GetBinding(target, Selector.SelectedItemProperty)?.Path.Path != nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.CurrentDevice))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("单设备目标没有绑定到明确可选择的设备列表。");
            if (ViewModel.Devices.FirstOrDefault(row => !ReferenceEquals(row, previousDevice)) is { } other)
            {
                target.SelectedItem = other;
                if (!ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.CurrentDevice, other)) throw new InvalidOperationException("选择目标未更新单设备操作上下文。");
                target.SelectedItem = previousDevice;
                if (!ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.CurrentDevice, previousDevice)) throw new InvalidOperationException("单设备操作目标未恢复。");
            }
            NavigateTo("应用");
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (singleTargetChoice.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed || singleTargetLabel.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("应用页仍显示无关的单设备目标，可能与应用勾选对象混淆。");
            NavigateTo("节点");
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (VisualDescendants<ComboBox>(Shell).Any(input => BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, Selector.SelectedItemProperty)?.Path.Path == "GroupFilter"))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("全局设备分组入口仍然存在。");
            if (previousDevice is not null && ViewModel.Devices.FirstOrDefault(row => !ReferenceEquals(row, previousDevice)) is { } filteredDevice)
            {
                var previousInfo = filteredDevice.Info;
                var previousStatus = deviceStatusFilter;
                var main = ViewModel.MainDevice;
                var selected = ViewModel.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected).ToArray();
                try
                {
                    await ViewModel.LoadNodesAsync();
                    var nodes = ViewModel.Nodes.ToArray();
                    var image = ViewModel.DebugImage;
                    var parameters = ViewModel.Parameters.ToArray();
                    filteredDevice.Info = previousInfo with { State = "Offline" };
                    deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = "离线";
                    await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
                    if (unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().Any(row => row.Device == previousDevice) || !unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().Any(row => row.Device == filteredDevice))
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("单设备目标隐藏反例没有形成。");
                    foreach (var tag in new[] { "应用", "节点" })
                    {
                        NavigateTo(tag);
                        await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
                        if (!target.Items.Contains(previousDevice) || !ReferenceEquals(target.SelectedItem, previousDevice)
                            || !ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.CurrentDevice, previousDevice) || !ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.MainDevice, main)
                            || !selected.SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected)) || !nodes.SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Nodes)
                            || !ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.DebugImage, image) || !parameters.SequenceEqual(ViewModel.Parameters))
                            throw new InvalidOperationException("状态筛选改写了单设备目标、主控、勾选或节点参数上下文。");
                    }
                }
                finally
                {
                    filteredDevice.Info = previousInfo;
                    deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = previousStatus;
                }
            }
            if (!VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Any(button => button.Name == "WorkspaceSettings") || !VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Any(button => button.Name == "DeviceDetails"))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("设置或设备属性入口缺失。");

            ShowDeviceDirectory();
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
            directoryWindow!.UpdateLayout();
            VerifyNoRemovedShellControls(directoryWindow, "设备详情");
            var directoryList = VisualDescendants<ListBox>(directoryWindow).Single(list => list.Name == "DetailsDeviceChoice");
            if (BindingOperations.GetBinding(directoryList, Selector.SelectedItemProperty)?.Path.Path != nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.CurrentDevice))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("设备目录已丢失明确选择功能。");
            var inputs = VisualDescendants<TextBox>(directoryWindow).Select(input => BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, TextBox.TextProperty)?.Path.Path).ToHashSet();
            if (!inputs.Contains(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.DeviceName)) || inputs.Contains("DeviceGroup"))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("设备名称编辑缺失或仍保留分组输入。");
            if (VisualDescendants<ComboBox>(directoryWindow).Any() || VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(directoryWindow).Any() || directoryList.Items.Count != ViewModel.Devices.Count)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("设备详情仍有全局筛选/群控控件或单设备目录被过滤。");
            var captions = VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(directoryWindow).Select(text => text.Text).ToArray();
            if (!captions.Any(caption => caption.StartsWith("画面", StringComparison.Ordinal)) || !captions.Any(caption => caption.StartsWith("节点", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("设备子系统状态缺失。");
            if (ViewModel.CurrentDevice is { } metadataTarget)
            {
                var info = metadataTarget.Info;
                var name = ViewModel.DeviceName;
                var metadata = ViewModel.Runtime.Metadata.GetMetadata(metadataTarget.Serial);
                const string retainedGroup = "  保留原分组验收  ";
                try
                {
                    metadataTarget.Info = info with { GroupId = retainedGroup };
                    ViewModel.DeviceName = "名称保存验收";
                    await ViewModel.SaveMetadataAsync();
                    using var freshCatalog = new CatalogRepository(Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "db.sqlite3"));
                    var saved = freshCatalog.GetMetadata(metadataTarget.Serial);
                    if (metadataTarget.Info.GroupId != retainedGroup || saved.GroupId != retainedGroup || saved.Name != "名称保存验收")
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("仅保存名称时修改或裁剪了既有分组数据。");
                }
                finally
                {
                    ViewModel.Runtime.Metadata.UpsertMetadata(metadataTarget.Serial, metadata.Name, metadata.GroupId);
                    metadataTarget.Info = info; ViewModel.DeviceName = name;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            ViewModel.CurrentDevice = previousDevice;
            if (!directoryWasVisible) directoryWindow?.Hide();
            NavigateTo(previousTag);
            UpdateLayout();
        }
    }

    private static void VerifyNoRemovedShellControls(DependencyObject source, string page)
    {
        var searchPaths = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { "Search", "AppSearch", "NodeSearch" };
        if (VisualDescendants<TextBox>(source).Any(input => searchPaths.Contains(BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, TextBox.TextProperty)?.Path.Path ?? "") || (input.ToolTip as string)?.Contains("搜索", StringComparison.Ordinal) == true))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"页面 {page} 仍有搜索输入或提示。");
        if (VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(source).Any(text => text.Text.Contains("当前设备", StringComparison.Ordinal) || text.Text is "高级管理" or "全部设备" || BindingOperations.GetBinding(text, TextBlock.TextProperty)?.Path.Path == "DeviceContext"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"页面 {page} 仍有旧设备摘要或独立标签。");
        if (VisualDescendants<ComboBox>(source).Any(input => BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, Selector.SelectedItemProperty)?.Path.Path == "GroupFilter"
            || input.Items.Cast<object>().Any(item => item as string == "全部分组"))
            || VisualDescendants<TextBox>(source).Any(input => BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, TextBox.TextProperty)?.Path.Path == "DeviceGroup"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"页面 {page} 仍有已删除的分组控件。");
    }
}

using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private FrameworkElement BuildShellPage()
    {
        var page = Page();
        var toolbar = Toolbar(); var input = BoundInput(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.ShellInput)); input.Width = 470; input.FontFamily = new FontFamily("Consolas"); input.KeyDown += ShellHistoryKey; toolbar.Children.Add(input); toolbar.Children.Add(Button("\uE768", "执行", ViewModel.ShellCommand));
        DockPanel.SetDock(toolbar, Dock.Top); page.Children.Add(toolbar);
        var history = new ListBox { ItemsSource = ViewModel.ShellHistory, BorderThickness = new Thickness(0), HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, Margin = new Thickness(0, 10, 0, 0) };
        var panel = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(StackPanel)); panel.SetValue(MarginProperty, new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 15));
        var command = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBlock)); command.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new Binding(nameof(ShellEntry.Command))); command.SetValue(TextBlock.FontWeightProperty, FontWeights.SemiBold); command.SetValue(TextBlock.FontFamilyProperty, new FontFamily("Consolas")); panel.AppendChild(command);
        var time = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBlock)); time.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new Binding(nameof(ShellEntry.Context))); time.SetValue(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, Brushes.Gray); panel.AppendChild(time);
        var output = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBox)); output.SetBinding(TextBox.TextProperty, new Binding(nameof(ShellEntry.Output))); output.SetValue(TextBox.IsReadOnlyProperty, true); output.SetValue(TextBox.TextWrappingProperty, TextWrapping.Wrap); output.SetValue(TextBox.AcceptsReturnProperty, true); output.SetValue(FontFamilyProperty, new FontFamily("Consolas")); panel.AppendChild(output); history.ItemTemplate = new DataTemplate { VisualTree = panel };
        history.MouseDoubleClick += (_, _) => { if (history.SelectedItem is ShellEntry entry) ViewModel.ShellInput = entry.Command; }; page.Children.Add(history); return page;
    }

    private void ShellHistoryKey(object sender, KeyEventArgs args)
    {
        if (args.Key == Key.Enter) { if (ViewModel.ShellCommand.CanExecute(null)) ViewModel.ShellCommand.Execute(null); shellHistoryCursor = -1; args.Handled = true; return; }
        if (args.Key is not Key.Up and not Key.Down || ViewModel.ShellHistory.Count == 0) return;
        shellHistoryCursor = Math.Clamp(shellHistoryCursor + (args.Key == Key.Up ? 1 : -1), -1, ViewModel.ShellHistory.Count - 1); ViewModel.ShellInput = shellHistoryCursor < 0 ? "" : ViewModel.ShellHistory[shellHistoryCursor].Command; if (sender is TextBox input) input.CaretIndex = input.Text.Length; args.Handled = true;
    }

}

using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private async Task<object> SettleIdlePageCaptureAsync(string page, IReadOnlyDictionary<DeviceRow, DeviceInfo> restoredDevices, string restoredFilter)
    {
        var deadline = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var reason = "尚未布局";
        while (deadline.Elapsed < TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3))
        {
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle);
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (ViewModel.Busy || ViewModel.Transferring || deviceStatusFilter != restoredFilter || restoredDevices.Any(pair => !ViewModel.Devices.Contains(pair.Key) || pair.Key.Info != pair.Value))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("分页截图不是已恢复的idle状态：" + page);
            try
            {
                var rows = page == "设备墙 / 主控" ? CaptureIdleDeviceRows() : [];
                var connected = unifiedDevices.Count(row => row.Connected);
                if (!workspaceCounts.Text.Contains($"已连接 {connected}", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new InvalidOperationException("页脚连接数未恢复。");
                return new
                {
                    page, captureState = "idle", statusFilter = deviceStatusFilter, busy = ViewModel.Busy, transferring = ViewModel.Transferring,
                    restoredDevices = ViewModel.Devices.Select(row => new { row.Serial, row.Info.State, row.Info.Generation, row.Info.TransportId }).ToArray(),
                    expectedRestoredDevices = restoredDevices.Select(pair => new { pair.Value.Serial, pair.Value.State, pair.Value.Generation, pair.Value.TransportId }).ToArray(),
                    directoryCount = unifiedDevices.Count, filteredCount = unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().Count(), connectedCount = connected,
                    footer = workspaceCounts.Text, actualWidth = ActualWidth, actualHeight = ActualHeight, renderedDeviceRows = rows, settledMilliseconds = deadline.ElapsedMilliseconds
                };
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException ex) { reason = ex.Message; }
            await Task.Delay(20);
        }
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"分页截图布局未在3秒内恢复：{page}；{reason}");
    }

    private object[] CaptureIdleDeviceRows()
    {
        var grid = VisualDescendants<DataGrid>(wallList).Single();
        var expected = unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().ToArray();
        var scroll = DeviceListScrollViewer() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("设备列表缺少实际滚动容器。");
        var presenter = VisualDescendants<ScrollContentPresenter>(scroll).FirstOrDefault(item => item.Name == "PART_ScrollContentPresenter")
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("设备列表缺少实际正文视口。");
        var viewport = presenter.TransformToAncestor(grid).TransformBounds(new Rect(presenter.RenderSize));
        var rows = new List<object>();
        foreach (var item in expected)
        {
            if (grid.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is not DataGridRow row || !row.IsVisible || row.ActualWidth <= 0 || row.ActualHeight <= 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("非空目录尚未生成实际行：" + item.Name);
            var bounds = row.TransformToAncestor(grid).TransformBounds(new Rect(row.RenderSize));
            var visible = Rect.Intersect(bounds, viewport);
            if (visible.IsEmpty || visible.Width <= 0 || bounds.Top < viewport.Top || bounds.Bottom > viewport.Bottom) throw new InvalidOperationException("设备行没有完整高度进入实际视口：" + item.Name);
            bool Visible(FrameworkElement control)
            {
                if (!control.IsVisible || control.ActualWidth <= 0 || control.ActualHeight <= 0) return false;
                var controlBounds = control.TransformToAncestor(grid).TransformBounds(new Rect(control.RenderSize));
                return viewport.Contains(controlBounds);
            }
            if (!VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(row).Any(text => text.Text == item.Name && Visible(text))) throw new InvalidOperationException("设备名称尚未呈现在视口：" + item.Name);
            var action = VisualDescendants<Button>(row).FirstOrDefault(button => Visible(button) && VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(button).Any(text => text.Text == item.PrimaryLabel && Visible(text)))
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("设备操作尚未呈现在视口：" + item.Name);
            foreach (var button in VisualDescendants<UnifiedDeviceTile>(row).SelectMany(tile => VisualDescendants<Button>(tile)).Where(button => button.Visibility == Visibility.Visible))
            {
                var cell = VisualDescendants<DataGridCell>(row).FirstOrDefault(cell => VisualDescendants<Button>(cell).Contains(button))
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("设备操作没有实际表格单元：" + item.Name);
                var actionBounds = button.TransformToAncestor(grid).TransformBounds(new Rect(button.RenderSize));
                var cellBounds = cell.TransformToAncestor(grid).TransformBounds(new Rect(cell.RenderSize));
                if (button.ActualWidth < 44 || button.ActualHeight < 44 || !Visible(button) || !cellBounds.Contains(actionBounds) || !bounds.Contains(actionBounds))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("设备操作未完整进入实际单元/行/视口或不足44命中区：" + item.Name + ":" + button.Name);
            }
            rows.Add(new { item.Key, item.Name, item.State, item.PrimaryLabel, row.ActualWidth, row.ActualHeight, visibleBounds = new { visible.X, visible.Y, visible.Width, visible.Height }, action = System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.GetName(action) });
        }
        if (expected.Length != 0 && rows.Count == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("非空目录截图没有实际设备行。");
        return rows.ToArray();
    }

    private async Task VerifyListConsoleSimplificationAsync()
    {
        NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控");
        await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
        if (VisualDescendants<ComboBox>(Shell).Any(input => input.Items.Cast<object>().Any(item => item as string == "全部分组")))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("设备管理仍显示已删除的全部分组筛选。");
        var obsolete = new[] { "设备卡片", "屏幕视图", "启动并连接", "接入已运行实例", "选择当前筛选中的全部设备" };
        if (VisualDescendants<FrameworkElement>(Shell).Any(control => control.ToolTip is string tip && obsolete.Any(label => tip.StartsWith(label, StringComparison.Ordinal))))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("设备管理仍显示重复视图、启动或全选入口。");
        if (VisualDescendants<FrameworkElement>(Shell).Any(control => control.ToolTip as string is "同步鼠标" or "同步键盘" or "自动截图"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("设备列表仍显示脱离主控场景的同步或截图开关。");
    }

    private async Task VerifyOneClickProjectionAsync()
    {
        NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控");
        SetWallViewMode("list");
        await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
        if (VisualDescendants<Expander>(Shell).Any(expander => expander.Header as string == "实例快捷操作")
            || VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(Shell).Any(text => text.Text is "应用包名" or "输入文字"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("设备管理仍保留与应用管理/文本输入重复的实例快捷表单。");
        if (VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(Shell).Any(text => text.Text == "后台启动") ||
            VisualDescendants<FrameworkElement>(Shell).Any(control => control.ToolTip is string tip && tip.Contains("隐藏本次启动", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("已删除的后台启动入口仍存在。");
        var expectedActions = new[] { "启动所选", "一键启动全部", "新建空白实例" };
        foreach (var label in expectedActions)
            if (!VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Any(button => button.ToolTip is string tip && tip.StartsWith(label, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("统一设备页遗漏有效操作：" + label);
        var clarityFailures = new List<string>();
        var instanceActions = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.ContextMenu is { } menu
            && new[] { "资源配置", "关闭实例", "重启实例" }.All(label => menu.Items.OfType<MenuItem>().Any(item => item.Header as string == label)));
        var instanceCaption = string.Join("", VisualDescendants<TextBlock>(instanceActions).Where(text => text.FontFamily.Source != "Segoe MDL2 Assets").Select(text => text.Text));
        if (instanceActions.Name != "InstanceActions" || instanceCaption != "实例操作" || instanceActions.ToolTip as string != "实例操作"
            || System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.GetName(instanceActions) != "实例操作")
            clarityFailures.Add($"实例菜单应使用稳定Name InstanceActions及可见/无障碍名称实例操作；actual name={instanceActions.Name}, caption={instanceCaption}, automation={System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.GetName(instanceActions)}, tooltip={instanceActions.ToolTip}");
        var workspaceMore = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.Name == "WorkspaceMore");
        if (ReferenceEquals(instanceActions, workspaceMore) || ReferenceEquals(instanceActions.ContextMenu, workspaceMore.ContextMenu))
            clarityFailures.Add("实例操作与工作区更多入口必须保持独立菜单和目标范围");
        var launchToolTips = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["启动所选"] = "启动所选：操作列表中已勾选且尚未连接的可接入实例，包括被当前筛选隐藏的已勾选实例；已运行的实例仅连接，不重复启动；不包含受保护实例。完成核验后自动连接并加入群控。",
            ["一键启动全部"] = "一键启动全部：操作全部尚未连接的可接入实例，包括被当前筛选隐藏的实例；已运行的实例仅连接，不重复启动；不包含受保护实例。完成核验后自动连接并加入群控。"
        };
        foreach (var (label, expectedTip) in launchToolTips)
        {
            var launch = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.GetName(button) == label);
            if (launch.ToolTip as string != expectedTip)
                clarityFailures.Add($"{label}提示必须说明所选/全部、筛选隐藏、运行态仅连接和保护范围；actual={launch.ToolTip}");
            if (launch.IsEnabled || !ToolTipService.GetShowOnDisabled(launch) || !ToolTipService.GetIsEnabled(launch))
                clarityFailures.Add($"{label}在真实Demo禁用状态仍须配置可读提示；enabled={launch.IsEnabled}, showOnDisabled={ToolTipService.GetShowOnDisabled(launch)}, tooltipEnabled={ToolTipService.GetIsEnabled(launch)}");
        }
        if (clarityFailures.Count > 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("设备操作清晰度验收失败：" + string.Join("；", clarityFailures));
        foreach (var label in new[] { "资源配置", "关闭实例", "重启实例" })
            if (!ldCommandsByLabel.ContainsKey(label)) throw new InvalidOperationException("更多菜单遗漏生命周期命令：" + label);
        var cancel = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.ToolTip as string == "取消启动");
        if (cancel.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed) throw new InvalidOperationException("没有启动任务时仍显示取消启动按钮。");
        NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控"); UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
        await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
        var originalDevices = ViewModel.Devices.Count;
        var originalSelection = unifiedDevices.ToDictionary(row => row.Key, row => row.IsSelected);
        if (unifiedDevices.Select(row => row.Key).Distinct().Count() != unifiedDevices.Count || wallWorkspace.RowDefinitions.Count != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("统一目录重复或仍有底部独立卡片区。");
        if (!unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.Instance is { AndroidStarted: false } && row.Device is null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("统一目录遗漏关闭实例。");
        try
        {
            foreach (var row in unifiedDevices.ToArray()) row.IsSelected = false;
            var cold = unifiedDevices.First(row => row.Instance is { Index: > 0, AndroidStarted: false } && row.Device is null);
            cold.Update(cold.Instance, null, false, "已连接");
            if (cold.State == "已连接") throw new InvalidOperationException("连接失效后仍显示历史已连接阶段。");
            UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
            cold.IsSelected = true;
            if (!workspaceCounts.Text.EndsWith("已选 1", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new InvalidOperationException("关闭实例的选择数量没有立即更新。");
            if (ViewModel.Targets().Count != 0 || ViewModel.CanWriteTargets()) throw new InvalidOperationException("只选择关闭实例时仍回落到旧当前设备。");
            var transfers = ViewModel.Transfers.Count;
            try { ViewModel.QueuePush(typeof(MainWindow).Assembly.Location, false); throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接选择被静默忽略。"); }
            catch (MatrixDevice.Core.DeviceException) { }
            if (ViewModel.Transfers.Count != transfers) throw new InvalidOperationException("未连接选择导致其它设备被加入传输。");
            ViewModel.Devices[0].IsSelected = true;
            if (ViewModel.Targets().Count != 0 || ViewModel.CanWriteTargets()) throw new InvalidOperationException("混合选择静默遗漏未连接设备。");
            var all = VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(Shell).Single(input => input.Name == "SelectAllDevices");
            all.IsChecked = true; all.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
            if (unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.CanSelect && !row.IsSelected) || ViewModel.Devices.Count != originalDevices) throw new InvalidOperationException("全选未涵盖关闭实例或伪造了可控设备。");
            if (all.IsChecked != true || !all.IsThreeState) throw new InvalidOperationException("全选表头没有反映完整选择或三态语义。");
            UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
            if (unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.CanSelect && !row.IsSelected)) throw new InvalidOperationException("自动目录更新丢失选择。");
            unifiedDevices.First(row => row.CanSelect).IsSelected = false;
            if (all.IsChecked is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException("部分选择未显示表头中间态。");
            all.IsChecked = false; all.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
            if (unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.IsSelected) || ViewModel.Devices.Any(row => row.IsSelected) || all.IsChecked != false)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("取消全选没有清除统一目录及设备选择。");
        }
        finally { foreach (var row in unifiedDevices.ToArray()) row.IsSelected = originalSelection.GetValueOrDefault(row.Key); }
        var originalConfirm = ViewModel.Confirm; var confirmations = 0;
        ViewModel.Confirm = (_, _) => { confirmations++; return false; };
        try
        {
            foreach (var invalid in new Dictionary<int, string>[] { new(), new() { [1] = "demo", [2] = "extra" }, new() { [1] = "" } })
            {
                try { await ConnectLdInstancesAsync([1], invalid); throw new InvalidOperationException("不完整的预批准串号进入启动流程。"); }
                catch (MatrixDevice.Core.DeviceException ex) when (ex.Status == 400 && ex.Code == 1007) { }
            }
            try { await ConnectLdInstancesAsync([1]); throw new InvalidOperationException("演示模式进入真实启动。"); }
            catch (MatrixDevice.Core.DeviceException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("演示", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { }
            if (confirmations != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("普通启动仍弹出确认框。");
        }
        finally { ViewModel.Confirm = originalConfirm; }
    }

    private async Task VerifyCanonicalDeviceActionsAsync(string? screenshot)
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("入口归属验收仅限演示模式。");
        var previousTag = (tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag?.ToString() ?? "设备墙 / 主控";

            foreach (var (path, caption, scope) in new[]

                (nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.SyncMouse), "同步点击滑动", "嵌入画面"),
                (nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.SyncKeyboard), "同步按键", "程序")
            })
            {
                var controls = VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(Shell).Where(input => BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty)?.Path.Path == path).ToArray();
                if (controls.Length != 1 || !VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(wallMainPanel).Contains(controls[0]) || controls[0].Content as string != caption
                    || controls[0].ToolTip is not string tip || !tip.Contains("主控", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !tip.Contains("勾选", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !tip.Contains(scope, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("主控同步控件的唯一归属或作用范围提示不清晰：" + path);
            }
            var expected = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["MainVolumeUp"] = "增大音量", ["MainVolumeDown"] = "减小音量" };
            var buttons = VisualDescendants<Button>(wallMainPanel).Where(button => expected.ContainsKey(button.Name)).ToArray();
            if (buttons.Length != 2 || buttons.Any(button => button.ToolTip as string != expected[button.Name] || button.Content is not TextBlock || button.ActualWidth != 44 || button.ActualHeight != 44 || button.Command is not AsyncCommand))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("主控音量图标、提示或稳定尺寸缺失。");
            var other = ViewModel.Devices.First(row => !ReferenceEquals(row, main));
            foreach (var row in ViewModel.Devices) row.IsSelected = ReferenceEquals(row, other);
            foreach (var enabled in new[] { false, true })

                throw new InvalidOperationException("切换到应用页后仍请求设备管理的主控截图。");
            if (applicationTargets.Any(row => row.IsSelected) || CanManageApplicationTargets() || !VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Any(button => button.ToolTip as string == "安装 APK"))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("应用入口缺失，或统一目录勾选隐式授权了应用目标。");
            NavigateTo("文本"); ViewModel.TextInput = "入口去重中文验证";
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (!VisualDescendants<TextBox>(Shell).Any(input => BindingOperations.GetBinding(input, TextBox.TextProperty)?.Path.Path == nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.TextInput))
                || !VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Any(button => ReferenceEquals(button.Command, ViewModel.TextCommand)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("独立文本输入或发送命令入口缺失。");
            if (!ReferenceEquals(current, ViewModel.CurrentDevice) || !ReferenceEquals(main, ViewModel.MainDevice) || selections.Any(pair => pair.Key.IsSelected != pair.Value))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("入口切换改写了设备上下文、群控勾选或主控。");
        }
        finally
        {
            main.Info = info; ViewModel.TextInput = text; ViewModel.SyncKeyboard = sync; ViewModel.SyncMouse = mouseSync;
            CloseMainControl();
            foreach (var row in unifiedDevices) row.IsSelected = unifiedSelections.GetValueOrDefault(row.Key);
            foreach (var pair in selections) pair.Key.IsSelected = pair.Value;
            ViewModel.UpdateSelection();
            SetWallViewMode(previousMode); NavigateTo(previousTag);
            if (wallMainPanel.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed || wallWorkspace.ColumnDefinitions[1].Width.Value != 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("关闭主控后没有归还列表宽度。");
        }
    }

    private async Task VerifyOperationGatesAsync()
    {
        var current = ViewModel.CurrentDevice!; var originalInfo = current.Info;
        try
        {
            current.Info = originalInfo with { State = "Offline" };
            if (!ViewModel.DeviceContext.Contains("离线", StringComparison.Ordinal) || ViewModel.CanUseDevice()) throw new InvalidOperationException("当前设备标题或命令仍显示旧在线状态");
        }
        finally { current.Info = originalInfo; }
        if (ViewModel.Devices.Count > 1)
        {
            var selections = ViewModel.Devices.Select(row => row.IsSelected).ToArray(); var previousText = ViewModel.TextInput;
            try
            {
                foreach (var row in ViewModel.Devices) row.IsSelected = false;
                var other = ViewModel.Devices.First(row => !ReferenceEquals(row, current)); other.IsSelected = true;
                current.Info = originalInfo with { State = "Offline" }; ViewModel.TextInput = "测试"; ViewModel.UpdateSelection();
                if (!ViewModel.CanWriteTargets() || ViewModel.CanWriteDevice() || !ViewModel.TextCommand.CanExecute(null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("批量目标和当前设备的门控作用域混淆");
                NavigateTo("文件"); await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
                var download = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.ToolTip as string == "添加下载");
                var upload = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.ToolTip as string == "添加上传");
                if (download.Command!.CanExecute(null) || !upload.Command!.CanExecute(null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("上传/下载控件作用域与执行目标不一致");
            }
            finally { current.Info = originalInfo; ViewModel.TextInput = previousText; for (var i = 0; i < selections.Length; i++) ViewModel.Devices[i].IsSelected = selections[i]; ViewModel.UpdateSelection(); }
        }
        var pending = new TransferRow { Serial = ViewModel.CurrentDevice!.Serial, Direction = "上传", LocalPath = "offline-gate.bin", RemotePath = "/sdcard/MatrixAcceptance/offline-gate.bin" };
        ViewModel.Transfers.Add(pending);
        try
        {
            ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(true);
            try
            {
                if (!ViewModel.Busy || !ViewModel.Runtime.Api.UiWriteBusy || ViewModel.StartTransfersCommand.CanExecute(null) || ViewModel.CanWriteDevice())
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("雷电忙状态没有阻止普通操作或API写入");
            }
            finally { ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(false); }
            var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            var busy = ViewModel.ExecuteAsync("忙状态退出与传输检查", () => release.Task);
            try
            {
                if (ViewModel.StartTransfersCommand.CanExecute(null) || !ViewModel.HasActiveOperations)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("普通忙操作没有阻止传输开始或未纳入退出活动守卫");
            }
            finally { release.SetResult(); await busy; }
            pending.State = "已停止";
            if (!ViewModel.StartTransfersCommand.CanExecute(null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("已停止的文件传输不能重试");
        }
        finally { ViewModel.Transfers.Remove(pending); ViewModel.UpdateSelection(); }
        apiProtocol.SelectedIndex = 2;
        if (apiSend.CanExecute(null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("未启动的接口允许发送请求");
        var serial = ViewModel.CurrentDevice!.Serial;
        await ViewModel.Runtime.Api.StartDeviceAsync(serial);
        try
        {
            apiMethod.SelectedIndex = 1; apiRoute.Text = "/tap"; apiPayload.Text = "{\"X\":20,\"Y\":20}"; apiSend.Refresh();
            await apiSend.ExecuteAsync();
            if (!apiResponse.Text.StartsWith("HTTP 200", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ViewModel.Error)) throw new InvalidOperationException("API面板忙状态阻止了自己的写请求");
        }
        finally { await ViewModel.Runtime.Api.StopDeviceAsync(serial); apiMethod.SelectedIndex = 0; apiRoute.Text = "/health"; apiPayload.Text = "{}"; apiResponse.Clear(); apiProtocol.SelectedIndex = 0; }
    }

    private object[] CaptureControlStates(string page, string state, FrameworkElement surface)
    {
        return VisualDescendants<FrameworkElement>(surface)
            .Where(control => control is ButtonBase or TextBox or Selector or RangeBase)
            .Select((control, index) =>
            {
                var property = control switch
                {
                    TextBox => TextBox.TextProperty,
                    ToggleButton => ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty,
                    Selector => Selector.SelectedItemProperty,
                    RangeBase => RangeBase.ValueProperty,
                    _ => null
                };
                var binding = property is null ? null : BindingOperations.GetBinding(control, property)?.Path?.Path;
                var command = (control as ICommandSource)?.Command;
                return (object)new
                {
                    caseId = $"UI-04-{page}-{index}", page, state, type = control.GetType().Name,
                    label = control.ToolTip as string ?? (control as ContentControl)?.Content as string ?? binding ?? control.Name,
                    binding, control.IsEnabled, control.IsVisible,
                    commandAvailable = command?.CanExecute((control as ICommandSource)?.CommandParameter),
                    result = "OBSERVED-NOT-EXERCISED", mode = "demo"
                };
            }).ToArray();
    }
}
