```csharp
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private async Task VerifyUnifiedDeviceActionsAsync(string? screenshot)
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("统一实例操作验收仅限演示模式。");
        NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控"); SetWallViewMode("list"); UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
        await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
        var previousStatus = deviceStatusFilter;
        var previousCurrent = ViewModel.CurrentDevice;
        var previousMain = ViewModel.MainDevice;
        var selection = unifiedDevices.ToDictionary(row => row.Key, row => row.IsSelected);
        var cold = unifiedDevices.Single(row => row.Instance is { Index: > 0, AndroidStarted: false });
        var other = unifiedDevices.First(row => row.Instance is null && row.Device is not null);
        var otherInfo = other.Device!.Info;
        var more = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.Name == "InstanceActions");
        var menu = more.ContextMenu ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("更多操作按钮没有实际菜单。");
        var menuActions = new[] { "资源配置", "关闭实例", "重启实例" }.ToDictionary(label => label,
            label => menu.Items.OfType<MenuItem>().Single(item => item.Header as string == label));
        if (menuActions.Any(pair => !ReferenceEquals(pair.Value.Command, ldCommandsByLabel[pair.Key])))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("更多菜单条目没有绑定实际生命周期命令。");
        async Task CheckMenuAsync(bool configuration, bool running)
        {
            menu.IsOpen = false;
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
            more.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
            var opened = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            while (true)
            {
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => { UpdateLayout(); menu.UpdateLayout(); }, DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle);
                if (menu.IsOpen && menu.IsLoaded && menu.IsVisible && menu.ActualWidth > 0 && menu.ActualHeight > 0) break;
                if (opened.Elapsed >= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"更多菜单打开超时：open={menu.IsOpen}, loaded={menu.IsLoaded}, visible={menu.IsVisible}, size={menu.ActualWidth}x{menu.ActualHeight}, active={IsActive}。");
                await Task.Delay(20);
            }
            foreach (var pair in menuActions)
            {
                var expected = pair.Key == "资源配置" ? configuration : running;
                if (pair.Value.Command!.CanExecute(null) != expected || pair.Value.IsEnabled != expected)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("更多菜单的可用状态与实际实例目标不一致：" + pair.Key);
            }
        }
        try
        {
            ClearWallSelection(); await CheckMenuAsync(false, false);
            cold.IsSelected = true; await CheckMenuAsync(true, false);
            if (ldSelection is not { } coldSelection || coldSelection.Index != cold.Index || coldSelection.Generation != cold.Instance?.Generation)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("统一目录单选与实际实例命令目标不一致。");
            cold.IsSelected = false; other.IsSelected = true;
            if (ldSelection is not null || ldCommandsByLabel["资源配置"].CanExecute(null) || ldCommandsByLabel["关闭实例"].CanExecute(null))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("非雷电行仍沿用旧实例目标。");
            if (!ReferenceEquals(previousCurrent, ViewModel.CurrentDevice) || !ReferenceEquals(previousMain, ViewModel.MainDevice)
                || !other.Device.IsSelected)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("目录勾选改写当前设备、主控或没有同步对应群控目标。");

            cold.IsSelected = true;
            await CheckMenuAsync(false, false);
            if (ldSelection is not null || ldCommandsByLabel["资源配置"].CanExecute(null))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("多选目录仍保留单实例命令目标。");
            other.Device.Info = otherInfo with { State = "Ready" };
            deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = "已连接";
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            if (unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().Contains(cold)) throw new InvalidOperationException("隐藏目标反例没有形成。");
            other.IsSelected = false;
            if (!cold.IsSelected || ldSelection is not { } hiddenSelection || hiddenSelection.Index != cold.Index || hiddenSelection.Generation != cold.Instance?.Generation)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("状态筛选后的唯一隐藏勾选目标与实例命令快照不一致。");
            var selectAll = VisualDescendants<CheckBox>(Shell).Single(input => input.Name == "SelectAllDevices");
            selectAll.IsChecked = false; selectAll.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
            if (unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.IsSelected) || ldSelection is not null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("表头取消选择没有清除隐藏目标或实例命令快照。");

            var beforeEmptyInfos = ViewModel.Devices.ToDictionary(row => row, row => row.Info);
            var beforeEmptyStatus = deviceStatusFilter;
            try
            {
                ClearWallSelection(); cold.IsSelected = true;
                foreach (var row in ViewModel.Devices) row.Info = row.Info with { State = "Ready" };
                deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = "离线";
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
                if (!unifiedDeviceView.IsEmpty || !cold.IsSelected || selectAll.IsChecked is not null || !selectAll.IsEnabled)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("空可见列表的隐藏勾选未显示为可取消的表头中间态。");
                selectAll.IsChecked = false; selectAll.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
                if (unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.IsSelected) || ViewModel.Devices.Any(row => row.IsSelected) || ldSelection is not null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("空可见列表中的表头取消未清除隐藏目标或实例命令快照。");
            }
            finally
            {
                foreach (var pair in beforeEmptyInfos) pair.Key.Info = pair.Value;
                deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = beforeEmptyStatus;
            }

            deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = previousStatus;
            other.Device.Info = otherInfo;
            var confirm = ViewModel.Confirm;
            ViewModel.Confirm = (_, _) => true;
            try
            {
                cold.IsSelected = true;
                await ExecuteLdPlayerAsync("launch");
                var running = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == cold.Index);
                var projected = unifiedDevices.Single(row => row.Index == cold.Index);
                if (!running.AndroidStarted || projected.Instance != running || projected.AndroidState != "已启动" || projected.ProcessId != running.ProcessId.ToString())
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("模拟命令后统一列表仍显示旧进程或安卓状态。");
                await CheckMenuAsync(false, true);
                if (screenshot is not null) SaveRender(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(screenshot)!, "instance-actions-menu.png"), menu);
                await ExecuteLdPlayerAsync("quit");
                var stopped = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == cold.Index);
                if (stopped.AndroidStarted || projected.Instance != stopped || projected.ProcessId != "-")
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("模拟关闭后统一列表未即时更新。");
            }
            finally { ViewModel.Confirm = confirm; }
            wallActionsViewport.ScrollToTop();
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, DispatcherPriority.Render);
            await Task.Delay(60);
            if (screenshot is not null) SaveRender(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(screenshot)!, "merged-device-actions.png"));
            var settings = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(input => input.Name == "WorkspaceSettings");
            var settingsTop = settings.TranslatePoint(new Point(), Shell).Y;
            var listTop = wallWorkspace.TranslatePoint(new Point(), Shell).Y;
            var footer = workspace.Children.OfType<FrameworkElement>().Single(child => Grid.GetRow(child) == 3);
            var footerTop = footer.TranslatePoint(new Point(), Shell).Y;
            var visibleListHeight = Math.Min(listTop + wallWorkspace.ActualHeight, footerTop) - Math.Max(listTop, 0);
            if (wallWorkspace.ActualHeight < 140 || visibleListHeight < 140 || listTop + wallWorkspace.ActualHeight > footerTop + 1
                || settingsTop < 0 || settingsTop + settings.ActualHeight > Shell.ActualHeight)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"统一页操作区挤占列表或裁切全局工具栏：列表高 {wallWorkspace.ActualHeight:F1}，设置顶 {settingsTop:F1}。");
            var create = VisualDescendants<Button>(Shell).Single(button => button.ToolTip as string == "新建空白实例");
            var actionTop = create.TranslatePoint(new Point(), wallActionsViewport).Y;
            if (actionTop < 0 || actionTop + create.ActualHeight > wallActionsViewport.ActualHeight)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("实例生命周期操作超出可见操作区。");
        }
        finally
        {
            menu.IsOpen = false;
            wallActionsViewport.ScrollToTop();
            other.Device.Info = otherInfo;
            deviceStatusChoice.SelectedItem = previousStatus;
            foreach (var row in unifiedDevices.ToArray()) row.IsSelected = selection.GetValueOrDefault(row.Key);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    internal async Task RunUnifiedAccessAcceptanceAsync(string output, string approvedCandidate, bool verifyBackgroundWindow = false)
    {
        if (ViewModel.Demo || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(output) || !ViewModel.DataDirectory.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "artifacts" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("接入验收必须使用artifacts下的独立配置及绝对证据路径。");
        var runtime = ViewModel.Runtime;
        var service = runtime.LdPlayer ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("未配置雷电。");
        if (runtime.Settings.AdbAllowedSerials.Length != 1 || runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.Count != 1 || !runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.ContainsKey(2))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("验收初始配置必须仅授权独立测试实例2。");
        var target = service.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1);
        if (!target.Name.StartsWith("MatrixAcceptance-", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !target.AndroidStarted)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("只允许已运行的独立验收实例1；本验收不会启动模拟器。");
        var previouslyOnline = ViewModel.Devices.Where(row => row.Info.Online).Select(row => row.Serial).ToArray();
        if (previouslyOnline.Length != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("原授权实例2未就绪。");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(output);
        var completed = false;
        await RunLdWorkspaceOperationAsync("独立实例接入验收", async ct =>
        {
            using var process = Process.GetProcessById(target.VBoxProcessId);
            var proofs = await LdConnectionAdmission.ResolveAsync((AdbDeviceBackend)runtime.Backend, service, [1], [target], new Dictionary<int, long> { [1] = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks }, ct);
            if (proofs.Single().Serial != approvedCandidate) throw new InvalidOperationException("验收目标串号与复制配置中预先批准的串号不符。");
            if (proofs.Single().Serial == previouslyOnline[0]) throw new InvalidOperationException("接入目标与原设备串号重复。");
            var before = ViewModel.Runtime;
            using (var cancelled = new CancellationTokenSource())
            {
                cancelled.Cancel();
                try { await ViewModel.ApplyLdConnectionsAsync(proofs, cancelled.Token); throw new InvalidOperationException("取消未生效。"); }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancelled.IsCancellationRequested) { }
            }
            if (!ReferenceEquals(before, ViewModel.Runtime) || ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.AdbAllowedSerials.Length != 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("取消接入改变了旧授权或运行时。");
            completed = true;
        });
        if (!completed) throw new InvalidOperationException("接入取消验收未完成：" + ldFeedback.Text);
        var previousRuntime = ViewModel.Runtime;
        var previousConfirm = ViewModel.Confirm; var confirmations = 0;
        ViewModel.Confirm = (_, _) => { confirmations++; throw new InvalidOperationException("一键启动弹出了确认框。"); };
        try { await ConnectLdInstancesAsync([1], new Dictionary<int, string> { [1] = approvedCandidate }); }
        finally { ViewModel.Confirm = previousConfirm; }
        {
            if (confirmations != 0 || ReferenceEquals(previousRuntime, ViewModel.Runtime) || ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.GetValueOrDefault(1) != approvedCandidate) throw new InvalidOperationException("一键接入没有通过原批准目标的核验。");
            if (ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.Count != 2 || ViewModel.Devices.Count(row => row.Info.Online) != 2)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("运行时未完成接入替换。");
            foreach (var index in new[] { 1, 2 }) if (!LdInstanceConnected(index)) throw new InvalidOperationException("实例未进入已连接状态：" + index);
            await ViewModel.RefreshAutomaticScreensAsync(ViewModel.Devices.Select(row => row.Serial).ToArray(), CancellationToken.None);
            if (ViewModel.Devices.Any(row => row.Screenshot is null)) throw new InvalidOperationException("接入后截图为空。");
            var hiddenAndRestored = false;
            if (verifyBackgroundWindow)
            {
                var player = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer!.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1);
                using var process = Process.GetProcessById(player.ProcessId);
                ldWindowVisibility ??= new LdWindowVisibility(Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "window-recovery"), Path.GetDirectoryName(ViewModel.Runtime.FrozenConnectionSettings.LdConsolePath)!);
                try
                {
                    if (!await ldWindowVisibility.HideAsync(player, process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks)) throw new InvalidOperationException("目标窗口原本不可见，本轮不能证明隐藏行为。");
                    if (!ldWindowVisibility.IsHidden(1)) throw new InvalidOperationException("目标窗口未隐藏。");
                    var png = await ViewModel.Runtime.Backend.ScreenshotAsync(approvedCandidate);
                    var size = PngImage.ReadDimensions(png);
                    var colors = Enumerable.Range(0, 16).Select(i => PngImage.ColorAt(png, i * (size.Width - 1) / 15, i * (size.Height - 1) / 15)).Distinct().Count();
                    if (colors < 2) throw new InvalidOperationException("隐藏后的截图未检出有效画面差异。");
                    await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(Path.Combine(output, "hidden-device.png"), png);
                }
                finally { await ldWindowVisibility.ShowAsync(1); }
                hiddenAndRestored = !ldWindowVisibility.IsHidden(1);
            }
            UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory(); NavigateTo("设备墙 / 主控"); SetWallViewMode("list");
            await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(UpdateLayout, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
            SaveRender(Path.Combine(output, "connected.png"));
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(output, "result.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
            {
                passed = true, existingIndex = 2, admittedIndex = 1, cancellationPreservedRuntime = true,
                originalAuthorizationPreserved = true, localInstances = service.Instances.Count,
                connectedDevices = ViewModel.Devices.Count(row => row.Info.Online),
                runtimeReplaced = true, screenshotsAvailable = true,
                emulatorLaunchNotRequested = true, scopeLimitedToApprovedIndices = true,
                startupConfirmationDialogs = confirmations, backgroundWindowVerified = hiddenAndRestored
            }, JsonDefaults.Options));
        }
    }
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Desktop/Views/UnifiedDevicesView.cs

```csharp
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Media;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public partial class MainWindow
{
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource directoryCancellation = new();
    private Task? directoryOperation;
    private CancellationTokenSource? ldOperationCancellation;
    private readonly List<TextBlock> deviceSummaries = [];
    private readonly ObservableCollection<UnifiedDeviceRow> unifiedDevices = [];
    private ICollectionView unifiedDeviceView = null!;
    private static readonly string[] DeviceStatusOptions = ["全部状态", "已连接", "已关闭", "启动中", "待连接", "离线", "未授权", "已发现", "异常", "未知", "受保护"];
    private string deviceStatusFilter = "全部状态";
    private ComboBox deviceStatusChoice = null!;
    private bool refreshingUnifiedFilter;
    private readonly Dictionary<int, string> launchPhases = [];
    private readonly List<TextBlock> launchFeedback = [];
    private readonly List<AsyncCommand> launchCommands = [];
    private readonly List<ActionCommand> launchCancelCommands = [];
    private Button? launchCancelButton;
    private bool updatingUnifiedDirectory;
    private readonly HashSet<int> coldLaunched = [];
    private LdWindowVisibility? ldWindowVisibility;
    private DateTimeOffset lastGuestDiscovery;

    private FrameworkElement BuildDeviceSummary()
    {
        var summary = new TextBlock { Foreground = WallMuted, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10), TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
        deviceSummaries.Add(summary);
        return summary;
    }

    private void InitializeUnifiedDevices()
    {
        unifiedDeviceView = new ListCollectionView(unifiedDevices);
        unifiedDeviceView.Filter = item => item is UnifiedDeviceRow row
            && (deviceStatusFilter == "全部状态" || row.FilterState == deviceStatusFilter);
        ViewModel.PropertyChanged += (_, args) => { if (args.PropertyName is nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.Counts)) UpdateUnifiedDirectory(); RefreshLaunchCommands(); };
    }

    private ComboBox BuildDeviceStatusFilter()
    {
        var choice = new ComboBox { Name = "DeviceStatusFilter", ItemsSource = DeviceStatusOptions, SelectedItem = deviceStatusFilter, Width = 145, MinHeight = 34, Margin = new Thickness(12, 0, 0, 10) };
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(choice, "设备状态筛选"); System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(choice, choice.Name);
        deviceStatusChoice = choice;
        choice.SelectionChanged += (_, _) => { deviceStatusFilter = (string)choice.SelectedItem; RefreshUnifiedFilter(); };
        return choice;
    }

    private void RefreshUnifiedFilter()
    {
        refreshingUnifiedFilter = true;
        try { unifiedDeviceView.Refresh(); }
        finally { refreshingUnifiedFilter = false; }
        SynchronizeUnifiedSelection();
    }

    internal void UpdateUnifiedDirectory()
    {
        if (updatingUnifiedDirectory || unifiedDeviceView is null) return;
        updatingUnifiedDirectory = true;
        try
        {
        var instances = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer?.Instances ?? [];
        var admitted = instances.Count(instance => ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.ContainsKey(instance.Index));
        var expected = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var boundSerials = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var instance in instances)
        {
            ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.TryGetValue(instance.Index, out var serial);
            var device = ViewModel.Devices.FirstOrDefault(row => row.Serial == serial);
            if (device is not null) boundSerials.Add(device.Serial);
            Upsert("ld:" + instance.Index, instance, device, LdInstanceConnected(instance.Index));
        }
        foreach (var device in ViewModel.Devices.Where(row => !boundSerials.Contains(row.Serial))) Upsert("device:" + device.Serial, null, device, device.Info.Online);
        foreach (var stale in unifiedDevices.Where(row => !expected.Contains(row.Key)).ToArray()) unifiedDevices.Remove(stale);
        foreach (var summary in deviceSummaries) summary.Text = $"本机 {instances.Count} 台 · 已接入 {admitted} 台 · 已连接 {unifiedDevices.Count(row => row.Connected)} 台";
        RefreshUnifiedFilter();
        void Upsert(string key, LdPlayerInstance? instance, DeviceRow? device, bool connected)
        {
            expected.Add(key);
            var row = unifiedDevices.FirstOrDefault(item => item.Key == key);
            if (row is null)
            {
                row = new UnifiedDeviceRow(key, ActivateUnifiedRowAsync, CanActivateUnifiedRow, ShowUnifiedWindowAsync, item => !ldBusy && !ViewModel.Busy && item.Index is { } index && ldWindowVisibility?.IsHidden(index) == true, item => item.Device is null ? Task.CompletedTask : OpenMainControlAsync(item.Device));
                row.PropertyChanged += (_, args) => { if (args.PropertyName == nameof(UnifiedDeviceRow.IsSelected)) SynchronizeUnifiedSelection(); };
                unifiedDevices.Add(row);
            }
            row.Update(instance, device, connected, instance is not null && launchPhases.TryGetValue(instance.Index, out var phase) ? phase : "",
                instance is null ? null : ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.GetValueOrDefault(instance.Index));
        }
        }
        finally { updatingUnifiedDirectory = false; }
    }

    private bool CanStartInstances() => !ldBusy && !captureInProgress && !ViewModel.HasActiveOperations && ViewModel.ConnectionReloadAvailable && scanOperation is not { IsCompleted: false };
    private bool CanActivateUnifiedRow(UnifiedDeviceRow row) => row.Connected ? !ViewModel.Busy : row.Index is > 0 and < 99999 && !ViewModel.Demo && CanStartInstances();
    private async Task ActivateUnifiedRowAsync(UnifiedDeviceRow row)
    {
        try
        {
            if (row.Connected && row.Device is not null) { ViewModel.CurrentDevice = row.Device; NavigateTo("节点"); }
            else if (row.Index is { } index) await ConnectLdInstancesAsync([index]);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { SetLaunchFeedback("操作失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex)); }
    }
    private async Task ShowUnifiedWindowAsync(UnifiedDeviceRow row)
    {
        try { if (row.Index is { } index && ldWindowVisibility is not null) await ldWindowVisibility.ShowAsync(index); UpdateUnifiedDirectory(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { SetLaunchFeedback("显示窗口失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex)); }
    }
    private void SetLaunchFeedback(string text) { if (ldFeedback is not null) ldFeedback.Text = text; foreach (var feedback in launchFeedback) feedback.Text = text; }
    private void SynchronizeUnifiedSelection()
    {
        var selected = unifiedDevices.Where(row => row.IsSelected).Take(2).ToArray();
        SelectUnifiedInstance(selected.Length == 1 ? selected[0] : null);
        ViewModel.SetPendingLaunchSelection(unifiedDevices.Count(row => row.IsSelected && !row.Connected));
        workspaceCounts.Text = $"目录 {unifiedDevices.Count} · 已连接 {unifiedDevices.Count(row => row.Connected)} · 筛选 {unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().Count()} · 已选 {unifiedDevices.Count(row => row.IsSelected)}";
        UpdateWallSelectionToggle();
        RefreshLaunchCommands();
    }
    private void RefreshLaunchCommands()
    {
        foreach (var command in launchCommands) command.Refresh();
        foreach (var command in launchCancelCommands) command.Refresh();
        foreach (var row in unifiedDevices) row.RefreshCommands();
        if (launchCancelButton is not null) launchCancelButton.Visibility = ldOperationCancellation is not null ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    }

    private FrameworkElement BuildOneClickLaunchTools()
    {
        var section = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 8) };
        var feedback = new TextBlock { Foreground = WallMuted, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, MinHeight = 19, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4) }; ldFeedback = feedback; launchFeedback.Add(feedback);
        var tools = Toolbar();
        tools.Children.Add(LaunchButton("\uE768", "启动所选", () => ConnectLdInstancesAsync(unifiedDevices.Where(row => row.IsSelected && !row.Connected && row.Index is > 0 and < 99999).Select(row => row.Index!.Value).ToArray()), () => !ViewModel.Demo && CanStartInstances() && unifiedDevices.Any(row => row.IsSelected && !row.Connected && row.Index is > 0 and < 99999), true));
        tools.Children.Add(LaunchButton("\uE768", "一键启动全部", StartAllLdInstancesAsync, () => !ViewModel.Demo && CanStartInstances() && unifiedDevices.Any(row => !row.Connected && row.Index is > 0 and < 99999)));
        tools.Children.Add(BuildInstanceActions());
        var stop = new ActionCommand(() => ldOperationCancellation?.Cancel(), () => ldOperationCancellation is not null);
        launchCancelCommands.Add(stop);
        var stopButton = WallButton("\uE71A", "取消启动", stop); stopButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; stopButton.Content = WallGlyph("\uE71A"); stopButton.Width = 34; stopButton.MinWidth = 0; stopButton.Padding = new Thickness(0); launchCancelButton = stopButton; tools.Children.Add(stopButton);
        ViewModel.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => stop.Refresh();
        section.Children.Add(tools);
        section.Children.Add(feedback);
        return section;
    }
    private Button LaunchButton(string glyph, string label, Func<Task> operation, Func<bool> enabled, bool primary = false)
    {
        var command = new AsyncCommand(async () => { try { await operation(); } catch (Exception ex) { SetLaunchFeedback(label + "失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex)); } }, enabled);
        launchCommands.Add(command); var button = WallButton(glyph, label, command, primary);
        button.ToolTip = label switch
        {
            "启动所选" => "启动所选：操作列表中已勾选且尚未连接的可接入实例，包括被当前筛选隐藏的已勾选实例；已运行的实例仅连接，不重复启动；不包含受保护实例。完成核验后自动连接并加入群控。",
            "一键启动全部" => "一键启动全部：操作全部尚未连接的可接入实例，包括被当前筛选隐藏的实例；已运行的实例仅连接，不重复启动；不包含受保护实例。完成核验后自动连接并加入群控。",
            _ => label
        };
        ToolTipService.SetShowOnDisabled(button, true);
        return button;
    }

    private bool LdInstanceConnected(int index) => ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.TryGetValue(index, out var serial)
        && ViewModel.Runtime.Api.LdSerialForWriteGuard?.Invoke(index) == serial
        && ViewModel.Devices.Any(row => row.Serial == serial && row.Info.Online);

    private string InstanceConnectionState(LdPlayerInstance instance) => instance.Index == 0 && !ViewModel.Demo ? "受保护" : LdInstanceConnected(instance.Index) ? "已连接"
        : instance.IsStarting || (!instance.AndroidStarted && (instance.ProcessId > 0 || instance.VBoxProcessId > 0)) ? "启动中"
        : !instance.AndroidStarted ? "已关闭" : ViewModel.Runtime.Settings.LdSerialBindings.ContainsKey(instance.Index) ? "需重新接入" : "待接入";

    private Task UpdateDeviceDirectoryAsync()
    {
        if (ViewModel.Demo || closing || directoryCancellation.IsCancellationRequested || ldBusy || captureInProgress || ViewModel.HasActiveOperations || directoryOperation is { IsCompleted: false }) return Task.CompletedTask;
        directoryOperation = RefreshDirectoryCoreAsync();
        return directoryOperation;
    }

    private async Task RefreshDirectoryCoreAsync()
    {
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(directoryCancellation.Token);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20));
        try
        {
            if (ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer is not null) await ViewModel.Runtime.RefreshLdPlayerAsync(deadline.Token);
            UpdateLdPlayerRows();
            if (DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - lastGuestDiscovery >= TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15))
            {
                lastGuestDiscovery = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                await ViewModel.RefreshDeviceSnapshotAsync(deadline.Token);
            }
            if (ldFeedback.Text.StartsWith("自动更新失败：", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ldFeedback.Text = "";
            UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (directoryCancellation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("directory-refresh-error", ex.ToString());
            SetLaunchFeedback("自动更新失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex));
        }
    }

    private async Task RunLdWorkspaceOperationAsync(string title, Func<CancellationToken, Task> operation)
    {
        if (ldBusy || captureInProgress || ViewModel.HasActiveOperations || scanOperation is { IsCompleted: false }) throw new DeviceException("请等待当前操作或网络扫描结束。", 409, 1003);
        if (!ViewModel.ConnectionReloadAvailable) throw new DeviceException("请先停止接口服务、脚本和文件传输。", 409, 1003);
        if (ViewModel.Demo) throw new DeviceException("演示模式不会操作真实模拟器。", 409, 1003);
        ViewModel.Runtime.RequireFrozenConnectionSettings();
        using var write = ViewModel.Runtime.Writes.AcquireAll();
        ldBusy = true; ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(true); RefreshLdButtons();
        await StopMonitorAsync();
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource(); ldOperationCancellation = cancellation;
        coldLaunched.Clear(); RefreshLaunchCommands();
        var complete = false;
        try
        {
            if (directoryOperation is not null) await directoryOperation;
            SetLaunchFeedback(title);
            await operation(cancellation.Token);
            complete = true;
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-workspace-complete", title);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { SetLaunchFeedback("已停止等待及后续任务，已启动的实例保持运行。"); ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-workspace-cancel", title); }
        catch (Exception ex) { SetLaunchFeedback(title + "失败：" + ViewModel.PresentError(ex)); ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-workspace-error", ex.ToString()); }
        finally
        {
            if (!complete)
            {
                foreach (var index in launchPhases.Keys.ToArray())
                    if (launchPhases[index] is not ("已连接" or "启动失败")) launchPhases[index] = cancellation.IsCancellationRequested ? "已取消" : "未完成";
            }
            ldOperationCancellation = null; ldBusy = false; ViewModel.SetExternalBusy(false);
            UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory(); RefreshLdButtons();
            MonitorNavigationChanged();
        }
    }

    private sealed class InlineLaunchProgress(MainWindow owner) : IProgress<LdLaunchProgress>
    {
        public void Report(LdLaunchProgress value) => owner.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => owner.OnLaunchProgress(value));
    }
    private IProgress<LdLaunchProgress> LaunchProgress() => new InlineLaunchProgress(this);
    private void OnLaunchProgress(LdLaunchProgress progress)
    {
        var phase = progress.State switch { "checking-resources" => "检查资源", "starting" => "正在启动", "waiting" => "等待安卓就绪", "ready" or "skipped" => "等待连接", "cancelled" => "已取消", _ => "启动失败" };
        launchPhases[progress.Index] = phase;
        if (progress.State == "starting") coldLaunched.Add(progress.Index);
        SetLaunchFeedback($"实例 {progress.Index}：{phase}");
        ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-launch-" + progress.State, $"index={progress.Index}; {progress.Message}");
        UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
    }

    internal async Task RecoverBackgroundWindowsAsync()
    {
        if (ViewModel.Demo || ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer is null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ViewModel.Runtime.FrozenConnectionSettings.LdConsolePath)) return;
        ldWindowVisibility ??= new LdWindowVisibility(System.IO.Path.Combine(ViewModel.DataDirectory, "window-recovery"), System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(ViewModel.Runtime.FrozenConnectionSettings.LdConsolePath)!);
        var errors = await ldWindowVisibility.RecoverPendingAsync();
        if (errors.Count > 0) { SetLaunchFeedback("部分后台窗口恢复失败，请检查日志。"); foreach (var error in errors) ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-window-recovery-error", error); }
    }

    private async Task StartAllLdInstancesAsync()
    {
        var confirmedInstances = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer?.Instances.Where(item => item.Index > 0 && item.Index != 99999 && !LdInstanceConnected(item.Index)).ToArray() ?? [];
        var indices = confirmedInstances.Select(item => item.Index).ToArray();
        if (indices.Length == 0) throw new DeviceException("没有可启动的独立实例。", 404, 1002);
        await ConnectLdInstancesAsync(indices);
    }

    private async Task ConnectLdInstancesAsync(int[] indices, IReadOnlyDictionary<int, string>? expectedSerials = null)
    {
        if (indices.Length == 0) throw new DeviceException("没有待接入的已运行实例。", 404, 1002);
        if (indices.Any(index => index <= 0 || index == 99999)) throw new DeviceException("实例0受保护，不能自动接入。", 403, 1003);
        var approvedSerials = expectedSerials is null ? null : new Dictionary<int, string>(expectedSerials);
        if (approvedSerials is not null && (approvedSerials.Count != indices.Length || indices.Any(index => !approvedSerials.TryGetValue(index, out var serial) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serial))))
            throw new DeviceException("验收预批准串号必须与目标实例逐一对应。", 400, 1007);
        var service = ViewModel.Runtime.LdPlayer ?? throw new DeviceException("雷电服务未配置。", 503, 2001);
        var confirmedInstances = indices.Select(index => service.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == index)).ToArray();
        var expectedBirths = confirmedInstances.Where(item => item.VBoxProcessId > 0).ToDictionary(item => item.Index, VBoxBirth);
        await RunLdWorkspaceOperationAsync("接入雷电设备", async ct =>
        {
            foreach (var index in indices) launchPhases[index] = "排队中";
            var started = await new LdLaunchCoordinator(service).StartAsync(indices, EnsureLaunchResourcesAsync, LaunchProgress(), ct, expectedInstances: confirmedInstances);
            var expected = started.Select(result => result.Instance ?? throw new DeviceException("启动结果缺少实例快照。", 409, 1003)).ToArray();
            foreach (var instance in expected)
                if (!expectedBirths.ContainsKey(instance.Index)) expectedBirths.Add(instance.Index, VBoxBirth(instance));
            using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct); deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(90));
            IReadOnlyList<LdConnectionProof> proofs;
            while (true)
            {
                try { proofs = await LdConnectionAdmission.ResolveAsync((AdbDeviceBackend)ViewModel.Runtime.Backend, service, indices, expected, expectedBirths, deadline.Token); break; }
                catch (DeviceException ex) when (ex.Status == 409 && ex.Code == 2002)
                { SetLaunchFeedback("等待雷电注册ADB连接…"); await Task.Delay(1500, deadline.Token); }
            }
            if (approvedSerials is not null && proofs.Any(proof => !approvedSerials.TryGetValue(proof.Index, out var serial) || serial != proof.Serial))
                throw new DeviceException("实际连接与验收预批准串号不符，未读取设备或保存授权。", 403, 1003);
            SetLaunchFeedback("正在核验安卓启动与截图…");
            await ViewModel.ApplyLdConnectionsAsync(proofs, deadline.Token);
            foreach (var index in indices) launchPhases[index] = "已连接";
            UpdateLdPlayerRows(); UpdateUnifiedDirectory();
            SetLaunchFeedback($"已启动并连接 {proofs.Count} 台设备。");
        });
    }

    private static long VBoxBirth(LdPlayerInstance instance)
    {
        using var process = System.Diagnostics.Process.GetProcessById(instance.VBoxProcessId);
        var birth = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks;
        if (process.HasExited) throw new DeviceException($"实例{instance.Index}的虚拟机进程已退出。", 409, 1003);
        return birth;
    }

    private async Task EnsureLaunchResourcesAsync(LdPlayerInstance instance, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(ViewModel.Runtime.FrozenConnectionSettings.LdConsolePath, instance.Index);
        var memory = new MemoryStatus { Length = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<MemoryStatus>() };
        var host = GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ref memory)
            ? new LdHostMemory(memory.AvailablePhysical, memory.AvailablePageFile, memory.MemoryLoad) : null;
        var assessment = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(configuration, host);
        var proceed = await ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(instance.Index, instance.Name, assessment, ct);
        if (!proceed) ldOperationCancellation?.Cancel();
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        if (!proceed) throw new OperationCanceledException("用户取消了资源风险启动。", ct);
    }

    private async Task<bool> ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(int index, string name, LdLaunchMemoryAssessment assessment, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        return await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            SetLaunchFeedback($"实例 {index}：{assessment.Message}");
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-launch-memory-assessment", $"index={index}; confirmation={assessment.RequiresConfirmation}; {assessment.Message}");
            if (!assessment.RequiresConfirmation) return true;
            var accepted = ViewModel.Confirm("启动资源风险", $"实例 {index}：{name}\n\n{assessment.Message}\n\n以上为检查时快照，配置和资源可能继续变化。这不是雷电官方的启动限制。继续可能导致卡顿或启动失败。\n确定：仍然启动本实例；取消：停止本批次后续启动，不关闭已运行实例。");
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write(accepted ? "ld-launch-memory-accepted" : "ld-launch-memory-declined", $"index={index}");
            return accepted;
        });
    }

    private async Task VerifyLaunchMemoryUiAsync()
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Demo) throw new InvalidOperationException("内存提示离线验收仅限演示模式。");
        var originalConfirm = ViewModel.Confirm;
        var confirmations = 0; var accept = true;
        CancellationTokenSource? cancelDuringConfirmation = null;
        ViewModel.Confirm = (title, message) =>
        {
            if (!Dispatcher.CheckAccess() || title != "启动资源风险" || !message.Contains("实例 2：离线内存测试", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !message.Contains("不是雷电官方", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("资源风险提示线程或目标范围错误。");
            confirmations++; cancelDuringConfirmation?.Cancel(); return accept;
        };
        try
        {
            var good = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(6144), new((ulong)(7.8 * 1073741824), 16UL * 1073741824, 75));
            if (!await Task.Run(() => ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(2, "离线内存测试", good, CancellationToken.None)) || confirmations != 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("7.8 GiB/75%的6 GiB实例被拦截或出现普通启动确认。");
            foreach (var nonblocking in new[]
            {
                LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(null, "实例 RAM 未知"), new(11UL * 1073741824, 20UL * 1073741824, 65)),
                LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(6144), null),
                LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(6144), new(6UL * 1073741824, 6UL * 1073741824, 99))
            })
                if (!await Task.Run(() => ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(2, "离线内存测试", nonblocking, CancellationToken.None)) || confirmations != 0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("未知、采样失败或仅估算余量不足仍触发资源确认。");
            var risk = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(8192), new((ulong)(7.8 * 1073741824), 16UL * 1073741824, 75));
            if (!await Task.Run(() => ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(2, "离线内存测试", risk, CancellationToken.None)) || confirmations != 1)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("用户无法确认继续风险启动。");
            accept = false;
            if (await Task.Run(() => ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(2, "离线内存测试", risk, CancellationToken.None)) || confirmations != 2)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("用户取消资源风险提示仍被接受。");
            using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource(); cancellation.Cancel();
            try
            {
                await ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(2, "离线内存测试", risk, cancellation.Token);
                throw new InvalidOperationException("已取消的资源检查仍可继续。");
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
            if (confirmations != 2) throw new InvalidOperationException("已取消的资源检查仍弹出提示。");
            using var duringConfirmation = new CancellationTokenSource();
            accept = true; cancelDuringConfirmation = duringConfirmation;
            try
            {
                await Task.Run(() => ConfirmLaunchMemoryAsync(2, "离线内存测试", risk, duringConfirmation.Token));
                throw new InvalidOperationException("提示期间取消后仍然接受启动。");
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (duringConfirmation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
            if (confirmations != 3) throw new InvalidOperationException("提示期间取消验收未覆盖确认回调。");
        }
        finally { ViewModel.Confirm = originalConfirm; }
    }

    private async Task EditLdInstanceAsync(bool create)
    {
        var selected = ldSelection;
        if (!create && selected is null) throw new DeviceException("请选择已停止的实例。", 400, 1007);
        var name = new TextBox { Text = create ? "矩阵测试-" + DateTime.Now.ToString("MMdd-HHmmss") : selected!.Name, IsReadOnly = !create };
        var cpu = new ComboBox { ItemsSource = new[] { 1, 2, 3, 4 }, SelectedItem = create ? 2 : (object?)null };
        var memory = new ComboBox { ItemsSource = new[] { 256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 4096, 8192 }, SelectedItem = create ? 2048 : (object?)null };
        var width = new TextBox { Text = (selected?.Instance.Width ?? 1280).ToString() };
        var height = new TextBox { Text = (selected?.Instance.Height ?? 720).ToString() };
        var dpi = new TextBox { Text = (selected?.Instance.Dpi ?? 240).ToString() };
        var content = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(20) };
        foreach (var field in new[] { Field("名称", name, 90), Field("新CPU核数", cpu, 90), Field("新内存 MiB", memory, 90), Field("宽度", width, 90), Field("高度", height, 90), Field("DPI", dpi, 90) }) content.Children.Add(field);
        var error = new TextBlock { TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Foreground = Brushes.Firebrick, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 8) }; content.Children.Add(error);
        var dialog = new Window { Owner = this, Title = create ? "新建空白模拟器" : "冷态资源配置", Width = 420, ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize, WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner };
        var layout = new DockPanel(); var buttons = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right, Margin = new Thickness(20, 8, 20, 16) };
        DockPanel.SetDock(buttons, Dock.Bottom); layout.Children.Add(buttons); layout.Children.Add(new ScrollViewer { Content = content, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled }); dialog.Content = layout;
        LdInstanceConfiguration? configuration = null;
        var submit = new Button { Content = create ? "创建并配置" : "保存配置", IsDefault = true, Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0) };
        submit.Click += (_, _) =>
        {
            try
            {
                if (!int.TryParse(width.Text, out var w) || !int.TryParse(height.Text, out var h) || !int.TryParse(dpi.Text, out var d)) throw new DeviceException("宽度、高度和DPI必须是整数。");
                if (cpu.SelectedItem is null || memory.SelectedItem is null) throw new DeviceException("请选择新的CPU核数和内存值。");
                configuration = new((int)cpu.SelectedItem, (int)memory.SelectedItem, w, h, d); LdInstanceEditor.Validate(configuration);
                dialog.DialogResult = true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { error.Text = ViewModel.PresentError(ex); }
        };
        var cancel = new Button { Content = "取消", IsCancel = true, MinWidth = 78, Name = "CancelInstanceEdit" }; buttons.Children.Add(cancel); buttons.Children.Add(submit);
        if (ShowOwnedDialog(dialog, 420, 560) != true || configuration is null) return;
        if (!ViewModel.Confirm(create ? "新建空白雷电实例" : "修改雷电实例资源", create ? $"创建空白实例“{name.Text.Trim()}”，配置 {configuration.Cpu}核 / {configuration.MemoryMb} MiB / {configuration.Width}×{configuration.Height}。\n不会复制账号或数据，不自动启动。继续？" : $"仅修改实例 {selected!.Index}：{selected.Name} 的CPU、内存和分辨率；不会修改设备身份。配置后需启动验证。继续？")) return;
        await RunLdWorkspaceOperationAsync(create ? "新建空白实例" : "配置实例", async ct =>
        {
            var editor = ViewModel.Runtime.LdEditor ?? throw new DeviceException("雷电编辑能力未配置，请重启程序。", 503, 2001);
            var target = selected?.Instance;
            if (create)
            {
                var result = await editor.CreateAsync(name.Text.Trim(), ct); target = result.Instance;
                ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-create", result.Message);
            }
            LdPlayerCommandResult configured;
            try { configured = await editor.ConfigureAsync(target!.Index, target.Generation, configuration, ct); }
            catch (Exception ex) when (create && ex is not OperationCanceledException)
            { throw new DeviceException($"已创建实例 {target!.Index}：{target.Name}，但配置失败：{ex.Message}。未删除或重复创建，请检查目录。", 409, 1003); }
            ViewModel.Runtime.Log.Write("ld-configure", configured.Message);
            ldFeedback.Text = $"实例 {target.Index} 已提交资源配置，启动后核验生效情况。";
        });
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct MemoryStatus { public uint Length, MemoryLoad; public ulong TotalPhysical, AvailablePhysical, TotalPageFile, AvailablePageFile, TotalVirtual, AvailableVirtual, AvailableExtendedVirtual; }
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ref MemoryStatus status);
}
```

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;

using System.Windows.Media;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed class UnifiedDeviceTile : Border
{
    public static readonly DependencyProperty OwnerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Owner), typeof(MainWindow), typeof(UnifiedDeviceTile), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnChanged));
    public static readonly DependencyProperty CompactProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(nameof(Compact), typeof(bool), typeof(UnifiedDeviceTile), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnCompactChanged));
    public MainWindow? Owner { get => (MainWindow?)GetValue(OwnerProperty); set => SetValue(OwnerProperty, value); }
    public bool Compact { get => (bool)GetValue(CompactProperty); set => SetValue(CompactProperty, value); }
    private UnifiedDeviceRow? row;
    private TextBlock? primaryLabel, controlLabel, primaryGlyph;
    public UnifiedDeviceTile()
    {
        DataContextChanged += (_, _) => { if (row is not null) row.PropertyChanged -= RowChanged; row = DataContext as UnifiedDeviceRow; if (IsLoaded && row is not null) row.PropertyChanged += RowChanged; Rebuild(); };
        Loaded += (_, _) => { if (row is not null) { row.PropertyChanged -= RowChanged; row.PropertyChanged += RowChanged; } Rebuild(); };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { if (row is not null) row.PropertyChanged -= RowChanged; };
    }
    private static void OnChanged(DependencyObject value, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs _) => ((UnifiedDeviceTile)value).Rebuild();
    private static void OnCompactChanged(DependencyObject value, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs _) => ((UnifiedDeviceTile)value).ApplyCompactLayout();
    private void RowChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs args) { if (args.PropertyName is "" or nameof(UnifiedDeviceRow.Device)) Rebuild(); }
    private void Rebuild()
    {
        if (row is null || Owner is null) { Child = null; return; }
        BorderThickness = new Thickness(0); Padding = new Thickness(0); Margin = new Thickness(0);
        Child = Actions(); ApplyCompactLayout();
    }
    private FrameworkElement Actions()
    {
        var actions = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        var label = new TextBlock { VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center }; label.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new Binding(nameof(UnifiedDeviceRow.PrimaryLabel)));
        primaryLabel = label; controlLabel = null;
        var glyph = new TextBlock { FontFamily = new FontFamily("Segoe MDL2 Assets"), Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 5, 0), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center }; glyph.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, new Binding(nameof(UnifiedDeviceRow.PrimaryGlyph)));
        primaryGlyph = glyph;
        var body = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal }; body.Children.Add(glyph); body.Children.Add(label);
        var start = new Button { Name = "DevicePrimaryAction", Content = body, Command = row!.PrimaryCommand, Height = 44, MinWidth = 44, Padding = new Thickness(10, 0, 10, 0), Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 4, 0) };
        start.SetBinding(System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.NameProperty, new Binding(nameof(UnifiedDeviceRow.PrimaryLabel)));
        start.SetBinding(ToolTipProperty, new Binding(nameof(UnifiedDeviceRow.PrimaryDescription))); ToolTipService.SetShowOnDisabled(start, true);
        start.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "SubtleButton"); actions.Children.Add(start);
        if (row.Connected && row.Device is not null)
        {
            var control = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal }; control.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "\uE7F4", FontFamily = new FontFamily("Segoe MDL2 Assets"), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
            controlLabel = new TextBlock { Text = "控制", VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, Margin = new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0) }; control.Children.Add(controlLabel);
            var main = new Button { Name = "DeviceMainAction", Content = control, Command = row.MainCommand, ToolTip = "打开此设备的主控面板", Height = 44, MinWidth = 44, Padding = new Thickness(6, 0, 6, 0), Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 4, 0) };
            System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(main, "控制此设备");
            main.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "SubtleButton"); actions.Children.Add(main);
        }
        var show = new Button { Name = "DeviceShowWindow", Width = 44, Height = 44, Padding = new Thickness(0), Content = new TextBlock { Text = "\uE8A7", FontFamily = new FontFamily("Segoe MDL2 Assets") }, Command = row.ShowWindowCommand, ToolTip = "显示模拟器窗口", Visibility = row.ShowWindowCommand.CanExecute(null) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed };
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(show, "显示模拟器窗口");
        show.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "IconButton"); actions.Children.Add(show);
        return actions;
    }
    private void ApplyCompactLayout()
    {
        if (Child is not Panel panel) return;
        if (primaryLabel is not null) primaryLabel.Visibility = Compact ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        if (controlLabel is not null) controlLabel.Visibility = Compact ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        if (primaryGlyph is not null) primaryGlyph.Margin = Compact ? new Thickness(0) : new Thickness(0, 0, 5, 0);
        foreach (var button in panel.Children.OfType<Button>().Where(button => button.Name != "DeviceShowWindow"))
        { button.Width = Compact ? 44 : double.NaN; button.Padding = Compact ? new Thickness(0) : new Thickness(button.Name == "DeviceMainAction" ? 6 : 10, 0, button.Name == "DeviceMainAction" ? 6 : 10, 0); }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    internal void ClearWallSelection()
    {

    internal async Task OpenMainControlAsync(DeviceRow row)
    {
        if (!ViewModel.Devices.Contains(row) || !row.Info.Online || ViewModel.Busy) throw new DeviceException("控制目标不可用，请选择已连接设备。", 409, 1003);
        await ViewModel.SetMainAsync(row);
        if (!ReferenceEquals(ViewModel.MainDevice, row)) return;
        mainControlOpen = true; ApplyDeviceWorkspaceLayout();
        UpdateWallSelectionToggle();
        await CaptureTickAsync();
    }

    internal void CloseMainControl()
    {

        if (mainControlOpen && wallList.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) CancelPendingListRestore();

    private void ApplyDeviceWorkspaceLayout()
    {

            hiddenListOffset ??= (beforeHide.HorizontalOffset, beforeHide.VerticalOffset);

        var restoreList = !hideList && wallList.Visibility != Visibility.Visible;
        wallMainPanel.Visibility = mainControlOpen ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        wallList.Visibility = hideList ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        Grid.SetColumn(wallMainPanel, narrow ? 0 : 1); Grid.SetColumnSpan(wallMainPanel, narrow ? 2 : 1);
        wallWorkspace.ColumnDefinitions[1].Width = new GridLength(mainControlOpen && !narrow ? 300 : 0);
        wallMainPanel.Margin = narrow ? new Thickness(0) : new Thickness(18, 0, 0, 0);
        var available = (wallWorkspace.Parent as FrameworkElement)?.ActualWidth ?? wallWorkspace.ActualWidth;
        var margin = available < 644 ? 12 : 22;
        wallWorkspace.Margin = new Thickness(margin, 18, margin, 18); wallHeading.Margin = new Thickness(margin, 18, margin, 0);
        ApplyDeviceListLayout();
        if (restoreList && hiddenListOffset is { } saved)
        {
            var ticket = ++listRestoreTicket;
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, (Action)(() =>
            {
                if (ticket != listRestoreTicket || wallList.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || DeviceListScrollViewer() is not { } scroll) return;
                UpdateLayout();
                if (ticket != listRestoreTicket || wallList.Visibility != Visibility.Visible) return;
                // Keep the return position through temporary wide-layout clamping.
                if (!mainControlOpen) hiddenListOffset = null;
                scroll.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(Math.Min(saved.Horizontal, scroll.ScrollableWidth)); scroll.ScrollToVerticalOffset(Math.Min(saved.Vertical, scroll.ScrollableHeight));
            }));
        }
    }

    private void CancelPendingListRestore()
    {
        if (wallList.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || hiddenListOffset is null) return;
        hiddenListOffset = null; listRestoreTicket++;
    }

    private ScrollViewer? DeviceListScrollViewer() => wallGrid is null ? null : VisualDescendants<ScrollViewer>(wallGrid).FirstOrDefault(scroll => scroll.Name == "DG_ScrollViewer");

    private void ApplyDeviceListLayout()
    {
        if (wallGrid is null || wallGrid.ActualWidth <= 0 || wallGrid.Visibility != Visibility.Visible) return;
        var compact = wallGrid.ActualWidth < 600;
        if (compactDeviceList == compact) return;
        compactDeviceList = compact; wallGrid.Tag = compact; wallGrid.FrozenColumnCount = 0;
        wallActionColumn.DisplayIndex = compact ? 1 : 4; wallNameColumn.DisplayIndex = 2; wallNumberColumn.DisplayIndex = compact ? 3 : 1;
        wallSelectionColumn.Width = compact ? 48 : 54; wallActionColumn.Width = compact ? 148 : 214;
        wallNameColumn.Width = compact ? Math.Max(120, Math.Min(175, wallGrid.ActualWidth - 213)) : 175;
        wallGrid.FrozenColumnCount = compact ? 2 : 0;
    }

    private void UpdateWallSelectionToggle()
    {
        if (wallSelectAll is not null)
        {
            var visible = unifiedDeviceView.Cast<UnifiedDeviceRow>().Where(row => row.CanSelect).ToArray();

        }
```

```csharp
        List<WorkspacePeerNode> ReadTree(AutomationPeer root)
        {
            var found = new List<WorkspacePeerNode>(); var seen = new HashSet<AutomationPeer>(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance); var pending = new Queue<(AutomationPeer Peer, int Parent, int Depth)>(); pending.Enqueue((root, 0, 0));

                var children = peer.GetChildren(); DiagnosticChildren(peer, owner, children);
                foreach (var child in children ?? []) pending.Enqueue((child, Id(peer), depth + 1));
            }
            return found;
        }
        object Node(WorkspacePeerNode node) => new { peerId = Id(node.Peer), ownerId = Id(node.Owner), node.Parent, node.Depth, peerType = node.Peer.GetType().FullName, ownerType = node.Owner?.GetType().FullName, ownerName = (node.Owner as FrameworkElement)?.Name, node.AutomationId, node.Name, node.Role, node.Enabled, node.Offscreen };
    }
    private sealed record WorkspacePeerNode(AutomationPeer Peer, UIElement? Owner, int Parent, int Depth, string AutomationId, string Name, string Role, bool Enabled, bool Offscreen);
    private sealed class WorkspaceAccessibilityPrecondition(string message) : InvalidOperationException(message) { }
}
```

```csharp
        workspaceCounts.TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis; workspaceCounts.SetBinding(ToolTipProperty, new Binding(nameof(TextBlock.Text)) { Source = workspaceCounts });

    }

    private Border BuildNavigation()
    {
        var sidebar = new Border { Background = ThemeBrush("SurfaceBrush"), BorderBrush = ThemeBrush("BorderBrush"), BorderThickness = new Thickness(0, 0, 1, 0) };
        var dock = new DockPanel(); sidebar.Child = dock;
        var brand = new Grid { Margin = new Thickness(18, 24, 12, 22) };
        brand.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(40) }); brand.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition());
        var mark = new Border { Width = 36, Height = 36, CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(8), Background = ThemeBrush("AccentBrush") };
        var icon = ShellGlyph("\uE80A", 20); icon.Foreground = Brushes.White; mark.Child = icon; brand.Children.Add(mark);
        var identity = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(9, 0, 0, 0), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        identity.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "矩阵设备", FontSize = 19, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold });
        identity.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "Android 设备工作台", FontSize = 11, Foreground = ThemeBrush("MutedBrush"), Margin = new Thickness(0, 4, 0, 0) });
        Grid.SetColumn(identity, 1); brand.Children.Add(identity); sidebarCaptions.Add(identity);
        DockPanel.SetDock(brand, Dock.Top); dock.Children.Add(brand);

        var bottom = new StackPanel(); DockPanel.SetDock(bottom, Dock.Bottom); dock.Children.Add(bottom);
        var collapseContent = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal };
        collapseGlyph = ShellGlyph("\uE76B", 14); collapseGlyph.Width = 24; collapseContent.Children.Add(collapseGlyph);
        var collapseText = new TextBlock { Text = "折叠侧栏", Margin = new Thickness(9, 0, 0, 0), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        collapseContent.Children.Add(collapseText); sidebarCaptions.Add(collapseText);
        var collapse = new Button { Content = collapseContent, ToolTip = "展开或折叠导航", Margin = new Thickness(12, 4, 12, 12), HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left };
        collapse.Name = "NavigationToggle";
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(collapse, collapse.Name);
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(collapse, "折叠导航");
        collapse.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "SubtleButton"); collapse.Click += (_, _) => { if (ActualWidth < 700) CloseNavigationDrawer(); else SetSidebarCollapsed(!sidebarCollapsed); }; bottom.Children.Add(collapse);
        var statistics = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(18, 15, 14, 16) };
        statistics.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = "本机工作区", FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, FontSize = 12 });
        var mode = BoundText(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.ModeLabel), true); mode.Foreground = ThemeBrush("MutedBrush"); mode.FontSize = 11; mode.Margin = new Thickness(0, 7, 0, 5); statistics.Children.Add(mode);
        var summary = BoundText(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.ApiSummary), true); summary.FontSize = 11; summary.Foreground = ThemeBrush("MutedBrush"); statistics.Children.Add(summary);
        sidebarStatistics = new Border { BorderBrush = ThemeBrush("BorderBrush"), BorderThickness = new Thickness(0, 1, 0, 0), Child = statistics }; bottom.Children.Add(sidebarStatistics);

        var links = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(10, 0, 10, 8) };
        foreach (var item in WorkspacePages)
        {
            var label = LocalizationService.PageDisplayName(item.Tag);
            var content = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal };
            var glyph = ShellGlyph(item.Icon); glyph.Width = 28; content.Children.Add(glyph);
            var caption = new TextBlock { Text = label, Margin = new Thickness(10, 0, 0, 0), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
            content.Children.Add(caption); sidebarCaptions.Add(caption);
            var link = new ToggleButton { Content = content, ToolTip = label, Margin = new Thickness(0, 2, 0, 2), MinHeight = 40, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left };
            link.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "NavigationButton");
            System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(link, label);
            System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(link, "Navigation." + item.Tag);
            link.Click += (_, _) => NavigateTo(item.Tag);
            navigation.Add(item.Tag, link); links.Children.Add(link);
        }
        dock.Children.Add(new ScrollViewer { Content = links, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled });
        return sidebar;
    }

    private FrameworkElement BuildWorkspaceToolbar()
    {
        var surface = new Border { Background = ThemeBrush("SurfaceBrush"), BorderBrush = ThemeBrush("BorderBrush"), BorderThickness = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 1), Padding = new Thickness(20, 10, 20, 10) };
        var row = new Grid(); surface.Child = row;
        workspaceToolbar = row;
        row.RowDefinitions.Add(new() { Height = GridLength.Auto }); row.RowDefinitions.Add(new() { Height = GridLength.Auto });
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition());
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto }); row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto }); row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        navigationMenuButton = new Button { Name = "WorkspaceNavigation", Content = ShellGlyph("\uE700"), Width = 38, Height = 38, ToolTip = "导航", Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };
        navigationMenuButton.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "IconButton"); System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(navigationMenuButton, "打开导航"); System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(navigationMenuButton, navigationMenuButton.Name);
        navigationMenuButton.Click += (_, _) => { if (navigationDrawerOpen) CloseNavigationDrawer(); else OpenNavigationDrawer(); }; row.Children.Add(navigationMenuButton);
        singleTargetGroup = new Grid(); singleTargetGroup.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new() { Width = GridLength.Auto }); singleTargetGroup.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new());
        Grid.SetColumn(singleTargetGroup, 1); row.Children.Add(singleTargetGroup);
        var targetLabel = new TextBlock { Text = "单设备目标", VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, Margin = new Thickness(2, 0, 10, 0), Foreground = ThemeBrush("MutedBrush") };
        singleTargetLabel = targetLabel;
        singleTargetGroup.Children.Add(targetLabel);
        var target = new ComboBox { Name = "SingleDeviceTarget", ItemsSource = new ListCollectionView(ViewModel.Devices), ItemTemplate = OperationTargetTemplate(), IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem = false, MinHeight = 38, MaxWidth = 520, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0), ToolTip = "节点、截图、命令等单设备操作目标" };
        singleTargetChoice = target;
        target.SetBinding(Selector.SelectedItemProperty, TwoWay(nameof(WorkspaceViewModel.CurrentDevice)));
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(target, "单设备目标"); Grid.SetColumn(target, 1); singleTargetGroup.Children.Add(target);
        var details = new Button { Name = "DeviceDetails", Content = ShellGlyph("\uE8A7"), ToolTip = "设备详情", MinHeight = 38, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 5, 0) };
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(details, "设备详情"); System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(details, details.Name);
        details.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "IconButton"); details.Click += (_, _) => ShowDeviceDirectory(); Grid.SetColumn(details, 2); row.Children.Add(details);
        var settings = new Button { Name = "WorkspaceSettings", Content = ShellGlyph("\uE713"), ToolTip = "设置", MinHeight = 38 };
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(settings, "设置"); System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(settings, settings.Name);
        settings.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "IconButton"); settings.Click += (_, _) => NavigateTo("设置"); Grid.SetColumn(settings, 4); row.Children.Add(settings);
        var advanced = new ContextMenu();
        var network = new MenuItem { Header = "网络连接（高级）" }; network.Click += (_, _) => ShowScanner(); advanced.Items.Add(network);
        var refresh = new MenuItem { Header = "立即更新目录" }; refresh.Click += async (_, _) => await UpdateDeviceDirectoryAsync(); advanced.Items.Add(refresh);
        var more = new Button { Name = "WorkspaceMore", Content = ShellGlyph("\uE712"), ToolTip = "更多", MinHeight = 38, ContextMenu = advanced };
        System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(more, "更多操作"); System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAutomationId(more, more.Name); more.SetResourceReference(StyleProperty, "IconButton");
        more.Click += (_, _) => { advanced.PlacementTarget = more; advanced.Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom; advanced.IsOpen = true; };
        advanced.PreviewKeyDown += (_, args) => { if (args.Key == Key.Escape) { advanced.IsOpen = false; args.Handled = true; } };
        advanced.Closed += (_, _) => more.Focus();
        Grid.SetColumn(more, 3); row.Children.Add(more);

    private static DataTemplate OperationTargetTemplate()
    {
        var text = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(TextBlock));
        text.SetValue(TextBlock.TextTrimmingProperty, TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis);
        var caption = new MultiBinding { StringFormat = "{0} · {1}" };
        caption.Bindings.Add(new Binding(nameof(DeviceRow.Name))); caption.Bindings.Add(new Binding(nameof(DeviceRow.Serial)));
        text.SetBinding(TextBlock.TextProperty, caption);
        return new DataTemplate { VisualTree = text };
    }

    private static ControlTemplate WorkspaceContentTemplate()
    {
        var presenter = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ContentPresenter), "PART_SelectedContentHost");
        presenter.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, new Binding(nameof(TabControl.SelectedContent)) { RelativeSource = RelativeSource.TemplatedParent });
        presenter.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding(nameof(TabControl.SelectedContentTemplate)) { RelativeSource = RelativeSource.TemplatedParent });
        presenter.SetValue(HorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch); presenter.SetValue(VerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Stretch);
        return new ControlTemplate(typeof(TabControl)) { VisualTree = presenter };
    }

    private void AttachWorkspacePages()
    {
        Grid.SetRow(tabs, 2); workspace.Children.Add(tabs); UpdateNavigation();
    }

    internal void NavigateTo(string tag)
    {
        var page = tabs.Items.Cast<TabItem>().SingleOrDefault(item => Equals(item.Tag, tag))
            ?? throw new ArgumentException("导航页面不存在：" + tag);
        tabs.SelectedItem = page; UpdateNavigation();
        if (navigationDrawerOpen) CloseNavigationDrawer();
    }

    private void UpdateNavigation()
    {
        var selected = (tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag?.ToString();
        if (selected != "设备墙 / 主控") CancelMainGesture();
        var targetVisibility = selected is "节点" or "截图 / 取色" or "Shell" or "文件" or "文本" or "脚本" or "API" or "扩展" ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        singleTargetLabel.Visibility = singleTargetChoice.Visibility = targetVisibility;
        singleTargetGroup.Visibility = targetVisibility;
        foreach (var item in navigation) item.Value.IsChecked = item.Key == selected;
        if (selected is not null && navigation.TryGetValue(selected, out var active) && active.IsLoaded) active.BringIntoView();
        var label = LocalizationService.PageDisplayName(selected ?? "设备墙 / 主控");
        Title = "矩阵设备 · " + label + (ViewModel.Demo ? " · 演示模式" : "");
    }

    private void SetSidebarCollapsed(bool collapsed)
    {
        sidebarPreference = collapsed; ApplyResponsiveWorkspace();
    }

    private void ApplyResponsiveWorkspace()
    {
        if (ActualWidth <= 0 || workspaceToolbar is null) return;
        var narrow = ActualWidth < 700;
        if (!narrow && navigationDrawerOpen) { navigationDrawerOpen = false; navigationReturnFocus = null; }
        sidebarCollapsed = narrow ? !navigationDrawerOpen : sidebarPreference ?? ActualWidth < 1100;
        sidebarColumn.Width = new GridLength(narrow ? 0 : sidebarCollapsed ? 72 : 212);
        navigationPane.Visibility = !narrow || navigationDrawerOpen ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        navigationPane.Width = narrow ? Math.Min(280, Math.Max(1, Shell.ActualWidth - 48)) : double.NaN;
        navigationPane.HorizontalAlignment = narrow ? HorizontalAlignment.Left : HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(navigationPane, narrow ? 2 : 1); Panel.SetZIndex(navigationPane, narrow ? 20 : 0);
        navigationBackdrop.Visibility = narrow && navigationDrawerOpen ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        workspace.IsEnabled = !navigationDrawerOpen;
        KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(navigationPane, narrow ? KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle : KeyboardNavigationMode.Continue);
        navigationMenuButton.Visibility = narrow ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        Grid.SetRow(singleTargetGroup, narrow ? 1 : 0); Grid.SetColumn(singleTargetGroup, narrow ? 0 : 1); Grid.SetColumnSpan(singleTargetGroup, narrow ? 5 : 1);
        singleTargetGroup.Margin = narrow ? new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0) : new Thickness(0);
        Grid.SetRow(workspaceStatus, narrow ? 1 : 0); Grid.SetColumn(workspaceStatus, narrow ? 0 : 1); Grid.SetColumnSpan(workspaceStatus, narrow ? 2 : 1);
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(workspaceCounts, narrow ? 2 : 1); workspaceStatus.TextAlignment = narrow ? TextAlignment.Left : TextAlignment.Right;
        foreach (var caption in sidebarCaptions) caption.Visibility = sidebarCollapsed ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        sidebarStatistics.Visibility = sidebarCollapsed ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        foreach (var link in navigation.Values) link.Padding = sidebarCollapsed ? new Thickness(8, 9, 8, 9) : new Thickness(14, 9, 14, 9);
        collapseGlyph.Text = sidebarCollapsed ? "\uE76C" : "\uE76B";
        if (collapseGlyph.Parent is StackPanel { Parent: Button collapse }) System.Windows.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(collapse, narrow ? "关闭导航" : sidebarCollapsed ? "展开导航" : "折叠导航");
    }

    private void OpenNavigationDrawer()
    {
        if (ActualWidth >= 700) return;
        navigationReturnFocus = Keyboard.FocusedElement; navigationDrawerOpen = true; ApplyResponsiveWorkspace();
        if ((tabs.SelectedItem as TabItem)?.Tag is string tag) { navigation[tag].BringIntoView(); navigation[tag].Focus(); }
    }

    private void CloseNavigationDrawer()
    {
        if (!navigationDrawerOpen) return;
        navigationDrawerOpen = false; ApplyResponsiveWorkspace();
        var previous = navigationReturnFocus as UIElement;
        void ReturnFocus()
        {
            if (navigationDrawerOpen || ActualWidth >= 700 || closing) return;
            if (previous is { IsVisible: true, IsEnabled: true }) previous.Focus(); else navigationMenuButton.Focus();
        }
        ReturnFocus();
        Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Input, (Action)ReturnFocus);
        navigationReturnFocus = null;
    }

    private void ShowDeviceDirectory()
    {
        if (directoryWindow is null)
        {
            directoryWindow = new Window { Owner = this, DataContext = ViewModel, Title = "设备详情", Width = 420, Height = 640, MinWidth = 360, MinHeight = 480, WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner };
            directoryWindow.Content = BuildDirectory();
            directoryWindow.Closing += (_, args) => { if (!closing) { args.Cancel = true; directoryWindow.Hide(); } };
        }
        ResponsiveLayout.FitOwnedWindow(directoryWindow, this, 420, 640); directoryWindow.Show(); directoryWindow.Activate();
    }

    private void ShowScanner()
    {
        if (scannerWindow is null)
        {
            var scanner = BuildScanner();
            if (scanner is Expander expander) expander.IsExpanded = true;
            scannerWindow = new Window { Owner = this, DataContext = ViewModel, Title = "网络连接（高级）", Width = 460, Height = 420, MinWidth = 360, MinHeight = 360, WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner };
            scannerWindow.Content = new ScrollViewer { Content = new Border { Padding = new Thickness(20), Child = scanner }, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled };
            scannerWindow.Closing += (_, args) => { if (!closing) { scanCancellation?.Cancel(); args.Cancel = true; scannerWindow.Hide(); } };
        }
        ResponsiveLayout.FitOwnedWindow(scannerWindow, this, 460, 420); scannerWindow.Show(); scannerWindow.Activate();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace MatrixDevice.Desktop;

public sealed partial class WorkspaceViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private MatrixRuntime runtime;
    private readonly string dataDirectory;
    private readonly bool demo;
    private readonly List<object> commands = [];
    private CancellationTokenSource? transferCancellation;
    private DeviceRow? currentDevice;
    private DeviceRow? mainDevice;
    private bool busy;
    private bool externalBusy;
    private int pendingLaunchSelection;
    private bool blockApiWhileBusy = true;
    private string status = "等待发现设备";
    private string error = "";
    private BitmapSource? debugImage;
    private readonly Dictionary<DeviceRow, CompletedScreenshot> completedScreenshots = [];
    private CompletedScreenshot? completedDebugImage;
    private CompletedNodeTree? completedNodeTree;
    private DebugSourceIdentity? observedCurrentDebugSource;
    private long debugPublicationRevision;
    private AndroidNode? nodeRoot;
    private NodeRow? selectedNode;
    private string shellInput = "";
    private string textInput = "";
    private string remotePath = "/sdcard/MatrixExchange/";
    private bool transferring;
    private bool showSystemApps;
    private AppInfo? selectedApp;
    private ScriptPackage? package;
    private bool syncMouse;
    private bool syncKeyboard;
    private int wallColumns;
    private string deviceName = "";
    private string settingsNotice = "";

    public WorkspaceViewModel(MatrixRuntime initialRuntime, string dataDirectory, bool demo)
    {
        runtime = initialRuntime;
        this.dataDirectory = dataDirectory;
        this.demo = demo;
        error = string.Join("\n", new[] { runtime.DiscoveryError, runtime.ApiStartupError }.Where(message => message is not null));
        syncMouse = runtime.Settings.SyncMouse;
        syncKeyboard = runtime.Settings.SyncKeyboard;
        wallColumns = runtime.Settings.WallColumns;
        Settings = new SettingsEditor(runtime.Settings);
        DeviceView = new ListCollectionView(Devices);
        AppsView = CollectionViewSource.GetDefaultView(Apps);
        RefreshCommand = Async(RefreshDevicesAsync, () => !Busy);
        ScreenshotCommand = Async(() => CaptureAsync(), CanUseDevice);
        WallRefreshCommand = Async(RefreshWallAsync, () => !Busy && Devices.Any(row => row.Info.Online));
        DumpCommand = Async(LoadNodesAsync, CanUseDevice);
        ShellCommand = Async(ExecuteShellAsync, () => CanWriteDevice() && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ShellInput));
        RefreshAppsCommand = Async(LoadAppsAsync, CanUseDevice);
        LaunchAppCommand = Async(() => ChangeAppAsync("launch"), () => CanWriteTargets() && SelectedApp is not null);
        StopAppCommand = Async(() => ChangeAppAsync("stop"), () => CanWriteTargets() && SelectedApp is not null);
        ClearAppCommand = Async(() => ChangeAppAsync("clear"), () => CanWriteTargets() && SelectedApp is not null);
        UninstallAppCommand = Async(() => ChangeAppAsync("uninstall"), () => CanWriteTargets() && SelectedApp is not null);
        TextCommand = Async(SendTextAsync, () => CanWriteTargets() && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TextInput));
        StartTransfersCommand = Async(StartTransfersAsync, () => !Busy && !Transferring && Transfers.Any(PendingTransfer));
        CancelTransfersCommand = Action(() => transferCancellation?.Cancel(), () => Transferring);
        StartScriptCommand = Async(StartScriptAsync, () => !Busy && !Transferring && package is not null && Targets().Any() && Targets().All(row => row.Info.Online) && Targets().Any(row => !ScriptBusy(row.Serial)));
        StopScriptCommand = Action(StopScripts, () => Targets().Any(row => ScriptBusy(row.Serial)));
        CancelScriptJobCommand = Action(CancelSelectedScriptJob, () => SelectedScriptJob?.CanCancel == true);
        StartApiCommand = Async(StartApisAsync, () => !Busy && (!runtime.Api.BasicRunning || !runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning));
        StopApiCommand = Async(StopApisAsync, () => !Busy && (runtime.Api.BasicRunning || runtime.Api.AutomatorRunning || runtime.Api.DevicePorts.Count > 0));
        StartDeviceApiCommand = Async(StartDeviceApisAsync, () => !Busy && Targets().Any(row => !runtime.Api.DevicePorts.ContainsKey(row.Serial)) && Targets().All(row => row.Info.Online && !ScriptBusy(row.Serial)));
        StopDeviceApiCommand = Async(StopDeviceApisAsync, () => !Busy && Targets().Any(row => runtime.Api.DevicePorts.ContainsKey(row.Serial)));
        SaveMetadataCommand = Async(SaveMetadataAsync, () => !Busy && CurrentDevice is not null);
        SaveSettingsCommand = Async(SaveSettingsAsync, () => !Busy);
        runtime.Scripts.EntryAdded += OnScriptLog;
        runtime.Scripts.StatusChanged += OnScriptStatus;
        AttachScriptJobs();
        LocalizationService.Current.LanguageChanged += OnLanguageChanged;
    }

    public MatrixRuntime Runtime => runtime;
    internal string DataDirectory => dataDirectory;
    public bool Demo => demo;
```
