```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace MatrixDevice.Host;

public static class LdRunningWindow
{
    // True means foreground activation was accepted; restoration itself is asynchronous.
    public static bool Show(LdPlayerInstance instance, string expectedInstallDirectory, long expectedPlayerBirth)
        => Show(instance, expectedInstallDirectory, expectedPlayerBirth, SetForegroundWindow);

    internal static bool Show(LdPlayerInstance instance, string expectedInstallDirectory, long expectedPlayerBirth, Func<IntPtr, bool> requestForeground)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(instance);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(requestForeground);
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) throw new PlatformNotSupportedException("Showing an existing instance window requires Windows.");
        if (instance.Index <= 0 || instance.Index >= 99999 || instance.Generation <= 0 || instance.ProcessId <= 0 || instance.TopWindow <= 0 || expectedPlayerBirth <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid running window target: index {instance.Index}, generation {instance.Generation}, PID {instance.ProcessId}, window {instance.TopWindow}, birth {expectedPlayerBirth}.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedInstallDirectory) || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(expectedInstallDirectory) || !Directory.Exists(expectedInstallDirectory))
            throw new ArgumentException($"The expected installation directory must exist and be absolute: {expectedInstallDirectory}.", nameof(expectedInstallDirectory));
        var install = Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(expectedInstallDirectory));
        var window = new IntPtr(instance.TopWindow);
        ValidateWindow(window, instance.ProcessId);
        using var process = OpenProcess(0x1000 | 0x100000, false, instance.ProcessId);
        if (process.IsInvalid) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot open player process {instance.ProcessId}.");
        RequireRunning(process, instance.ProcessId);
        if (!GetProcessTimes(process, out var created, out _, out _, out _))
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot read player process {instance.ProcessId} birth.");
        var birth = DateTime.FromFileTimeUtc(created).Ticks;
        if (birth != expectedPlayerBirth)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Player process {instance.ProcessId} birth mismatch: expected {expectedPlayerBirth}, actual {birth}.");
        var executable = new StringBuilder(32768); var size = (uint)executable.Capacity;
        if (!QueryFullProcessImageName(process, 0, executable, ref size))
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot read player process {instance.ProcessId} executable path.");
        var executableDirectory = Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(executable.ToString()));
        if (executableDirectory is null || !Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(executableDirectory).Equals(install, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Player process {instance.ProcessId} executable directory {executableDirectory} does not match {install}.");
        RequireRunning(process, instance.ProcessId);
        ValidateWindow(window, instance.ProcessId);
        if (!ShowWindowAsync(window, 9)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Restore request was rejected for instance {instance.Index}, window {instance.TopWindow}.");
        RequireRunning(process, instance.ProcessId);
        ValidateWindow(window, instance.ProcessId);
        return requestForeground(window);
    }

    private static void ValidateWindow(IntPtr window, int expectedPid)
    {
        if (!IsWindow(window) || GetAncestor(window, 2) != window)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Window {window} is not an existing top-level window.");
        if (GetWindowThreadProcessId(window, out var pid) == 0 || pid != expectedPid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Window {window} owner mismatch: expected PID {expectedPid}, actual {pid}.");
    }

    private static void RequireRunning(SafeProcessHandle process, int pid)
    {
        var state = WaitForSingleObject(process, 0);
        if (state == 258) return;
        if (state == uint.MaxValue) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot check player process {pid} liveness.");
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Player process {pid} is not running (wait state {state}).");
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern SafeProcessHandle OpenProcess(uint access, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] bool inherit, int pid);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern uint WaitForSingleObject(SafeProcessHandle handle, uint milliseconds);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GetProcessTimes(SafeProcessHandle process, out long created, out long exited, out long kernel, out long user);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", EntryPoint = "QueryFullProcessImageNameW", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool QueryFullProcessImageName(SafeProcessHandle process, uint flags, StringBuilder path, ref uint size);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool IsWindow(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern IntPtr GetAncestor(IntPtr window, uint flags);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr window, out int pid);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool ShowWindowAsync(IntPtr window, int command);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr window);
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Host/Monitoring/ResourceSampler.cs

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("MatrixDevice.Tests")]

namespace MatrixDevice.Host;

public sealed record MonitorProcessTarget(int Index, long Generation, int PlayerPid, long PlayerBirth, int VBoxPid, long VBoxBirth);
public sealed record MonitorResourceSample(int Index, long Generation, DateTimeOffset ObservedAt, double? CpuPercent, long? WorkingSetBytes, string? Error);
public sealed record HostResourceSample(DateTimeOffset ObservedAt, double? CpuPercent, long? TotalPhysical, long? AvailablePhysical, string? Error);

public sealed class ResourceSampler
{
    private readonly object gate = new();
    private readonly Func<HostCounters> readHost;
    private readonly Func<int, long, ProcessCounters> readProcess;
    private readonly Func<int> readProcessorCount;
    private readonly TimeProvider clock;
    private readonly Dictionary<int, InstanceBaseline> instances = [];
    private HostCounters? previousHost;

    public ResourceSampler() : this(ReadHost, ReadProcess, ReadProcessorCount, TimeProvider.System) { }

    internal ResourceSampler(Func<HostCounters> readHost, Func<int, long, ProcessCounters> readProcess, Func<int> readProcessorCount, TimeProvider clock)
    {
        this.readHost = readHost ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(readHost));
        this.readProcess = readProcess ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(readProcess));
        this.readProcessorCount = readProcessorCount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(readProcessorCount));
        this.clock = clock ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(clock));
    }

    public HostResourceSample SampleHost()
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            var observedAt = clock.GetUtcNow();
            try
            {
                var current = readHost();
                if (current.TotalPhysical <= 0 || current.AvailablePhysical < 0 || current.AvailablePhysical > current.TotalPhysical)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid physical memory: total {current.TotalPhysical}, available {current.AvailablePhysical}.");
                double? cpu = null;
                if (previousHost is { } previous)
                {
                    if (current.Idle < previous.Idle || current.Kernel < previous.Kernel || current.User < previous.User)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Host CPU counters moved backwards.");
                    var total = checked(current.Kernel - previous.Kernel + current.User - previous.User);
                    var idle = current.Idle - previous.Idle;
                    if (total == 0 || idle > total) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid host CPU interval: total {total}, idle {idle}.");
                    cpu = (1d - (double)idle / total) * 100d;
                }
                previousHost = current;
                return new(observedAt, cpu, current.TotalPhysical, current.AvailablePhysical, null);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (IsSamplingFailure(ex))
            {
                previousHost = null;
                return new(observedAt, null, null, null, ex.Message);
            }
        }
    }

    public MonitorResourceSample SampleInstance(MonitorProcessTarget target)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(target);
        lock (gate)
        {
            var observedAt = clock.GetUtcNow();
            try
            {
                if (target.Index <= 0 || target.Index == 99999 || target.Generation <= 0 || target.PlayerPid <= 0 || target.VBoxPid <= 0 || target.PlayerBirth <= 0 || target.VBoxBirth <= 0)
                    throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid monitor target: index {target.Index}, generation {target.Generation}, player {target.PlayerPid}/{target.PlayerBirth}, VBox {target.VBoxPid}/{target.VBoxBirth}.");
                if (target.PlayerPid == target.VBoxPid && target.PlayerBirth != target.VBoxBirth)
                    throw new ArgumentException($"Process {target.PlayerPid} has conflicting expected birth times.");
                var processorCount = readProcessorCount();
                if (processorCount <= 0) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid logical processor count: {processorCount}.");
                var player = ReadVerifiedProcess(target.PlayerPid, target.PlayerBirth);
                var vbox = target.VBoxPid == target.PlayerPid ? null : ReadVerifiedProcess(target.VBoxPid, target.VBoxBirth);
                var cpuTicks = checked(player.CpuTicks + (vbox?.CpuTicks ?? 0));
                // Working sets contain shared pages; this is not exclusive or guest memory.
                var workingSet = checked(player.WorkingSetBytes + (vbox?.WorkingSetBytes ?? 0));
                var timestamp = clock.GetTimestamp();
                double? cpu = null;
                if (instances.TryGetValue(target.Index, out var previous) && previous.Target == target)
                {
                    var elapsed = clock.GetElapsedTime(previous.Timestamp, timestamp).TotalSeconds;
                    if (elapsed <= 0 || cpuTicks < previous.CpuTicks)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid CPU interval for instance {target.Index}: elapsed {elapsed}, CPU ticks {previous.CpuTicks} -> {cpuTicks}.");
                    cpu = Math.Min(100d, (cpuTicks - previous.CpuTicks) / (double)TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond / elapsed / processorCount * 100d);
                }
                instances[target.Index] = new(target, cpuTicks, timestamp);
                return new(target.Index, target.Generation, observedAt, cpu, workingSet, null);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (IsSamplingFailure(ex))
            {
                instances.Remove(target.Index);
                return new(target.Index, target.Generation, observedAt, null, null, $"Instance {target.Index}: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }

    private ProcessCounters ReadVerifiedProcess(int pid, long birth)
    {
        var value = readProcess(pid, birth);
        if (value.Birth != birth) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Process {pid} birth mismatch: expected {birth}, actual {value.Birth}.");
        if (value.CpuTicks < 0 || value.WorkingSetBytes < 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid counters for process {pid}: CPU ticks {value.CpuTicks}, working set {value.WorkingSetBytes}.");
        return value;
    }

    private static bool IsSamplingFailure(Exception ex) => ex is Win32Exception or IOException or InvalidOperationException or ArgumentException or NotSupportedException or OverflowException or DllNotFoundException or EntryPointNotFoundException;

    private static HostCounters ReadHost()
    {
        RequireWindows();
        var groups = GetActiveProcessorGroupCount();
        if (groups == 0) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "Cannot read active processor groups.");
        if (groups != 1) throw new PlatformNotSupportedException($"Host CPU sampling does not support {groups} processor groups.");
        var memory = new MemoryStatus { Length = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<MemoryStatus>() };
        if (!GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ref memory)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "Cannot read physical memory.");
        if (!GetSystemTimes(out var idle, out var kernel, out var user)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "Cannot read host CPU times.");
        return new(idle, kernel, user, checked((long)memory.TotalPhysical), checked((long)memory.AvailablePhysical));
    }

    private static int ReadProcessorCount()
    {
        RequireWindows();
        var count = GetActiveProcessorCount(ushort.MaxValue);
        if (count == 0) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "Cannot read active logical processors.");
        return checked((int)count);
    }

    private static ProcessCounters ReadProcess(int pid, long expectedBirth)
    {
        RequireWindows();
        // Keep one handle so PID reuse cannot switch the process between identity and counters.
        using var handle = OpenProcess(0x1000 | 0x0010 | 0x100000, false, pid);
        if (handle.IsInvalid) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot open process {pid} for resource sampling.");
        RequireRunning(handle, pid);
        if (!GetProcessTimes(handle, out var created, out _, out _, out _))
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot read process {pid} identity.");
        var birth = DateTime.FromFileTimeUtc(created).Ticks;
        if (birth != expectedBirth) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Process {pid} birth mismatch: expected {expectedBirth}, actual {birth}.");
        var memory = new ProcessMemory { Size = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<ProcessMemory>() };
        if (!K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(handle, ref memory, memory.Size))
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot read process {pid} working set.");
        if (!GetProcessTimes(handle, out _, out _, out var kernel, out var user))
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot read process {pid} CPU times.");
        RequireRunning(handle, pid);
        return new(birth, checked(kernel + user), checked((long)memory.WorkingSet));
    }

    private static void RequireRunning(SafeProcessHandle handle, int pid)
    {
        var state = WaitForSingleObject(handle, 0);
        if (state == 258) return;
        if (state == uint.MaxValue) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Cannot check process {pid} liveness.");
        if (state == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Process {pid} has exited.");
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unexpected wait state {state} for process {pid}.");
    }

    private static void RequireWindows()
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) throw new PlatformNotSupportedException("Resource sampling requires Windows.");
    }

    internal sealed record HostCounters(ulong Idle, ulong Kernel, ulong User, long TotalPhysical, long AvailablePhysical);
    internal sealed record ProcessCounters(long Birth, long CpuTicks, long WorkingSetBytes);
    private sealed record InstanceBaseline(MonitorProcessTarget Target, long CpuTicks, long Timestamp);

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct MemoryStatus
    {
        public uint Length, Load;
        public ulong TotalPhysical, AvailablePhysical, TotalPageFile, AvailablePageFile, TotalVirtual, AvailableVirtual, AvailableExtended;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct ProcessMemory
    {
        public uint Size, PageFaultCount;
        public nuint PeakWorkingSet, WorkingSet, QuotaPeakPagedPool, QuotaPagedPool, QuotaPeakNonPagedPool, QuotaNonPagedPool, PageFile, PeakPageFile;
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern ushort GetActiveProcessorGroupCount();
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern uint GetActiveProcessorCount(ushort group);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GetSystemTimes(out ulong idle, out ulong kernel, out ulong user);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ref MemoryStatus memory);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern SafeProcessHandle OpenProcess(uint access, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] bool inherit, int pid);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern uint WaitForSingleObject(SafeProcessHandle handle, uint milliseconds);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool GetProcessTimes(SafeProcessHandle process, out long created, out long exited, out long kernel, out long user);
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(SafeProcessHandle process, ref ProcessMemory memory, uint size);
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Host/Monitoring/ScreenVideoSession.cs

```csharp
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Host;

public sealed record ScreenVideoFrame(int Width, int Height, byte[] Bgra, long Sequence, DateTimeOffset ReceivedAt);

public sealed class ScreenVideoSession : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly AdbDeviceBackend _backend;
    private readonly string _serial;
    private readonly string _ffmpegPath;
    private readonly int _width;
    private readonly int _height;
    private readonly Action<ScreenVideoFrame> _frame;
    private readonly Action<string> _status;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _shutdown = new();
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private Task? _completion;
    private bool _disposed;
    private string? _lastError;
    private long _sequence;

    public ScreenVideoSession(AdbDeviceBackend backend, string serial, string ffmpegPath, int width, int height,
        Action<ScreenVideoFrame> frame, Action<string> status)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(backend);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(serial);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(ffmpegPath);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(frame);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(status);
        if (width is < 16 or > 1920 || height is < 16 or > 1920 || width % 2 != 0 || height % 2 != 0 || (long)width * height > 2073600)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(width), $"Invalid video dimensions: {width}x{height}.");
        _backend = backend;
        _serial = serial;
        _ffmpegPath = Path.GetFullPath(ffmpegPath);
        _width = width;
        _height = height;
        _frame = frame;
        _status = status;
    }

    public Task Completion { get { lock (_gate) return _completion ?? Task.CompletedTask; } }
    public bool IsRunning { get { lock (_gate) return _completion is { IsCompleted: false }; } }
    public string? LastError => Volatile.Read(ref _lastError);

    public void Start()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(_disposed, this);
            if (_completion is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException("A video session can only be started once.");
            _completion = Task.Run(() => RunAsync(_shutdown.Token));
        }
    }

    private async Task RunAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            _status("正在启动 H.264 视频流");
            await RunSegmentAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested && ex is OperationCanceledException or IOException or ObjectDisposedException && !HasUnconfirmedCleanup(ex))
        {
            _status("视频流已停止");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _lastError, ex.Message);
            _status("视频已停止：" + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private async Task RunSegmentAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(_ffmpegPath)) throw new FileNotFoundException("找不到视频解码组件。", _ffmpegPath);
        using var process = new Process { StartInfo = CreateStartInfo(_ffmpegPath, _width, _height) };
        if (!process.Start()) throw new IOException("无法启动视频解码组件。");
        using var segment = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        using var cancellation = segment.Token.Register(() => StopDecoder(process));
        var errors = new StringBuilder();
        var stderr = CaptureErrorsAsync(process.StandardError, errors);
        var stream = PumpAsync(process.StandardInput.BaseStream, segment.Token);
        var frames = ReadFramesAsync(process.StandardOutput.BaseStream, segment.Token);
        var exit = process.WaitForExitAsync();
        try
        {
            var completed = await Task.WhenAny(stream, frames, exit).ConfigureAwait(false);
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (completed == exit)
            {
                await exit.ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (!stream.IsCompleted) throw new IOException($"视频解码器提前退出（代码 {process.ExitCode}）。");
            }
            if (completed == frames)
            {
                await frames.ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (!stream.IsCompleted) throw new IOException("视频解码器在采集结束前关闭了输出。");
            }
            await stream.ConfigureAwait(false);
            await Task.WhenAll(frames, exit).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            await stderr.ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (process.ExitCode != 0) throw new IOException($"视频解码失败（代码 {process.ExitCode}）。");
            throw new IOException("视频采集连接已结束。");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            await segment.CancelAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            await ObserveCleanupAsync(stderr).ConfigureAwait(false);
            throw new IOException(ex.Message + (errors.Length == 0 ? "" : " 解码器：" + errors), ex);
        }
        finally
        {
            await segment.CancelAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            await ObserveCleanupAsync(Task.WhenAll(stream, frames, exit, stderr)).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var cleanupError = stream.Exception?.GetBaseException();
            if (cleanupError?.Data.Contains("VideoCleanupUnconfirmed") == true)
                System.Runtime.ExceptionServices.ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(cleanupError).Throw();
        }
    }

    private static ProcessStartInfo CreateStartInfo(string ffmpegPath, int width, int height)
    {
        var info = new ProcessStartInfo(ffmpegPath)
        {
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
            WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden,
            RedirectStandardInput = true,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true
        };
        foreach (var argument in new[] { "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-probesize", "32", "-analyzeduration", "0",
            "-threads", "1", "-f", "h264", "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-vf", FormattableString.Invariant($"scale={width}:{height}"),
            "-threads", "1", "-pix_fmt", "bgra", "-fps_mode", "passthrough", "-flush_packets", "1", "-f", "rawvideo", "pipe:1" })
            info.ArgumentList.Add(argument);
        return info;
    }

    private async Task PumpAsync(Stream stdin, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try { await _backend.StreamScreenVideoAsync(_serial, _width, _height, stdin, ct).ConfigureAwait(false); }
        finally { await stdin.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); }
    }

    private async Task ReadFramesAsync(Stream stdout, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var first = true;
        while (true)
        {
            var bytes = new byte[checked(_width * _height * 4)];
            var offset = 0;
            using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
            if (first) deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20));
            try
            {
                while (offset < bytes.Length)
                {
                    var read = await stdout.ReadAsync(bytes.AsMemory(offset), deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    if (read == 0)
                    {
                        if (offset > 0) throw new IOException($"视频帧被截断：{offset}/{bytes.Length} 字节。");
                        if (first) throw new IOException("视频解码器未输出首帧，设备可能不支持 H.264 采集。");
                        return;
                    }
                    offset += read;
                }
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                throw new TimeoutException("等待视频首帧超过 20 秒，已停止当前采集。");
            }
            // Deliver synchronously: the consumer replaces its latest frame; no frame or dispatcher queue is built here.
            _frame(new(_width, _height, bytes, Interlocked.Increment(ref _sequence), DateTimeOffset.UtcNow));
            if (first) { _status("H.264 视频流已连接"); first = false; }
        }
    }

    private static async Task CaptureErrorsAsync(StreamReader stderr, StringBuilder errors)
    {
        var block = new char[1024];
        int count;
        while ((count = await stderr.ReadAsync(block).ConfigureAwait(false)) != 0)
        {
            errors.Append(block, 0, count);
            if (errors.Length > 8192) errors.Remove(0, errors.Length - 8192);
        }
    }

    private static void StopDecoder(Process process)
    {
        try { if (!process.HasExited) process.Kill(entireProcessTree: false); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
    }

    private static async Task ObserveCleanupAsync(Task task)
    {
        try { await task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15)).ConfigureAwait(false); }
        catch (TimeoutException ex)
        {
            var unconfirmed = new IOException("视频会话清理超过 15 秒，退出状态未确认。", ex);
            unconfirmed.Data["VideoCleanupUnconfirmed"] = true;
            throw unconfirmed;
        }
        catch (Exception) { /* The main task retains failures; cleanup only drains already stopped owned streams. */ }
    }

    private static bool HasUnconfirmedCleanup(Exception error) => error.Data.Contains("VideoCleanupUnconfirmed") ||
        error is AggregateException aggregate && aggregate.InnerExceptions.Any(HasUnconfirmedCleanup) ||
        error.InnerException is { } inner && HasUnconfirmedCleanup(inner);

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        Task? completion;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_disposed) return;
            _disposed = true;
            completion = _completion;
        }
        await _shutdown.CancelAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (completion is not null) await completion.ConfigureAwait(false);
        _shutdown.Dispose();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Host;

public sealed record DeviceMetadata(string Serial, string Name = "", string GroupId = "", string Remark = "");
public sealed record GroupRecord(string Id, string Name);

public sealed class CatalogRepository : IDisposable
{
    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection;
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private static readonly HashSet<string> Categories = ["Group", "DeviceGroupRelation", "DeviceRemarkRelation", "EthernetScan", "CustomDeviceCommand", "ScriptDeviceConfiguration", "EnvironmentConfig", "Proxy", "Server", "AppCk", "User"];
    public CatalogRepository(string path)
    {
        path = Path.GetFullPath(path);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
        var sqlitePath = path;
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows() && !path.StartsWith(@"\\?\", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !path.StartsWith(@"\\.\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            sqlitePath = path.StartsWith(@"\\", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? @"\\?\UNC\" + path[2..] : @"\\?\" + path;
        _connection = new SqliteConnection(new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder { DataSource = sqlitePath, Pooling = false }.ToString());
        try
        {
        _connection.Open();
        using var integrity = _connection.CreateCommand();
        integrity.CommandText = "PRAGMA integrity_check;";
        if (!string.Equals(integrity.ExecuteScalar()?.ToString(), "ok", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new IOException("SQLite integrity check failed: " + path);
        using var version = _connection.CreateCommand();
        version.CommandText = "PRAGMA user_version;";
        var previous = Convert.ToInt32(version.ExecuteScalar());
        if (previous > 1) throw new IOException("Unsupported database schema version: " + previous);
        if (previous == 0)
        {
            if (new FileInfo(path).Length > 0)
            {
                using var backup = new SqliteConnection(new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder { DataSource = sqlitePath + ".pre-migration.bak", Pooling = false }.ToString());
                backup.Open();
                _connection.BackupDatabase(backup);
            }
            using var transaction = _connection.BeginTransaction();
            foreach (var category in Categories)
            {
                using var create = _connection.CreateCommand();
                create.Transaction = transaction;
                create.CommandText = $"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS [{category}] (Id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, Payload TEXT NOT NULL, UpdatedUtc TEXT NOT NULL);";
                create.ExecuteNonQuery();
            }
            using var migration = _connection.CreateCommand();
            migration.Transaction = transaction;
            migration.CommandText = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DeviceMetadata(Serial TEXT PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT NOT NULL, GroupId TEXT NOT NULL, Remark TEXT NOT NULL); PRAGMA user_version=1;";
            migration.ExecuteNonQuery();
            transaction.Commit();
        }
        }
        catch { _connection.Dispose(); throw; }
    }

    public DeviceMetadata GetMetadata(string serial)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = "SELECT Serial, Name, GroupId, Remark FROM DeviceMetadata WHERE Serial=$serial;";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$serial", serial);
            using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
            return reader.Read() ? new(reader.GetString(0), reader.GetString(1), reader.GetString(2), reader.GetString(3)) : new(serial);
        }
    }
    public IReadOnlyList<DeviceMetadata> GetAllMetadata()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = "SELECT Serial, Name, GroupId, Remark FROM DeviceMetadata ORDER BY Serial;";
            using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
            List<DeviceMetadata> rows = [];
            while (reader.Read()) rows.Add(new(reader.GetString(0), reader.GetString(1), reader.GetString(2), reader.GetString(3)));
            return rows;
        }
    }
    public void UpsertMetadata(string serial, string name, string groupId)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serial)) throw new ArgumentException("Serial is required", nameof(serial));
        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = "INSERT INTO DeviceMetadata VALUES($serial,$name,$group,'') ON CONFLICT(Serial) DO UPDATE SET Name=excluded.Name,GroupId=excluded.GroupId;";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$serial", serial);
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$name", name);
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$group", groupId);
            command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }
    public void SetRemark(string serial, string remark)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            var old = GetMetadata(serial);
            UpsertMetadata(serial, old.Name, old.GroupId);
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = "UPDATE DeviceMetadata SET Remark=$remark WHERE Serial=$serial;";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$remark", remark);
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$serial", serial);
            command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }
    public void Put<T>(string category, string id, T value)
    {
        ValidateCategory(category);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = $"INSERT INTO [{category}] VALUES($id,$payload,$at) ON CONFLICT(Id) DO UPDATE SET Payload=excluded.Payload,UpdatedUtc=excluded.UpdatedUtc;";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$id", id);
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$payload", JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, JsonDefaults.Options));
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$at", DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("O"));
            command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }
    public IReadOnlyList<T> GetAll<T>(string category)
    {
        ValidateCategory(category);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = $"SELECT Payload FROM [{category}] ORDER BY Id;";
            using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
            List<T> rows = [];
            while (reader.Read()) rows.Add(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(reader.GetString(0), JsonDefaults.Options)!);
            return rows;
        }
    }
    public void Delete(string category, string id)
    {
        ValidateCategory(category);
        lock (_gate)
        {
            using var command = _connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = $"DELETE FROM [{category}] WHERE Id=$id;";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$id", id);
            command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        }
    }
    private static void ValidateCategory(string category)
    {
        if (!Categories.Contains(category)) throw new ArgumentException("Unknown entity category: " + category);
    }
    public void Dispose() => _connection.Dispose();
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Host/Persistence/SettingsStore.cs

```csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

namespace MatrixDevice.Host;

public sealed class SettingsStore(string path)
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions MergeJson = new(JsonDefaults.Options) { DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.Never };
    private readonly string _path = Path.GetFullPath(path);
    private AppSettings? _baseline;
    public List<string> Warnings { get; } = [];

    public AppSettings Load()
    {
        Warnings.Clear();
        var settings = Read(_path);
        if (settings is null)
        {
            settings = Read(_path + ".bak");
            if (settings is not null)
            {
                settings = settings with { AdbAllowedSerials = [], LdSerialBindings = [], AgentSerial = null, AgentBaseUrl = null };
                Warnings.Add("已从备份恢复一般设置；设备授权与雷电绑定已清空，请重新确认。");
            }
        }
        settings ??= new AppSettings();
        var normalized = Normalize(settings);
        _baseline = Normalize(normalized);
        return normalized;
    }

    public AppSettings Save(AppSettings current)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(current);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(_path)!);
        var name = "MatrixDevice.Settings." + Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_path.ToUpperInvariant())));
        using var gate = new Mutex(false, name);
        var acquired = false;
        try
        {
            try { acquired = gate.WaitOne(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)); }
            catch (AbandonedMutexException) { acquired = true; }
            if (!acquired) throw new IOException("Settings file is busy: " + _path);
            var disk = Read(_path);
            var merged = current;
            if (_baseline is not null && disk is not null)
            {
                var baselineJson = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(_baseline, MergeJson)!.AsObject();
                var localJson = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(current, MergeJson)!.AsObject();
                var diskJson = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(disk, MergeJson)!.AsObject();
                foreach (var property in localJson)
                {
                    if (property.Key == "ldSerialBindings" && property.Value is JsonObject localBindings && baselineJson[property.Key] is JsonObject originalBindings)
                    {
                        var bindings = diskJson[property.Key] as JsonObject;
                        if (bindings is null) { bindings = new JsonObject(); diskJson[property.Key] = bindings; }
                        foreach (var key in originalBindings.Select(x => x.Key).Union(localBindings.Select(x => x.Key)).ToArray())
                            if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(localBindings[key], originalBindings[key]))
                            {
                                if (localBindings.TryGetPropertyValue(key, out var changed)) bindings[key] = changed?.DeepClone();
                                else bindings.Remove(key);
                            }
                    }
                    else if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(property.Value, baselineJson[property.Key]))
                        diskJson[property.Key] = property.Value?.DeepClone();
                }
                merged = diskJson.Deserialize<AppSettings>(JsonDefaults.Options)!;
            }
            merged = Normalize(merged);
            var temp = _path + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
            try
            {
                using (var stream = new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None))
                {
                    JsonSerializer.Serialize(stream, merged, JsonDefaults.Options);
                    stream.Flush(true);
                }
                if (File.Exists(_path)) File.Replace(temp, _path, _path + ".bak", true);
                else File.Move(temp, _path);
                _baseline = Normalize(merged);
                return merged;
            }
            finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
        }
        finally { if (acquired) gate.ReleaseMutex(); }
    }

    private AppSettings? Read(string file)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(file)) return null;
        try
        {
            return Normalize(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AppSettings>(File.ReadAllText(file, Encoding.UTF8), JsonDefaults.Options)
                ?? throw new JsonException("Configuration is null"));
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or JsonException or ArgumentException or NotSupportedException)
        {
            Warnings.Add(file + ": " + e.Message);
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static AppSettings Normalize(AppSettings value) => value with
    {
        AdbAllowedSerials = NormalizeAuthorizedSerials(value.AdbAllowedSerials),
        BasicApiPort = value.BasicApiPort is >= 1 and <= 65535 ? value.BasicApiPort : 8080,
        AutomatorApiPort = value.AutomatorApiPort is >= 1 and <= 65535 ? value.AutomatorApiPort : 17171,
        WallColumns = Math.Clamp(value.WallColumns, 5, 20),
        MainMaxSize = Math.Clamp(value.MainMaxSize, 180, 4096),
        MiniMaxSize = Math.Clamp(value.MiniMaxSize, 180, 4096),
        MainMaxFps = Math.Clamp(value.MainMaxFps, 1, 120),
        MiniMaxFps = Math.Clamp(value.MiniMaxFps, 1, 120),
        WindowWidth = double.IsFinite(value.WindowWidth) ? Math.Clamp(value.WindowWidth, AppSettings.MinimumWindowWidth, AppSettings.MaximumWindowWidth) : AppSettings.DefaultWindowWidth,
        WindowHeight = double.IsFinite(value.WindowHeight) ? Math.Clamp(value.WindowHeight, AppSettings.MinimumWindowHeight, AppSettings.MaximumWindowHeight) : AppSettings.DefaultWindowHeight,
        CommandTimeoutSeconds = Math.Clamp(value.CommandTimeoutSeconds, 1, 300),
        LdSerialBindings = (value.LdSerialBindings ?? []).Where(x => x.Key >= 0 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Value))
            .ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Value.Trim()),
        Language = "zh-CN"
    };
    private static string[] NormalizeAuthorizedSerials(string[]? serials)
    {
        if (serials is null) return [];
        if (serials.Any(serial => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serial) || serial.StartsWith('-') || serial.Any(char.IsWhiteSpace) || serial.Contains('\0')))
            throw new JsonException("授权设备串号包含无效值，拒绝此配置");
        return serials.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
    }
}
```

## src/MatrixDevice.Mcp/BoundedTransportStreams.cs

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using ModelContextProtocol;
using ModelContextProtocol.Protocol;

namespace MatrixDevice.Mcp;

internal abstract class NonSeekableStream : Stream
{
    public override bool CanSeek => false;
    public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override long Position { get => throw new NotSupportedException(); set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }
    public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override void Flush() { }
}

internal sealed class BoundedInputStream(Stream input, ProtocolAdmission admission, Guid epoch) : NonSeekableStream
{
    private readonly OwnedConsoleIo io = new(input);
    private readonly byte[] readBuffer = new byte[65536];
    private int readOffset, readCount;
    private byte[]? frame;
    private int frameOffset;
    private readonly TaskCompletionSource<ITransport> transport = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    internal Exception? Failure { get; private set; }
    internal bool Eof { get; private set; }
    internal bool IoTerminal => io.IsTerminal;
    internal void SetTransport(ITransport value) => transport.TrySetResult(value);
    public override bool CanRead => true;
    public override bool CanWrite => false;
    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken token) => ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count), token).AsTask();

    public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken token = default)
    {
        try
        {
            while (frame is null)
            {
                using var line = new MemoryStream();
                var ended = false;
                while (!ended)
                {
                    if (readOffset == readCount)
                    {
                        readCount = await io.RunAsync(() => input.Read(readBuffer, 0, readBuffer.Length), token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        readOffset = 0;
                        if (readCount == 0)
                        {
                            Eof = true; admission.Stop();
                            if (line.Length != 0) throw new InvalidDataException("Incomplete final stdio message.");
                            return 0;
                        }
                    }
                    var next = readBuffer.AsSpan(readOffset, readCount - readOffset).IndexOf((byte)'\n');
                    var take = next < 0 ? readCount - readOffset : next;
                    if (line.Length + take > 1048576) throw new InvalidDataException("Stdio request exceeds 1048576 bytes before SDK deserialization.");
                    line.Write(readBuffer.AsSpan(readOffset, take)); readOffset += take;
                    if (next >= 0) { readOffset++; ended = true; }
                }
                var bytes = line.ToArray();
                if (bytes.Length == 0 || bytes.All(b => b is (byte)' ' or (byte)'\t' or (byte)'\r')) continue;
                using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(bytes, new JsonDocumentOptions { MaxDepth = 36 });
                var root = document.RootElement;
                if (root.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) throw new InvalidDataException("MCP stdio requires one JSON-RPC object per line.");
                var hasId = root.TryGetProperty("id", out var idValue);
                if (root.EnumerateObject().Count(p => p.Name == "id") > 1) throw new InvalidDataException("Duplicate outer JSON-RPC id is ambiguous.");
                RequestId id = hasId ? ProtocolAdmission.Id(idValue) : default;
                if (hasId) admission.RegisterSeen(id);
                if (hasId && !root.TryGetProperty("method", out _)) throw new InvalidDataException("Unsolicited client response is not supported by this tools-only server.");
                var isTool = root.TryGetProperty("method", out var method) && method.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String && method.GetString() == "tools/call";
                string? toolName = null;
                if (isTool && root.TryGetProperty("params", out var parameters) && parameters.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && parameters.TryGetProperty("name", out var name) && name.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String) toolName = name.GetString();
                try { StrictJson.Validate(root); }
                catch (Exception error)
                {
                    if (!hasId) throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid notification JSON.", error);
                    await RejectAsync(id, isTool, error, token).ConfigureAwait(false); continue;
                }
                if (!hasId)
                {
                    if (!root.TryGetProperty("method", out _) || !admission.Notification(root)) continue;
                }
                else
                {
                    var rejection = admission.Reserve(id, toolName == "matrix.jobs.cancel");
                    if (rejection is not null)
                    {
                        await RejectAsync(id, isTool, new ToolFailure(rejection, "Request admission is full or rate-limited; cancel has a separate reserved channel."), token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                frame = new byte[bytes.Length + 1]; bytes.CopyTo(frame, 0); frame[^1] = (byte)'\n'; frameOffset = 0;
            }
            var copied = Math.Min(buffer.Length, frame.Length - frameOffset);
            frame.AsMemory(frameOffset, copied).CopyTo(buffer); frameOffset += copied;
            if (frameOffset == frame.Length) frame = null;
            return copied;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (token.IsCancellationRequested || admission.Stopping) { return 0; }
        catch (Exception error) { Failure = error; admission.Stop(); Console.Error.WriteLine("mcp-input-failure: " + error.GetType().Name + ": " + error.Message); throw; }
    }

    private async Task RejectAsync(RequestId id, bool isTool, Exception error, CancellationToken token)
    {
        // Rejection is one awaited SDK send, never a per-line detached task or queue.
        var sender = await transport.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
        JsonRpcMessage response = isTool
            ? new JsonRpcResponse { Id = id, Result = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(McpToolHost.Result(McpToolHost.Error(epoch, error)), McpJsonUtilities.DefaultOptions) }
            : new JsonRpcError { Id = id, Error = new JsonRpcErrorDetail { Code = (int)McpErrorCode.InvalidParams, Message = "Request rejected by bounded transport admission." } };
        using var budget = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(token);
        budget.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
        await sender.SendMessageAsync(response, budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
    internal void Stop() { admission.Stop(); io.Stop(); }
    internal async Task DrainAsync() { try { await io.DrainAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); } catch (OperationCanceledException) { } }
    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing) { if (disposing) { Stop(); io.Dispose(); } base.Dispose(disposing); }
}

internal sealed class BoundedOutputStream(Stream output, ProtocolAdmission admission) : NonSeekableStream
{
    private readonly OwnedConsoleIo io = new(output);
    private readonly MemoryStream message = new();
    internal Exception? Failure { get; private set; }
    internal bool IoTerminal => io.IsTerminal;
    internal Action? OnFailure { get; set; }
    public override bool CanRead => false;
    public override bool CanWrite => true;
    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    public override Task WriteAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken token) => WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count), token).AsTask();
    public override ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken token = default)
    {
        try
        {
            // After the SDK acquired its send lock, finish this complete frame even
            // if its request was cancelled. Only our owned I/O deadline may abort it.
            if (message.Length + buffer.Length > 1048577) throw new InvalidDataException("SDK response exceeds 1048576 bytes plus newline.");
            message.Write(buffer.Span);
            return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
        }
        catch (Exception error) { Fail(error); throw; }
    }
    public override async Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken token)
    {
        try
        {
            var bytes = message.ToArray();
            if (bytes.Length is 0 or > 1048577 || bytes[^1] != (byte)'\n') throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid outbound SDK message boundary.");
            using var budget = new CancellationTokenSource();
            budget.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
            await io.RunAsync(() => { output.Write(bytes); output.Flush(); return true; }, budget.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(bytes.AsMemory(0, bytes.Length - 1));
            if (document.RootElement.TryGetProperty("id", out var id)) admission.ResponseFlushed(ProtocolAdmission.Id(id));
            message.SetLength(0);
        }
        catch (Exception error) { Fail(error); throw; }
    }
    private void Fail(Exception error) { Failure ??= error; admission.Stop(); io.Stop(); OnFailure?.Invoke(); }
    internal async Task DrainAsync() { try { await io.DrainAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); } catch (OperationCanceledException) { } }
    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing) { if (disposing) { io.Dispose(); message.Dispose(); } base.Dispose(disposing); }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using MatrixDevice.Features;

namespace MatrixDevice.Mcp;

internal sealed record ImportedScript(Guid Reference, string Sha256, ScriptPackage Package, long Bytes, FileStream FrozenHandle);

internal sealed class ImportedScriptStore(string importRoot, string stagingDirectory) : IDisposable
{
    private readonly object gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, ImportedScript> scripts = [];
    private int reservations;
    private long reservedBytes;
    private bool disposed;
    private bool stopping;
    internal int CleanupFailures { get; private set; }
    internal void StopAccepting() { lock (gate) stopping = true; }

    internal ImportedScript Get(Guid reference)
    { lock (gate) return scripts.GetValueOrDefault(reference) ?? throw new ToolFailure("UNKNOWN_REFERENCE", "Unknown script reference for this server epoch."); }

    internal async Task<(ImportedScript Script, JsonObject Response)> ImportAsync(Guid epoch, string relativePath, string expectedHash, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (relativePath.Length > 4096 || Path.IsPathRooted(relativePath) || relativePath.Contains(':') || relativePath.Contains('/') || relativePath.Contains('%')
            || relativePath.Split('\\').Any(s => s.Length == 0 || s is "." or ".." || s.EndsWith('.') || s.EndsWith(' ') || s.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()) >= 0))
            throw new ToolFailure("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "relativePath must contain unambiguous root-relative Windows file segments.");
        if (expectedHash.Length != 64 || expectedHash.Any(c => !char.IsAsciiHexDigitLower(c))) throw new ToolFailure("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "sha256 must contain 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.");
        var full = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(importRoot, relativePath));
        if (!full.StartsWith(importRoot + "\\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) throw new ToolFailure("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "Import path escaped the authorized root.");
        using var sourceIdentity = StablePath.Open(full, false);
        using var source = new FileStream(sourceIdentity.Leaf, FileAccess.Read);
        var size = source.Length;
        if (size is <= 0 or > 16777216) throw new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Archive byte limit is 16777216.");
        lock (gate)
        {
            ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(disposed, this);
            if (stopping) throw new ToolFailure("CANCELLED", "Server is stopping; no new script references are accepted.");
            if (scripts.Count + reservations >= 16 || reservedBytes + size > 67108864) throw new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Immutable script reference or staging byte capacity reached.");
            reservations++; reservedBytes += size;
        }
        var path = Path.Combine(stagingDirectory, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".zip");
        FileStream? frozen = null;
        var committed = false;
        var created = false;
        string? fileIdentity = null;
        try
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            frozen = new FileStream(path, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.Read, 65536, FileOptions.Asynchronous);
            created = true; fileIdentity = StablePath.Identity(frozen.SafeFileHandle);
            using var digest = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
            var buffer = new byte[65536]; long copied = 0;
            while (true)
            {
                var read = await source.ReadAsync(buffer, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (read == 0) break;
                copied += read;
                if (copied > size || copied > 16777216) throw new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Source changed size or exceeded the archive byte limit.");
                digest.AppendData(buffer.AsSpan(0, read));
                await frozen.WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(0, read), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            if (copied != size) throw new ToolFailure("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "Source size changed while freezing.");
            await frozen.FlushAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var hash = Convert.ToHexStringLower(digest.GetHashAndReset());
            if (!string.Equals(hash, expectedHash, StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new ToolFailure("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "Archive SHA256 mismatch.");
            frozen.Dispose(); frozen = null;
            // File.OpenRead in the original importer cannot share an existing writer.
            // Reopen read-only, then prove the same file identity and complete bytes.
            frozen = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 65536, FileOptions.Asynchronous);
            if (StablePath.Identity(frozen.SafeFileHandle) != fileIdentity || frozen.Length != size
                || Convert.ToHexStringLower(await SHA256.HashDataAsync(frozen, ct).ConfigureAwait(false)) != hash)
                throw new ToolFailure("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "Frozen file identity or bytes changed during the read-only handoff.");
            frozen.Position = 0;
            // The legacy importer reads only our immutable, write-locked copy.
            var package = await Task.Run(() => ScriptPackageService.Load(path), CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(false);
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var manifest = package.Manifest;
            var metadata = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(new { packageId = manifest.Id, packageVersion = manifest.Version, displayName = manifest.Name }, StrictJson.Options);
            if (metadata.Length > 8192) throw new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Manifest response metadata exceeds 8192 serialized bytes.");
            var reference = Guid.NewGuid();
            var body = StrictJson.Node(new
            {
                ok = true, serverEpoch = epoch, scriptRef = reference, sha256 = hash,
                packageId = manifest.Id, packageVersion = manifest.Version, displayName = manifest.Name,
                stepCount = package.Steps.Count, parameterCount = package.Parameters.Count,
                bindingVersion = package.ExecutionContract?.Version,
                parameterKeys = package.Parameters.Select(p => p.Key).ToArray(),
                retention = "process-lifetime; immutable; no-execution-authority"
            });
            if (JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(body, StrictJson.Options).Length > 65536) throw new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Complete parameter key list exceeds the response byte budget.");
            var script = new ImportedScript(reference, hash, package, size, frozen);
            lock (gate)
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(disposed, this);
                if (stopping) throw new ToolFailure("CANCELLED", "Server stopped before script reference registration.");
                scripts.Add(reference, script);
                committed = true;
            }
            return (script, body);
        }
        finally
        {
            var cleaned = !created;
            if (!committed)
            {
                frozen?.Dispose();
                if (created) cleaned = StablePath.DeleteOwned(path, fileIdentity);
                if (!cleaned)
                {
                    lock (gate) { CleanupFailures++; stopping = true; }
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("mcp-staging-cleanup-refused: identity not proven; byte reservation retained; imports stopped.");
                }
            }
            lock (gate) { reservations--; if (!committed && cleaned) reservedBytes -= size; }
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (disposed) return;
            disposed = true;
            foreach (var script in scripts.Values) script.FrozenHandle.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Features;
using MatrixDevice.Host;
using ModelContextProtocol;
using ModelContextProtocol.Protocol;
using ModelContextProtocol.Server;

namespace MatrixDevice.Mcp;

internal sealed class McpToolHost(MatrixRuntime runtime, McpPolicy policy, ImportedScriptStore scripts, Guid epoch)
{
    internal static readonly string[] Names = ["matrix.capabilities", "matrix.devices.list", "matrix.scripts.import", "matrix.jobs.start", "matrix.jobs.get", "matrix.jobs.cancel"];
    private static readonly string[] Types = ["Capabilities", "DevicesList", "ScriptImport", "JobStart", "JobGet", "JobCancel"];
    private static readonly string[] Descriptions =
    [
        "查看本进程能力、授权范围与限额；真实设备写入尚未启用。",
        "列出授权目录中的设备与当前身份，不扫描网络、不启动模拟器。",
        "校验并冻结授权导入根中的脚本包，只创建引用，不执行脚本。",
        "按防重 operationId 向一个明确目标接纳脚本作业，返回原调度器 JobId。",
        "按 JobId 读取原任务状态、实际结果及有界日志。",
        "仅请求取消指定 JobId，不影响其他任务，不回滚已经发送的操作。"
    ];
    private readonly OperationLedger ledger = new(runtime, policy, scripts, epoch);
    private readonly object handlerGate = new();
    private int handlers;
    private bool stopping;
    private TaskCompletionSource? drained;
    private static readonly JsonObject Definitions = ReadDefinitions();
    internal void StopAccepting() { lock (handlerGate) stopping = true; ledger.StopAccepting(); scripts.StopAccepting(); }

    private static JsonObject ReadDefinitions()
    {
        using var stream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream("MatrixDevice.Mcp.Schemas.json")!;
        return JsonNode.Parse(stream)!["$defs"]!.AsObject();
    }

    internal ListToolsResult ListTools()
    {
        var tools = new List<Tool>();
        for (var i = 0; i < Names.Length; i++)
        {
            JsonElement Schema(string suffix) => JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new JsonObject
            {
                ["type"] = "object", ["$ref"] = "#/$defs/" + Types[i] + suffix,
                ["$defs"] = Definitions.DeepClone(), ["$schema"] = "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
            });
            tools.Add(new Tool { Name = Names[i], Description = Descriptions[i], InputSchema = Schema("Input"), OutputSchema = Schema("Output"), Annotations = new ToolAnnotations { ReadOnlyHint = i is 0 or 1 or 4, DestructiveHint = i is 3 or 5, IdempotentHint = i is not 2 } });
        }
        return new() { Tools = tools };
    }

    internal async ValueTask<CallToolResult> CallAsync(RequestContext<CallToolRequestParams> context, CancellationToken requestToken)
    {
        var parameters = context.Params ?? throw new McpProtocolException("Tool call parameters are required.", McpErrorCode.InvalidParams);
        if (!Names.Contains(parameters.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)) throw new McpProtocolException("Unknown tool.", McpErrorCode.InvalidParams);
        lock (handlerGate)
        {
            if (stopping) return Result(Error(epoch, new ToolFailure("CANCELLED", "Server is stopping.")));
            handlers++;
        }
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(requestToken);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));
        try
        {
            var argumentsBytes = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(parameters.Arguments ?? new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>(), StrictJson.Options);
            if (argumentsBytes.Length > 65536) throw new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Tool arguments exceed 65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes.");
            using var validated = StrictJson.Parse(argumentsBytes, 32);
            var input = validated.RootElement;
            deadline.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            JsonObject body;
            switch (parameters.Name)
            {
                case "matrix.capabilities":
                    StrictJson.Object(input, []);
                    var limits = new JsonObject();
                    foreach (var item in Definitions["Limits"]!["properties"]!.AsObject()) limits[item.Key] = item.Value!["const"]!.DeepClone();
                    body = StrictJson.Node(new
                    {
                        ok = true, serverEpoch = epoch, contractVersion = "matrix-mcp/1", protocolVersion = "2025-11-25", mode = "demo",
                        scopes = policy.Scopes, authorizedSerials = policy.Serials, realWritesEnabled = false,
                        supportedTools = Names, supportedActions = new[] { "launch", "launchapp", "wait", "sleep", "click", "swipe" },
                        unsupportedCapabilities = new[] { "real-writes", "http", "capture", "host-exec", "instance-lifecycle", "apk-management", "restart-resume", "protocol-tasks" },
                        limits, retention = "process-lifetime; terminal-jobs-oldest-completion-100; no-restart-resume"
                    });
                    break;
                case "matrix.devices.list":
                    StrictJson.Object(input, []); policy.Require("devices.read");
                    body = StrictJson.Node(new
                    {
                        ok = true, serverEpoch = epoch, mode = "demo", snapshotUtc = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
                        devices = runtime.Devices.Snapshot.Where(d => policy.Serials.Contains(d.Serial, StringComparer.Ordinal)).Select(d => new
                        {
                            target = new { serial = d.Serial, generation = d.Generation.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), transportId = d.TransportId },
                            instanceIndex = (int?)null, displayName = StrictJson.Short(d.Name, 256).Text, online = d.Online,
                            writeAllowed = d.Online && policy.Scopes.Contains("jobs.start", StringComparer.Ordinal)
                        }).ToArray()
                    });
                    break;
                case "matrix.scripts.import":
                    StrictJson.Object(input, ["serverEpoch", "relativePath", "sha256"], "serverEpoch", "relativePath", "sha256");
                    policy.Require("scripts.import"); ledger.RequireEpoch(input);
                    body = (await scripts.ImportAsync(epoch, StrictJson.String(input, "relativePath", 4096), StrictJson.String(input, "sha256", 64), deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false)).Response;
                    break;
                case "matrix.jobs.start": body = ledger.Start(input, deadline.Token); break;
                case "matrix.jobs.get":
                    StrictJson.Object(input, ["serverEpoch", "jobId", "logLimit"], "serverEpoch", "jobId");
                    policy.Require("jobs.read"); ledger.RequireEpoch(input);
                    body = GetJob(StrictJson.Uuid(input, "jobId"), StrictJson.Integer(input, "logLimit", 0, 100, 50));
                    break;
                case "matrix.jobs.cancel":
                    StrictJson.Object(input, ["serverEpoch", "jobId"], "serverEpoch", "jobId");
                    policy.Require("jobs.cancel"); ledger.RequireEpoch(input);
                    body = ledger.Cancel(StrictJson.Uuid(input, "jobId"));
                    break;
                default: throw new InvalidOperationException();
            }
            return Result(body);
        }
        catch (Exception error)
        {
            if (error is OperationCanceledException && !requestToken.IsCancellationRequested) error = new ToolFailure("DEADLINE_EXCEEDED", "Tool request exceeded its 30-second budget before completing.");
            return Result(Error(epoch, error));
        }
        finally
        {
            lock (handlerGate) { handlers--; if (handlers == 0) drained?.TrySetResult(); }
        }
    }

    private JsonObject GetJob(Guid id, int logLimit)
    {
        var owned = ledger.Get(id);
        var status = runtime.Scripts.GetJob(id) ?? throw new ToolFailure("UNKNOWN_REFERENCE", "Job is not retained.");
        var allLogs = runtime.Scripts.GetJobLogs(id);
        var error = status.Error is null ? (Text: (string?)null, Truncated: false) : StrictJson.Short(status.Error, 2048);
        var logs = allLogs.TakeLast(logLimit).Select(entry =>
        {
            var message = StrictJson.Short(entry.Message, 2048);
            return StrictJson.Node(new { timestampUtc = entry.Timestamp, message = message.Text, truncated = message.Truncated });
        }).ToList();
        var body = StrictJson.Node(new
        {
            ok = true, serverEpoch = epoch, snapshotUtc = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
            job = new
            {
                jobId = id, operationId = owned.OperationId, target = OperationLedger.Target(owned.Target), scriptRef = owned.Script.Reference,
                sha256 = owned.Script.Sha256, packageId = status.PackageId, packageVersion = status.PackageVersion,
                state = status.State.ToString(), stepIndex = status.StepIndex, stepCount = status.StepCount,
                startedUtc = status.StartedUtc, endedUtc = status.EndedUtc, error = error.Text, result = status.Result,
                errorTruncated = error.Truncated, resultTruncatedForResponse = false, terminalReason = OperationLedger.Reason(owned, status)
            },
            availableLogs = allLogs.Count, logWindowLimit = 500, omittedLogCount = allLogs.Count - logs.Count, logs
        });
        while (Bytes(body) > 65536 && body["logs"]!.AsArray().Count > 0)
        {
            body["logs"]!.AsArray().RemoveAt(0);
            body["omittedLogCount"] = allLogs.Count - body["logs"]!.AsArray().Count;
        }
        var originalResult = status.Result;
        if (Bytes(body) > 65536 && originalResult is not null)
        {
            var runes = originalResult.EnumerateRunes().ToArray(); var low = 0; var high = runes.Length;
            body["job"]!["resultTruncatedForResponse"] = true;
            while (low < high)
            {
                var mid = (low + high + 1) / 2;
                body["job"]!["result"] = string.Concat(runes.Take(mid).Select(r => r.ToString())) + "[MCP响应预算截断]";
                if (Bytes(body) <= 65536) low = mid; else high = mid - 1;
            }
            body["job"]!["result"] = string.Concat(runes.Take(low).Select(r => r.ToString())) + "[MCP响应预算截断]";
        }
        return body;
    }

    internal static int Bytes(JsonObject body) => JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(body, StrictJson.Options).Length;
    internal static CallToolResult Result(JsonObject body)
    {
        if (Bytes(body) > 65536) body = Error(body["serverEpoch"]!.GetValue<Guid>(), new ToolFailure("CAPACITY", "Business response exceeds 65536 serialized bytes."));
        var text = JsonSerializer.Serialize(body, StrictJson.Options);
        return new() { IsError = !body["ok"]!.GetValue<bool>(), StructuredContent = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(body, StrictJson.Options), Content = [new TextContentBlock { Text = text }] };
    }

    internal static JsonObject Error(Guid epoch, Exception error)
    {
        var code = error switch
        {
            ToolFailure failure => failure.Code,
            OperationCanceledException => "CANCELLED",
            DeviceException device => device.Code switch { 1007 => "INVALID_ARGUMENT", 2001 => "NOT_SUPPORTED", 1003 => "IDENTITY_CHANGED", _ => "INVALID_ARGUMENT" },
            JsonException or ArgumentException or InvalidDataException => "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
            IOException => "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
            _ => "INTERNAL"
        };
        var safeMessage = error is IOException ? "File access failed within the authorized import or staging boundary." : error.Message;
        var message = StrictJson.Short(code == "INTERNAL" ? "Internal MCP operation failure. See local diagnostics." : safeMessage, 2048);
        if (code == "INTERNAL") Console.Error.WriteLine("mcp-internal: " + error.GetType().Name);
        return StrictJson.Node(new { ok = false, serverEpoch = epoch, error = new { code, message = message.Text, errorTruncated = message.Truncated, projectCode = error is DeviceException original ? (int?)original.Code : null, retryable = false } });
    }

    internal async Task<object[]> StopAsync()
    {
        Task wait;
        lock (handlerGate) { stopping = true; wait = handlers == 0 ? Task.CompletedTask : (drained ??= new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)).Task; }
        // Stop new submissions first; cancellation follows the original JobId, not serial.
        var drain = ledger.DrainAsync();
        await wait.ConfigureAwait(false);
        return await drain.ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
}
```
