```csharp
    private static ScriptPackage Package() => new() { Manifest = new() { Id = "write-test", Name = "own Demo write", Version = "1" }, Steps = [new() { Action = "click", Value = "20,30" }] };
    private static string Temp() { var path = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "matrix-write-tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")); Directory.CreateDirectory(path); return path; }
    private static int Port() { var listener = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, 0); listener.Start(); var port = ((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port; listener.Stop(); return port; }
    private static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }
    private static bool Reject(Action action) { try { action(); return false; } catch (DeviceException error) when (error.Status == 409 && error.Code == 1003) { return true; } }
    private static async Task<bool> RejectAsync(Func<Task> action) { try { await action().WaitAsync(Step); return false; } catch (DeviceException error) when (error.Status == 409 && error.Code == 1003) { return true; } }
    private sealed class ContractMissing(string member) : Exception("CONTRACT-NOT-IMPLEMENTED: public " + member + " is absent; this is not a reproduced backend behavior.");
    private static Task Contract(string name, Action action)
    {
        if (unresolved is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException("NOT-RUN: " + unresolved);
        try { action(); Console.WriteLine("DEVICE_WRITE_CASE " + JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name, classification = "CONTRACT-PASS", pending = 0 })); return Task.CompletedTask; }
        catch (Exception error) { Console.WriteLine("DEVICE_WRITE_CASE " + JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name, classification = error is ContractMissing ? "CONTRACT-NOT-IMPLEMENTED" : "PRODUCT-FAIL", error = error.ToString(), pending = 0 })); throw; }
    }
    private static async Task Run(string name, Func<Probe, Task> action)
    {
        if (unresolved is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException("NOT-RUN: " + unresolved);
        var probe = await Probe.Create(); Exception? primary = null, cleanup = null;
        try { await action(probe); } catch (Exception error) { primary = error; }
        try { await probe.DisposeAsync(); } catch (Exception error) { cleanup = error; unresolved = name + " cleanup was not terminal: " + error; retained.Add(probe); }
        Console.WriteLine("DEVICE_WRITE_CASE " + JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name, gatePresent = probe.GatePresent, observations = probe.Observations, calls = probe.Backend.Calls.ToArray(), tasks = probe.Tasks.Select(task => task.Status.ToString()), backendTasks = probe.Backend.Tasks.Select(task => task.Status.ToString()), cleanupTasks = probe.CleanupTasks.Select(task => task.Status.ToString()), cleanupError = cleanup?.ToString(), primaryError = primary?.ToString(), pending = probe.Tasks.Concat(probe.Backend.Tasks).Concat(probe.CleanupTasks).Distinct().Count(task => !task.IsCompleted) }));
        if (primary is not null && cleanup is not null) throw new AggregateException(primary, cleanup);
        if (primary is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(primary).Throw();
        if (cleanup is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(cleanup).Throw();
    }
    private sealed class Gate(object value)
    {
        internal object Value => value;
        internal static Gate? Optional() { var type = typeof(IDeviceBackend).Assembly.GetType("MatrixDevice.Core.DeviceWriteCoordinator"); return type is null ? null : new(Activator.CreateInstance(type)!); }
        internal static Gate Required() => Optional() ?? throw new ContractMissing("DeviceWriteCoordinator");
        internal IDisposable Acquire(IEnumerable<string> serials) => (IDisposable)Invoke("Acquire", [typeof(IEnumerable<string>)], [serials])!;
        internal IDisposable All() => (IDisposable)Invoke("AcquireAll", [], [])!;
        internal bool Busy(string serial) => (bool)Invoke("IsBusy", [typeof(string)], [serial])!;
        private object? Invoke(string name, Type[] signature, object?[] arguments)
        {
            var method = value.GetType().GetMethod(name, signature) ?? throw new ContractMissing(name);
            try { return method.Invoke(value, arguments); } catch (TargetInvocationException error) when (error.InnerException is not null) { ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(error.InnerException).Throw(); throw; }
        }
        internal static T Construct<T>(Gate? gate, params object[] original)
        {
            if (gate is null) return (T)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(T), original)!;
            var constructor = typeof(T).GetConstructors().SingleOrDefault(item => item.GetParameters().Length == original.Length + 1 && item.GetParameters()[^1].ParameterType == gate.Value.GetType()) ?? throw new ContractMissing(typeof(T).Name + " shared gate constructor");
            return (T)constructor.Invoke(original.Append(gate.Value).ToArray());
        }
    }
    private sealed class Probe : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        internal readonly BlockingBackend Backend = new();
        internal DeviceCatalog Catalog = null!;
        internal ScriptScheduler Scheduler = null!;
        internal InputCoordinator Input = null!;
        internal ApiServiceManager Api = null!;
        internal RollingLog Log = null!;
        internal readonly HttpClient Http = new() { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10) };
        internal readonly List<Task> Tasks = [];
        internal readonly List<Task> CleanupTasks = [];
        internal readonly List<object> Observations = [];
        internal bool GatePresent;
        internal string Url = "";
        internal static async Task<Probe> Create()
        {
            var p = new Probe();
            try
            {
                var gate = Gate.Optional(); p.GatePresent = gate is not null;
                p.Catalog = new(p.Backend); await p.Catalog.RefreshAsync();
                p.Scheduler = Gate.Construct<ScriptScheduler>(gate, p.Backend, p.Catalog, true);
                p.Input = Gate.Construct<InputCoordinator>(gate, p.Catalog, p.Backend);
                p.Log = new(Temp()); p.Api = Gate.Construct<ApiServiceManager>(gate, p.Catalog, p.Backend, new AutomationService(p.Backend, p.Catalog), p.Log);
                p.Api.ScriptWriteBusy = serial => p.Scheduler.GetStatus(serial).State is ScriptRunState.Running or ScriptRunState.Cancelling;
                p.Api.AnyScriptWriteBusy = () => p.Catalog.Snapshot.Any(device => p.Api.ScriptWriteBusy(device.Serial));
                await p.Api.StartAutomatorAsync(Port()); p.Url = "http://127.0.0.1:" + p.Api.RunningAutomatorPort; return p;
            }
            catch (Exception primary)
            {
                try { await p.DisposeAsync(); } catch (Exception cleanup) { unresolved = "Probe construction cleanup failed: " + cleanup; retained.Add(p); throw new AggregateException(primary, cleanup); }
                throw;
            }
        }
        internal T Track<T>(T task) where T : Task { Tasks.Add(task); return task; }
        internal Task<HttpResponseMessage> Post(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => Track(Http.PostAsJsonAsync(Url + "/input/tap", new { serial, x = 20, y = 30 }, ct));
        internal ScriptJobHandle Submit(string serial) { var info = Catalog.GetRequired(serial); var handle = Scheduler.SubmitJob(new(serial, info.Generation, info.TransportId, true), Package()); Track(handle.Completion); return handle; }
        internal InputSnapshot Snapshot(InputKind kind, string[] targets) { var info = Catalog.GetRequired(A); return new() { SourceSerial = A, SourceGeneration = info.Generation, Generation = Input.CurrentGeneration, Kind = kind, TargetSerials = targets, SourceWidth = info.Width, SourceHeight = info.Height, X = 20, Y = 30, GestureId = 42 }; }
        internal void Observe(object observation) => Observations.Add(observation);
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            Backend.Release.TrySetResult();
            var requests = Task.WhenAll(Tasks); CleanupTasks.Add(requests);
            try { await requests.WaitAsync(Drain); } catch when (Tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted)) { }
            var backend = Task.WhenAll(Backend.Tasks); CleanupTasks.Add(backend);
            try { await backend.WaitAsync(Drain); } catch when (Backend.Tasks.All(task => task.IsCompleted)) { }
            var errors = new List<Exception>();
            async Task Close(Func<Task> dispose)
            {
                Task original;
                try { original = dispose(); CleanupTasks.Add(original); }
                catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); return; }
                try { await original.WaitAsync(Step); }
                catch (Exception error)
                {
                    if (!original.IsCompleted) throw new InvalidOperationException("CLEANUP-FAIL: original disposal task is still pending; later components will not be released.", error);
                    errors.Add(error);
                }
            }
            if (Api is not null) await Close(() => Api.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            if (Input is not null) await Close(() => Input.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            if (Scheduler is not null) await Close(() => Scheduler.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            await Close(() => Backend.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            if (Log is not null) await Close(() => Log.DisposeAsync().AsTask());
            foreach (var response in Tasks.OfType<Task<HttpResponseMessage>>().Where(task => task.IsCompletedSuccessfully)) response.Result.Dispose();
            Http.Dispose(); if (errors.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("CLEANUP-FAIL", errors);
        }
    }
    private sealed record BackendCall(string Lane, string Serial);
    private sealed class BlockingBackend : IDeviceBackend, IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend
    {
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend inner = new();
        private string? holdLane, holdSerial; private int held;
        internal bool ThrowNext;
        internal ConcurrentQueue<BackendCall> Calls { get; } = new();
        internal ConcurrentBag<Task> Tasks { get; } = [];
        internal TaskCompletionSource Entered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal TaskCompletionSource Release { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal TaskCompletionSource CancelObserved { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal TaskCompletionSource PinnedEntered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal TaskCompletionSource Drained { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal TaskCompletionSource BDrained { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal TaskCompletionSource ADrained { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        internal void Hold(string lane, string serial) { holdLane = lane; holdSerial = serial; }
        internal int Count(string lane, string serial) => Calls.Count(call => call.Lane == lane && call.Serial == serial);
        internal async Task<string> Taps(string serial) => (await inner.DumpAsync(serial)).ChildNodeList[1].Text!;
        private Task Tap(string lane, string serial, Func<CancellationToken, Task> actual, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var task = Core(); Tasks.Add(task); return task;
            async Task Core()
            {
                Calls.Enqueue(new(lane, serial)); if (lane == "pinned") PinnedEntered.TrySetResult();
                if (ThrowNext) { ThrowNext = false; throw new IOException("own Demo injected backend failure"); }
                var block = lane == holdLane && serial == holdSerial && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref held, 1, 0) == 0;
                try
                {
                    if (block) { using var registration = ct.Register(() => CancelObserved.TrySetResult()); Entered.TrySetResult(); await Release.Task; }
                    await actual(block ? CancellationToken.None : ct); if (serial == B) BDrained.TrySetResult();
                    if (serial == A) ADrained.TrySetResult();
                }
                finally { if (block) Drained.TrySetResult(); }
            }
        }
        public IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands BindIdentity(DeviceCatalog catalog) => new Pinned(this, ((IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend)inner).BindIdentity(catalog));
        private sealed class Pinned(BlockingBackend owner, IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands commands) : IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands
        {
            public bool IsDemo => commands.IsDemo;
            public Task TapAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => owner.Tap("pinned", target.Serial, token => commands.TapAsync(target, x, y, token), ct);
            public Task SwipeAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int duration, CancellationToken ct = default) => commands.SwipeAsync(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration, ct);
            public Task<string> StartAppAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => commands.StartAppAsync(target, packageName, ct);
        }
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => Tap("legacy", serial, token => inner.TapAsync(serial, x, y, token), ct);
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.DiscoverAsync(ct);
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.DumpAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ShellAsync(serial, command, useRoot, ct);
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int duration, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SwipeAsync(serial, x1, y1, x2, y2, duration, ct);
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.KeyEventAsync(serial, code, ct);
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TextAsync(serial, text, ct);
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.StartAppAsync(serial, packageName, activity, ct);
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.StopAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ClearAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ListAppsAsync(serial, showSystem, needVersion, ct);
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string path, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.InstallAsync(serial, path, ct);
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.UninstallAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string path, string remote, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PushAsync(serial, path, remote, progress, ct);
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remote, string path, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PullAsync(serial, remote, path, progress, ct);
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SetNodeTextAsync(serial, selector, text, ct);
        public ValueTask DisposeAsync() => inner.DisposeAsync();
    }
}
```

```csharp
    private static async Task ProcessReplacementAsync()
    {
        var directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "MatrixDevice.Tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")); Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        async Task<Process> Start(int port, string receipt)
        {
            var info = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath!) { UseShellExecute = false, CreateNoWindow = true, WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden, RedirectStandardOutput = true, RedirectStandardError = true };
            if (string.Equals(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(Environment.ProcessPath), "dotnet", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) info.ArgumentList.Add(typeof(ExistingAdbTests).Assembly.Location);
            foreach (var value in new[] { "--adb-owned-test-server", port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), receipt }) info.ArgumentList.Add(value);
            var child = Process.Start(info)!;
            try { var ready = await child.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync().WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)); Assert(int.TryParse(ready, out var actual) && actual == port, "Owned fixture did not become ready."); return child; }
            catch { if (!child.HasExited) child.Kill(false); await child.WaitForExitAsync(); child.Dispose(); throw; }
        }
        async Task Stop(Process child) { if (!child.HasExited) child.Kill(false); await child.WaitForExitAsync(); child.Dispose(); }
        var listener = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, 0); listener.Start(); var port = ((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port; listener.Stop();
        var first = await Start(port, Path.Combine(directory, "first.txt")); Process? second = null;
        try
        {
            await using var old = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings { AdbAllowedSerials = ["allowed"] }, new(IPAddress.Loopback, port));
            await old.DiscoverAsync(); await Stop(first); first = null!;
            var receipt = Path.Combine(directory, "second.txt"); second = await Start(port, receipt);
            await Expect(409, () => old.KeyEventAsync("allowed", 3)); await Expect(409, () => old.DiscoverAsync());
            await using var inherited = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings(), new(IPAddress.Loopback, port));
            inherited.InheritServerEpoch(old);
            await Expect(409, () => inherited.ListRegisteredDevicesAsync());
            Assert(!File.Exists(receipt) || new FileInfo(receipt).Length == 0, "Replacement server received a request from the old client.");
            await using var fresh = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings { AdbAllowedSerials = ["allowed"] }, new(IPAddress.Loopback, port));
            Assert((await fresh.DiscoverAsync()).Single().Online, "Fresh discovery could not establish a new epoch.");
        }
        finally { if (first is not null) await Stop(first); if (second is not null) await Stop(second); }
    }
    private static async Task InvalidIdentityAsync()
    {
        await using var server = new FakeAdbServer();
        await using var backend = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings { AdbAllowedSerials = ["allowed"] }, server.Endpoint);
        var handler = new CaptureHandler();
        backend.RegisterAgent("allowed", new PhoneAgentClient("http://127.0.0.1:9999", handler));
        await Expect(503, () => backend.KeyEventAsync("allowed", 3));
        await Expect(503, () => backend.SetNodeTextAsync("allowed", new(), "text"));
        Assert(server.Requests.Count == 0 && handler.Path.Length == 0, "Cold guest action performed I/O");
        foreach (var identity in new[] { "", "0", "4294967296", "invalid", "offline", "absent" })
        {
            server.InvalidIdentity = null; await backend.DiscoverAsync();
            server.InvalidIdentity = identity;
            var devices = await backend.DiscoverAsync();
            Assert(devices.All(device => !device.Online), "Invalid identity remained Ready");
            var requests = server.Requests.Count;
            await Expect(503, () => backend.KeyEventAsync("allowed", 3));
            await Expect(503, () => backend.SetNodeTextAsync("allowed", new(), "text"));
            Assert(server.Requests.Count == requests && handler.Path.Length == 0, "Invalidated guest identity performed I/O");
        }
    }
    private static async Task ReconnectAsync()
    {
        await using var server = new FakeAdbServer();
        await using var backend = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings { AdbAllowedSerials = ["allowed"] }, server.Endpoint);
        var catalog = new DeviceCatalog(backend); await catalog.RefreshAsync();
        var generation = catalog.GetRequired("allowed").Generation;
        var blocked = backend.ShellAsync("allowed", "gated"); await server.GateEntered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
        var key = backend.KeyEventAsync("allowed", 3);
        server.TransportId = 2;
        var refresh = catalog.RefreshAsync();
        try
        {
            var timer = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            while (backend.ObservedTransportId("allowed") != 2)
            {
                if (timer.Elapsed > TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2)) throw new TimeoutException("New transport not observed");
                await Task.Delay(5);
            }
        }
        finally { server.GateRelease.TrySetResult(); }
        await blocked;
        await Expect(409, () => key);
        await refresh;
        Assert(catalog.GetRequired("allowed").Generation > generation, "Transport reconnect retained generation");
        Assert(!server.Requests.Any(request => request.Contains("input keyevent", StringComparison.Ordinal) || request.StartsWith("host:transport:", StringComparison.Ordinal)), "Stale input or serial fallback emitted");
    }
    private static void Assert(bool value, string message) { if (!value) throw new Exception(message); }
    private static async Task Expect(int status, Func<Task> action)
    {
        try { await action(); }
        catch (DeviceException ex) when (ex.Status == status) { return; }
        throw new Exception($"Expected DeviceException status={status}");
    }
}

internal sealed class FakeAdbServer : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TcpListener listener;
    private readonly string? receipt;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource stop = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentBag<Task> clients = [];
    private readonly Task accepting;
    public ConcurrentQueue<string> Requests { get; } = [];
    public string Version { get; set; } = "0029";
    public string LaunchOutput { get; set; } = "Starting: Intent\nStatus: ok\n";
    public uint TransportId { get; set; } = 1;
    public string? InvalidIdentity { get; set; }
    public TaskCompletionSource GateEntered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    public TaskCompletionSource GateRelease { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    public bool TruncatePull { get; set; }
    public bool TruncateStat { get; set; }
    public bool EarlyDone { get; set; }
    public byte[] Png { get; } = PngImage.Create(4, 3, (x, y) => ((byte)(x * 20), (byte)(y * 40), (byte)90));
    private byte[] file = [];
    public IPEndPoint Endpoint => (IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint;
    public FakeAdbServer(int port = 0, string? receipt = null) { this.receipt = receipt; listener = new(IPAddress.Loopback, port); listener.Start(); accepting = AcceptAsync(); }
    private async Task AcceptAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var client = await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(stop.Token);
                clients.Add(HandleAsync(client));
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        catch (ObjectDisposedException) when (stop.IsCancellationRequested) { }
    }
    private async Task HandleAsync(TcpClient client)
    {
        using (client)
        {
            try
            {
                var stream = client.GetStream();
                while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    var prefix = new byte[4]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(prefix, stop.Token);
                    var length = int.Parse(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(prefix), NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    var body = new byte[length]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(body, stop.Token);
                    var request = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body); Requests.Enqueue(request);
                    if (receipt is not null) await File.AppendAllTextAsync(receipt, request + "\n", stop.Token);
                    if (request == "host:version") { await HostAsync(stream, Version); return; }
                    if (request == "host:devices-l")
                    {
                        var allowed = InvalidIdentity == "absent" ? "" :
                            $"allowed\t{(InvalidIdentity == "offline" ? "offline" : "device")} model:Test" +
                            (InvalidIdentity == "" ? "" : " transport_id:" + (InvalidIdentity is null or "offline" ? TransportId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : InvalidIdentity)) + "\n";
                        await HostAsync(stream, allowed + "private\tdevice model:Private transport_id:99\n"); return;
                    }
                    if (request.StartsWith("host:transport-id:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { await stream.WriteAsync("OKAY"u8.ToArray(), stop.Token); continue; }
                    await stream.WriteAsync("OKAY"u8.ToArray(), stop.Token);
                    if (request == "sync:") { await SyncAsync(stream); return; }
                    if (request.StartsWith("exec:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { await stream.WriteAsync(Png, stop.Token); return; }
                    if (!request.StartsWith("shell,v2,raw:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new IOException("Unexpected fixture request: " + request);
                    var closeInput = new byte[5]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(closeInput, stop.Token);
                    var command = request[13..];
                    if (command == "gated") { GateEntered.TrySetResult(); await GateRelease.Task.WaitAsync(stop.Token); }
                    if (command == "blocked") { await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, stop.Token); return; }
                    if (command == "truncated") { await stream.WriteAsync(new byte[] { 1, 20, 0, 0, 0, 1 }, stop.Token); return; }
                    if (command == "huge") { var header = new byte[5]; header[0] = 1; BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(1), AdbDeviceBackend.MaximumStdoutBytes + 1); await stream.WriteAsync(header, stop.Token); return; }
                    var text = command.StartsWith("cmd package resolve-activity ", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "priority=0 isDefault=false\ncom.matrix.test/.LauncherAlias\n" : command.StartsWith("am start -W ", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? LaunchOutput : command switch { "getprop" => "[ro.product.brand]: [Fixture]\n[ro.product.model]: [Test]\n[ro.build.version.release]: [14]\n", "wm size" => "Physical size: 4x3\n", "dumpsys input" => "SurfaceOrientation: 0\n", _ => "fixture\n" };
                    await ShellPacketAsync(stream, command == "fail" ? (byte)2 : (byte)1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text));
                    await ShellPacketAsync(stream, 3, [command == "fail" ? (byte)7 : (byte)0]);
                    return;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException) { }
        }
    }
    private async Task HostAsync(Stream stream, string value)
    {
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value);
        await stream.WriteAsync(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("OKAY" + bytes.Length.ToString("X4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), stop.Token);
        await stream.WriteAsync(bytes, stop.Token);
    }
    private async Task ShellPacketAsync(Stream stream, byte channel, byte[] value)
    {
        var header = new byte[5]; header[0] = channel; BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(1), value.Length);
        await stream.WriteAsync(header, stop.Token); await stream.WriteAsync(value, stop.Token);
    }
    private async Task SyncAsync(Stream stream)
    {
        using var upload = new MemoryStream();
        while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var header = new byte[8]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, stop.Token);
            var command = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(header, 0, 4); var length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
            if (command == "DONE") { file = upload.ToArray(); await SyncPacketAsync(stream, "OKAY", []); continue; }
            if (command == "QUIT") return;
            var bytes = new byte[length]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(bytes, stop.Token);
            if (command == "DATA") { await upload.WriteAsync(bytes, stop.Token); continue; }
            if (command == "SEND") continue;
            if (command == "STAT")
            {
                if (TruncateStat) { await stream.WriteAsync("STAT"u8.ToArray(), stop.Token); return; }
                var response = new byte[16]; "STAT"u8.CopyTo(response); BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(response.AsSpan(4), 33206); BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(response.AsSpan(8), file.Length);
                await stream.WriteAsync(response, stop.Token); continue;
            }
            if (command == "RECV")
            {
                if (EarlyDone) { await SyncPacketAsync(stream, "DATA", file.Take(100).ToArray()); await SyncPacketAsync(stream, "DONE", []); continue; }
                for (var offset = 0; offset < file.Length; offset += 65536)
                    await SyncPacketAsync(stream, "DATA", file.AsSpan(offset, Math.Min(65536, file.Length - offset)).ToArray());
                if (TruncatePull) { await stream.WriteAsync("DONE"u8.ToArray(), stop.Token); return; }
                await SyncPacketAsync(stream, "DONE", []); continue;
            }
            throw new IOException("Unexpected sync command: " + command);
        }
    }
    private async Task SyncPacketAsync(Stream stream, string command, byte[] value)
    {
        var header = new byte[8]; Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(command).CopyTo(header, 0); BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(4), value.Length);
        await stream.WriteAsync(header, stop.Token); await stream.WriteAsync(value, stop.Token);
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        stop.Cancel(); listener.Stop(); await accepting;
        await Task.WhenAll(clients); stop.Dispose();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Text;
using System.Globalization;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

internal static class LdLaunchMemoryTests
{
    private const ulong Mib = 1024 * 1024;
    private const ulong Gib = 1024 * Mib;

    public static void Register(Action<string, Func<Task>> test)
    {
        test("LD memory reads only the confirmed literal RAM key and leaves the configuration intact", ReadConfigurationAsync);
        test("LD memory reads the same instance current machine RAM without guessing missing settings", MachineConfigurationAsync);
        test("LD memory rejects unsafe ambiguous and unsupported machine XML without leaking configuration", UnknownMachineConfigurationAsync);
        test("LD memory conflicting sources and invalid explicit RAM remain unknown", SourceConflictsAsync);
        test("LD memory missing malformed ambiguous and unreasonable RAM remain unknown without leaking JSON", UnknownConfigurationAsync);
        test("LD memory invalid paths indices missing files and oversized files return warnings", ConfigurationBoundsAsync);
        test("LD memory 7.8 GiB at 75 percent accepts 2 and 6 GiB but warns for 8 GiB", TypicalCapacityAsync);
        test("LD memory only measured capacity below configured RAM requires confirmation", RiskThresholdsAsync);
        test("LD memory unknown sampling and diagnostic warnings remain nonblocking without guessing zero", UnknownAssessmentAsync);
        test("LD memory messages show sampled RAM capacity load and estimates with invariant numeric formatting", AssessmentMessageAsync);
    }

    private static void Assert(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
    private static Task ReadConfigurationAsync()
    {
        using var fixture = new MemoryFixture();
        const string json = "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":6144,\"privateUnrelated\":\"PRIVATE_CONFIG_MUST_NOT_APPEAR\"}";
        fixture.Write(json);
        var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
        Assert(configuration.MemoryMb == 6144 && configuration.Warning is null, "Confirmed literal integer RAM was not read.");
        Assert(File.ReadAllText(fixture.ConfigurationPath) == json && new FileInfo(fixture.ConsolePath).Length == 0, "ReadConfiguration mutated a fixture or used the console executable.");
        foreach (var ram in new[] { 256, 2048, 8192, 65536 })
        {
            fixture.Write("{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":" + ram + "}");
            Assert(LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2).MemoryMb == ram, "Valid custom RAM was rejected: " + ram);
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task UnknownConfigurationAsync()
    {
        using var fixture = new MemoryFixture();
        foreach (var json in new[]
        {
            "{}", "[]", "{\"advancedSettings\":{\"memorySize\":2048}}", "{\"performanceSettings\":{\"memorySize\":2048}}",
            "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":\"2048\"}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":2048.5}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":null}",
            "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":0}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":-1}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":65537}",
            "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":2048,\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":8192}", "{\"PRIVATE_CONFIG_MUST_NOT_APPEAR\":broken}"
        })
        {
            fixture.Write(json);
            var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
            Assert(configuration.MemoryMb is null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuration.Warning), "Unknown RAM was guessed instead of warned.");
            Assert(!configuration.Warning!.Contains("PRIVATE_CONFIG_MUST_NOT_APPEAR", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !configuration.Warning.Contains(json, StringComparison.Ordinal), "Configuration contents leaked into its warning.");
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static string MachineXml(string memory, string extra = "") => "<VirtualBox xmlns=\"http://www.virtualbox.org/\"><Machine><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"" + memory + "\"/></Hardware>" + extra + "</Machine></VirtualBox>";

    private static Task MachineConfigurationAsync()
    {
        using var fixture = new MemoryFixture();
        fixture.Write("{}");
        var xml = MachineXml("6144", "<Snapshot><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"1024\"/></Hardware></Snapshot>");
        fixture.WriteMachine(xml);
        var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
        Assert(configuration.MemoryMb == 6144 && configuration.Warning is null, "Missing JSON RAM did not read current machine RAM, or selected a snapshot.");
        Assert(File.ReadAllText(fixture.ConfigurationPath) == "{}" && File.ReadAllText(fixture.MachinePath) == xml && new FileInfo(fixture.ConsolePath).Length == 0, "RAM reads mutated files or executed the console.");
        fixture.Write("{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":2048}"); fixture.WriteMachine(MachineXml("2048"));
        Assert(LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2).MemoryMb == 2048, "Matching configuration sources were not accepted.");
        File.WriteAllText(fixture.MachinePath, MachineXml("2048"), new UTF8Encoding(true));
        Assert(LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2).MemoryMb == 2048, "XML UTF-8 BOM was rejected.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task UnknownMachineConfigurationAsync()
    {
        using var fixture = new MemoryFixture(); fixture.Write("{}");
        foreach (var xml in new[]
        {
            "broken PRIVATE_CONFIG_MUST_NOT_APPEAR", "<VirtualBox/>", MachineXml("0"), MachineXml("-1"), MachineXml("65537"), MachineXml("2048.5"), MachineXml("2GB"),
            "<VirtualBox xmlns=\"http://www.virtualbox.org/\"><Machine><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"2048\"/><Memory RAMSize=\"8192\"/></Hardware></Machine></VirtualBox>",
            "<VirtualBox xmlns=\"http://www.virtualbox.org/\"><Machine><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"2048\"/></Hardware></Machine><Machine><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"8192\"/></Hardware></Machine></VirtualBox>",
            "<VirtualBox xmlns=\"http://www.virtualbox.org/\"><Machine><Snapshot><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"2048\"/></Hardware></Snapshot></Machine></VirtualBox>",
            "<VirtualBox xmlns=\"http://www.virtualbox.org/\"><Machine><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"2048\"/></Hardware><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"8192\"/></Hardware></Machine></VirtualBox>",
            MachineXml("2048").Replace("http://www.virtualbox.org/", "https://untrusted.example/"),
            "<!DOCTYPE VirtualBox [<!ENTITY ram \"2048\">]><VirtualBox xmlns=\"http://www.virtualbox.org/\"><Machine><Hardware><Memory RAMSize=\"&ram;\"/></Hardware></Machine></VirtualBox>",
            "<!DOCTYPE VirtualBox SYSTEM \"file:///PRIVATE_CONFIG_MUST_NOT_APPEAR\">" + MachineXml("2048"), new string(' ', 1024 * 1024 + 1)
        })
        {
            fixture.WriteMachine(xml);
            var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
            Assert(configuration.MemoryMb is null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuration.Warning), "Unsafe or ambiguous machine configuration supplied RAM.");
            Assert(!configuration.Warning!.Contains("PRIVATE_CONFIG_MUST_NOT_APPEAR", StringComparison.Ordinal), "XML configuration contents or parser details leaked.");
        }
        fixture.WriteMachine(MachineXml("2048"));
        using (var locked = new FileStream(fixture.MachinePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.None))
            Assert(LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2).MemoryMb is null, "Locked XML was accepted.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task SourceConflictsAsync()
    {
        using var fixture = new MemoryFixture(); fixture.WriteMachine(MachineXml("6144"));
        foreach (var json in new[] { "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":2048}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":0}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":\"6144\"}", "{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":6144,\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":8192}" })
        {
            fixture.Write(json);
            var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
            Assert(configuration.MemoryMb is null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuration.Warning), "Conflicting or explicit invalid RAM was bypassed by XML fallback.");
        }
        fixture.Write("{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":6144}");
        Assert(LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2).MemoryMb == 6144, "Matching RAM did not recover.");
        fixture.WriteMachine("broken");
        var unverifiedMachine = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
        Assert(unverifiedMachine.MemoryMb == 6144 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(unverifiedMachine.Warning), "Unreadable second source was silently claimed consistent or discarded known JSON RAM.");
        fixture.WriteMachine(MachineXml("6144"));
        using (var locked = new FileStream(fixture.MachinePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.None))
        {
            var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
            Assert(configuration.MemoryMb == 6144 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuration.Warning), "Locked second source did not preserve a diagnostic alongside known JSON RAM.");
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task ConfigurationBoundsAsync()
    {
        using var fixture = new MemoryFixture();
        fixture.Write("{\"advancedSettings.memorySize\":2048}");
        foreach (var input in new[] { ("", 2), ("ldconsole.exe", 2), (fixture.ConsolePath + '\0', 2), (fixture.ConsolePath, 0), (fixture.ConsolePath, -1), (fixture.ConsolePath, 99999), (fixture.ConsolePath, 1) })
        {
            var configuration = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(input.Item1, input.Item2);
            Assert(configuration.MemoryMb is null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuration.Warning), "Invalid or missing configuration did not remain unknown.");
        }
        using (var locked = new FileStream(fixture.ConfigurationPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.None))
            Assert(LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2).MemoryMb is null, "Unreadable configuration did not remain unknown.");
        fixture.Write(new string(' ', 1024 * 1024 + 1));
        var oversized = LdLaunchMemory.ReadConfiguration(fixture.ConsolePath, 2);
        Assert(oversized.MemoryMb is null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(oversized.Warning), "Oversized configuration was accepted.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task TypicalCapacityAsync()
    {
        var host = new LdHostMemory(78 * Gib / 10, 16 * Gib, 75);
        foreach (var ram in new[] { 2048, 6144 })
        {
            var result = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(ram), host);
            Assert(!result.RequiresConfirmation && result.RecommendedPhysicalBytes == ((ulong)ram + 1536) * Mib, "Fixed 11 GiB or 80-percent gate still rejects normal RAM: " + ram);
        }
        var high = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(8192), host);
        Assert(high.RequiresConfirmation && high.RecommendedPhysicalBytes == 9728 * Mib && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(high.Message), "8 GiB instance did not receive an advisory warning.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task RiskThresholdsAsync()
    {
        var ram = 4096 * Mib; var recommended = 5632 * Mib;
        foreach (var load in new uint[] { 0, 80, 89, 90, 100, 101 })
            Assert(!LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(4096), new(ram, ram, load)).RequiresConfirmation, "Headroom, load or unknown load triggered confirmation with sufficient configured RAM capacity.");
        foreach (var host in new[] { new LdHostMemory(ram - 1, ram, 0), new LdHostMemory(ram, ram - 1, 0), new LdHostMemory(0, ram, 100), new LdHostMemory(ram - 1, ram, 101) })
        {
            var result = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(4096), host);
            Assert(result.RequiresConfirmation && result.RecommendedPhysicalBytes == recommended && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Message), "A measured RAM capacity deficit was missed.");
        }
        Assert(LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(4096, "存在非阻断读取提示"), new(ram - 1, ram, 0)).RequiresConfirmation, "A diagnostic warning suppressed a known deficit.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task UnknownAssessmentAsync()
    {
        foreach (var ram in new int?[] { null, 0, -1, int.MaxValue })
        {
            var result = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(ram, "RAM 未知"), new(16 * Gib, 16 * Gib, 10));
            Assert(!result.RequiresConfirmation && result.RecommendedPhysicalBytes is null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Message) && !result.Message.Contains("满足建议预算", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Unknown RAM was guessed or escalated to confirmation.");
            Assert(!LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(ram, "RAM 未知"), new(0, 0, 100)).RequiresConfirmation, "Unknown RAM fabricated a deficit comparison.");
        }
        var noHost = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(6144), null);
        Assert(!noHost.RequiresConfirmation && noHost.RecommendedPhysicalBytes == 7680 * Mib && noHost.Message.Contains("未知", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Missing host became a capacity deficit or discarded known RAM.");
        var warning = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(2048, "配置读取存在警告"), new(16 * Gib, 16 * Gib, 0));
        Assert(!warning.RequiresConfirmation && warning.Message.Contains("配置读取存在警告", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Diagnostic warning was hidden or became a modal.");
        Assert(!LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(2048), new(16 * Gib, 16 * Gib, 101)).RequiresConfirmation, "Malformed load became a capacity deficit.");
        var screenshot = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(null, "实例内存字段缺失"), new(11 * Gib, 20 * Gib, 65));
        Assert(!screenshot.RequiresConfirmation && screenshot.Message.Contains("未知", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !screenshot.Message.Contains("确认风险后", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Reported 11 GiB 65-percent unknown RAM still needs confirmation.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task AssessmentMessageAsync()
    {
        var previous = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        try
        {
            CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("fr-FR");
            var host = new LdHostMemory(78 * Gib / 10, 16 * Gib, 75);
            var known = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(6144), host);
            foreach (var text in new[] { "配置 RAM 6144 MiB", "可用物理 7.8 GiB", "可用提交 16.0 GiB", "负载 75%", "物理建议预算 7.5 GiB", "512 MiB", "1024 MiB", "非官方最低要求", "采样时刻" })
                Assert(known.Message.Contains(text, StringComparison.Ordinal), "Known memory message omitted a reproducible value: " + text);
            var warning = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(8192), host);
            Assert(warning.Message.Contains("物理建议预算 9.5 GiB", StringComparison.Ordinal) && warning.Message.Contains("仍可继续", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Risk message hid its budget or became a hard refusal.");
            var unknownHost = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(6144), null);
            foreach (var text in new[] { "配置 RAM 6144 MiB", "可用物理 未知", "可用提交 未知", "负载 未知", "物理建议预算 7.5 GiB" })
                Assert(unknownHost.Message.Contains(text, StringComparison.Ordinal), "Unknown host message fabricated or omitted a value: " + text);
            var unknownRam = LdLaunchMemory.Assess(new(null), host);
            Assert(unknownRam.Message.Contains("配置 RAM 未知", StringComparison.Ordinal) && unknownRam.Message.Contains("物理建议预算 未知", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Unknown RAM message guessed a numeric budget.");
        }
        finally { CultureInfo.CurrentCulture = previous; }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private sealed class MemoryFixture : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly string directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "MatrixDevice.Tests", "LdLaunchMemory", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        public string ConsolePath => Path.Combine(directory, "ldconsole.exe");
        public string ConfigurationPath => Path.Combine(directory, "vms", "config", "leidian2.config");
        public string MachinePath => Path.Combine(directory, "vms", "leidian2", "leidian.vbox");
        public MemoryFixture()
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(ConfigurationPath)!);
            File.WriteAllBytes(ConsolePath, []);
        }
        public void Write(string json) => File.WriteAllText(ConfigurationPath, json, new UTF8Encoding(false));
        public void WriteMachine(string xml) { Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(MachinePath)!); File.WriteAllText(MachinePath, xml, new UTF8Encoding(false)); }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (File.Exists(ConfigurationPath)) File.Delete(ConfigurationPath);
            File.Delete(ConsolePath);
            if (File.Exists(MachinePath)) File.Delete(MachinePath);
            if (Directory.Exists(Path.GetDirectoryName(MachinePath)!)) Directory.Delete(Path.GetDirectoryName(MachinePath)!);
            Directory.Delete(Path.GetDirectoryName(ConfigurationPath)!);
            Directory.Delete(Path.Combine(directory, "vms"));
            Directory.Delete(directory);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using MatrixDevice.Core;
using MatrixDevice.Host;

public static class LdRunningWindowTests
{
    public static void Register(Action<string, Func<Task>> test)
    {
        test("existing LD window rejects protected stale and foreign identities before showing", RejectionAsync);
        test("existing LD window restores an owned native window and reports focus refusal", RestoreAsync);
        test("existing LD window refuses child and destroyed handles", InvalidHandleAsync);
    }

    private static Task RejectionAsync()
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) return Task.CompletedTask;
        var window = CreateOwnWindow();
        using var process = Process.GetCurrentProcess();
        var birth = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks;
        var install = Path.GetDirectoryName(process.MainModule!.FileName)!;
        var instance = OwnInstance(window);
        var calls = 0;
        bool Focus(IntPtr _) { calls++; return true; }
        try
        {
            foreach (var invalid in new[] { instance with { Index = 0 }, instance with { Index = -1 }, instance with { Index = 99999 }, instance with { Index = 100000 }, instance with { Generation = 0 }, instance with { ProcessId = int.MaxValue } })
                ExpectRefusal(() => LdRunningWindow.Show(invalid, install, birth, Focus));
            ExpectRefusal(() => LdRunningWindow.Show(instance, install, birth + 1, Focus));
            ExpectRefusal(() => LdRunningWindow.Show(instance, Path.GetTempPath(), birth, Focus));
            ExpectRefusal(() => LdRunningWindow.Show(instance, "relative-install", birth, Focus));
            Assert(calls == 0 && !IsWindowVisible(window), "Rejected identity reached activation or showed the window.");
        }
        finally { DestroyWindow(window); }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task RestoreAsync()
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) return Task.CompletedTask;
        var window = CreateOwnWindow();
        using var process = Process.GetCurrentProcess();
        var birth = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks;
        var install = Path.GetDirectoryName(process.MainModule!.FileName)!;
        var instance = OwnInstance(window);
        var calls = 0;
        try
        {
            var foreground = LdRunningWindow.Show(instance, install, birth, handle => { calls++; Assert(handle == window, "Activation changed target."); return false; });
            PumpMessages();
            Assert(!foreground && calls == 1 && IsWindowVisible(window), "Foreground refusal was treated as failure to request restoration or reported as success.");
            Assert(GetParent(window) == IntPtr.Zero, "Restoration reparented the window.");
            LdRunningWindow.Show(instance, install, birth);
            PumpMessages();
            Assert(IsWindowVisible(window), "Native foreground request hid the existing window.");
        }
        finally { DestroyWindow(window); }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static Task InvalidHandleAsync()
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) return Task.CompletedTask;
        var parent = CreateOwnWindow(); var child = CreateOwnWindow(parent);
        using var process = Process.GetCurrentProcess();
        var birth = process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks;
        var install = Path.GetDirectoryName(process.MainModule!.FileName)!;
        try
        {
            ExpectRefusal(() => LdRunningWindow.Show(OwnInstance(child), install, birth));
            Assert(!IsWindowVisible(parent), "Child-window rejection changed its parent.");
            DestroyWindow(child); child = IntPtr.Zero;
            var destroyed = parent; DestroyWindow(parent); parent = IntPtr.Zero;
            ExpectRefusal(() => LdRunningWindow.Show(OwnInstance(destroyed), install, birth));
        }
        finally { if (child != IntPtr.Zero) DestroyWindow(child); if (parent != IntPtr.Zero) DestroyWindow(parent); }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static LdPlayerInstance OwnInstance(IntPtr window) => new(1, "Owned native test window", window.ToInt64(), 0, false, Environment.ProcessId, -1);

    private static IntPtr CreateOwnWindow(IntPtr parent = default)
    {
        var window = CreateWindowEx(0x08000080, "STATIC", "Owned monitoring window test", parent == IntPtr.Zero ? 0x00CF0000u : 0x40000000u,
            -20000, -20000, 120, 80, parent, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (window == IntPtr.Zero) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "Cannot create the owned native test window.");
        return window;
    }

    private static void PumpMessages()
    {
        while (PeekMessage(out var message, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 1))
        {
            TranslateMessage(ref message); DispatchMessage(ref message);
        }
    }

    private static void ExpectRefusal(Action action)
    {
        try { action(); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException or Win32Exception) { return; }
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid existing-window target was accepted.");
    }

    private static void Assert(bool valid, string message) { if (!valid) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct WindowMessage
    {
        public IntPtr Window;
        public uint Message;
        public nuint WParam;
        public IntPtr LParam;
        public uint Time;
        public int X, Y;
        public uint Private;
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "CreateWindowExW", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)] private static extern IntPtr CreateWindowEx(uint exStyle, string className, string title, uint style, int x, int y, int width, int height, IntPtr parent, IntPtr menu, IntPtr instance, IntPtr parameter);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool DestroyWindow(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] private static extern IntPtr GetParent(IntPtr window);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "PeekMessageW")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool PeekMessage(out WindowMessage message, IntPtr window, uint minimum, uint maximum, uint remove);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static extern bool TranslateMessage(ref WindowMessage message);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", EntryPoint = "DispatchMessageW")] private static extern IntPtr DispatchMessage(ref WindowMessage message);
}
```

## tests/MatrixDevice.Tests/LdWorkspaceTests.cs

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using MatrixDevice.Core;

public static class LdWorkspaceTests
{
    public static void Register(Action<string, Func<Task>> test)
    {
        test("LD workspace launch validates the whole batch before touching the console", LaunchValidationAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch validates the complete confirmation snapshot before console calls", ConfirmationValidationAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch rejects replacement after user confirmation before launching", ConfirmationReplacementAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch starts once per instance and waits sequentially", SequentialLaunchAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch skips ready instances and waits for existing processes", ExistingProcessesAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch timeout never retries or starts later instances", LaunchTimeoutAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch cancellation leaves launched instances alone", LaunchCancellationAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch resource rejection stops the remaining batch", ResourceRejectionAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch resource cancellation stops the remaining batch without closing guests", ResourceCancellationAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch rejects changed generations after the resource callback", ResourceGenerationAsync);
        test("LD workspace launch rejects changed instance identity while waiting", LaunchIdentityAsync);
        test("LD workspace coordinator serializes overlapping batches", OverlappingBatchesAsync);
        test("LD workspace create validates names before console calls", CreateValidationAsync);
        test("LD workspace create confirms one new index and never copies or deletes", CreateAsync);
        test("LD workspace create retains a nonzero command warning after unique confirmation", CreateReportedFailureAsync);
        test("LD workspace create rejects ambiguous changes without retrying", CreateAmbiguityAsync);
        test("LD workspace create does not swallow cancellation or command timeouts", CreateInterruptionAsync);
        test("LD workspace configure validates all resource values before console calls", ConfigureValidationAsync);
        test("LD workspace configure requires fully stopped and current instances", ConfigurePreconditionsAsync);
        test("LD workspace configure sends only whitelisted resource parameters", ConfigureAsync);
    }

    private static async Task LaunchValidationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var coordinator = new LdLaunchCoordinator(service);
        var resources = 0;
        foreach (var indices in new[] { Array.Empty<int>(), new[] { 0 }, new[] { 99999 }, new[] { -1 }, new[] { 1, 1 }, new[] { 1, 0 } })
            await Expect(400, () => coordinator.StartAsync(indices, _ => { resources++; return Task.CompletedTask; }));
        Assert(runner.Calls.Count == 0 && resources == 0, "Invalid launch batch reached the console or resource callback.");
    }

    private static async Task SequentialLaunchAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        runner.OnLaunch = index =>
        {
            if (index == 2) Assert(runner.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1).Flag == 1, "Second instance started before the first was ready.");
        };
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var resources = 0; var checkedIndices = new List<int>(); var progress = new RecordingProgress();
        var result = await Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], (instance, ct) =>
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            checkedIndices.Add(instance.Index); resources++;
            Assert(instance.ProcessId <= 0 && instance.VBoxProcessId <= 0, "Resource check did not receive the stopped target snapshot.");
            Assert(instance.Index == 1 || runner.Instances.Single(item => item.Index == 1).Flag == 1, "Next resource check ran before the previous instance was ready.");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }, progress);
        Assert(resources == 2 && runner.Count("launch") == 2, "Launch or resource checks were skipped or repeated.");
        Assert(checkedIndices.SequenceEqual([1, 2]), "Resource estimates were not associated with each target instance.");
        Assert(result.Select(item => item.Index).SequenceEqual([1, 2]) && result.All(item => item.State == "ready"), "Sequential results were incomplete.");
        Assert(progress.Items.Any(item => item.State == "waiting") && result.All(item => item.Message.Contains("ADB", StringComparison.Ordinal)), "Progress incorrectly claimed guest readiness.");
        Assert(!runner.Calls.Any(call => call.Contains("0") || call[0] is "adb" or "quit" or "quitall"), "Batch touched protected or global operations.");
    }

    private static async Task ConfirmationValidationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var snapshot = (await service.RefreshAsync()).ToArray();
        var before = runner.Calls.Count;
        var resources = 0;
        var invalidSnapshots = new IReadOnlyList<LdPlayerInstance>[]
        {
            [], [snapshot[0]], [snapshot[0], snapshot[0]],
            [snapshot[0], snapshot[1], snapshot[0] with { Index = 3 }],
            [snapshot[0], snapshot[1] with { Index = 3 }]
        };
        var coordinator = Coordinator(service);
        foreach (var invalid in invalidSnapshots)
            await Expect(400, () => coordinator.StartAsync([1, 2], _ => { resources++; return Task.CompletedTask; }, expectedInstances: invalid));
        Assert(runner.Calls.Count == before && resources == 0, "Invalid confirmation snapshot reached the console or resource callback.");
        var result = await coordinator.StartAsync([1, 2], _ => { resources++; return Task.CompletedTask; }, expectedInstances: snapshot.Reverse().ToArray());
        Assert(result.Count == 2 && result.All(item => item.State == "ready") && runner.Count("launch") == 2, "Valid unordered confirmation snapshot blocked normal launch generations.");
    }

    private static async Task ConfirmationReplacementAsync()
    {
        foreach (var rename in new[] { true, false })
        {
            var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
            await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
            var snapshot = (await service.RefreshAsync()).ToArray();
            if (rename) runner.Instances[0].Name = "replacement";
            else
            {
                runner.Instances[0].Width++;
                await service.RefreshAsync();
                runner.Instances[0].Width--;
                await service.RefreshAsync();
            }
            var resources = 0;
            await Expect(409, () => Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], _ => { resources++; return Task.CompletedTask; }, expectedInstances: snapshot));
            Assert(resources == 0 && runner.Count("launch") == 0, "Replacement after confirmation launched a changed or later instance.");
        }
    }

    private static async Task ExistingProcessesAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        runner.Instances[0] = new(1, "A", 1, 101, 201);
        runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B", 2, 102, -1) { BootReads = 3 });
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var result = await Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], (instance, ct) => throw new InvalidOperationException("Existing processes must not reserve another launch."));
        Assert(result[0].State == "skipped" && result[1].State == "ready" && runner.Count("launch") == 0, "Existing processes were relaunched or marked ready too early.");
        var zeroPid = new FakeConsole(); zeroPid.Instances[0] = new(1, "A", 2) { BootReads = 3 };
        await using var zeroPidService = new LdPlayerService(zeroPid);
        var progress = new RecordingProgress();
        var zeroPidResult = await Coordinator(zeroPidService).StartAsync([1], _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Starting flag must not reserve another launch."), progress);
        Assert(zeroPidResult[0].State == "ready" && zeroPid.Count("launch") == 0 && progress.Items.Any(item => item.Instance is { IsStarting: true, ProcessId: <= 0, VBoxProcessId: <= 0 }), "Zero-PID startup flag was relaunched or never observed while waiting.");
    }

    private static async Task LaunchTimeoutAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole { NeverReady = true }; runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        await Expect(504, () => new LdLaunchCoordinator(service, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(40), TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(2))
            .StartAsync([1, 2], _ => Task.CompletedTask));
        Assert(runner.Count("launch") == 1 && runner.Calls.Where(call => call[0] == "launch").All(call => call[2] == "1"), "Timed out launch was retried or the next instance started.");
        Assert(runner.Count("quit") == 0, "Timed out launch closed a guest.");
    }

    private static async Task LaunchCancellationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole { NeverReady = true }; runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var progress = new RecordingProgress(item => { if (item.State == "waiting") cancellation.Cancel(); });
        try { await Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], _ => Task.CompletedTask, progress, cancellation.Token); throw new InvalidOperationException("Cancellation was ignored."); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        Assert(runner.Count("launch") == 1 && runner.Count("quit") == 0, "Cancellation retried, continued, or closed the owned launch.");
    }

    private static async Task ResourceRejectionAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var resources = 0;
        await Expect(503, () => Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], _ => ++resources == 1 ? Task.CompletedTask : throw new DeviceException("reserve rejected", 503, 2000)));
        Assert(resources == 2 && runner.Count("launch") == 1 && runner.Count("quit") == 0, "Resource rejection did not stop after the first ready instance.");
    }

    private static async Task ResourceCancellationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B")); runner.Instances.Add(new(3, "C"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var checkedIndices = new List<int>();
        try
        {
            await Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2, 3], (instance, ct) =>
            {
                checkedIndices.Add(instance.Index);
                if (instance.Index == 2) cancellation.Cancel();
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }, ct: cancellation.Token);
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Resource warning cancellation was ignored.");
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        Assert(checkedIndices.SequenceEqual([1, 2]) && runner.Count("launch") == 1 && runner.Count("quit") == 0,
            "Declined resource warning started the declined or later instance, or closed an already started instance.");
    }

    private static async Task LaunchIdentityAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole { RenameAfterLaunch = true }; runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        await Expect(409, () => Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], _ => Task.CompletedTask));
        Assert(runner.Count("launch") == 1, "Changed target identity was retried or another target started.");
    }

    private static async Task ResourceGenerationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var resourceChecks = 0;
        await Expect(409, () => Coordinator(service).StartAsync([1, 2], async ct =>
        {
            resourceChecks++;
            var instance = runner.Instances[0];
            var width = instance.Width;
            instance.Width++;
            await service.RefreshAsync(ct);
            instance.Width = width;
            await service.RefreshAsync(ct);
        }));
        Assert(resourceChecks == 1 && runner.Count("launch") == 0, "Changed original generation was silently replaced or a later target started.");
    }

    private static async Task OverlappingBatchesAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole(); runner.Instances.Add(new(2, "B"));
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var coordinator = Coordinator(service);
        await Task.WhenAll(coordinator.StartAsync([1, 2], _ => Task.CompletedTask), coordinator.StartAsync([1, 2], _ => Task.CompletedTask));
        Assert(runner.Count("launch") == 2, "Overlapping batches launched an instance more than once.");
    }

    private static async Task CreateValidationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var editor = new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service);
        foreach (var name in new[] { "", " ", "--option", "bad\nname", "bad\n", "\tbad", "bad\0name", "bad,name", new string('a', 81) })
            await Expect(400, () => editor.CreateAsync(name));
        Assert(runner.Calls.Count == 0, "Invalid creation name reached the CLI.");
        await Expect(409, () => editor.CreateAsync("A"));
        Assert(runner.Count("add") == 0, "Duplicate name created another instance.");
    }

    private static async Task CreateAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var result = await new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service).CreateAsync("测试实例 B");
        Assert(result.Instance.Index == 2 && result.Instance.Name == "测试实例 B" && !result.CommandReportedFailure, "Creation result was not the unique new instance.");
        Assert(runner.Count("add") == 1 && runner.Calls.All(call => call[0] is "list2" or "add"), "Creation retried or used unrelated operations.");
    }

    private static async Task CreateReportedFailureAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole { AddReportsFailure = true };
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var result = await new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service).CreateAsync("B");
        Assert(result.CommandReportedFailure && result.Instance.Index == 2 && result.Message.Contains("退出码=1", StringComparison.Ordinal), "Creation command failure warning was lost.");
        Assert(runner.Count("add") == 1, "Nonzero add was blindly retried.");
    }

    private static async Task CreateAmbiguityAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole { AddExtraInstance = true };
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        await Expect(409, () => new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service).CreateAsync("B"));
        Assert(runner.Count("add") == 1 && runner.Count("remove") == 0, "Ambiguous creation retried or deleted data.");
        var wrongNameRunner = new FakeConsole { CreatedNameOverride = "external" };
        await using var wrongNameService = new LdPlayerService(wrongNameRunner);
        await Expect(409, () => new LdInstanceEditor(wrongNameRunner, wrongNameService).CreateAsync("B"));
        Assert(wrongNameRunner.Count("add") == 1, "Wrong-name creation was accepted or retried.");
    }

    private static async Task CreateInterruptionAsync()
    {
        var timedOut = new FakeConsole { AddReportsTimeout = true };
        await using var timeoutService = new LdPlayerService(timedOut);
        await Expect(504, () => new LdInstanceEditor(timedOut, timeoutService).CreateAsync("B"));
        Assert(timedOut.Count("add") == 1 && timedOut.Count("list2") == 1, "Timed out creation issued more CLI commands.");
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var cancelled = new FakeConsole { OnAdd = cancellation.Cancel };
        await using var cancelledService = new LdPlayerService(cancelled);
        try { await new LdInstanceEditor(cancelled, cancelledService).CreateAsync("B", cancellation.Token); throw new InvalidOperationException("Create cancellation was ignored."); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellation.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        Assert(cancelled.Count("add") == 1 && cancelled.Count("list2") == 1 && cancelled.Count("remove") == 0, "Cancelled creation retried, queried again, or deleted an instance.");
    }

    private static async Task ConfigureValidationAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var editor = new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service);
        var valid = new LdInstanceConfiguration(2, 2048, 720, 1280, 240);
        foreach (var configuration in new[] { valid with { Cpu = 0 }, valid with { Cpu = 6 }, valid with { MemoryMb = 0 }, valid with { MemoryMb = 3072 }, valid with { Width = 0 }, valid with { Height = 100_000 }, valid with { Dpi = 0 } })
            await Expect(400, () => editor.ConfigureAsync(1, 1, configuration));
        foreach (var index in new[] { 0, -1, 99999 }) await Expect(400, () => editor.ConfigureAsync(index, 1, valid));
        await Expect(400, () => editor.ConfigureAsync(1, 0, valid));
        Assert(runner.Calls.Count == 0, "Invalid configuration reached the console.");
    }

    private static async Task ConfigurePreconditionsAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var editor = new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service);
        var configuration = new LdInstanceConfiguration(2, 2048, 720, 1280, 240);
        foreach (var instance in new[] { new FakeInstance(1, "A", 1, 101, 201), new FakeInstance(1, "A", 2, 101, -1), new FakeInstance(1, "A", 2), new FakeInstance(1, "A", 0, -1, 201), new FakeInstance(1, "A") { TopWindow = 1 } })
        {
            runner.Instances[0] = instance;
            var current = (await service.RefreshAsync()).Single();
            await Expect(409, () => editor.ConfigureAsync(1, current.Generation, configuration));
        }
        runner.Instances[0] = new(1, "A");
        var stopped = (await service.RefreshAsync()).Single(); runner.Instances[0].Width++;
        await Expect(409, () => editor.ConfigureAsync(1, stopped.Generation, configuration));
        Assert(runner.Count("modify") == 0, "Running, starting, or stale instance was configured.");
    }

    private static async Task ConfigureAsync()
    {
        var runner = new FakeConsole();
        await using var service = new LdPlayerService(runner);
        var current = (await service.RefreshAsync()).Single();
        var result = await new LdInstanceEditor(runner, service).ConfigureAsync(1, current.Generation, new(4, 4096, 1080, 1920, 480));
        Assert(result.Accepted && !result.Verified && result.Instance?.Width == 1080 && result.Instance.Height == 1920, "Resource command result overclaimed verification or lost the observation.");
        var call = runner.Calls.Single(args => args[0] == "modify");
        Assert(call.SequenceEqual(["modify", "--index", "1", "--cpu", "4", "--memory", "4096", "--resolution", "1080,1920,480"]), "Unapproved configuration arguments were sent.");
    }

    private static LdLaunchCoordinator Coordinator(LdPlayerService service) => new(service, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1));
    private static void Assert(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }
    private static async Task Expect(int status, Func<Task> action)
    {
        try { await action(); }
        catch (DeviceException error) when (error.Status == status) { return; }
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Expected DeviceException status={status}.");
    }

    private sealed class RecordingProgress(Action<LdLaunchProgress>? observer = null) : IProgress<LdLaunchProgress>
    {
        public List<LdLaunchProgress> Items { get; } = [];
        public void Report(LdLaunchProgress value) { Items.Add(value); observer?.Invoke(value); }
    }

    private sealed class FakeInstance(int index, string name, int flag = 0, int processId = -1, int vboxPid = -1)
    {
        public int Index { get; } = index;
        public string Name { get; set; } = name;
        public int Flag { get; set; } = flag;
        public int ProcessId { get; set; } = processId;
        public int VBoxPid { get; set; } = vboxPid;
        public long TopWindow { get; set; }
        public int Width { get; set; } = 720;
        public int Height { get; set; } = 1280;
        public int Dpi { get; set; } = 240;
        public int BootReads { get; set; }
        public string List2() => string.Join(',', Index, Name, TopWindow, 0, Flag, ProcessId, VBoxPid, Width, Height, Dpi);
    }

    private sealed class FakeConsole : ILdConsoleRunner
    {
        public List<FakeInstance> Instances { get; } = [new(1, "A")];
        public List<string[]> Calls { get; } = [];
        public bool NeverReady { get; init; }
        public bool RenameAfterLaunch { get; init; }
        public bool AddReportsFailure { get; init; }
        public bool AddReportsTimeout { get; init; }
        public bool AddExtraInstance { get; init; }
        public string? CreatedNameOverride { get; init; }
        public Action<int>? OnLaunch { get; set; }
        public Action? OnAdd { get; init; }
        public int Count(string command) => Calls.Count(call => call[0] == command);
        public Task<string> RunAsync(IReadOnlyList<string> arguments, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var args = arguments.ToArray(); Calls.Add(args);
            if (args[0] == "list2")
            {
                foreach (var instance in Instances.Where(item => item.Flag == 2 && item.BootReads > 0))
                    if (--instance.BootReads == 0) { instance.Flag = 1; instance.ProcessId = 100 + instance.Index; instance.VBoxPid = 200 + instance.Index; }
                return Task.FromResult(string.Join('\n', Instances.Select(item => item.List2())));
            }
            if (args[0] == "launch")
            {
                var index = int.Parse(args[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture); OnLaunch?.Invoke(index);
                var instance = Instances.Single(item => item.Index == index);
                instance.Flag = 2; instance.ProcessId = 100 + index; instance.VBoxPid = 200 + index;
                instance.BootReads = NeverReady ? 0 : 3;
                if (RenameAfterLaunch) instance.Name = "changed";
            }
            else if (args[0] == "add")
            {
                Instances.Add(new(Instances.Max(item => item.Index) + 1, CreatedNameOverride ?? args[2]));
                if (AddExtraInstance) Instances.Add(new(Instances.Max(item => item.Index) + 1, "external"));
                OnAdd?.Invoke();
                if (AddReportsTimeout) throw new DeviceException("雷电 CLI 超时：命令=add，结果未知", 504, 2000);
                if (AddReportsFailure) throw new DeviceException("雷电 CLI 执行失败：命令=add，退出码=1", 503, 2000);
            }
            else if (args[0] == "modify")
            {
                var instance = Instances.Single(item => item.Index == int.Parse(args[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                var size = args[8].Split(',').Select(value => int.Parse(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).ToArray();
                instance.Width = size[0]; instance.Height = size[1]; instance.Dpi = size[2];
            }
            else throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected fake console command: " + args[0]);
            return Task.FromResult("");
        }
    }
}
```
