```csharp
    private static async Task AssertUnprovenStartupAsync(FakeScreenVideoServer server, AdbDeviceBackend backend, Task video)
    {
        await Expect(409, () => video.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(6)));
        var count = server.Requests.Count;
        await Expect(409, () => backend.StreamScreenVideoAsync("allowed", 32, 32, Stream.Null));
        Assert(server.Requests.Count == count, "Unproven startup permitted another guest request.");
        Assert(server.Requests.All(request => !request.Contains("kill -TERM", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !request.StartsWith("shell,v2,raw:rm -f", StringComparison.Ordinal)), "Unproven startup signalled a PID or removed its evidence artifact.");
    }

    private static async Task FramesAsync()
    {
        await using var backend = new AdbDeviceBackend(new());
        var received = new List<ScreenVideoFrame>();
        await using var session = new ScreenVideoSession(backend, "allowed", "unused.exe", 16, 16, received.Add, _ => { });
        var method = typeof(ScreenVideoSession).GetMethod("ReadFramesAsync", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
        var bytes = Enumerable.Range(0, 16 * 16 * 4 * 3).Select(index => (byte)(index % 251)).ToArray();
        using var input = new FragmentedVideoStream(bytes);
        var before = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        await (Task)method.Invoke(session, [input, CancellationToken.None])!;
        Assert(received.Count == 3 && received.Select(frame => frame.Sequence).SequenceEqual(new long[] { 1, 2, 3 }), "Decoder lost, repeated or reordered complete frames.");
        Assert(received.All(frame => frame.Width == 16 && frame.Height == 16 && frame.ReceivedAt >= before), "Frame geometry or receive clock missing.");
        Assert(received.SelectMany(frame => frame.Bgra).SequenceEqual(bytes), "Fragmented output corrupted BGRA frames.");
        using var truncated = new FragmentedVideoStream(new byte[100]);
        try { await (Task)method.Invoke(session, [truncated, CancellationToken.None])!; throw new Exception("Truncated frame published."); }
        catch (IOException) { }
        Assert(received.Count == 3, "Partial frame was published.");
    }

    private static Task DecoderArgumentsAsync()
    {
        var method = typeof(ScreenVideoSession).GetMethod("CreateStartInfo", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;
        var info = (System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo)method.Invoke(null, ["C:\\trusted path\\ffmpeg.exe", 320, 240])!;
        var arguments = info.ArgumentList.ToArray();
        Assert(!info.UseShellExecute && info.CreateNoWindow && info.RedirectStandardInput && info.RedirectStandardOutput && info.RedirectStandardError, "Decoder process isolation missing.");
        Assert(info.FileName == "C:\\trusted path\\ffmpeg.exe" && arguments.Contains("h264") && arguments.Contains("bgra") && arguments.Contains("scale=320:240") && arguments.Contains("passthrough"), "Fixed video decode contract missing.");
        Assert(!arguments.Contains("-r") && !arguments.Any(argument => argument.Contains("fps=", StringComparison.Ordinal)), "Decoder fabricated repeated frames.");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

internal sealed class CountingVideoStream(long target) : Stream
{
    public long Count { get; private set; }
    public TaskCompletionSource Reached { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    public override ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); Count += buffer.Length;
        if (Count >= target) Reached.TrySetResult();
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }
    public override bool CanRead => false; public override bool CanSeek => false; public override bool CanWrite => true;
    public override long Length => Count; public override long Position { get => Count; set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }
    public override void Flush() { }
    public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}

internal sealed class FragmentedVideoStream(byte[] bytes) : MemoryStream(bytes)
{
    public override ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default) => base.ReadAsync(buffer[..Math.Min(buffer.Length, 37)], ct);
}

internal sealed class FakeScreenVideoServer : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TcpListener _listener = new(IPAddress.Loopback, 0);
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _stop = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentBag<Task> _clients = [];
    private readonly Task _accepting;
    public IPEndPoint Endpoint => (IPEndPoint)_listener.LocalEndpoint;
    public ConcurrentQueue<string> Requests { get; } = [];
    public TaskCompletionSource VideoEntered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    public TaskCompletionSource VideoClosed { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    public uint TransportId { get; set; } = 1;
    public bool Flood { get; set; }
    public bool Unsupported { get; set; }
    public bool EndImmediately { get; set; }
    public byte[]? VideoBytes { get; set; }
    public bool StallAfterDisconnect { get; set; }
    public bool ChangedProcessBirth { get; set; }
    public bool HoldServerOkay { get; set; }
    public bool DisconnectAfterServerOkay { get; set; }
    public string? ProcessDisappearsAt { get; set; }
    public string? ProcessReadFailsAt { get; set; }
    public TaskCompletionSource ServerRequestEntered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private bool _processAlive = true;
    private string _processCommandLine = "";
    private static string Stat(bool changed = false) => "12345 (matrix (test)) S " + string.Join(' ', Enumerable.Repeat("0", 18)) + (changed ? " 999 0\n" : " 789 0\n");
    private TaskCompletionSource? _activeServer;

    public FakeScreenVideoServer() { _listener.Start(); _accepting = AcceptAsync(); }
    private async Task AcceptAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            while (!_stop.IsCancellationRequested) _clients.Add(HandleAsync(await _listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(_stop.Token)));
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
    }
    private async Task HandleAsync(TcpClient client)
    {
        using (client)
        {
            try
            {
                var stream = client.GetStream();
                while (!_stop.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    var prefix = new byte[4]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(prefix, _stop.Token);
                    var body = new byte[int.Parse(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(prefix), NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)];
                    await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(body, _stop.Token);
                    var request = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body); Requests.Enqueue(request);
                    if (request == "host:version") { await HostAsync(stream, "0029"); return; }
                    if (request == "host:devices-l") { await HostAsync(stream, $"allowed\tdevice model:Fixture transport_id:{TransportId}\n"); return; }
                    var startsServer = request.Contains("com.genymobile.scrcpy.Server", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    if (startsServer)
                    {
                        ServerRequestEntered.TrySetResult();
                        if (HoldServerOkay) await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, _stop.Token);
                    }
                    await stream.WriteAsync("OKAY"u8.ToArray(), _stop.Token);
                    if (startsServer && DisconnectAfterServerOkay) return;
                    if (request.StartsWith("host:transport-id:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                    if (request == "sync:") { await SyncAsync(stream); return; }
                    if (request.StartsWith("localabstract:scrcpy_", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        var active = _activeServer;
                        if (Unsupported)
                        {
                            try { await stream.WriteAsync("not h264"u8.ToArray(), _stop.Token); var closed = await stream.ReadAsync(new byte[1], _stop.Token); if (closed != 0) throw new IOException("Unexpected video input."); }
                            finally { active?.TrySetResult(); }
                            return;
                        }
                        await stream.WriteAsync(VideoBytes ?? [0, 0, 0, 1, 0x67, 0x42, 0, 0x1f], _stop.Token);
                        VideoEntered.TrySetResult();
                        try
                        {
                            if (EndImmediately) return;
                            if (Flood)
                            {
                                var block = new byte[65536];
                                while (!_stop.IsCancellationRequested) await stream.WriteAsync(block, _stop.Token);
                            }
                            else { var closed = await stream.ReadAsync(new byte[1], _stop.Token); if (closed != 0) throw new IOException("Unexpected client video bytes."); }
                        }
                        finally { if (!StallAfterDisconnect) active?.TrySetResult(); VideoClosed.TrySetResult(); }
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!request.StartsWith("shell,v2,raw:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new IOException("Unexpected video fixture request: " + request);
                    await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(new byte[5], _stop.Token);
                    if (request.Contains("com.genymobile.scrcpy.Server", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        var active = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
                        _activeServer = active;
                        _processAlive = true;
                        var marker = Regex.Match(request, @"MATRIX_VIDEO_[0-9a-f]{32}:").Value;
                        var nonce = Regex.Match(request, @"matrix\.video\.session=([0-9a-f]{32})").Groups[1].Value;
                        var scid = Regex.Match(request, @"scid=([0-9a-f]{8})").Groups[1].Value;
                        _processCommandLine = "app_process\0-Dmatrix.video.session=" + nonce + "\0/\0com.genymobile.scrcpy.Server\0" + "3.3.4\0scid=" + scid + "\0";
                        await PacketAsync(stream, 1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(marker + "12345\n" + Stat()));
                        await active.Task.WaitAsync(_stop.Token);
                        await PacketAsync(stream, 3, [0]); return;
                    }
                    var command = request[13..];
                    string text;
                    var stage = command.Contains("kill -TERM 12345", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "signal" : command.Contains("cmdline", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "snapshot" : command == "cat /proc/12345/stat" ? "recheck" : null;
                    if (stage is not null && (ProcessDisappearsAt == stage || ProcessReadFailsAt == stage))
                    {
                        var disappeared = ProcessDisappearsAt == stage;
                        if (disappeared) { _processAlive = false; _activeServer?.TrySetResult(); }
                        await PacketAsync(stream, 2, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(disappeared ? "cat: /proc/12345/stat: No such file or directory" : "cat: /proc/12345/stat: Permission denied"));
                        await PacketAsync(stream, 3, [1]); return;
                    }
                    if (command.Contains("MATRIX_VIDEO_PID_12345_ABSENT", StringComparison.Ordinal)) text = _processAlive ? "" : "MATRIX_VIDEO_PID_12345_ABSENT";
                    else if (command.Contains("kill -TERM 12345", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        _processAlive = ProcessDisappearsAt == "recheck" || ProcessReadFailsAt == "recheck";
                        if (!_processAlive) _activeServer?.TrySetResult();
                        text = "";
                    }
                    else if (command.Contains("/proc/12345/stat", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    {
                        if (!_processAlive) { await PacketAsync(stream, 2, "cat: /proc/12345/stat: No such file or directory"u8.ToArray()); await PacketAsync(stream, 3, [1]); return; }
                        text = Stat(ChangedProcessBirth) + (command.Contains("cmdline", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "\n" + _processCommandLine : "");
                    }
                    else text = command switch { "getprop" => "[ro.product.model]: [Fixture]\n", "wm size" => "Physical size: 32x32\n", "dumpsys input" => "SurfaceOrientation: 0\n", _ => "fixture\n" };
                    await PacketAsync(stream, 1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text));
                    await PacketAsync(stream, 3, [0]); return;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException) { }
        }
    }
    private async Task SyncAsync(Stream stream)
    {
        var header = new byte[8];
        while (true)
        {
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, _stop.Token);
            var name = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(header, 0, 4); var length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
            if (name == "QUIT") return;
            if (name == "DONE") { await stream.WriteAsync(new byte[] { 0x4f, 0x4b, 0x41, 0x59, 0, 0, 0, 0 }, _stop.Token); continue; }
            if (length < 0 || length > 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Invalid sync fixture length.");
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(new byte[length], _stop.Token);
        }
    }
    private async Task HostAsync(Stream stream, string value)
    {
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value);
        await stream.WriteAsync(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("OKAY" + bytes.Length.ToString("X4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), _stop.Token);
        await stream.WriteAsync(bytes, _stop.Token);
    }
    private async Task PacketAsync(Stream stream, byte channel, byte[] bytes)
    {
        var header = new byte[5]; header[0] = channel; BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(1), bytes.Length);
        await stream.WriteAsync(header, _stop.Token); await stream.WriteAsync(bytes, _stop.Token);
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        _stop.Cancel(); _listener.Stop(); await _accepting; await Task.WhenAll(_clients); _stop.Dispose();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;

    public static void Register(Action<string, Func<Task>> test)

        test("Script jobs freeze differentiated target parameters and retain actual Demo results", () => Demo(async probe =>
        {
            probe.Backend.HoldBeforeFirstTap = true;

            var secondValues = new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["point"] = Element("\"100,110\"") };
            var a = probe.Submit("DEMO-001", source, overrides: firstValues);
            await probe.Backend.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(Deadline);
            var b = probe.Submit("DEMO-002", source, overrides: secondValues);
            source.Steps.Clear(); source.Parameters.Clear(); firstValues["point"] = Element("null"); secondValues.Clear();
            probe.Backend.Release.TrySetResult();
            await Task.WhenAll(a.Completion, b.Completion).WaitAsync(Deadline);
            var jobs = probe.Scheduler.GetJobs();
            Check(a.JobId != Guid.Empty && b.JobId != Guid.Empty && a.JobId != b.JobId && jobs.Count == 2, "Accepted targets did not receive distinct jobs.");
            foreach (var handle in new[] { a, b })
            {
                var status = probe.Job(handle);
                Check(status.JobId == handle.JobId && status.State == ScriptRunState.Completed && status.EndedUtc is { } ended && ended >= status.StartedUtc &&
                    status.PackageId == "job-package" && status.PackageVersion == "author-7" && status.StepCount == 2 && status.StepIndex == 1,
                    "A job lost its frozen package, progress or terminal metadata.");
                Check(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(status.Result) && probe.Scheduler.GetJobLogs(handle.JobId).Count > 0, "Terminal result or task logs are missing.");
            }
            Check(probe.Backend.Calls.Count == 4 && probe.Backend.Calls.Where(call => call.Target.Serial == "DEMO-001").All(call => call.Value == "80,90") &&

            Check(await probe.Backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 2" && await probe.Backend.Taps("DEMO-002") == "Tap 2" &&
                await probe.Backend.Taps("DEMO-003") == "Tap 0", "Actual Demo effects were lost or crossed to the unselected third target.");
            Check(probe.Backend.LegacyWrites == 0, "A pinned job fell back to the serial-only backend interface.");
        }));

            Check(probe.Scheduler.CancelJob(job.JobId), "Pinned job cancellation failed after a legacy duplicate.");
            await job.Completion.WaitAsync(Deadline);
            Check(probe.Job(job).State == ScriptRunState.Cancelled && await probe.Backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 0" && probe.Backend.LegacyWrites == 0,
                "Shared occupancy executed a duplicate action or changed cancellation semantics.");
        }));

        test("Script jobs recheck generation after SetDevice acknowledgement before sending the command", async () =>
        {
            foreach (var step in new[] { Click(), new ScriptStep { Action = "launch", Value = "com.android.settings" } })
            {
                var server = new SetDeviceBarrierServer(); Exception? primary = null; Exception? cleanup = null;
                try
                {
                    var backend = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings { AdbAllowedSerials = ["allowed"], CommandTimeoutSeconds = 5 }, server.Endpoint);
                    await Run(backend, null, false, async probe =>
                    {
                        var old = probe.Target("allowed");
                        Check(old.TransportId == 1 && backend.ObservedTransportId("allowed") == 1, "Initial identity was not discovered through the owned wire server.");
                        var transportOrdinal = step.Action == "launch" ? 2 : 1;
                        var baseline = server.Requests.Count;
                        server.ArmNextTransport(transportOrdinal); var handle = probe.Submit("allowed", Package(step));
                        try
                        {
                            await server.Entered.Task.WaitAsync(Deadline);
                            var beforeCommand = server.Requests.ToArray().Skip(baseline).ToArray();
                            Check(beforeCommand.Count(request => request == "host:transport-id:1") == transportOrdinal &&
                                (transportOrdinal == 1 || beforeCommand.Any(request => request.StartsWith("shell,v2,raw:cmd package resolve-activity ", StringComparison.Ordinal))) &&
                                !beforeCommand.Any(IsInput), "Fixture did not reach the intended tap/am-start SetDevice boundary after a valid launcher resolution.");
                            probe.Backend.InventoryOverride = probe.Catalog.Snapshot.Select(info => info with { Width = info.Width + 1 }).ToArray();
                            await probe.Catalog.RefreshAsync();
                            var changed = probe.Target("allowed");
                            Check(changed.Generation > old.Generation && changed.TransportId == old.TransportId && backend.ObservedTransportId("allowed") == 1,
                                "Fixture did not change generation while retaining the same actual transport.");
                        }
                        finally { server.Release.TrySetResult(); }
                        var error = await Observe(handle.Completion);
                        Check(error is DeviceException { Status: 409 } && probe.Job(handle).State == ScriptRunState.Failed &&
                            !server.Requests.Any(IsInput) && !server.Requests.Any(request => request.StartsWith("host:transport:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) &&
                            server.Errors.IsEmpty, "Generation changed during SetDevice but a command was sent, the job succeeded, or the owned wire fixture failed.");
                    });
                }
                catch (Exception error) { primary = error; }
                finally { server.Release.TrySetResult(); try { await server.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(Deadline); } catch (Exception error) { cleanup = error; } }
                if (primary is not null && cleanup is not null) throw new AggregateException(primary, cleanup);
                if (cleanup is not null) throw cleanup;
                if (primary is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(primary).Throw();
            }
        });
    }

    private static bool IsInput(string request) => request.Contains("input tap", StringComparison.Ordinal) || request.Contains("input swipe", StringComparison.Ordinal) || request.Contains("am start", StringComparison.Ordinal);
    private static ScriptStep Click() => new() { Action = "click", Value = "1,1" };
    private static ScriptPackage Package(params ScriptStep[] steps) => new() { Manifest = new() { Id = "job-package", Name = "Owned job package", Version = "author-7" }, Steps = [.. steps] };
    private static ScriptPackage BoundPackage() => Package(Click(), Click()) with
    {
        Parameters = [new() { Key = "point", Type = "string", Value = Element("\"40,50\"") }],
        ExecutionContract = new() { Version = 1, Bindings = [new() { StepIndex = 0, Field = "value", ParameterKey = "point" }, new() { StepIndex = 1, Field = "value", ParameterKey = "point" }] }
    };
    private static JsonElement Element(string json) { using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(json); return document.RootElement.Clone(); }
    private static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }
    private static void Reject(Action action)
    {
        try { action(); } catch (DeviceException) { return; }
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Rejected submission did not throw DeviceException before admission.");
    }
    private static async Task<Exception?> Observe(Task task)
    {
        try { await task.WaitAsync(Deadline); return null; } catch (TimeoutException) { throw; } catch (Exception error) { return error; }
    }
    private static async Task<Exception?> Observe(Func<Task> action)
    { try { return await Observe(action()); } catch (TimeoutException) { throw; } catch (Exception error) { return error; } }
    private static Task Demo(Func<Probe, Task> run) => Run(new DemoDeviceBackend(), null, true, run);
    private static async Task Adb(Func<Probe, FakeAdbServer, AdbDeviceBackend, Task> run)
    {
        var server = new FakeAdbServer();
        var backend = new AdbDeviceBackend(new AppSettings { AdbAllowedSerials = ["allowed"], CommandTimeoutSeconds = 5 }, server.Endpoint);
        await Run(backend, server, false, probe => run(probe, server, backend));
    }
    private static async Task Run(IDeviceBackend inner, FakeAdbServer? server, bool demo, Func<Probe, Task> run)
    {
        var backend = new RecordingBackend(inner, demo); var probe = new Probe(backend, demo);
        Exception? failure = null; var cleanup = new List<Exception>();
        try { await probe.Catalog.RefreshAsync(); probe.Scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend, probe.Catalog, demo); await run(probe); }
        catch (Exception error) { failure = error; }
        finally
        {
            backend.Release.TrySetResult(); server?.GateRelease.TrySetResult();
            if (probe.Scheduler is not null)
            {
                try { foreach (var job in probe.Scheduler.GetJobs()) if (job.State is ScriptRunState.Running or ScriptRunState.Cancelling) probe.Scheduler.CancelJob(job.JobId); }
                catch (Exception error) { cleanup.Add(error); }
                try { await probe.Scheduler.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(Deadline); } catch (Exception error) { cleanup.Add(error); }
            }
            foreach (var task in probe.Tasks.Concat(backend.CommandTasks).Distinct())
            {
                try { await task.WaitAsync(Deadline); } catch (Exception error) when (task.IsCompleted && error is not TimeoutException)
                { Console.WriteLine($"OBSERVED script-job-task {task.Status}: {error.GetType().Name}: {error.Message}"); }
                catch (Exception error) { cleanup.Add(error); }
            }
            try { await backend.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(Deadline); } catch (Exception error) { cleanup.Add(error); }
            if (server is not null) try { await server.DisposeAsync().AsTask().WaitAsync(Deadline); } catch (Exception error) { cleanup.Add(error); }
        }
        if (cleanup.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("Owned script job fixture cleanup failed.", failure is null ? cleanup : new[] { failure }.Concat(cleanup));
        if (failure is not null) ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(failure).Throw();
    }

    private sealed class Probe(RecordingBackend backend, bool demo)
    {
        public RecordingBackend Backend { get; } = backend;
        public DeviceCatalog Catalog { get; } = new(backend);
        public ScriptScheduler Scheduler { get; set; } = null!;
        public List<Task> Tasks { get; } = [];
        public ScriptJobTarget Target(string serial) { var info = Catalog.GetRequired(serial); return new(info.Serial, info.Generation, info.TransportId, demo); }
        public ScriptJobHandle Submit(string serial, ScriptPackage package, CancellationToken ct = default, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>? overrides = null)
        { var handle = Scheduler.SubmitJob(Target(serial), package, ct, overrides); Track(handle.Completion); return handle; }
        public ScriptJobStatus Job(ScriptJobHandle handle) => Scheduler.GetJob(handle.JobId) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Accepted job disappeared.");
        public Task<T> Track<T>(Task<T> task) { Tasks.Add(task); return task; }
        public Task Track(Task task) { Tasks.Add(task); return task; }
    }

    private sealed record Call(DeviceCommandTarget Target, string Action, string Value);
    private sealed class RecordingBackend(IDeviceBackend inner, bool third) : IDeviceBackend, IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend
    {
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend? other = third ? new() : null;
        private int firstTap;
        public IDeviceBackend Inner { get; } = inner;
        public ConcurrentQueue<Call> Calls { get; } = new();
        public ConcurrentBag<Task> CommandTasks { get; } = [];
        public ConcurrentQueue<string> LaunchOutputs { get; } = new();
        public bool HoldBeforeFirstTap { get; set; }
        public bool HoldAfterFirstTap { get; set; }
        public bool IgnoreHeldCancellation { get; set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>? InventoryOverride { get; set; }
        public int LegacyWrites { get; private set; }
        public TaskCompletionSource Entered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource Release { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource Submitted { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands BindIdentity(DeviceCatalog catalog) => new Commands(this, ((IIdentityPinnedDeviceBackend)inner).BindIdentity(catalog));
        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
        { if (InventoryOverride is { } inventory) { ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested(); return inventory; } var result = await inner.DiscoverAsync(ct); return other is null ? result : result.Concat((await other.DiscoverAsync(ct)).Take(1).Select(info => info with { Serial = "DEMO-003" })).ToArray(); }
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => serial == "DEMO-003" && other is not null ? other.DumpAsync("DEMO-001", ct) : inner.DumpAsync(serial, ct);
        public async Task<string> Taps(string serial) => (await DumpAsync(serial)).ChildNodeList[1].Text!;
        private Task Forbidden() { LegacyWrites++; throw new InvalidOperationException("Pinned script used the legacy serial-only command interface."); }
        public Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forbidden();
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default) => Forbidden();
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default) { Forbidden(); return Task.FromResult(""); }
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ShellAsync(serial, command, useRoot, ct);
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ScreenshotAsync(serial, ct);
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.KeyEventAsync(serial, code, ct);
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.TextAsync(serial, text, ct);
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.StopAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ClearAppAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.ListAppsAsync(serial, showSystem, needVersion, ct);
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.InstallAsync(serial, localPath, ct);
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.UninstallAsync(serial, packageName, ct);
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PushAsync(serial, localPath, remotePath, progress, ct);
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.PullAsync(serial, remotePath, localPath, progress, ct);
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => inner.SetNodeTextAsync(serial, selector, text, ct);
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() { Release.TrySetResult(); await inner.DisposeAsync(); if (other is not null) await other.DisposeAsync(); }

        private sealed class Commands(RecordingBackend owner, IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands innerCommands) : IIdentityPinnedDeviceCommands
        {
            public bool IsDemo => innerCommands.IsDemo;
            public Task TapAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default)
            {
                var task = TapCore(target, x, y, ct); owner.CommandTasks.Add(task); return task;
            }
            private async Task TapCore(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct)
            {
                owner.Calls.Enqueue(new(target, "click", $"{x},{y}"));
                var held = target.Serial == "DEMO-001" && Interlocked.Increment(ref owner.firstTap) == 1;
                if (held && owner.HoldBeforeFirstTap)
                { owner.Entered.TrySetResult(); if (owner.IgnoreHeldCancellation) await owner.Release.Task; else await owner.Release.Task.WaitAsync(ct); }
                var actual = innerCommands.TapAsync(target, x, y, held && owner.IgnoreHeldCancellation ? CancellationToken.None : ct);
                owner.Submitted.TrySetResult(); await actual;
                if (held && owner.HoldAfterFirstTap) { owner.Entered.TrySetResult(); await owner.Release.Task; }
            }
            public Task SwipeAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default)
            { owner.Calls.Enqueue(new(target, "swipe", $"{x1},{y1},{x2},{y2},{durationMs}")); var task = innerCommands.SwipeAsync(target, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct); owner.CommandTasks.Add(task); return task; }
            public Task<string> StartAppAsync(DeviceCommandTarget target, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default)
            { owner.Calls.Enqueue(new(target, "launch", packageName)); var task = LaunchCore(target, packageName, ct); owner.CommandTasks.Add(task); return task; }
            private async Task<string> LaunchCore(DeviceCommandTarget target, string packageName, CancellationToken ct)
            { var actual = await innerCommands.StartAppAsync(target, packageName, ct); return owner.LaunchOutputs.TryDequeue(out var output) ? output : actual; }
        }
    }

    private sealed class SetDeviceBarrierServer : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        private readonly TcpListener listener = new(IPAddress.Loopback, 0);
        private readonly CancellationTokenSource stop = new();
        private readonly ConcurrentBag<Task> clients = [];
        private readonly Task accepting;
        private int armed;
        public ConcurrentQueue<string> Requests { get; } = new();
        public ConcurrentQueue<string> Errors { get; } = new();
        public TaskCompletionSource Entered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource Release { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public IPEndPoint Endpoint => (IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint;
        public SetDeviceBarrierServer() { listener.Start(); accepting = Accept(); }
        public void ArmNextTransport(int nth = 1)
        { if (nth is not (1 or 2)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(nth)); Interlocked.Exchange(ref armed, nth); }
        private async Task Accept()
        {
            try { while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested) { var client = await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(stop.Token); clients.Add(Handle(client)); } }
            catch (Exception error) when (stop.IsCancellationRequested && error is OperationCanceledException or ObjectDisposedException or SocketException) { }
        }
        private async Task Handle(TcpClient client)
        {
            using (client)
            {
                try
                {
                    var stream = client.GetStream();
                    while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
                    {
                        var prefix = new byte[4]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(prefix, stop.Token);
                        var length = int.Parse(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(prefix), NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                        if (length is < 1 or > 8192) throw new InvalidDataException("Unexpected owned ADB request length.");
                        var bytes = new byte[length]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(bytes, stop.Token);
                        var request = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes); Requests.Enqueue(request);
                        if (request is "host:version" or "host:devices-l")
                        {
                            var payload = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(request == "host:version" ? "0029" : "allowed\tdevice model:Test transport_id:1\n");
                            await stream.WriteAsync(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("OKAY" + payload.Length.ToString("X4", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)), stop.Token);
                            await stream.WriteAsync(payload, stop.Token); return;
                        }
                        if (request == "host:transport-id:1")
                        {
                            if (Volatile.Read(ref armed) > 0 && Interlocked.Decrement(ref armed) == 0) { Entered.TrySetResult(); await Release.Task.WaitAsync(stop.Token); }
                            await stream.WriteAsync("OKAY"u8.ToArray(), stop.Token); continue;
                        }
                        if (!request.StartsWith("shell,v2,raw:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new InvalidDataException("Unexpected owned ADB request: " + request);
                        await stream.WriteAsync("OKAY"u8.ToArray(), stop.Token);
                        var stdin = new byte[5]; await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(stdin, stop.Token);
                        var command = request[13..];
                        var output = command.StartsWith("cmd package resolve-activity ", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "com.android.settings/.Settings\n" :
                            command.StartsWith("am start -W ", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "Starting: Intent\nStatus: ok\n" : command switch
                        {
                            "getprop" => "[ro.product.brand]: [Fixture]\n[ro.product.model]: [Test]\n[ro.build.version.release]: [14]\n",
                            "wm size" => "Physical size: 4x3\n",
                            "dumpsys input" => "SurfaceOrientation: 0\n",
                            _ => "fixture\n"
                        };
                        await Packet(stream, 1, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(output)); await Packet(stream, 3, [0]); return;
                    }
                }
                catch (EndOfStreamException) { }
                catch (Exception error) when (stop.IsCancellationRequested && error is OperationCanceledException or ObjectDisposedException or IOException or SocketException) { }
                catch (Exception error) { Errors.Enqueue(error.ToString()); }
            }
        }
        private async Task Packet(Stream stream, byte channel, byte[] payload)
        {
            var header = new byte[5]; header[0] = channel; BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32LittleEndian(header.AsSpan(1), payload.Length);
            await stream.WriteAsync(header, stop.Token); await stream.WriteAsync(payload, stop.Token);
        }
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() { Release.TrySetResult(); stop.Cancel(); listener.Stop(); await accepting; await Task.WhenAll(clients); stop.Dispose(); }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        {
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); await using var backend = new RecordingBackend { HoldFirstTap = true }; await using var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend);
            var wire = Wire(value: "\"40,50\"");
            wire["steps"]!.AsArray().Add(JsonNode.Parse("{\"action\":\"click\",\"value\":\"10,20\"}"));
            wire["executionContract"]!["bindings"]!.AsArray().Add(Binding(1, "value", "point"));
            var package = files.RoundTrip(wire); var overrides = new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["point"] = Element("\"80,90\"") };
            var running = RunWithOverrides(scheduler, "DEMO-001", package, overrides);
            try
            {
                await backend.FirstTapEntered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
                package.Steps.Clear(); package.Parameters.Clear(); overrides["point"] = Element("null");
            }
            finally { backend.ReleaseFirstTap.TrySetResult(); }
            await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
            Check(backend.Writes.Count == 2 && backend.Writes.All(write => write.Value == "80,90") && await backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 2", "Accepted steps changed after source mutation.");
            Check(package.Steps.Count == 0 && package.Parameters.Count == 0 && overrides["point"].ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null, "Executor restored or modified caller-owned inputs.");
        });
        test("Script bindings version and binding shape errors reject before admission", async () =>
        {
            var invalid = new List<JsonObject>();
            foreach (var version in new[] { 0, 2, -1 }) { var wire = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); wire["executionContract"]!["version"] = version; invalid.Add(wire); }
            var noVersion = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); noVersion["executionContract"]!.AsObject().Remove("version"); invalid.Add(noVersion);
            var noBindings = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); noBindings["executionContract"]!.AsObject().Remove("bindings"); invalid.Add(noBindings);
            var nullBindings = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); nullBindings["executionContract"]!["bindings"] = null; invalid.Add(nullBindings);
            foreach (var bindings in new[] { "[null]", "[{\"field\":\"value\",\"parameterKey\":\"point\"}]", "[{\"stepIndex\":-1,\"field\":\"value\",\"parameterKey\":\"point\"}]", "[{\"stepIndex\":1,\"field\":\"value\",\"parameterKey\":\"point\"}]", "[{\"stepIndex\":0,\"field\":\"Value\",\"parameterKey\":\"point\"}]", "[{\"stepIndex\":0,\"field\":\"value\",\"parameterKey\":\"Point\"}]", "[{\"stepIndex\":0,\"field\":\"value\",\"parameterKey\":\" \"}]" })
            { var wire = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); wire["executionContract"]!["bindings"] = JsonNode.Parse(bindings); invalid.Add(wire); }
            var duplicate = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); duplicate["executionContract"]!["bindings"]!.AsArray().Add(Binding(0, "value", "point")); invalid.Add(duplicate);
            foreach (var wire in invalid) await RejectWire(wire);
        });
        test("Script bindings fields must be consumed by the selected action", async () =>
        {
            var waitValue = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); waitValue["steps"]![0] = JsonNode.Parse("{\"action\":\"wait\",\"durationMs\":0}");
            await RejectWire(waitValue);
            foreach (var action in new[] { "click", "swipe", "launch", "launchapp" })
            {
                var wire = DurationWire("0"); wire["steps"]![0] = new JsonObject { ["action"] = action, ["value"] = action is "launch" or "launchapp" ? "com.matrix.demo" : action == "click" ? "10,20" : "10,20,30,40,100" };
                await RejectWire(wire);
            }
        });
        test("Script bindings nonnull Probability rejects only the new execution contract", async () =>
        {
            foreach (var probability in new[] { 0, 0.5, 1 })
            {
                var wire = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); wire["steps"]![0]!["probability"] = probability;
                await RejectWire(wire);
            }
        });
        test("Script bindings resolved action syntax is validated before a Running state", async () =>
        {
            foreach (var (action, literal, value) in new[] { ("click", "10,20", "not-coordinates"), ("launch", "com.matrix.demo", "invalid package"), ("launchapp", "com.matrix.demo", "1.bad"), ("swipe", "10,20,30,40,100", "10,20,30,40,0") })
            {
                var wire = Wire(value: JsonSerializer.Serialize(value)); wire["steps"]![0] = new JsonObject { ["action"] = action, ["value"] = literal };
                await RejectWire(wire);
            }
        });
        test("Script bindings full Value refuses JSON coercion and undefined override values", async () =>
        {
            foreach (var value in new[] { "42", "true", "[]", "{}", "\"\"" })
            {
                var wire = Wire(value: value, fallback: "\"60,70\""); wire["parameters"]![0]!.AsObject().Remove("type"); await RejectWire(wire);
            }
        });
        test("Script bindings duration accepts zero and Int32 maximum without changing literal package", async () =>
        {
            foreach (var value in new[] { "0", "2147483647" })
            {
                using var files = new PackageFiles(); var package = files.RoundTrip(DurationWire(value));
                var compiled = Compile(package, null);
                Check(compiled.Steps.Single().DurationMs == int.Parse(value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) && package.Steps.Single().DurationMs == 0, "Int32 duration binding or source isolation failed.");
            }
            using var runnableFiles = new PackageFiles(); await using var backend = new RecordingBackend(); await using var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend);
            await scheduler.RunAsync("DEMO-001", runnableFiles.RoundTrip(DurationWire("0")));
            Check(scheduler.GetStatus("DEMO-001").State == ScriptRunState.Completed && backend.Writes.IsEmpty, "Zero-duration wait did not complete without input.");
        });
        test("Script bindings duration rejects negative overflow fraction exponent and nonnumeric values", async () =>
        {
            foreach (var value in new[] { "-1", "2147483648", "1.5", "1.0", "1e0", "\"1\"", "true", "[]", "{}", "null" }) await RejectWire(DurationWire(value));
        });
        test("Script bindings nonzero duration reaches the original wait and cancellation prevents its next action", async () =>
        {
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); await using var backend = new RecordingBackend(); await using var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend);
            var wire = DurationWire("10000"); wire["steps"]!.AsArray().Add(JsonNode.Parse("{\"action\":\"click\",\"value\":\"10,20\"}"));
            var entered = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            scheduler.EntryAdded += (_, entry) => { if (entry.Message.StartsWith("步骤 1/2：", StringComparison.Ordinal)) entered.TrySetResult(); };
            var package = files.RoundTrip(wire); var running = scheduler.RunAsync("DEMO-001", package);
            try
            {
                await entered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
                await Task.Delay(50);
                Check(!running.IsCompleted && backend.Writes.IsEmpty, "PRODUCT-WRONG-EFFECT: bound nonzero duration did not wait before the next action.");
            }
            finally
            {
                scheduler.Stop("DEMO-001");
                await running.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
            }
            Check(scheduler.GetStatus("DEMO-001").State == ScriptRunState.Cancelled && backend.Writes.IsEmpty && await backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 0", "Bound wait cancellation ran its next action or did not become terminal Cancelled.");
            Check(Compile(package, null).Steps[0].DurationMs == 10000, "Bound nonzero duration did not preserve its exact Int32 value.");
        });
        test("Script bindings overrides respect declared type numeric bounds and exact keys", async () =>
        {
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); var wire = DurationWire("0"); wire["parameters"]![0]!["type"] = "int"; wire["parameters"]![0]!["min"] = 0; wire["parameters"]![0]!["max"] = 5;
            var package = files.RoundTrip(wire);
            foreach (var overrides in new[]
            {
                new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["delay"] = Element("6") },
                new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["delay"] = Element("\"2\"") },
                new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["Delay"] = Element("2") },
                new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["unknown"] = Element("2") }
            }) await RejectBeforeRun(package, overrides);
        });
        test("Script bindings ordinary literal actions and parameterized launch and swipe use the existing backend", async () =>
        {
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); await using var backend = new RecordingBackend(); await using var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend);
            var wire = Wire(value: "\"10,20,30,40,100\""); wire["steps"] = JsonNode.Parse("[{\"action\":\"launchapp\",\"value\":\"com.matrix.demo\"},{\"action\":\"swipe\",\"value\":\"1,2,3,4,50\"},{\"action\":\"click\",\"value\":\"15,25\"}]");
            wire["parameters"]!.AsArray().Add(new JsonObject { ["key"] = "app", ["type"] = "string", ["defaultValue"] = "com.android.settings" });
            wire["executionContract"]!["bindings"] = new JsonArray(Binding(0, "value", "app"), Binding(1, "value", "point"));
            await scheduler.RunAsync("DEMO-001", files.RoundTrip(wire));
            Check(backend.Writes.SequenceEqual(new[] { new Write("DEMO-001", "launch", "com.android.settings"), new Write("DEMO-001", "swipe", "10,20,30,40,100"), new Write("DEMO-001", "click", "15,25") }), "Parameterized launch/swipe or unbound literal call changed.");
            Check((await backend.DumpAsync("DEMO-001")).PackageName == "com.android.settings" && await backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 2", "Original Demo engine did not observe launch and both input effects.");
        });
        test("Script bindings legacy packages retain Probability raw steps and nullable values after resource-bearing import", async () =>
        {
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); await using var backend = new RecordingBackend(); await using var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend);
            var wire = Wire(value: "null", fallback: "\"60,70\""); wire.Remove("executionContract"); wire["steps"]![0]!["probability"] = 0;
            var package = files.RoundTrip(wire);
            Check(package.Parameters.Single().Value is null && package.Steps.Single().Probability == 0, "Legacy nullable/Probability interpretation changed.");
            await scheduler.RunAsync("DEMO-001", package);
            Check(backend.Writes.Single().Value == "10,20" && await backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 1", "Legacy parameters or Probability acquired new execution meaning.");
            wire["executionContract"] = null;
            await scheduler.RunAsync("DEMO-002", files.RoundTrip(wire));
            Check(backend.Writes.Last().Value == "10,20" && await backend.Taps("DEMO-002") == "Tap 1", "Explicit null contract no longer uses the legacy path.");
            await RunWithOverrides(scheduler, "DEMO-001", package, new Dictionary<string, JsonElement>());
            Check(backend.Writes.Last().Value == "10,20" && await backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 2", "Empty overrides changed legacy execution.");
        });
        test("Script bindings nonempty overrides on a legacy package reject rather than silently disappear", async () =>
        {
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); var wire = Wire(value: "\"40,50\""); wire.Remove("executionContract");
            await RejectBeforeRun(files.RoundTrip(wire), new Dictionary<string, JsonElement> { ["point"] = Element("\"80,90\"") });
        });
        test("Script bindings scoped null handling never changes global JsonDefaults behavior", () =>
        {
            var options = JsonDefaults.Options; var converters = options.Converters.ToArray(); var ignore = options.DefaultIgnoreCondition;
            var legacyBefore = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new ScriptParameter { Key = "probe", Value = null }, options);
            using var files = new PackageFiles(); files.RoundTrip(Wire(value: "null", fallback: "\"60,70\""));
            var legacyAfter = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ScriptParameter>("{\"key\":\"probe\",\"value\":null}", options)!;
            Check(ReferenceEquals(options, JsonDefaults.Options) && options.DefaultIgnoreCondition == ignore && options.Converters.SequenceEqual(converters), "V1 parsing changed global serializer configuration.");
            Check(legacyAfter.Value is null && legacyBefore == JsonSerializer.Serialize(new ScriptParameter { Key = "probe", Value = null }, options), "V1 converter leaked to ordinary model serialization.");
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
    }

    private static JsonObject Wire(string? value = null, string? fallback = null)
    {
        var parameter = new JsonObject { ["key"] = "point", ["type"] = "string" };
        if (value is not null) parameter["value"] = JsonNode.Parse(value);
        if (fallback is not null) parameter["defaultValue"] = JsonNode.Parse(fallback);
        return new JsonObject
        {
            ["steps"] = JsonNode.Parse("[{\"action\":\"click\",\"value\":\"10,20\"}]"),
            ["parameters"] = new JsonArray(parameter),
            ["executionContract"] = new JsonObject { ["version"] = 1, ["bindings"] = new JsonArray(Binding(0, "value", "point")) }
        };
    }
    private static JsonObject DurationWire(string value)
    {
        var wire = Wire(); wire["steps"] = JsonNode.Parse("[{\"action\":\"wait\",\"durationMs\":0}]");
        wire["parameters"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["key"] = "delay", ["value"] = JsonNode.Parse(value) });
        wire["executionContract"]!["bindings"] = new JsonArray(Binding(0, "durationMs", "delay")); return wire;
    }
    private static JsonObject Binding(int index, string field, string key) => new() { ["stepIndex"] = index, ["field"] = field, ["parameterKey"] = key };
    private static JsonElement Element(string json) { using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(json); return document.RootElement.Clone(); }
    private static Task RunWithOverrides(ScriptScheduler scheduler, string serial, ScriptPackage package, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement> overrides)
    {
        var method = typeof(ScriptScheduler).GetMethod("RunAsync", [typeof(string), typeof(ScriptPackage), typeof(CancellationToken), typeof(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>)]);
        if (method is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("CONTRACT-NOT-IMPLEMENTED: RunAsync(string, ScriptPackage, CancellationToken, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>).");
        return (Task)Invoke(method, scheduler, [serial, package, CancellationToken.None, overrides])!;
    }
    private static ScriptPackage Compile(ScriptPackage package, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>? overrides)
    {
        var type = typeof(ScriptPackage).Assembly.GetType("MatrixDevice.Features.ScriptExecutionCompiler");
        var method = type?.GetMethod("Compile", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static, binder: null, types: [typeof(ScriptPackage), typeof(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>)], modifiers: null);
        if (method is null) throw new InvalidOperationException("CONTRACT-NOT-IMPLEMENTED: ScriptExecutionCompiler.Compile(ScriptPackage, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>).");
        return (ScriptPackage)Invoke(method, null, [package, overrides])!;
    }
    private static object? Invoke(MethodInfo method, object? target, object?[] arguments)
    {
        try { return method.Invoke(target, arguments); }
        catch (TargetInvocationException error) when (error.InnerException is not null) { ExceptionDispatchInfo.Capture(error.InnerException).Throw(); throw; }
    }
    private static async Task RejectWire(JsonObject wire)
    {
        using var files = new PackageFiles(); ScriptPackage package;
        try { package = files.RoundTrip(wire); }
        catch (DeviceException error) { Check(error.Status == 400 && error.Code == 1007, "Invalid wire was not rejected as 400/1007."); return; }
        await RejectBeforeRun(package);
    }
    private static async Task RejectBeforeRun(ScriptPackage package, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement>? overrides = null)
    {
        await using var backend = new RecordingBackend(); await using var scheduler = new ScriptScheduler(backend); var statuses = new List<ScriptRunStatus>(); scheduler.StatusChanged += statuses.Add;
        DeviceException? failure = null;
        try { if (overrides is null) await scheduler.RunAsync("DEMO-001", package); else await RunWithOverrides(scheduler, "DEMO-001", package, overrides); }
        catch (DeviceException error) { failure = error; }
        Check(failure is { Status: 400, Code: 1007 }, "PRODUCT-INVALID-ADMITTED: invalid bound input was not rejected as 400/1007 before scheduling.");
        Check(backend.Writes.IsEmpty && statuses.Count == 0 && scheduler.GetStatus("DEMO-001").State == ScriptRunState.Idle && scheduler.GetLogs("DEMO-001").Count == 0, "Rejected bindings touched the backend or created a Running/log state.");
        Check(await backend.Taps("DEMO-001") == "Tap 0" && await backend.Taps("DEMO-002") == "Tap 0" && await backend.Taps("DEMO-003") == "Tap 0", "Rejected bindings changed a Demo target.");
    }
    private static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message); }

    private sealed class PackageFiles : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly string directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "matrix-script-binding-tests-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        public string SavedPath => Path.Combine(directory, "saved.jxscript");
        public ScriptPackage RoundTrip(JsonObject wire)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory); var path = Path.Combine(directory, "source.jxscript");
            using (var archive = ZipFile.Open(path, ZipArchiveMode.Create))
            {
                Write("manifest.json", "{\"id\":\"binding-test\",\"name\":\"Binding test\",\"version\":\"author-42\"}");
                Write("script.json", wire.ToJsonString()); Write("resources/not-executable.txt", "Attached data is not code.");
                void Write(string name, string text) { using var writer = new StreamWriter(archive.CreateEntry(name).Open()); writer.Write(text); }
            }
            var imported = ScriptPackageService.Load(path);
            ScriptPackageService.Save(SavedPath, imported); var loaded = ScriptPackageService.Load(SavedPath);
            Check(loaded.Manifest.Version == "author-42", "Execution contract reused the manifest author version.");
            File.Delete(path); return loaded;
        }
        public void Dispose() { foreach (var file in new[] { Path.Combine(directory, "source.jxscript"), SavedPath }) if (File.Exists(file)) File.Delete(file); if (Directory.Exists(directory)) Directory.Delete(directory); }
    }
    private sealed record Write(string Serial, string Action, string Value);
    private sealed class RecordingBackend : IDeviceBackend
    {
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend first = new();
        private readonly DemoDeviceBackend third = new();
        public ConcurrentQueue<Write> Writes { get; } = new();
        public bool HoldFirstTap { get; init; }
        public TaskCompletionSource FirstTapEntered { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        public TaskCompletionSource ReleaseFirstTap { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        private int taps;
        public bool IsSimulation => true;
        private (DemoDeviceBackend Backend, string Serial) Target(string serial) => serial switch { "DEMO-001" or "DEMO-002" => (first, serial), "DEMO-003" => (third, "DEMO-001"), _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unknown fixture target: " + serial) };
        public async Task<string> Taps(string serial) => (await DumpAsync(serial)).ChildNodeList[1].Text!;
        public async Task TapAsync(string serial, int x, int y, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            Writes.Enqueue(new(serial, "click", $"{x},{y}"));
            if (HoldFirstTap && Interlocked.Increment(ref taps) == 1) { FirstTapEntered.TrySetResult(); await ReleaseFirstTap.Task.WaitAsync(ct); }
            var target = Target(serial); await target.Backend.TapAsync(target.Serial, x, y, ct);
        }
        public Task SwipeAsync(string serial, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2, int durationMs, CancellationToken ct = default)
        { Writes.Enqueue(new(serial, "swipe", $"{x1},{y1},{x2},{y2},{durationMs}")); var target = Target(serial); return target.Backend.SwipeAsync(target.Serial, x1, y1, x2, y2, durationMs, ct); }
        public Task<string> StartAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, string? activity = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
        { Writes.Enqueue(new(serial, "launch", packageName)); var target = Target(serial); return target.Backend.StartAppAsync(target.Serial, packageName, activity, ct); }
        public Task<AndroidNode> DumpAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) { var target = Target(serial); return target.Backend.DumpAsync(target.Serial, ct); }
        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<DeviceInfo>> DiscoverAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => (await first.DiscoverAsync(ct)).Concat((await third.DiscoverAsync(ct)).Take(1).Select(info => info with { Serial = "DEMO-003" })).ToArray();
        public Task<string> ShellAsync(string serial, string command, bool useRoot = false, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new InvalidOperationException("Scripts must not gain arbitrary shell execution.");
        public Task<byte[]> ScreenshotAsync(string serial, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task KeyEventAsync(string serial, int code, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task TextAsync(string serial, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task<string> StopAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task<bool> ClearAppAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task<IReadOnlyList<AppInfo>> ListAppsAsync(string serial, bool showSystem = false, bool needVersion = true, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task InstallAsync(string serial, string localPath, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task UninstallAsync(string serial, string packageName, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task PushAsync(string serial, string localPath, string remotePath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task PullAsync(string serial, string remotePath, string localPath, IProgress<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public Task SetNodeTextAsync(string serial, NodeSelector selector, string text, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() { ReleaseFirstTap.TrySetResult(); await first.DisposeAsync(); await third.DisposeAsync(); }
    }
}
```

## tools/Build.ps1

```powershell
param([string] $DotnetPath, [switch] $Verify)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$projectPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)).Path
if (-not $DotnetPath) {
    $bundled = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $projectPath) '.tools/dotnet/dotnet.exe'
    $DotnetPath = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bundled) { $bundled } else { (Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction Stop).Source }
}
$DotnetPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $DotnetPath).Path
$sdkVersion = & $DotnetPath --version
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cannot read .NET SDK version' }
$sdkRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $DotnetPath) ('sdk/' + $sdkVersion)
$oldDotnet = $env:MATRIX_DOTNET_EXE
$oldCompiler = $env:MATRIX_CSC_DLL
try {
    $env:MATRIX_DOTNET_EXE = $DotnetPath
    $env:MATRIX_CSC_DLL = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'Roslyn/bincore/csc.dll'
    $buildArgs = @('build', (Join-Path $projectPath 'MatrixDevice.slnx'), '-c', 'Release', '--nologo', '-m:1', '-p:UseSharedCompilation=false', '-p:CscToolExe=csc-managed.cmd', ('-p:CscToolPath=' + $PSScriptRoot))
    & $DotnetPath @buildArgs
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Project build failed' }
    if ($Verify) {
        & $DotnetPath (Join-Path $projectPath 'tests/MatrixDevice.Tests/bin/Release/net10.0/MatrixDevice.Tests.dll')
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Verification failed' }
        $mcpEvidence = 'artifacts/mcp-stdio-main/verify-' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
        Write-Output ('MCP_EVIDENCE_RELATIVE=' + $mcpEvidence)
        & $DotnetPath (Join-Path $projectPath 'tests/MatrixDevice.Mcp.Tests/bin/Release/net10.0/MatrixDevice.Mcp.Tests.dll') --dotnet $DotnetPath --server (Join-Path $projectPath 'src/MatrixDevice.Mcp/bin/Release/net10.0/MatrixDevice.Mcp.dll') --output (Join-Path $projectPath $mcpEvidence)
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'MCP Demo verification failed' }
        Write-Output ('MCP_DEMO_VERIFIED_RELATIVE=' + $mcpEvidence)
    }
} finally {
    $env:MATRIX_DOTNET_EXE = $oldDotnet
    $env:MATRIX_CSC_DLL = $oldCompiler
}
```

## tools/Get-AdbHostState.ps1

```powershell
param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $OutputDirectory)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($OutputDirectory)) { throw '证据目录必须为绝对路径。' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDirectory -Force | Out-Null
function Read-Exact([IO.Stream] $Stream, [int] $Length) {
    $bytes = [byte[]]::new($Length)
    $offset = 0
    while ($offset -lt $Length) {
        $count = $Stream.Read($bytes, $offset, $Length - $offset)
        if ($count -eq 0) { throw 'ADB host响应截断。' }
        $offset += $count
    }
    return ,$bytes
}
function Read-HostQuery([string] $Request) {
    if ($Request -notin @('host:version', 'host:devices-l')) { throw '仅允许主机只读查询。' }
    $client = [Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new()
    try {
        $connection = $client.ConnectAsync([Net.IPAddress]::Loopback, 5037)
        if (-not $connection.Wait(3000)) { throw '现有ADB服务连接超时；不启动服务。' }
        $stream = $client.GetStream()
        $stream.ReadTimeout = 3000
        $stream.WriteTimeout = 3000
        $body = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Request)
        $prefix = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($body.Length.ToString('X4'))
        $stream.Write($prefix)
        $stream.Write($body)
        $status = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString((Read-Exact $stream 4))
        $length = [Convert]::ToInt32([Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString((Read-Exact $stream 4)), 16)
        $result = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString((Read-Exact $stream $length))
        if ($status -ne 'OKAY') { throw "ADB host拒绝：$result" }
        return $result
    }
    finally { $client.Dispose() }
}
$owners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5037 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object {
        $process = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$_"
        [ordered]@{
            processId = $_
            executable = $process.ExecutablePath
            createdUtc = $process.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
            sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $process.ExecutablePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        }
    })
if ($owners.Count -gt 1) { throw "ADB5037所有者不唯一，实际=$($owners.Count)；不创建或停止服务。" }
$snapshot = [ordered]@{
    capturedUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    owner = if ($owners.Count -eq 1) { $owners[0] } else { $null }
    protocol = if ($owners.Count -eq 1) { Read-HostQuery 'host:version' } else { $null }
    devices = if ($owners.Count -eq 1) { Read-HostQuery 'host:devices-l' } else { $null }
    guestCommands = 0
}
$path = Join-Path $OutputDirectory ('adb-host-' + [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-fff') + '.json')
$snapshot | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Encoding utf8
$snapshot | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
```

## tools/Invoke-HttpToolkitMcp.ps1

```powershell
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $OutputPath, [string] $ToolName = '', [string] $ArgumentsJson = '{}')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($OutputPath)) { throw '输出路径须为绝对路径。' }
$command = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\HTTP Toolkit\resources\httptoolkit-mcp.cmd'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $command -PathType Leaf)) { throw '未安装官方HTTP Toolkit MCP CLI。' }
$start = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new('cmd.exe')
$start.Arguments = '/d /s /c ""' + $command + '""'
$start.UseShellExecute = $false; $start.CreateNoWindow = $true; $start.WindowStyle = 'Hidden'
$start.RedirectStandardInput = $true; $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
$process = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
$errorRead = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
$responses = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function Call-Rpc([int] $Id, [string] $Method, [object] $Parameters) {
    $request = @{jsonrpc='2.0'; id=$Id; method=$Method; params=$Parameters}
    $process.StandardInput.WriteLine(($request | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 40 -Compress)); $process.StandardInput.Flush()
    $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(45)
    while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline) {
        $read = $process.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync()
        if (-not $read.Wait(45000)) { throw "HTTP Toolkit MCP超时：$Method" }
        if ($null -eq $read.Result) { throw 'HTTP Toolkit MCP输出提前结束。' }
        $response = $read.Result | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 80
        $responses.Add($response)
        if ($response.id -eq $Id) { return $response }
    }
    throw "HTTP Toolkit MCP超时：$Method"
}
try {
    [void](Call-Rpc 1 'initialize' @{protocolVersion='2025-11-25'; capabilities=@{}; clientInfo=@{name='matrix-multi-acceptance';version='1.0'}})
    $process.StandardInput.WriteLine('{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}'); $process.StandardInput.Flush()
    $listed = Call-Rpc 2 'tools/list' @{}
    if ($ToolName) {
        $tool = @($listed.result.tools | Where-Object name -eq $ToolName)
        if ($tool.Count -ne 1 -or $tool[0].annotations.readOnlyHint -ne $true) { throw '仅允许当前官方列表中明确标记只读的工具。' }
        $arguments = $ArgumentsJson | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable -Depth 80
        $called = Call-Rpc 3 'tools/call' @{name=$ToolName;arguments=$arguments}
        if ($called.error -or $called.result.isError) { throw 'HTTP Toolkit拒绝此只读调用，结果未计为捕获成功。' }
    }
} finally {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $OutputPath) -Force | Out-Null
    $responses | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 100 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $OutputPath -Encoding utf8NoBOM
    try { $process.StandardInput.Close() } catch [IO.IOException] { Write-Warning $_.Exception.Message }
    if (-not $process.WaitForExit(3000)) { $process.Kill() }
    if ($errorRead.Wait(3000)) { $errorRead.Result | Set-Content -LiteralPath ($OutputPath + '.stderr.txt') -Encoding utf8NoBOM }
    $process.Dispose()
}
if ($ToolName) { $called | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 40 }
else { $listed.result.tools | Select-Object name,description,annotations,inputSchema | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 }

```

## tools/Measure-MultiEvidence.ps1

```powershell
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Directory, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $SpecFile)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$directoryPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Directory).Path
function Read-Journal([string] $Name) {
    @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directoryPath $Name) | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | ConvertFrom-Json)
}
function Percentile([double[]] $Values, [double] $Fraction) {
    if ($Values.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No values for percentile' }
    $ordered = @($Values | Sort-Object)
    $ordered[[math]::Max(0, [math]::Ceiling($ordered.Count * $Fraction) - 1)]
}
$summaries = Read-Journal 'summary.jsonl'
if ($summaries.Count -ne 1 -or $summaries[0].status -ne 'PASS-LIVE-MULTI') { throw 'Only a completed successful run can be analyzed as acceptance evidence' }
$summary = $summaries[0]
$specPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $SpecFile).Path
$spec = Get-Content -LiteralPath $specPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directoryPath 'run-manifest.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $specPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $manifest.specSha256) { throw 'Run manifest does not match the supplied specification' }
if ($spec.minutes -lt 1 -or $spec.minutes -gt 30 -or $summary.pressureMs -lt $spec.minutes * 60000 -or $summary.targetCount -ne $spec.targets.Count) { throw 'Completed duration or target count is below specification' }
$cases = Read-Journal 'results.jsonl'
if (@($cases | Where-Object { $_.status -ne 'PASS-LIVE' }).Count) { throw 'Failed cases cannot be counted as successful acceptance' }
foreach ($case in $cases) {
    $file = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $directoryPath $case.file))
    if (-not $file.StartsWith($directoryPath + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Case path is outside evidence directory' }
    if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $case.sha256) { throw "Case hash mismatch: $($case.file)" }
}
$rounds = @($cases | Where-Object { $_.task -match '^round-\d+$' })
$returns = Read-Journal 'returns.jsonl'
if ($rounds.Count -ne $returns.Count) { throw 'Round and return counts differ' }
$http = Read-Journal 'http.jsonl'
$requestIds = @($http.id | Select-Object -Unique)
if ($requestIds.Count -ne $http.Count) { throw 'Duplicate HTTP request ID' }
$keys = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
foreach ($returned in $returns) {
    $target = @($spec.targets | Where-Object { $_.serial -eq $returned.serial -and $_.index -eq $returned.index })
    if ($target.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Return is not from a unique specified target' }
    if (-not $keys.Add("$($returned.serial):$($returned.round)")) { throw 'Duplicate device/round return' }
    $case = @($rounds | Where-Object { $_.serial -eq $returned.serial -and $_.task -eq "round-$($returned.round)" })
    if ($case.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Return has no unique successful round' }
    $payload = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directoryPath $case[0].file) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($payload.nonce -ne $returned.nonce -or $payload.sha256 -ne $returned.sha256 -or $payload.text -ne $returned.text) { throw 'Return does not match recorded actual round' }
    $ack = @($http | Where-Object { $_.task -eq 'data-return' -and $_.body.serial -eq $returned.serial -and $_.body.round -eq $returned.round })
    if ($ack.Count -ne 1 -or $ack[0].status -ne 200) { throw 'Missing unique HTTP acknowledgement' }
    if ($ack[0].body.sha256 -ne $returned.sha256 -or $ack[0].body.nonce -ne $returned.nonce -or $ack[0].body.text -ne $returned.text) { throw 'HTTP return payload does not match actual round' }
    $reply = $ack[0].response | ConvertFrom-Json
    if (-not $reply.accepted -or $reply.serial -ne $returned.serial -or $reply.nonce -ne $returned.nonce) { throw 'Incorrect HTTP acknowledgement' }
    $textRequests = @($http | Where-Object { $_.task -eq 'text-input' -and $_.serial -eq $returned.serial -and $_.body.text -eq $returned.text })
    if ($textRequests.Count -ne 1 -or $textRequests[0].status -ne 200) { throw 'Missing unique successful text request' }
    $identity = @($http | Where-Object { $_.task -eq 'identity-return' -and $_.serial -eq $returned.serial -and $_.response.Contains($returned.sha256, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) })
    if ($identity.Count -ne 1 -or $identity[0].status -ne 200) { throw 'Missing unique successful device readback' }
    $readback = ($identity[0].response | ConvertFrom-Json).data.output
    if (-not $readback.StartsWith($returned.nonce, [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -or -not $readback.Contains($returned.sha256, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Device readback does not match instance nonce and file hash' }
}
$pressureStart = @($rounds | Sort-Object { [datetimeoffset] $_.start })[0].start
$resources = @(Read-Journal 'resources.jsonl' | Where-Object { [datetimeoffset] $_.utc -ge [datetimeoffset] $pressureStart })
if ($resources.Count -lt 2) { throw 'Not enough pressure resource samples' }
$workers = Read-Journal 'workers.jsonl'
$deviceStats = foreach ($group in $returns | Group-Object serial) {
    $serial = $group.Name
    $items = @($rounds | Where-Object { $_.serial -eq $serial } | Sort-Object { [datetimeoffset] $_.start })
    $end = @($workers | Where-Object { $_.serial -eq $serial -and $_.state -eq 'end' })
    if ($end.Count -ne 1 -or $end[0].rounds -ne $items.Count -or $end[0].returns -ne $items.Count) { throw 'Worker totals do not match successful rounds' }
    $summaryCount = @($summary.returns.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $serial })
    if ($summaryCount.Count -ne 1 -or $summaryCount[0].Value -ne $items.Count) { throw 'Summary return totals do not match successful rounds' }
    $nonce = @($group.Group.nonce | Select-Object -Unique)
    if ($nonce.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Worker nonce changed' }
    $gaps = @(for ($i = 1; $i -lt $items.Count; $i++) { ([datetimeoffset]$items[$i].end - [datetimeoffset]$items[$i-1].end).TotalMilliseconds })
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Serial = $serial; Index = $group.Group[0].index; Rounds = $items.Count
        UploadMiB = ($group.Group.bytes | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum / 1MB
        MedianRoundMs = Percentile $items.durationMs .5; P95RoundMs = Percentile $items.durationMs .95
        MaxRoundMs = ($items.durationMs | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
        MaxReturnGapMs = ($gaps | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
        FirstStart = $items[0].start; LastEnd = $items[-1].end
    }
}
if (@($deviceStats | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Index -Unique).Count -ne $summary.targetCount) { throw 'Target count mismatch' }
if (@($returns | Group-Object nonce).Count -ne $summary.targetCount) { throw 'Different devices shared a nonce' }
if (@($http | Where-Object { $_.proxy -ne $spec.proxyPort }).Count) { throw 'HTTP proxy port does not match specification' }
$processStats = foreach ($pidGroup in @($resources.processes | Group-Object pid)) {
    $items = @($pidGroup.Group)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Pid = [int]$pidGroup.Name; Name = $items[0].processName
        FirstWorkingSetMiB = $items[0].workingSet64 / 1MB; LastWorkingSetMiB = $items[-1].workingSet64 / 1MB
        PeakWorkingSetMiB = ($items.workingSet64 | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum / 1MB
        FirstPrivateMiB = $items[0].privateMemorySize64 / 1MB; LastPrivateMiB = $items[-1].privateMemorySize64 / 1MB
        PeakPrivateMiB = ($items.privateMemorySize64 | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum / 1MB
        FirstHandles = $items[0].handleCount; LastHandles = $items[-1].handleCount
        PeakHandles = ($items.handleCount | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
        CpuTimeDeltaMs = $items[-1].cpuTimeMs - $items[0].cpuTimeMs
    }
}
[pscustomobject]@{
    Summary = $summary; SpecSha256 = $manifest.specSha256; VerifiedCaseHashes = $cases.Count; RoundReturnPairs = $returns.Count
    DeviceStats = @($deviceStats); HttpCount = $http.Count
    HttpStatuses = @($http | Group-Object status | Select-Object Name,Count)
    HttpProxyPorts = @($http.proxy | Select-Object -Unique)
    HttpMedianMs = Percentile $http.durationMs .5; HttpP95Ms = Percentile $http.durationMs .95
    PressureResourceSamples = $resources.Count
    CpuMedianPercent = Percentile $resources.cpuPercent .5; CpuP95Percent = Percentile $resources.cpuPercent .95
    CpuMaxPercent = ($resources.cpuPercent | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
    MinAvailableGiB = ($resources.availablePhysical | Measure-Object -Minimum).Minimum / 1GB
    MaxCommitPercent = (@($resources | ForEach-Object { 100 * (1 - $_.availablePageFile / $_.totalPageFile) }) | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum
    ProcessStats = @($processStats)
    Limits = @('File-only validation; no live host or guest checks or current DLL hash verification', 'Direct HTTP journals are not HTTP Toolkit captures', 'Per-process working sets are not summed as deduplicated physical RAM', 'No GPU or long-term leak conclusion')
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10

```
